domains.name: rawmaterial
domains.description: Single source of truth for all raw material master data, chemical feedstocks, intermediates, and input substances used in chemical synthesis and production. Manages CAS number registry, SDS/MSDS records, supplier-material relationships, incoming material specifications, material hazard classifications under GHS and TSCA, and material qualification. Supports Raw Material Procurement and Sourcing processes within SAP MM and production planning with material availability and quality attributes.

products.name: material_master
products.description: Single source of truth for all raw material master records in the chemical manufacturing enterprise. Captures the full identity of each raw material, chemical feedstock, intermediate, or input substance including CAS number reference, IUPAC name, common trade name, molecular formula, molecular weight, physical state at STP, material class (feedstock, intermediate, solvent, catalyst, additive, excipient), SAP material number, material group, unit of measure, shelf life, storage temperature range, humidity requirements, light sensitivity, retest interval, material lifecycle status (new, active, phase-out, obsolete), material category classification, and incompatibility flags. Serves as the authoritative registry for all raw material identities referenced by procurement, production planning, formulation, quality, and EHS domains. Each material has exactly one material_master record regardless of how many suppliers provide it.

products.name: cas_registry
products.description: Authoritative CAS (Chemical Abstracts Service) number registry for all chemical substances managed within the enterprise. Each record links a unique CAS number to its canonical chemical identity including IUPAC name, synonyms, molecular formula, InChI key, SMILES notation, chemical family, substance type (pure substance, mixture, polymer, UVCB), regulatory status under TSCA, REACH, and other jurisdictions, and cross-references to internal material master records. products.name: sds_record
products.description: Safety Data Sheet (SDS/MSDS) master records for each raw material, maintained in compliance with GHS (Globally Harmonized System) and OSHA HazCom standards. Each record captures the 16-section GHS SDS structure including supplier identity, hazard identification, composition/ingredient information, first-aid measures, fire-fighting measures, accidental release measures, handling and storage, exposure controls/PPE, physical and chemical properties, stability and reactivity, toxicological information, ecological information, disposal considerations, transport information, regulatory information, and other information. Tracks SDS version number, effective date, expiry date, issuing supplier, language, and regulatory jurisdiction. Linked to material master and GHS classification records. Supports EHS compliance, worker safety training, and emergency response.
products.reference: GHS SDS / OSHA HazCom 2012 / REACH Article 31

products.name: rawmaterial_ghs_classification
products.description: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) and CLP (Classification, Labelling and Packaging) hazard classification records for each raw material substance. This product is the exclusive SSOT for GHS-framework hazard data: hazard class (flammable liquid, acute toxicity, skin corrosion, respiratory sensitizer, carcinogen, environmental hazard, etc.), hazard category (Category 1, 2, 3, etc.), signal word (Danger/Warning), hazard statements (H-codes), precautionary statements (P-codes), pictogram codes (GHS01-GHS09), classification basis (test data, read-across, expert judgment, calculation method for mixtures), classification date, regulatory jurisdiction (GHS Rev 9, EU CLP, OSHA HazCom 2012), and classification authority. Non-GHS hazard frameworks (NFPA, DOT, EPA, OSHA PEL) are owned by material_hazard_profile. Supports SDS Section 2 authoring, label generation, transport classification, and REACH/CLP compliance reporting.
products.reference: GHS Rev 9 / EU CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008

products.name: material_specification
products.description: Incoming raw material quality specifications defining the acceptance criteria for each material purchased and received. Each specification record captures the material, specification version, effective date, specification owner, and a full set of quality parameters including assay/purity limits (min/max), moisture content limits, heavy metals limits (PPM), pH range, color (APHA/Gardner), viscosity range, density range, particle size distribution, residual solvent limits, microbiological limits, and any material-specific analytical parameters. products.name: incoming_inspection
products.description: Records of incoming quality inspection events performed on received raw material lots at the plant gate, warehouse, or tank farm. Each inspection record captures the inspection lot number (SAP QM), material, supplier, purchase order reference, delivery note number, received quantity, sample plan and sample size, inspection date, inspection type (identity test, full COA review, skip lot, reduced, tightened per ANSI/ASQ Z1.4), individual test results against specification parameters (assay, pH, moisture, appearance, color, viscosity, density, particle size, etc.), overall inspection decision (accept, reject, hold, conditional release), disposition instructions, inspector ID, inspection completion timestamp, and any OOS (Out of Specification) or OOT (Out of Trend) findings. attributes.name: voc_content_percent

products.name: material_composition
products.description: Detailed chemical composition records for raw materials that are mixtures, blends, or multi-component substances. Each record captures the parent material, component substance (CAS number, IUPAC name), component concentration (nominal, minimum, maximum), concentration unit (% w/w, % v/v, PPM), component function (active ingredient, solvent, stabilizer, impurity, contaminant), confidential business information (CBI) flag for trade secret components, and the composition version and effective date. Supports SDS Section 3 (Composition/Information on Ingredients), REACH mixture classification, formulation compatibility assessment, and regulatory disclosure obligations.
products.reference: GHS SDS Section 3 / REACH Mixture Regulation

attributes.name: component_cas_number

attributes.name: component_iupac_name

attributes.name: component_percentage_of_total

attributes.name: composition_code

attributes.name: composition_description

attributes.name: composition_type

attributes.name: concentration_max

attributes.description: Standard GHS precautionary statement for safe handling.

attributes.name: version_number

products.name: material_regulatory_status
products.description: Consolidated cross-jurisdictional regulatory compliance summary for each raw material, providing a single-pane view of a material's global regulatory standing across ALL applicable frameworks (REACH, TSCA, CLP, OSHA, EPA TRI, DOT, China IECSC, Japan CSCL, Korea K-REACH, and others). Each record captures substance identity, regulatory framework, jurisdiction, registration/listing status, compliance status (compliant, non-compliant, pending, exempt), restriction applicability, compliance deadlines, and responsible regulatory affairs manager. This product is the SSOT for the consolidated regulatory compliance decision ('can we use this material in jurisdiction X?') — it aggregates status from jurisdiction-specific detail products (reach_registration for EU REACH dossier data, tsca_inventory for US EPA TSCA data) but adds coverage for jurisdictions without dedicated detail products and provides the single authoritative compliance summary used by procurement, import/export, and market access teams.
products.reference: REACH / TSCA / GHS / EPA / FDA Regulatory Frameworks

products.name: distribution_agreement
products.description: Represents the contractual relationship between a raw material (material_master) and a distributor. Each record captures the specific terms under which a distributor is authorized to sell a material, including price, MOQ, and regulatory compliance flags.. Existence Justification: In the chemical manufacturing business, each raw material can be sold by multiple authorized distributors, and each distributor can sell multiple raw materials. The relationship is managed through a distribution agreement that captures price, minimum order quantity, and compliance requirements, and is created, updated, and deleted by business users.

products.name: rawmaterial_lot_allocation
products.description: Represents the allocation of a specific raw material lot to a particular invoice line. Each record captures the quantity of the lot used, the unit price applied, the lot identifier, and the lot expiry date, enabling full traceability from procurement through billing.. Existence Justification: A raw material lot can be split across multiple customer invoice lines, and a single invoice line can be fulfilled using material from multiple lots. The allocation of specific lot quantities, unit prices, and expiry dates is actively recorded to satisfy traceability and regulatory requirements.

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all customer identity, profiles, accounts, and relationships across B2B industrial customers, distributors, and end-user segments. Manages customer master data, contact information, credit terms, shipping preferences, technical service requirements, customer segmentation, corporate accounts, site locations, and customer hierarchies. Integrates with Salesforce CRM as system of record.

products.name: account
products.description: Core B2B customer account master record representing industrial customers, distributors, and end-user organizations. Stores the authoritative identity of each customer entity including legal business name, DUNS number, tax ID, SIC/NAICS industry classification, account tier, account status, primary business type (direct industrial, distributor, toll processor, OEM), annual revenue band, employee count, parent account reference for corporate hierarchy, Salesforce CRM account ID, SAP customer number, credit rating, account manager assignment, onboarding date, and shipping/delivery preferences at the account level. This is the SSOT for all customer identity in the chemical-manufacturing enterprise.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Account / SAP SD Customer Master

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer account record in the chemical manufacturing enterprise data platform (Silver Layer). Primary key for all downstream joins.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) payments require linking a customer account to its bank account record for payment processing.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Needed for the 'Primary Product' field used in account forecasting and pricing reports to identify the main chemical a key account purchases.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost Allocation Report requires each customer account to be assigned a cost center for internal expense tracking and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal sales or account manager employee assigned as the primary relationship owner for this customer account. Used for territory management, performance reporting, and CRM workflow routing.

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent account record for corporate hierarchy management. Enables roll-up of subsidiary accounts to ultimate parent for consolidated reporting, credit exposure, and enterprise-level relationship management.

attributes.name: preferred_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: Preferred carrier selection for each account is used in carrier performance and rate negotiation reports; linking enables direct lookup of the carrier entity.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Preferred Vendor Management per account; procurement strategy reports require linking each account to its designated vendor.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability dashboards map revenue per customer to profit centers, so each account needs a profit_center_id FK.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Required for R&D Sponsorship Tracking report linking each project to the sponsoring customer account, enabling revenue attribution and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: revenue_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue Recognition process uses a default GL account per customer; linking account to gl_account enables automated posting.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Linking account to its segment normalizes segment data and eliminates the redundant segment code stored on account.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Territory‑assignment report requires each Account to be linked to its Sales Territory for quota and coverage planning.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer account. Active: transacting customer. Inactive: no recent transactions. Prospect: under evaluation. Suspended: temporarily halted due to credit or compliance issues. Blocked: SAP-level block applied (e.g., credit block, delivery block). Closed: account permanently deactivated.

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Commercial segmentation tier assigned to the account based on revenue contribution, strategic importance, and growth potential. Strategic: top-tier key accounts with dedicated resources. Preferred: high-value accounts with preferred pricing. Standard: regular commercial accounts. Transactional: low-frequency or spot-buy customers.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classifies the primary business relationship type of the customer account. Direct Industrial: buys chemicals for own manufacturing use. Distributor: resells to downstream customers. Toll Processor: processes materials on behalf of Chemical Mfg or third parties. OEM: original equipment manufacturer integrating chemical products. End User: final consumer of the product. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_industrial|distributor|toll_processor|oem|end_user — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: annual_revenue_band
attributes.description: Banded range of the customer organization's annual revenue used for segmentation and strategic account planning (e.g., '<$10M', '$10M-$100M', '$100M-$1B', '>$1B'). Sourced from Dun & Bradstreet or CRM qualification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: <$10M|$10M-$100M|$100M-$1B|>$1B — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the customer's billing location. Used for invoice generation, tax jurisdiction determination, and financial reporting under FASB and SOX.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the customer's billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction assignment, invoice compliance, and geographic sales reporting.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the customer's billing address. Used for international tax compliance, REACH/ECHA regulatory applicability, export control (TSCA), and currency determination.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the customer's billing address. Used for tax rate lookup, geographic segmentation, and logistics zone assignment.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the customer's billing address. Used for sales tax determination, regulatory jurisdiction mapping (EPA, OSHA state programs), and regional sales analytics.

attributes.name: blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account has an active block in SAP S/4HANA preventing order processing, delivery, or invoicing. Blocks may be applied for credit risk, compliance violations, or sanctions screening failures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; OFAC Sanctions; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the customer account record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure in the account's billing currency authorized for this customer account. Managed in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO credit management. Drives order release decisions and credit block triggers.

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency credit exposure management.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal or external credit risk rating assigned to the customer account (e.g., A, B, C, D or numeric score). Derived from Dun & Bradstreet data or internal credit assessment. Drives credit limit setting and payment term eligibility.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to uniquely identify the customer business entity globally. Used for credit risk assessment, corporate hierarchy linkage, and supplier/customer due diligence.

attributes.name: employee_count_band
attributes.description: Banded range of the customer organization's total employee headcount used for account sizing and segmentation (e.g., '1-50', '51-500', '501-5000', '>5000'). Sourced from Dun & Bradstreet or CRM qualification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1-50|51-500|501-5000|>5000 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code governing delivery responsibility and risk transfer for shipments to this customer. Used in SAP S/4HANA SD order processing and Oracle Transportation Management for freight planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent confirmed sales order placed by this customer account. Used for customer activity monitoring, churn risk identification, and account health scoring.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full registered legal name of the customer organization as it appears on official business registration documents, contracts, and invoices. Used for regulatory reporting, SOX compliance, and legal correspondence.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: The six-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code identifying the customer's industry sector. Used for market analysis, customer segmentation, and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer account was formally onboarded and activated in the enterprise systems (SAP S/4HANA and Salesforce CRM). Used for customer tenure analysis, cohort reporting, and relationship lifecycle management.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, NT60, 2/10NT30) defining the agreed payment due date and any early payment discount conditions for this customer. Drives accounts receivable aging and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: reach_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliance Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer requires REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) compliance documentation for supplied substances. Applicable for EU-based customers or those exporting to EU markets. Drives regulatory document management.

attributes.name: requires_coa_on_delivery
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Certificate of Analysis (COA) on Delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Analysis (COA) to accompany each product lot shipment. COA documents quality test results against specification. Driven by customer quality agreements and GMP requirements.

attributes.name: requires_sds_on_delivery
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires Safety Data Sheet (SDS) on Delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) to accompany every chemical shipment delivery. Mandatory for GHS-compliant chemical distribution. Drives document generation in SAP S/4HANA SD and EHS workflows.

attributes.name: salesforce_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Account ID
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by Salesforce CRM for this account. Used to reconcile and synchronize customer master data between the lakehouse and the CRM system of record.

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: The customer master number assigned in SAP S/4HANA SD (Sales and Distribution) module. Used for order-to-cash processing, credit management, and financial postings in the ERP system.

attributes.name: shipping_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the customer's primary shipping destination. Used for export compliance, DOT hazardous materials transport classification, REACH applicability, and logistics routing.

attributes.name: shipping_mode
attributes.description: The customer's preferred mode of transportation for product delivery. LTL (Less Than Truckload) and FTL (Full Truckload) are common for bulk chemical shipments. Drives logistics planning and DOT hazmat transport compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ltl|ftl|parcel|rail|ocean|air|intermodal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management; DOT; SAP EWM

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: The four-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code that categorizes the customer's primary business activity. Used for market segmentation, regulatory reporting, and industry analytics.

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: The government-issued tax identification number (EIN, VAT number, or equivalent) for the customer entity. Required for tax reporting, invoice compliance, and regulatory filings under FASB and SOX.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: The operating or 'doing business as' (DBA) trade name of the customer, which may differ from the legal entity name. Used in commercial communications and sales reporting.

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer requires TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act) compliance certification for chemical products supplied. Applicable for US-based industrial customers subject to EPA chemical substance regulations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the customer account record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Used for change data capture, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

products.name: contact
products.description: Individual contact persons associated with a customer account, including procurement managers, plant engineers, quality managers, EHS coordinators, and technical buyers. Captures full name, job title, department, direct phone, mobile, email, preferred communication channel, contact role (technical, commercial, EHS, logistics), LinkedIn profile, language preference, do-not-contact flag, and Salesforce CRM contact ID. Supports technical sales and customer service workflows.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the contact person record in the customer domain silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customer account this contact is associated with. Links the contact to the B2B industrial customer, distributor, or end-user account.

attributes.name: account_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer site or plant location this contact is associated with. A customer account may have multiple plant sites; this links the contact to their operational location for logistics and technical service routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account Site

attributes.name: sponsor_rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Needed for Sponsor Contact Management process to associate external customer contacts with the R&D projects they fund, supporting contract compliance and communication.

attributes.name: coa_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred delivery method for Certificate of Analysis (COA) and Certificate of Compliance (COC) documents for this contact. Drives automated document distribution workflows in the quality management process.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: Functional role classification of the contact in relation to Chemical Mfg business interactions. Drives workflow routing for technical sales, EHS (Environment Health and Safety) compliance, logistics coordination, and quality inquiries. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: technical|commercial|ehs|logistics|quality|procurement|finance|executive — promote to reference product if additional roles are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. 'active' indicates the contact is reachable and engaged; 'inactive' indicates the contact is no longer in the role; 'do_not_contact' enforces communication suppression; 'pending_verification' indicates the record awaits validation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact by their relationship to Chemical Mfg. 'internal' denotes Chemical Mfg employees; 'external' denotes customer personnel; 'distributor' denotes channel partner contacts; 'end_user' denotes final consumer contacts; 'consultant' denotes third-party advisors.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was first created in the silver layer data product. Supports audit trail requirements, GDPR data retention tracking, and data lineage for the customer domain.

attributes.name: crm_contact_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this contact record in Salesforce CRM, the system of record for customer contact management. Used for bi-directional synchronization between the lakehouse and Salesforce.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the contact's purchase order authority limit (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures correct monetary interpretation across multi-currency customer accounts.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional area the contact belongs to within the customer organization (e.g., Procurement, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Environment Health and Safety, Logistics, R&D). Supports targeted communication routing.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has opted out of or been suppressed from all outbound communications. When True, no marketing, sales, or non-essential operational communications should be sent. Enforces GDPR and CCPA consent management requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 and Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: do_not_contact_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the do_not_contact_flag is set to True. Supports regulatory audit trails for GDPR right-to-erasure and CCPA opt-out compliance. Null when do_not_contact_flag is False.

attributes.name: ehs_contact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Contact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated EHS (Environment Health and Safety) coordinator or responsible person at the customer site. EHS contacts receive hazardous material notifications, incident reports, and regulatory compliance updates.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); EPA (Environmental Protection Agency); Intelex EHS Management; ISO 45001

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the contact. Used for order confirmations, technical documentation delivery, Safety Data Sheet (SDS) distribution, Certificate of Analysis (COA) transmission, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: email_secondary
attributes.description: Alternate or secondary email address for the contact. Used as a fallback communication channel when the primary email is undeliverable, or for routing specific document types (e.g., invoices to a separate accounts payable email).

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the contact person. Used in personalized communications, technical sales outreach, and customer service workflows.

attributes.name: is_decision_maker
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact holds purchasing or approval authority within their organization. Used by technical sales teams to prioritize engagement and qualify opportunities in the chemical sales cycle.

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated primary contact for the associated customer account. Only one contact per customer account should be flagged as primary. Used to determine the default recipient for account-level communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the contact within their organization (e.g., Procurement Manager, Plant Engineer, Quality Manager, EHS Coordinator, Technical Buyer). Used for routing communications and identifying decision-makers.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for communications with this contact, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'fr', 'zh-CN'). Ensures SDS, COA, and regulatory documents are delivered in the correct language per REACH and GHS requirements.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; GHS (Globally Harmonized System); REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: last_interaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recorded business interaction with this contact (e.g., sales call, technical inquiry, order placement, site visit). Used to measure contact engagement recency and identify dormant contacts for re-engagement campaigns.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the contact person. Combined with first_name to form the full display name for business correspondence and CRM records.

attributes.name: linkedin_profile_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn public profile URL for the contact. Used by technical sales and account management teams for relationship intelligence, pre-call research, and identifying decision-maker networks within B2B industrial customer organizations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the contact person. Used for disambiguation when multiple contacts share the same first and last name within a customer organization.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: phone_direct
attributes.description: Direct office or desk phone number for the contact in E.164 international format. Used for urgent technical support, order management, and regulatory compliance communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: phone_fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the contact in E.164 international format. Relevant for regulatory document transmission (e.g., SDS, COA, purchase orders) in industries and regions where fax remains a compliance-accepted channel.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: phone_mobile
attributes.description: Mobile or cell phone number for the contact in E.164 international format. Used for SMS notifications, emergency EHS (Environment Health and Safety) alerts, and field-level technical support.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred channel for receiving business communications from Chemical Mfg. Drives outbound communication routing in Salesforce CRM and customer service workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: purchase_order_authority_limit
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value in the customer's base currency that this contact is authorized to approve on a Purchase Order (PO). Used by the technical sales team to identify the appropriate contact for order approvals and to escalate large orders to higher-authority contacts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact should receive regulatory compliance notifications, including TSCA updates, REACH substance restriction alerts, EPA reporting deadlines, and product reformulation notices. Supports proactive regulatory communication workflows.
attributes.references: TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act); REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; EPA Regulations; ECHA

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact's association with the customer account was terminated (e.g., due to role change, departure, or account closure). Null for currently active contacts. Used for historical record retention and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (storage limitation); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact was first established as an active contact for the customer account. Used to calculate relationship tenure and for historical analysis of contact network evolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal salutation or honorific prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr., Prof.). Used in formal business correspondence, regulatory submissions, and technical documentation.

attributes.name: sds_distribution_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has consented to receive Safety Data Sheet (SDS) and Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) documents electronically. Required for OSHA HazCom 2012 and GHS compliance in chemical product distribution.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200); GHS (Globally Harmonized System); REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system from which this contact record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and master data management reconciliation between Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; ISO/IEC 11179

attributes.name: technical_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is designated to receive technical service support, including application engineering assistance, formulation guidance, process troubleshooting, and Certificate of Analysis (COA) requests.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this contact record in the silver layer. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.

products.name: site
products.description: Physical customer site or plant location where chemical products are delivered, consumed, or processed. Captures site name, site type (manufacturing plant, distribution center, R&D lab, warehouse), street address, city, state, country, GPS coordinates, UN/LOCODE, site capacity, operating hours, dock restrictions, hazmat receiving capability, tank farm availability, bulk vs. packaged receipt capability, preferred carrier, shipping mode (LTL, FTL, bulk tanker, rail), packaging preference, delivery window constraints, unloading equipment availability, temperature-controlled requirements, site EHS contact, and site-level regulatory permits. Distinct from the account (corporate entity) — one account may have many sites.
products.reference: SAP SD Ship-To Party / Salesforce CRM Location

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer site or plant location record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the site entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master (Ship-To Party / Delivery Address)

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent corporate account (customer master) that owns this site. One account may have many sites. Supports customer hierarchy navigation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM - Account Object

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Site‑level operating cost allocation reports need each site tied to a cost center for accurate expense tracking.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Site Manager assignment needed for daily operations, safety compliance, and site performance reporting.

attributes.name: parent_site_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier for the parent site in a site hierarchy (e.g., a campus or complex with multiple sub-sites). Enables multi-level site hierarchy modeling for large industrial customers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM - Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Site‑level preferred supplier for deliveries; logistics planning uses this link to route shipments.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse_location. Business justification: Required for Delivery Planning Report that maps each customer site to the warehouse location used for shipments, enabling logistics scheduling and compliance with delivery windows.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the customer site. Used for shipment routing, hazardous materials transport documentation (DOT), and regulatory permit filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Address; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail for the customer site (suite, building, dock number, gate reference). Supplements address_line1 for precise delivery routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Address; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: bulk_receipt_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site has infrastructure (tank farm, unloading arms, pumps) to receive bulk liquid or solid chemical shipments via tanker truck or rail car.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Storage Type Configuration; Oracle Transportation Management - Facility Capability

attributes.name: capacity_mt
attributes.description: Maximum chemical storage capacity of the site expressed in metric tons. Used for supply planning, inventory replenishment modeling, and tank farm utilization analytics.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Storage Capacity Management; EPA SPCC Plan

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the customer site is located. Used for freight zone determination, tax jurisdiction, and regulatory reporting (EPA TRI, OSHA PSM).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Address; EPA Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) Reporting

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer site requires a Certificate of Analysis (COA) with each chemical product shipment. Supports quality assurance, incoming inspection, and GMP compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GMP Guidelines; LabWare LIMS - COA Generation

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the customer site location (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). Drives export compliance, REACH/TSCA applicability, and international freight documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ECHA REACH Regulation; TSCA; DOT International Hazmat

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the site record was first created in the system (ISO 8601 format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR data retention compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Data Retention; GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation)

attributes.name: delivery_window_end
attributes.description: Latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour) at which the site accepts chemical deliveries. Used for carrier scheduling, route optimization, and on-time delivery KPI measurement.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management - Delivery Window Constraints; SAP EWM

attributes.name: delivery_window_start
attributes.description: Earliest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour) at which the site accepts chemical deliveries. Used for carrier scheduling, route optimization, and on-time delivery KPI measurement.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management - Delivery Window Constraints; SAP EWM

attributes.name: dock_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text description of physical dock constraints at the site (e.g., maximum trailer length, dock height limitations, no live unload, appointment required). Used by Oracle TMS and carrier dispatch.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management - Facility Notes; SAP EWM - Dock Management

attributes.name: ehs_contact_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Contact Name
attributes.description: Name of the designated EHS contact at the customer site. Required for hazardous chemical deliveries, SDS acknowledgment, emergency response coordination, and OSHA PSM compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM; EPA RMP; GHS; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: ehs_contact_phone
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Contact Phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the site EHS contact. Used for emergency chemical incident response, hazmat delivery coordination, and regulatory inspection notifications.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM; EPA Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act (EPCRA); Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the customer site. Used for transmission of SDS, COA, COC, and regulatory documentation where electronic fax is the required delivery channel.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Communication; GHS SDS Distribution Requirements

attributes.name: hazmat_receiving_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site is certified and equipped to receive hazardous chemical materials per DOT and OSHA regulations. Governs which chemical products can be shipped to this site.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; GHS

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: ICC Incoterms code defining the delivery responsibility and risk transfer point for chemical shipments to this site (e.g., DAP, DDP, FOB). Drives freight cost allocation and SAP SD billing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD - Incoterms; DOT Hazmat Shipping Terms

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the customer site in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used for route optimization in Oracle Transportation Management, emergency response planning, and geospatial analytics.
attributes.references: WGS 84 Coordinate System; Oracle Transportation Management - Geocoding

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the customer site in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used for route optimization, emergency response planning, and geospatial analytics.
attributes.references: WGS 84 Coordinate System; Oracle Transportation Management - Geocoding

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Textual description of the site's standard operating hours for receiving deliveries (e.g., 'Mon-Fri 06:00-18:00 CST'). Used by Oracle TMS and SAP EWM for delivery window scheduling.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management - Delivery Window; SAP EWM - Receiving Schedule

attributes.name: packaging_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred packaging format for chemical product receipt at this site (e.g., bulk tanker, 55-gallon drum, IBC tote, bag). Drives order fulfillment, SKU selection, and GHS labeling requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Delivery Item Category; GHS Packaging and Labelling; DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the site's primary regulatory operating or environmental permit. Triggers renewal alerts and may restrict chemical deliveries if permit lapses.
attributes.references: EPA Permit Compliance System; OSHA PSM; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the customer site. Used for delivery coordination, emergency contact, and carrier communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Communication; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the customer site. Used for freight rate calculation, carrier zone assignment, and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Address; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: preferred_carrier
attributes.description: Name or code of the customer's preferred freight carrier for deliveries to this site. Used in Oracle TMS carrier selection and rate negotiation.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management - Carrier Preference; SAP S/4HANA SD - Shipping Conditions

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: ECHA REACH registration number applicable to the customer site for EU-based locations. Required for chemical supply compliance under REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; European Chemicals Agency

attributes.name: regulatory_permit_number
attributes.description: Primary environmental or operating permit number issued to the customer site by a regulatory authority (EPA, state agency, OSHA). Required for hazardous chemical delivery authorization and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act; EPA RCRA; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: salesforce_site_code
attributes.description: External system identifier for this site record in Salesforce CRM (system of record). Used for data lineage, cross-system reconciliation, and integration with Salesforce-driven sales and service workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account/Site Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Integration

attributes.name: sds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site requires a GHS-compliant Safety Data Sheet (SDS) to accompany every chemical shipment. Mandatory for hazardous chemical deliveries under OSHA HazCom and GHS standards.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom Standard; GHS; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: shipping_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for chemical product deliveries to this site. Drives freight planning, DOT hazmat packaging requirements, and carrier assignment. LTL = Less Than Truckload, FTL = Full Truckload.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management - Mode of Transport; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; SAP S/4HANA SD - Shipping Conditions

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the site, sourced from SAP S/4HANA customer master or Salesforce CRM. Used in order management, shipping documents, and COA/COC references.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Ship-To Party Number; Salesforce CRM - Account Site Code

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the customer site or plant location (e.g., 'Baytown Refinery', 'Chicago Distribution Center'). Used on shipping labels, SDS delivery documentation, and customer communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Name; Salesforce CRM - Account Site Name

attributes.name: site_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer site record. Controls whether orders, deliveries, and EHS documentation can be processed against this site.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Account Group Status; Salesforce CRM - Account Status

attributes.name: site_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical site by its primary operational function. Drives logistics planning, hazmat receiving rules, and EHS compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturing_plant|distribution_center|rd_lab|warehouse|terminal|blending_facility|storage_depot|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Classification; Oracle Transportation Management - Location Type

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the customer site. Used for tax jurisdiction, DOT hazmat routing restrictions, and state-level environmental permit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master Address; DOT 49 CFR; EPA State Reporting

attributes.name: tank_farm_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer site has a dedicated tank farm for bulk liquid chemical storage. Determines eligibility for bulk tanker delivery and long-term supply agreements.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Storage Infrastructure; EPA SPCC (Spill Prevention Control and Countermeasure) Plan

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site requires temperature-controlled storage or delivery conditions for chemical products (e.g., cryogenic, refrigerated, or heated materials).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Conditions; Oracle Transportation Management - Special Requirements

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the customer site (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'Europe/Berlin'). Used for delivery window scheduling, order cutoff time calculation, and global reporting normalization.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Oracle Transportation Management - Scheduling

attributes.name: un_locode
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character location code identifying the customer site's port, city, or logistics node. Used in international shipping documentation, ASN processing, and TMS routing.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations); Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: unloading_equipment
attributes.description: Description of unloading equipment available at the site (e.g., forklift, pump, conveyor, crane, vacuum system). Ensures carrier and driver preparedness for chemical product offloading.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Resource Management; Oracle Transportation Management - Facility Capability

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the site record (ISO 8601 format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture, audit trail, and master data governance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Data Governance; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

products.name: account_hierarchy
products.description: Corporate hierarchy relationships between customer accounts, capturing parent-child relationships for multinational chemical buyers, conglomerates, and distributor networks. Stores parent account, child account, hierarchy level (global ultimate, domestic ultimate, subsidiary, division, plant), effective date, end date, hierarchy type (ownership, commercial, billing), and consolidation flag. Enables enterprise-level revenue rollup, credit exposure aggregation, and global account management for large industrial customers.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy / D&B Corporate Linkage

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each account hierarchy relationship record in the customer domain. Primary key for the account_hierarchy data product.

attributes.name: child_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child account in the hierarchy relationship. References the subordinate node (e.g., subsidiary, division, or plant-level account) beneath the parent account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Node; Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent account in the hierarchy relationship. References the superior node (e.g., global ultimate, domestic ultimate, or intermediate holding entity) above the child account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Node; Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: account_segment
attributes.description: Commercial segmentation tier of the child account within the enterprise account management framework. 'strategic' = top-tier global accounts; 'key' = significant regional accounts; 'growth' = high-potential developing accounts; 'standard' = transactional accounts; 'distributor' = channel distribution partners. Used for resource allocation and service level differentiation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Segmentation; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the business approver who authorized this hierarchy relationship record (e.g., global account manager, credit manager, or master data governance owner). Required for SOX-compliant master data change management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Approval

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship record was formally approved by the designated business approver. Supports SOX-compliant audit trail for master data governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code explaining why this hierarchy relationship was created or last modified. 'acquisition' = parent acquired child; 'divestiture' = child was divested; 'restructuring' = internal reorganization; 'correction' = data correction; 'initial_setup' = first-time configuration; 'merger' = entities merged. Supports audit trail and MOC (Management of Change) compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; SOX Audit Trail; ACC Responsible Care MOC

attributes.name: consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy relationship is used for financial consolidation purposes (e.g., rolling up revenue, credit exposure, or receivables to the parent account). True = included in financial consolidation rollup; False = excluded (e.g., commercial grouping only).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Consolidation; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country of domicile or registration of the child account in this hierarchy relationship. Used for REACH compliance jurisdiction determination, export control, and geographic revenue reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ECHA REACH Regulation; EPA; DOT Hazardous Materials

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account hierarchy relationship record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX-compliant master data governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 9001 Record Control; FASB

attributes.name: credit_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's credit exposure is aggregated to the parent account for enterprise-level credit limit management. True = child credit exposure rolls up to parent; False = child is assessed independently. Critical for managing credit risk across multinational chemical buyers and conglomerates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Credit Management; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Control

attributes.name: customer_group_code
attributes.description: SAP customer group classification code assigned to the child account, used for pricing, reporting, and statistical analysis. Examples include industrial buyer, distributor, OEM, or end-user segments in the chemical manufacturing context.

attributes.name: domestic_ultimate_duns
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet D-U-N-S number of the domestic ultimate parent entity (highest-level entity within the same country). Used for country-level credit aggregation and domestic account consolidation.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet Corporate Linkage; SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (D-U-N-S) nine-digit identifier for the child account. Used for corporate linkage verification, credit risk assessment, and third-party data enrichment. Enables matching to D&B global corporate hierarchy for multinational chemical buyers.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet Corporate Linkage; SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this parent-child hierarchy relationship becomes or became effective. Used for time-based revenue rollup, credit exposure aggregation, and historical hierarchy analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Validity; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this parent-child hierarchy relationship ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active relationship. Used for historical hierarchy reconstruction and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Validity; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: global_ultimate_duns
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet D-U-N-S number of the global ultimate parent entity in the corporate ownership chain. Used to link the hierarchy record to the top-level worldwide parent for enterprise credit exposure and global account management.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet Corporate Linkage; SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this hierarchy relationship, as assigned in SAP S/4HANA SD customer hierarchy configuration or Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: hierarchy_depth
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the child account node within the full hierarchy tree, where 1 represents a direct child of the root (global ultimate). Enables efficient tree traversal queries and level-based revenue rollup in enterprise account analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Designates the structural tier of the child account within the corporate hierarchy. 'global_ultimate' is the top-level worldwide parent; 'domestic_ultimate' is the highest-level entity within a country; 'subsidiary' is a legally distinct owned entity; 'division' is an internal business unit; 'plant' or 'site' is a specific manufacturing or distribution location. Aligns with Dun & Bradstreet corporate linkage levels used in B2B credit and sales analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: global_ultimate|domestic_ultimate|subsidiary|division|plant|site — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Level; Dun & Bradstreet Corporate Linkage; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain from the root account to the child account (e.g., '/10001/10045/10089'). Enables fast subtree queries and hierarchy visualization without recursive joins. Populated by the ETL/data pipeline from SAP or Salesforce hierarchy data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hierarchy relationship record. 'active' indicates the relationship is currently in effect; 'inactive' indicates it has been suspended; 'pending' indicates it is awaiting approval or activation; 'terminated' indicates the relationship has been formally ended.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the parent-child relationship. 'ownership' reflects legal corporate ownership structure; 'commercial' reflects sales and account management grouping; 'billing' reflects consolidated invoicing structure; 'reporting' reflects management reporting rollup; 'logistics' reflects shipping and delivery consolidation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ownership|commercial|billing|reporting|logistics — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Type; Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_version
attributes.description: Incrementing version number for this hierarchy relationship record, supporting optimistic concurrency control and change history tracking. Incremented each time the hierarchy relationship is modified (e.g., reclassification, ownership change).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: industry_sector_code
attributes.description: Industry classification code for the child account's primary business sector (e.g., automotive, construction, electronics, consumer goods, agriculture). Aligns with SAP industry sector configuration and NAICS/SIC codes. Used for market segment analytics and product portfolio alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Industry Sector; NAICS; SIC

attributes.name: legal_entity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account in this hierarchy relationship represents a distinct legal entity (e.g., incorporated subsidiary) as opposed to an internal division or operational site. Relevant for REACH registration, TSCA compliance, and financial consolidation under FASB ASC 810.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; ECHA REACH Regulation; TSCA; SOX

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional business context about this hierarchy relationship, such as special commercial arrangements, pending ownership changes, or exceptions to standard rollup rules. Populated by global account managers or master data stewards.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Notes; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: pricing_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether volume-based pricing and rebate agreements negotiated at the parent account level apply to this child account. True = child account inherits parent pricing terms; False = child account has independent pricing. Relevant for chemical distributor networks and multinational industrial buyers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Pricing; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: primary_relationship_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the global account manager or key account owner responsible for managing the overall parent-child relationship. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account ownership. Used for global account management and escalation routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Owner; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Internal sales or operational region code assigned to the child account (e.g., AMER, EMEA, APAC, or sub-regional codes). Used for geographic revenue rollup, territory management, and regional account reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Sales Organization; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: relationship_role
attributes.description: Describes the role of the child account in the context of this specific hierarchy relationship. 'parent' indicates the account acts as a superior node; 'child' indicates a subordinate node; 'sibling' indicates a peer relationship under the same parent; 'co_parent' indicates shared ownership or joint venture structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: revenue_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's revenue is included in the parent account's enterprise revenue rollup for global account management, rebate calculation, and volume pricing agreements. True = revenue rolls up; False = revenue is tracked independently.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy Pricing; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: SAP Sales Organization code associated with the child account in this hierarchy relationship. Determines pricing procedures, order management rules, and revenue attribution within the SAP S/4HANA SD module.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this hierarchy relationship was sourced. 'SAP_SD' = SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution customer hierarchy; 'SALESFORCE_CRM' = Salesforce CRM account hierarchy; 'MANUAL' = manually entered by master data team; 'DUNS_ENRICHMENT' = derived from Dun & Bradstreet corporate linkage data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; Dun & Bradstreet

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: The natural key or record identifier for this hierarchy relationship in the originating source system (e.g., SAP customer hierarchy node ID or Salesforce Account relationship ID). Used for cross-system traceability and delta load reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this account hierarchy relationship record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data loads, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.

products.name: segment
products.description: Market segmentation classification for customer accounts used in commercial strategy, pricing, and technical service allocation. Captures segment code, segment name (e.g., Automotive OEM, Agrochemical Distributor, Specialty Coatings, Pharma Excipient, Electronics), segment tier, industry vertical (NAICS-based), strategic account flag, growth potential rating, wallet share estimate, segment owner, and applicable product portfolio. Drives targeted marketing, pricing tiers, and technical service prioritization.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Account Segment / Commercial Segmentation Model

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer segment record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the customer_segment data product.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the commercial or marketing leader who formally approved the creation or last revision of this customer segment definition. Supports governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 9001 - Document Control; Salesforce CRM - Approval Process

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer segment definition was formally approved by the designated authority. Used for governance tracking and audit compliance under SOX and ISO 9001 document control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 9001 - Document Control

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The internal business unit or division of Chemical Mfg responsible for serving this customer segment (e.g., Performance Materials, Agricultural Solutions, Specialty Chemicals, Industrial Chemicals). Maps to SAP FI/CO profit center and Salesforce CRM business unit hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Profit Center Accounting; Salesforce CRM - Business Unit

attributes.name: coa_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment require a Certificate of Analysis (COA) to accompany each shipment, confirming that the product meets specified quality parameters. True = COA mandatory per shipment; False = COA provided on request. Relevant for pharmaceutical excipient, food-grade, and high-purity electronic chemical segments.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems; GMP - Good Manufacturing Practice; FDA 21 CFR; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customer segment record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO/IEC 27001 - Audit Trail

attributes.name: credit_risk_category
attributes.description: Aggregate credit risk classification for the customer segment based on historical payment behavior, financial health of segment participants, and industry credit risk benchmarks. Informs credit limit setting and payment term defaults in SAP FI/CO. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Credit Management; FASB ASC 310 - Receivables

attributes.name: crm_segment_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this customer segment as maintained in Salesforce CRM, the system of record for customer segmentation. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the Silver Layer lakehouse and Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: default_payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms applied to customers in this segment as a default in SAP SD order processing (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Can be overridden at the individual customer account level.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Payment Terms; SAP FI/CO - Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 606 - Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this customer segment definition becomes effective and applicable for customer classification, pricing, and commercial operations. Supports temporal validity tracking for segment evolution and historical analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Validity Period; Salesforce CRM - Effective Date; ISO 8601

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this customer segment definition expires or is superseded. Null indicates an open-ended segment with no planned end date. Used for segment lifecycle management and transition planning when segment structures are revised.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Validity Period; Salesforce CRM - Effective Date; ISO 8601

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment require chemical products to be manufactured under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) conditions, as applicable to pharmaceutical excipient, API intermediate, and food-contact chemical segments. True = GMP manufacturing and documentation required; False = standard industrial quality.
attributes.references: GMP - Good Manufacturing Practice; FDA 21 CFR Parts 210/211; ISO 9001; EudraLex Volume 4

attributes.name: growth_potential_rating
attributes.description: Commercial assessment of the revenue growth potential for this customer segment over a 3-5 year horizon: high (significant expansion opportunity), medium (stable moderate growth), low (mature or declining market), emerging (nascent segment with high uncertainty but upside potential). Used in commercial strategy and capital allocation decisions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Opportunity Management; SAP FI/CO - Strategic Planning

attributes.name: hazmat_shipping_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products shipped to customers in this segment are classified as hazardous materials requiring DOT/IATA/IMDG compliant shipping documentation, placarding, and carrier certification. True = hazmat shipping protocols apply; False = non-hazardous standard shipping. Drives logistics configuration in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR - Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA DGR; IMDG Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Default Incoterms code applicable to commercial transactions with customers in this segment, defining the allocation of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller (e.g., DAP for delivered at place, FOB for free on board, DDP for delivered duty paid). Configured in SAP SD delivery terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 - ICC International Chamber of Commerce; SAP SD - Delivery Terms

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The primary end-market industry vertical served by this customer segment, expressed as a NAICS (North American Industry Classification System) sector name or code description (e.g., Automotive Parts Manufacturing, Agricultural Chemical Distribution, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Electronic Component Manufacturing). Aligns with NAICS 2022 classification.
attributes.references: NAICS 2022 - North American Industry Classification System; Salesforce CRM - Industry Field

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review of this customer segment definition, including assessment of segment criteria, customer assignments, and commercial strategy alignment. Supports periodic governance review cycles.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Management Review; Salesforce CRM - Account Planning

attributes.name: min_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) applicable to customers in this segment, expressed in the standard unit of measure for the segment's primary product portfolio (e.g., kg, MT, liters). Enforced in SAP SD order entry to ensure commercial viability of transactions.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Minimum Order Quantity; SAP MM - Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: min_order_quantity_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity field (e.g., kg = kilograms, MT = metric tonnes, L = liters, gal = gallons, drum = 200L drum, IBC = intermediate bulk container, bag = 25kg bag). Aligns with SAP MM unit of measure configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|MT|L|gal|drum|IBC|bag — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM - Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 - Quantities and Units

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code representing the primary industry classification of the customer segment. Used for regulatory reporting (EPA TRI, TSCA), market analysis, and alignment with industry benchmarks. Enables cross-segment analytics by industry sector.
attributes.references: NAICS 2022; EPA TRI Reporting; TSCA - Toxic Substances Control Act

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this customer segment definition. Ensures segment definitions remain current with market conditions, regulatory changes, and commercial strategy evolution.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Management Review; Salesforce CRM - Account Planning

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the commercial leader (e.g., Business Development Manager, Market Segment Manager) accountable for the segment strategy, performance targets, and customer relationships within this segment. Aligns with Salesforce CRM account ownership model.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Owner; SAP SD - Sales Representative

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Corporate email address of the segment owner for routing commercial inquiries, escalations, and reporting. Used in automated workflow notifications from Salesforce CRM and SAP SD.
