attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Owner; Internal HR Directory

attributes.name: preferred_packaging_type
attributes.description: Standard packaging format preferred by customers in this segment for chemical product delivery (e.g., 200L drums, 1000L IBC totes, bulk tanker, 25kg bags, 1kg laboratory bottles). Influences supply chain planning, warehouse operations in SAP EWM, and logistics configuration in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Packaging; Oracle Transportation Management; DOT 49 CFR - Hazardous Materials Transport

attributes.name: pricing_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the pricing tier applicable to customers in this segment, referencing the SAP SD pricing procedure and condition type configuration. Determines base price lists, discount structures, and rebate eligibility. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Pricing Procedure; SAP SD - Condition Type

attributes.name: primary_product_portfolio
attributes.description: Description of the primary chemical product lines, formulations, or product families applicable to this customer segment (e.g., Epoxy Resins, Polyurethane Intermediates, Crop Protection Actives, Electronic-Grade Solvents). Drives product recommendation logic and technical service scoping.
attributes.references: SAP MM - Material Master; SAP SD - Product Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM - Product Catalog

attributes.name: reach_registration_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are located in the European Economic Area and therefore require REACH registration documentation for all chemical substances supplied above 1 tonne per year. True = REACH compliance documentation required; False = not applicable. Drives regulatory documentation workflows.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA - European Chemicals Agency

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_profile
attributes.description: Description of the primary regulatory frameworks applicable to customers in this segment that Chemical Mfg must support (e.g., REACH compliance documentation for EU customers, TSCA Section 6 for US industrial customers, GHS SDS requirements, FDA food-contact compliance for food-grade chemical customers). Drives documentation and compliance reporting obligations.
attributes.references: REACH - Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals; TSCA - Toxic Substances Control Act; GHS - Globally Harmonized System; FDA; EPA

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region primarily associated with this customer segment (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC, Latin America). Used for territory planning, quota allocation, and regional commercial reporting in SAP SD and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales Organization; Salesforce CRM - Territory Management

attributes.name: sap_customer_group
attributes.description: SAP SD customer group code (field KDGRP) associated with this segment, used for pricing condition determination, rebate processing, and sales statistics grouping in SAP S/4HANA. Enables direct mapping between the segment definition and SAP SD commercial configuration.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Customer Group (KDGRP); SAP S/4HANA SD Configuration

attributes.name: sds_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment require Safety Data Sheet (SDS) documentation to be provided with all chemical shipments as a standard commercial requirement. True = SDS mandatory for all orders; False = SDS provided on request only. Aligns with GHS and OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HCS) requirements.
attributes.references: GHS - Globally Harmonized System; OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the customer segment (e.g., AUTO_OEM, AGRO_DIST, SPEC_COAT, PHARMA_EXC, ELEC_MFG). Used as the business key in Salesforce CRM and SAP SD customer classification. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Segmentation; SAP SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the customer segment, including the types of customers included, their primary use cases for chemical products, and the commercial rationale for the segment definition.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the customer segment (e.g., Automotive OEM, Agrochemical Distributor, Specialty Coatings, Pharma Excipient, Electronics). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used in commercial strategy, pricing tiers, and technical service allocation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Segmentation; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer segment definition: active (in use for commercial operations), inactive (no longer applied to new customers), under_review (being evaluated for revision), deprecated (replaced by a newer segment structure). Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Segmentation; SAP SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: segment_tier
attributes.description: Commercial priority tier assigned to the segment, reflecting strategic importance and resource allocation level. Tier 1 represents the highest-priority segments (e.g., strategic global accounts), while Tier 4 represents transactional or low-volume segments. Drives pricing authority, technical service allocation, and account management coverage.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Segmentation; SAP SD Pricing Procedure

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segment by customer relationship type: end_user (direct consumer of chemicals), distributor (reseller/channel partner), oem (original equipment manufacturer), toll_manufacturer (contract processor), trading_company (commodity trader), government (public sector). Serves as the primary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: end_user|distributor|oem|toll_manufacturer|trading_company|government|broker|cooperative — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP SD - Customer Account Group; Salesforce CRM - Account Type

attributes.name: strategic_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are classified as strategic accounts requiring dedicated key account management, executive sponsorship, and customized commercial terms. True = strategic segment; False = standard commercial segment. Drives resource allocation in Salesforce CRM and SAP SD pricing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Strategic Account Management; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: target_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Annual revenue target in US Dollars (USD) set for this customer segment as part of the commercial planning cycle. Used in SAP FI/CO profitability analysis (CO-PA) and Salesforce CRM quota management. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity. This is a planning input, not a calculated aggregate.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - CO-PA Profitability Analysis; FASB ASC 606 - Revenue Recognition; SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: technical_service_level
attributes.description: Level of technical service and application support allocated to customers in this segment: full_service (dedicated technical account manager, on-site support, custom formulation assistance), standard (remote technical support, standard SDS/COA documentation), self_service (online portal access only), none (no technical service). Drives resource planning for technical sales teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Service Level; SAP SD - Customer Service; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this customer segment record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with Salesforce CRM, and audit compliance. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO/IEC 27001 - Audit Trail

attributes.name: wallet_share_estimate_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the total addressable spend within this segment that Chemical Mfg currently captures (0.00 to 100.00). Represents the MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE principal quantitative fact for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used in commercial strategy to identify penetration gaps and prioritize growth investments. Classified as confidential due to competitive sensitivity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Planning; SAP FI/CO - Revenue Analysis

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Customer credit standing and financial risk profile managed by the credit department. Stores credit limit (in base currency), credit exposure, payment terms code (Net 30, Net 60, COD, Prepay), credit rating (internal and external Dun & Bradstreet), credit hold flag, credit hold reason, credit review date, next review date, credit analyst, credit insurance policy reference, days sales outstanding (DSO) target, and credit block status in SAP SD. Critical for order-to-cash risk management in chemical distribution.
products.reference: SAP SD Credit Management (FD32) / D&B Credit Assessment

attributes.name: credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer credit profile record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD (Sales and Distribution) — Credit Management

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer master record for whom this credit profile is maintained. Links the credit profile to the customer entity in the customer domain.

attributes.name: primary_credit_analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: credit_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is currently subject to a credit block in SAP SD (KNKK-CTLPC / KNVV-AUFSD). When True, new sales orders for this customer are blocked from delivery and billing until the block is resolved by the credit department. Critical control for order-to-cash risk management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Block (VKM1/VKM3); SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: credit_block_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the customer credit block is active. 'overlimit' indicates exposure exceeds approved limit; 'payment_overdue' indicates past-due invoices; 'credit_review' indicates periodic review in progress; 'legal_dispute' indicates an active dispute; 'sanctions_hold' indicates a regulatory/compliance hold; 'manual_hold' indicates a discretionary hold by the credit analyst.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control) — Sanctions Compliance

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: SAP credit control area code (KKBER) that governs the credit limit and exposure tracking for this customer. Defines the organizational unit responsible for credit management, typically aligned to a company code or regional finance entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls

attributes.name: credit_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Current total credit exposure for the customer, representing the sum of open receivables, open sales orders, and open deliveries not yet invoiced. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA credit exposure calculation (KNKK-SKFOR). Used to assess proximity to credit limit and trigger credit blocks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Exposure (FD33); FASB ASC 310 — Receivables

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is on a general credit hold, which may be broader than a specific SAP credit block. A credit hold may prevent new orders, shipments, or both, and is managed by the credit department independently of the automated SAP block logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: credit_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum insured amount under the trade credit insurance policy for this customer. Represents the portion of the credit exposure that is covered by the insurer in the event of customer default. Used to calculate the net uninsured credit exposure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 — Receivables; Trade Credit Insurance Policy Terms

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the trade credit insurance policy covering this customer's receivables. Credit insurance is commonly used in chemical distribution to mitigate counterparty default risk on large B2B accounts. Enables linkage to the insurer's policy documentation for claims processing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 — Receivables; Euler Hermes / Atradius — Trade Credit Insurance Standards

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure (in base currency) extended to the customer by the credit department. Stored in SAP S/4HANA as KNKK-KLIMK. Drives order block logic in SAP SD when exposure approaches or exceeds this threshold. Critical for order-to-cash risk management in chemical distribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management (FD32); FASB ASC 310 — Receivables

attributes.name: credit_limit_approval_level
attributes.description: Authorization level required to approve or modify the credit limit for this customer, based on the credit limit amount and risk category. Enforces the company's credit approval authority matrix and SOX segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Internal Controls; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures correct multi-currency credit exposure calculation across global chemical distribution operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: credit_limit_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current approved credit limit became effective. Supports audit trail requirements and enables historical analysis of credit limit changes over time. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; SOX — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: credit_limit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current approved credit limit expires and requires renewal or re-approval. Nullable for open-ended credit arrangements. When populated, triggers automated alerts to the credit analyst for timely renewal. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: credit_notes_text
attributes.description: Free-text field for credit analyst notes, observations, and commentary related to the customer's credit profile. May include context on credit decisions, customer communications, or risk factors not captured in structured fields. Restricted to credit department personnel.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; SOX — Audit Documentation

attributes.name: credit_profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer credit profile. 'active' indicates the profile is in use for order-to-cash processing; 'suspended' indicates temporary hold; 'under_review' indicates a scheduled or triggered credit review is in progress; 'pending_approval' indicates a new or revised limit awaiting authorization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; FASB (Financial Accounting Standards Board) — Receivables

attributes.name: credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal credit review was conducted for this customer. Used to track compliance with the credit department's periodic review schedule and to assess the currency of the credit assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; FASB ASC 310; SOX — Financial Controls

attributes.name: credit_risk_category
attributes.description: Categorical risk classification assigned to the customer by the credit department, summarizing the overall credit risk level. Drives credit limit approval thresholds, review frequency, and escalation procedures. 'critical' indicates customers requiring executive-level approval for any credit extension.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 — Receivables; SOX — Financial Risk Controls

attributes.name: credit_segment
attributes.description: Customer segmentation classification from a credit management perspective. 'strategic' and 'key_account' customers may receive preferential credit terms; 'distributor' reflects the B2B distribution channel common in chemical manufacturing; 'new_customer' triggers enhanced due diligence and conservative initial limits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Customer Classification; ACC — Responsible Care

attributes.name: credit_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the approved credit limit currently utilized, calculated as (credit_exposure_amount / credit_limit_amount) × 100. Provides a normalized risk indicator for credit analysts and automated alerting when utilization exceeds defined thresholds (e.g., 80%, 90%, 100%).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: dso_actual_days
attributes.description: Actual current days sales outstanding (DSO) for this customer, representing the average number of days receivables remain outstanding. Compared against dso_target_days to identify payment performance trends and trigger credit review actions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 — Receivables; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: dso_target_days
attributes.description: Target number of days sales outstanding (DSO) established for this customer by the credit department. Represents the expected average collection period for receivables from this customer. Used as a benchmark for monitoring actual collection performance and identifying deteriorating payment behavior.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 — Receivables; ACC — Responsible Care Financial Practices

attributes.name: dun_bradstreet_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to uniquely identify the customer's business entity. Used to retrieve and link external credit reports and financial risk data for the customer.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet — DUNS Number Standard; ISO 6523 — Organization Identifiers

attributes.name: dun_bradstreet_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned by Dun & Bradstreet (D&B) for the customer organization. Includes the D&B PAYDEX score or composite credit appraisal code. Used to supplement internal credit assessment with third-party financial risk data for B2B industrial customers and distributors in chemical distribution.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet — Commercial Credit Reporting; FASB ASC 310 — Receivables

attributes.name: internal_credit_rating
attributes.description: Internally assigned credit rating for the customer, determined by the credit department based on payment history, financial statements, and risk assessment. Typically expressed as a letter or alphanumeric grade (e.g., A1, B2, C3) aligned to the company's internal credit scoring methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: A1|A2|B1|B2|C1|C2|D — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 — Receivables; ACC (American Chemistry Council) — Responsible Care Financial Practices

attributes.name: last_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit limit or credit terms were last formally approved by an authorized approver. Supports SOX audit trail requirements and enables tracking of the age of the most recent credit authorization.

attributes.name: last_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user ID of the individual who last approved the credit limit or credit terms for this customer. Provides an audit trail for credit authorization decisions in compliance with SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX — Financial Controls; SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management Workflow

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal credit review of this customer. Determined by the credit review cycle (e.g., annual, semi-annual, triggered by risk events). Used by credit analysts to manage their review workload and ensure timely reassessment of credit limits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: oldest_overdue_days
attributes.description: Number of days since the oldest overdue invoice for this customer became past due. Used to assess the severity of payment delinquency and to trigger escalation actions such as collections referral or credit block.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Accounts Receivable; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: overdue_amount
attributes.description: Total value of invoices that are past their due date for this customer, expressed in the credit limit currency. A key indicator of payment risk and a primary trigger for credit block activation and credit review escalation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Accounts Receivable (FBL5N); FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: payment_behavior_score
attributes.description: Internally calculated payment behavior score for the customer, derived from historical payment patterns including on-time payment rate, frequency of late payments, and average days late. Expressed as a numeric score (e.g., 1–100). Used as an input to the internal credit rating and credit limit decisions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 — Receivables; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Accounts Receivable Analytics

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code assigned to the customer credit profile, defining the due date and discount structure for invoices. Common values in chemical distribution include NET30 (net 30 days), NET60, NET90, COD (Cash on Delivery), and PREPAY (prepayment required). Stored in SAP as ZTERM on the customer master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Payment Terms (OBB8); FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: profile_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit profile record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for this entity, supporting SOX compliance and data lineage requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX — Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA SD — Credit Management

attributes.name: profile_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the credit profile record. Used for change tracking, data freshness assessment, and incremental load processing in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline.
attributes.references: SOX — Audit Trail; Databricks Lakehouse — Silver Layer Change Data Capture

attributes.name: sanctions_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent sanctions and restricted party screening was performed for this customer. Used to ensure screening is current and to schedule re-screening at required intervals per compliance policy.
attributes.references: OFAC — Sanctions Compliance; ECHA (European Chemicals Agency) — REACH Compliance

attributes.name: sanctions_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the most recent sanctions and restricted party screening check performed for this customer. Chemical manufacturers must screen customers against OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists. 'flagged' triggers immediate credit hold and compliance review.
attributes.references: OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control) — Sanctions Compliance; TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act); REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals)

attributes.name: sap_credit_account_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP (Systems Applications and Products) Credit Account Number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP credit management account number (KNKK-KNKLI) assigned to the customer in SAP S/4HANA SD. Used as the business identifier for cross-system reconciliation with the ERP credit management module.

attributes.name: special_credit_terms
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special or negotiated credit terms applicable to this customer that deviate from standard payment terms. Examples include extended payment schedules, seasonal credit adjustments, or terms negotiated as part of a strategic account agreement in chemical distribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Customer Master; FASB ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition

products.name: regulatory_profile
products.description: Customer regulatory and compliance profile capturing jurisdiction-specific requirements that govern how chemical products are sold, labeled, and documented for that customer. Stores applicable regulatory frameworks (REACH, TSCA, GHS, RoHS, PROP65), required documentation (SDS version, COA, COC, MSDS language), country of destination, import/export license numbers, end-use declaration, restricted substance list acknowledgment, customer EHS certification status, and audit rights agreement. Ensures regulatory compliance in chemical sales.
products.reference: REACH Article 35 / TSCA Section 8 / GHS SDS Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer regulatory and compliance profile record in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom this regulatory profile applies. Links to the customer master record in Salesforce CRM / SAP S/4HANA SD.

attributes.name: hazmat_storage_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.hazmat_storage_rule. Business justification: Ensures Regulatory Compliance Mapping, linking a customer's regulatory profile to the specific hazmat storage rule applied for safe handling and reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Regulatory contact person is an employee; linking enables tracking of communications and compliance responsibilities.

attributes.name: approved_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of chemical product categories or families that are approved for sale to this customer under the current regulatory profile (e.g., solvents, adhesives, specialty polymers). Restricts order processing to compliant product types.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA, SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: audit_rights_agreed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has agreed to grant the supplier audit rights to verify compliance with regulatory requirements, safe handling practices, and end-use declarations for supplied chemicals.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, ACC Responsible Care, SOX

attributes.name: audit_rights_agreement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer formally agreed to audit rights provisions. Used to track agreement currency and renewal obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, ACC Responsible Care, SOX

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis must accompany each shipment to this customer, confirming that the chemical product meets specified quality and composition standards.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, GMP, LabWare LIMS, SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: coc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Compliance is required with each shipment, attesting that the product conforms to applicable regulatory and customer-specified requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, SAP S/4HANA QM, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory profile record was first created in the system, establishing the audit trail for compliance record-keeping purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, SOX, SAP S/4HANA SD, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country of destination for chemical product shipments to this customer. Drives applicable regulatory framework selection (e.g., REACH for EU, TSCA for USA).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA, DOT, GHS

attributes.name: destination_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or trade bloc of the customer destination (e.g., European Union, North America, Asia-Pacific) used for regional regulatory framework grouping and reporting.

attributes.name: downstream_user_notification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer qualifies as a REACH downstream user and has been notified of their obligations under REACH, including use conditions, exposure scenarios, and risk management measures.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this regulatory profile becomes binding and governs chemical product sales and documentation obligations for the customer.

attributes.name: ehs_certification_expiry
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the customer's EHS certification. Triggers re-validation workflow when approaching expiry to ensure continued compliance eligibility.

attributes.name: ehs_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Certification Number
attributes.description: Certificate number or registration identifier for the customer's EHS management system certification (e.g., ISO 14001 certificate number), used for audit trail and verification.
attributes.references: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, OSHA, Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: ehs_certification_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Certification Status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer's EHS certification relevant to handling and using chemical products (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 45001, OSHA VPP). Determines eligibility for certain product categories.
attributes.references: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, OSHA, Intelex EHS Management, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: end_use_declaration
attributes.description: Customer's declared intended end-use application for the chemical products purchased (e.g., industrial solvent, agricultural formulation, polymer additive, pharmaceutical intermediate). Required for REACH downstream user obligations and export control compliance.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA, ECHA, EAR

attributes.name: end_use_sector
attributes.description: Industry sector classification of the customer's end-use application for purchased chemicals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|construction|electronics|agriculture|pharmaceuticals|consumer_goods|coatings|textiles|food_contact|industrial — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this regulatory profile expires and must be renewed or re-validated. Null indicates an open-ended profile with no scheduled expiry.

attributes.name: export_license_number
attributes.description: Export license or authorization number issued by the originating country's regulatory authority for controlled chemical substances, required for dual-use or restricted chemicals.
attributes.references: EAR (Export Administration Regulations), TSCA, DOT, EPA

attributes.name: ghs_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals applies to products sold to this customer, requiring GHS-compliant Safety Data Sheets and labels.
attributes.references: GHS (UN Globally Harmonized System), OSHA HazCom 2012, REACH CLP Regulation

attributes.name: hazmat_transport_class
attributes.description: DOT/IATA/IMDG hazardous materials transport classification applicable to chemical products shipped to this customer (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 8 Corrosive). Governs packaging, labeling, and shipping documentation requirements.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR, IATA DGR, IMDG Code, NFPA, Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: import_license_number
attributes.description: Customer's import license or permit number issued by the destination country's regulatory authority, required for controlled or restricted chemical substances. Must be validated before shipment.
attributes.references: TSCA, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, DOT, ECHA, EPA

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory compliance audit conducted at or for this customer. Used to schedule next audit and assess compliance currency.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this regulatory profile record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and downstream data synchronization.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, SOX, SAP S/4HANA SD, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: msds_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the legacy MSDS format (pre-GHS) is required in addition to or instead of the current SDS format, applicable for customers in jurisdictions that have not fully adopted GHS.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this regulatory profile to ensure continued accuracy, completeness, and alignment with current regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: profile_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this regulatory profile, used in correspondence, audits, and regulatory submissions. Format: REGP-YYYYMMDD-CountryCode.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer regulatory profile. Active indicates all requirements are met and sales may proceed; pending_review indicates documentation is under assessment; suspended indicates a compliance hold; expired indicates the profile requires renewal.

attributes.name: profile_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer relationship type that determines applicable regulatory obligations and documentation requirements for chemical product sales.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA

attributes.name: prop65_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether California Proposition 65 (Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act) warning requirements apply to products sold to this customer based on end-use state or distribution territory.

attributes.name: reach_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the European Chemicals Agency REACH regulation applies to chemical products sold to this customer, based on destination country and product use.

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the designated regulatory affairs or EHS contact at the customer organization for compliance documentation, SDS distribution, and regulatory notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: regulatory_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated regulatory affairs or EHS contact person at the customer organization responsible for managing compliance documentation and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, ISO 14001, Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: restricted_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of chemical product categories that are restricted or prohibited from sale to this customer based on regulatory, end-use, or jurisdictional constraints. Triggers order block in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, TSCA, RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: restricted_substance_ack_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer formally acknowledged the supplier's Restricted Substance List. Used to track acknowledgment currency and trigger renewal when the RSL is updated.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, ECHA

attributes.name: restricted_substance_acknowledgment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has formally acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the supplier's Restricted Substance List, confirming awareness of substances that are prohibited or restricted in supplied products.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, ECHA, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: rohs_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether EU RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) directive requirements apply to chemical products or materials sold to this customer, particularly relevant for electronics-sector customers.

attributes.name: sds_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) specifying the required language for Safety Data Sheets provided to this customer (e.g., en, de, fr, zh-CN).
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, GHS, OSHA HazCom 2012, ISO 639-1

attributes.name: sds_version_required
attributes.description: The specific version or format standard of the Safety Data Sheet required by this customer or their jurisdiction (e.g., GHS Rev 7, OSHA 2012, EU 2015/830). Ensures correct SDS format is provided with each shipment.
attributes.references: GHS, OSHA HazCom 2012, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, ISO 11014

attributes.name: special_labeling_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of any customer-specific or jurisdiction-specific labeling requirements beyond standard GHS/SDS requirements, such as additional language requirements, customer-specific hazard statements, or country-specific pictogram standards.
attributes.references: GHS, REACH CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008, OSHA HazCom 2012, NFPA 704

attributes.name: svhc_notification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires proactive notification when any supplied product contains Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) above 0.1% w/w threshold, as mandated under REACH Article 33.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Article 33, ECHA SVHC Candidate List

attributes.name: tsca_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the US EPA Toxic Substances Control Act requirements apply to chemical products sold to this customer.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Primary UN number identifying the hazardous substance or article for transport documentation purposes. Required on shipping papers, labels, and placards for regulated chemical shipments to this customer.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR, IATA DGR, IMDG Code, GHS, UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

products.name: service_profile
products.description: Technical service and application support profile for a customer account, capturing the level of technical assistance contracted or agreed upon. Stores assigned technical service representative (TSR), application engineer, service tier (standard, premium, strategic), approved product applications, lab support entitlement, on-site visit frequency, formulation assistance flag, pilot plant access flag, joint development agreement reference, and technical complaint escalation path. Supports the technical sales model common in specialty chemical businesses where deep application engineering differentiates suppliers.

attributes.name: service_profile_id
attributes.description: Primary key for service_profile

attributes.name: primary_service_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which this technical service profile is established. Links the service profile to the customer master record in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: primary_service_tsr_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee designated as the primary Technical Service Representative (TSR) for this customer account. The TSR is the main point of contact for day-to-day technical support and application assistance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Team; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: tertiary_service_backup_tsr_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Backup Technical Service Representative (TSR) Employee ID
attributes.description: Reference to the secondary or backup Technical Service Representative (TSR) who covers the account in the primary TSR's absence, ensuring continuity of technical support.

attributes.name: approved_applications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or free-text description of the specific product applications and end-use segments approved for this customer under this service profile (e.g., automotive coatings, agricultural adjuvants, electronic encapsulants). Drives application-specific technical support scope.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: coa_auto_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Certificates of Analysis (COA) are automatically delivered to the customer with each shipment as part of this service profile. When True, COA documents are generated from LabWare LIMS and transmitted electronically upon shipment confirmation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Clause 8.6; GMP; LabWare LIMS; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: complaint_response_sla_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Technical Complaint Response Service Level Agreement (SLA) Days
attributes.description: Contracted number of business days within which Chemical Mfg must provide an initial technical response to a customer complaint or out-of-specification (OOS) claim under this service profile. Drives CAPA process timelines.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Clause 8.7; CAPA Process; Salesforce CRM - Entitlement SLA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this technical service profile record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls; ISO 9001 - Records Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the customer receiving technical service. Distinguishes between direct industrial customers, distributors, OEM manufacturers, end-users, and strategic accounts, which determines the nature and depth of technical service provided.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Type; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this technical service profile becomes active and binding. Marks the start of the contracted service period.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Service Contract Start Date; ISO 9001

attributes.name: escalation_path
attributes.description: Defined escalation path for technical complaints and out-of-specification (OOS) issues raised by this customer. Specifies the sequence of escalation contacts from TSR through regional management to executive level, aligned with the customer's service tier and criticality.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Clause 8.7 Nonconforming Outputs; CAPA Process; Salesforce CRM - Case Escalation

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this technical service profile expires or is scheduled to end. Null indicates an open-ended service agreement with no fixed termination date.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Service Contract End Date; ISO 9001

attributes.name: formulation_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is entitled to formulation assistance services under this service profile. When True, Chemical Mfg's formulation scientists provide direct support in developing or optimizing the customer's product formulations using Chemical Mfg materials.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; ACC Responsible Care; Salesforce CRM - Entitlement

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: The primary industry or end-use market segment of the customer (e.g., automotive, construction, electronics, agriculture, consumer goods, coatings, adhesives). Drives application-specific technical support expertise assignment and approved application scope. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|construction|electronics|agriculture|consumer_goods|coatings|adhesives|pharmaceuticals|food_contact|textiles — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care; REACH; TSCA; Salesforce CRM - Industry Field

attributes.name: jda_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the Joint Development Agreement (JDA) between Chemical Mfg and the customer, if applicable. A JDA formalizes collaborative R&D activities, IP ownership, and co-development milestones. Populated only for strategic-tier customers with active joint development programs.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care; TSCA; Salesforce CRM - Contract Object

attributes.name: lab_support_entitlement
attributes.description: Level of laboratory support the customer is entitled to under this service profile. 'None' indicates no lab support; 'Basic' covers standard analytical testing; 'Advanced' includes formulation development support; 'Full' includes dedicated lab time and custom testing via LabWare LIMS.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this technical service profile record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls; ISO 9001 - Records Management; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this technical service profile was last formally reviewed and validated with the customer, ensuring service entitlements, contacts, and approved applications remain current and accurate.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Management Review; Salesforce CRM - Service Contract

attributes.name: lims_customer_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Customer Code
attributes.description: Customer identifier in LabWare LIMS used to associate lab test requests, COA generation, and analytical results with this customer's service profile. Enables traceability between lab activities and customer service entitlements.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Scheduled Service Profile Review Date
attributes.description: Date on which the next formal review of this technical service profile is scheduled. Ensures periodic validation of service entitlements and alignment with evolving customer application needs.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Management Review; Salesforce CRM - Service Contract

attributes.name: onsite_visit_frequency
attributes.description: Agreed frequency of on-site technical service visits to the customer's facility by the assigned TSR or application engineer. Drives field service scheduling and travel planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Service Contract; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: pilot_plant_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has been granted access to Chemical Mfg's pilot plant facilities for scale-up trials, process validation, or application development. Typically reserved for strategic-tier customers with active joint development programs.
attributes.references: PSM (Process Safety Management); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary technical contact at the customer organization. Used for technical communications, SDS/COA distribution, and complaint correspondence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Contact Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary technical contact person at the customer's organization who interfaces with Chemical Mfg's technical service team. This is the customer-side counterpart to the assigned TSR.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Contact Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number of the primary technical contact at the customer organization for urgent technical support communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Contact Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this technical service profile, used in customer-facing communications and cross-system references. Sourced from Salesforce CRM service agreement records.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title for the technical service profile, typically reflecting the customer name and service tier (e.g., 'Acme Corp - Strategic Technical Service Profile').

attributes.name: profile_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or qualifications relevant to this customer's technical service profile, such as specific handling requirements, regulatory sensitivities, or strategic account notes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Service Contract Notes; ISO 9001

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the technical service profile, indicating whether the service agreement is currently in force, pending activation, suspended, or expired.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Service Contract Status; ISO 9001

attributes.name: regulatory_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service profile includes regulatory support services, such as assistance with REACH registration dossiers, TSCA compliance documentation, or GHS classification queries. Relevant for customers in regulated end-use markets.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA; GHS; ECHA

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the profile expiration date that an automated renewal reminder should be triggered to the assigned TSR and account manager. Supports proactive service contract renewal management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Service Contract Renewal; ISO 9001

attributes.name: sample_request_entitlement
attributes.description: Maximum number of product sample requests the customer is entitled to per calendar year under this service profile. Supports the technical sales model where samples are provided for application evaluation and qualification.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Entitlement; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sap_sold_to_party
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD sold-to party number for the customer associated with this service profile. Used to link technical service entitlements to order management, pricing, and delivery processes in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master; SAP BP (Business Partner)

attributes.name: sds_distribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Chemical Mfg is responsible for proactively distributing Safety Data Sheets (SDS) to this customer as part of the service profile. When True, updated SDS documents are automatically distributed upon revision.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom Standard; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: service_site_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the customer site location where technical services are delivered. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g., REACH for EU, TSCA for USA) and regional TSR assignment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; REACH; TSCA; DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: service_site_location
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the specific customer plant, facility, or site location to which this technical service profile applies. A customer may have multiple sites with different service profiles.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Site; SAP S/4HANA SD - Ship-To Party

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the level of technical service and application support contracted or agreed upon with the customer. 'Standard' provides basic technical support; 'Premium' includes dedicated resources and faster response; 'Strategic' includes joint development, pilot plant access, and executive engagement. Drives resource allocation and SLA commitments.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care Program; Salesforce CRM - Service Level

attributes.name: technical_training_entitlement
attributes.description: Number of technical training sessions (webinars, workshops, or on-site training) the customer is entitled to per year under this service profile. Covers product application training, safety handling, and regulatory updates.
attributes.references: OSHA Training Requirements; ACC Responsible Care; Salesforce CRM - Entitlement

products.name: qualification
products.description: Customer-approved chemical products and grades that have been qualified for use at a specific customer site or application. Captures customer account, site, approved SKU/product code, grade, application use case, qualification date, qualification method (lab trial, plant trial, third-party cert), approval status, expiry date, approved volume range, and any customer-specific specification deviations. Critical in automotive, pharma, and electronics chemical supply where customer qualification is mandatory before commercial supply.
products.reference: Customer Approved Supplier List (ASL) / PPAP / Customer Qualification Record

attributes.name: qualification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for qualification

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B customer account for whom this product qualification applies. Links to the customer master record in Salesforce CRM and SAP SD.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal product master record (SKU/material) that has been qualified for supply to this customer site.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: customer_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer plant, facility, or site location where the qualified product is approved for use. Qualifications are site-specific in chemical supply to automotive, pharma, and electronics sectors.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Qualification owner employee tracks responsibility for product approvals, required for qualification audit and renewal processes.

attributes.name: apl_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the qualification record, typically assigned by the customer or jointly by the supplier and customer. Used in customer correspondence, COA references, and audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: application_use_case
attributes.description: The specific end-use application or process for which the chemical product has been qualified at the customer site (e.g., automotive coating adhesion, semiconductor etch bath, pharmaceutical excipient, agricultural formulation carrier).
attributes.references: REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals); ECHA

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer product qualification. 'approved' = fully qualified for commercial supply; 'conditionally_approved' = approved with restrictions or deviations; 'pending_review' = under evaluation; 'suspended' = temporarily halted pending investigation; 'revoked' = permanently withdrawn; 'expired' = past expiry date without renewal.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: approved_by_customer_contact
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the customer representative (e.g., quality engineer, procurement manager) who formally approved the qualification. Business-confidential as it identifies a specific customer decision-maker.

attributes.name: approved_by_internal_user
attributes.description: The name or employee ID of the internal Chemical Mfg representative (e.g., technical sales, quality manager) who managed and approved the qualification from the supplier side.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: The CAS Registry Number of the primary chemical substance in the qualified product. Used for regulatory cross-referencing under REACH, TSCA, and customer EHS systems.
attributes.references: CAS (Chemical Abstracts Service); REACH; TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act); ECHA

attributes.name: change_notification_lead_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of calendar days advance notice required to be given to the customer before implementing any change to the qualified product. Populated only when change_notification_required_flag is True.

attributes.name: change_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires formal notification (e.g., PCN - Product Change Notification) before any change to the qualified product formulation, process, or raw material source. Critical in automotive and electronics supply chains.
attributes.references: IATF 16949; JEDEC JESD46 (Product Change Notification); ISO 9001

attributes.name: coa_template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the COA template configured for this customer-product qualification. Defines which quality parameters and test results are reported on the COA accompanying each shipment.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; LabWare LIMS; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this qualification record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: crm_qualification_code
attributes.description: The qualification record identifier in Salesforce CRM, the system of record for customer-facing qualification activities. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational CRM.

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: The customer's own internal part number or material code assigned to this qualified chemical product. Used for cross-referencing in purchase orders, COA requests, and EDI transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Material Info Record; ANSI X12 EDI

attributes.name: customer_spec_number
attributes.description: The customer's internal specification document number that defines the quality requirements for this qualified product. Referenced on COA and COC documents during shipment.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this qualification record is binding and commercial supply may commence. May differ from qualification_date if there is a ramp-up or transition period.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this qualification is contractually binding for commercial supply. Null for open-ended qualifications. Used in supply chain planning and order management validation.

attributes.name: exclusive_supply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Chemical Mfg is the sole qualified supplier for this product at this customer site. True = exclusive supply arrangement; False = customer has multiple qualified suppliers.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer qualification expires and must be renewed or re-qualified. Null indicates an open-ended qualification with no defined expiry. Critical for supply continuity planning.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: The end-market industry segment of the customer for which this qualification applies. Drives regulatory requirements, COA content, and qualification rigor. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|electronics|pharmaceutical|agriculture|construction|consumer_goods|industrial|aerospace|food_beverage|coatings — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACC (American Chemistry Council); ECHA; FDA; IATF 16949

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this qualification record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lims_qualification_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Qualification ID
attributes.description: The qualification record identifier in LabWare LIMS, used to cross-reference lab trial data, test results, and analytical reports that supported the qualification decision.

attributes.name: max_approved_volume_kg
attributes.description: The maximum annual or periodic supply volume in kilograms approved under this qualification. Volumes exceeding this threshold require customer notification or re-qualification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Customer Supply Agreement

attributes.name: min_approved_volume_kg
attributes.description: The minimum annual or periodic supply volume in kilograms approved under this qualification. Volumes below this threshold may require re-qualification or customer notification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Customer Supply Agreement

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional qualification conditions, restrictions, or contextual information not captured in structured fields. Examples: special handling requirements, packaging restrictions, labelling requirements specific to this customer.

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: The specific chemical grade or quality tier of the product that has been qualified (e.g., Technical Grade, Reagent Grade, Electronic Grade, Pharmaceutical Grade, Food Grade). Critical differentiator in chemical supply.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the product qualification was formally approved and granted by the customer. This is the effective start date for commercial supply under this qualification.

attributes.name: qualification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the product was qualified for use at the customer site. 'lab_trial' = bench-scale testing at customer or supplier lab; 'plant_trial' = full-scale production trial at customer facility; 'third_party_cert' = qualification via third-party certification body; 'desk_review' = documentation-only review; 'customer_audit' = qualification via customer site audit; 'equivalency_study' = qualification via equivalency to an already-approved product.

attributes.name: qualification_scope
attributes.description: Defines the geographic or organizational scope of the qualification. 'site_specific' = applies only to the named customer site; 'global_account' = applies across all sites of the customer account; 'regional' = applies to a defined regional cluster of sites; 'product_family' = applies to a family of related products.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: The European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) REACH registration number for the qualified substance. Required for supply into EU markets. Format: 01-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX-XX-XXXX.
attributes.references: REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals); ECHA

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_standard
attributes.description: The primary regulatory or quality standard under which this qualification was conducted (e.g., IATF 16949 for automotive, ICH Q7 for pharmaceutical API, IPC-7711 for electronics, ISO 9001 for general industrial). Drives audit and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; IATF 16949; GMP; FDA; ECHA REACH

attributes.name: renewal_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days before the expiry date that the renewal process must be initiated to ensure supply continuity. Used to trigger renewal workflow alerts in the quality management system.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification requires periodic renewal before the expiry date. True = renewal process must be initiated; False = qualification is perpetual or renewal is not contractually required.

attributes.name: sds_issue_date
attributes.description: The issue date of the Safety Data Sheet version referenced in this qualification. Used to verify that the customer was provided with current GHS-compliant hazard information at time of qualification.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA HazCom 2012; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: sds_version
attributes.description: The version number of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) that was current at the time of qualification. Ensures traceability between the qualification and the hazard communication documentation provided to the customer.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA HazCom 2012; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific product variant approved for supply. Aligns with SAP material number and customer-facing product catalogue.

attributes.name: spec_deviation_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of any customer-approved deviations from the standard product specification included in this qualification. Populated only when spec_deviation_flag is True.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) Process

attributes.name: spec_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification includes customer-approved deviations from the standard product specification. True = one or more approved deviations exist; False = qualification is to standard specification.

attributes.name: volume_period
attributes.description: The time period to which the approved volume range (min/max) applies. Defines whether volume limits are annual, quarterly, monthly, or per-order constraints.

products.name: interaction
products.description: Log of all customer-facing interactions and touchpoints including sales calls, technical visits, complaint calls, email exchanges, webinar attendance, trade show meetings, and portal logins. Captures interaction type, channel (phone, email, in-person, video, portal), date and time, duration, participants (internal and customer contacts), subject, outcome, follow-up actions, and linked opportunity or case. Sourced from Salesforce CRM activity records. Supports customer relationship management and account planning.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer interaction record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the interaction data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (account) involved in this interaction. Links to the customer master data product.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service case or complaint record linked to this interaction, if applicable. Supports complaint resolution tracking and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; Intelex EHS CAPA Module

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Supports support interaction logs tying each customer interaction to the specific chemical product discussed, required for service quality metrics.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer contact person who participated in this interaction. Links to the customer contact data product.

attributes.name: customer_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer site or plant location where the interaction occurred or is relevant to. Supports site-level account management and technical service tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Site; SAP S/4HANA SD Ship-To Party

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee (account manager or sales representative) who owns the customer account and is responsible for this interaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Representative

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity linked to this interaction, if applicable. Enables tracking of interactions that advance a specific sales pursuit.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Interaction Log per Order ties customer/technical interactions to a specific sales order, enabling SLA measurement and order‑level support metrics.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Enables Interaction‑Project Mapping report, tying customer interactions (meetings, calls) to specific R&D projects for account planning and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the interaction was conducted. Supports omnichannel analytics and customer engagement reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Channel; ISO 9001 Customer Communication

attributes.name: coa_request_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requested a Certificate of Analysis (COA) during this interaction. Supports quality document fulfillment tracking and customer quality management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management; LabWare LIMS COA Module

attributes.name: complaint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involves or originated from a customer complaint. Triggers linkage to the complaint/case management workflow and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) process.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction; Salesforce CRM Case

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this interaction record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CreatedDate; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: crm_activity_code
attributes.description: External identifier from Salesforce CRM activity record. Used to trace the interaction back to the system of record for reconciliation and lineage.

attributes.name: customer_participant_count
attributes.description: Number of customer-side contacts who participated in the interaction. Indicates the breadth of customer engagement and stakeholder involvement.

attributes.name: customer_participants
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer contact names or identifiers who participated in the interaction. Confidential business relationship data.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Invitees; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Numeric satisfaction rating provided by the customer or assessed by the account manager following the interaction, typically on a 1-5 or 1-10 scale. Supports Key Performance Indicator (KPI) tracking for customer relationship health.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total elapsed time of the interaction in minutes. Used to assess engagement depth, resource utilization, and account planning efficiency.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the required follow-up action must be completed. Used for task management and account manager accountability tracking.

attributes.name: follow_up_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific follow-up actions committed to during the interaction. Captures commitments made to the customer for accountability and continuity.

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up action or subsequent interaction is required as a result of this interaction. Drives task creation and account planning workflows.

attributes.name: interaction_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer interaction occurred. Used for day-level scheduling, account planning, and reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Date; ISO 9001 Customer Communication Records

attributes.name: interaction_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the interaction content, discussion points, and context. Captures technical topics discussed, products referenced, and any regulatory or compliance matters raised.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Description; ISO 9001 Customer Communication Records

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interaction record. Indicates whether the interaction was completed as planned, cancelled, or requires rescheduling.

attributes.name: interaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the customer interaction commenced. Supports time-zone-aware analytics and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature or purpose of the customer interaction. Distinguishes between sales-driven, technical service, complaint handling, and digital engagement touchpoints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_call|technical_visit|complaint_call|email_exchange|webinar|trade_show|portal_login|video_conference — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Type; ACC Responsible Care Customer Engagement Guidelines

attributes.name: internal_participant_count
attributes.description: Number of internal Chemical Mfg employees who participated in the interaction. Used for resource utilization and engagement intensity analysis.

attributes.name: internal_participants
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of internal employee names or identifiers who participated in the interaction (e.g., account manager, technical service representative, application chemist). Supports multi-participant interaction tracking.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the interaction took place (e.g., customer plant site, trade show venue, video conference URL, Chemical Mfg office). Relevant for in-person and on-site technical visits.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this interaction record was last updated in the system. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: next_interaction_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next planned customer interaction as agreed during this touchpoint. Supports account planning cadence and proactive customer engagement management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity; ACC Responsible Care Account Planning

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The result or disposition of the interaction as assessed by the internal participant. Supports win/loss analysis, customer satisfaction tracking, and account health scoring.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Result; ACC Responsible Care Customer Satisfaction

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the interaction, reflecting urgency of follow-up or strategic importance of the customer engagement.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The Chemical Mfg product line or portfolio segment discussed during the interaction (e.g., performance materials, agricultural solutions, specialty chemicals). Supports product-level engagement analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Product Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM Product

attributes.name: regulatory_topic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interaction involved discussion of regulatory or compliance topics such as REACH, TSCA, GHS, SDS requirements, or EPA/OSHA obligations. Supports regulatory engagement tracking and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA; EPA; OSHA; GHS

attributes.name: sales_territory_code
attributes.description: The sales territory code associated with this interaction, derived from the account owner's territory assignment. Supports territory-level performance reporting and account planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Territory; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: sample_request_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requested a product sample during this interaction. Triggers linkage to the sample request fulfillment process in the sales domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity; SAP S/4HANA SD Sample Management

attributes.name: sds_request_flag
