attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requested a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) during this interaction. Supports regulatory document fulfillment tracking per GHS and OSHA HazCom requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system from which this interaction record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration governance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief title or subject line summarizing the topic of the interaction. Mirrors the Salesforce CRM activity subject field and supports keyword search and categorization.

attributes.name: technical_topic
attributes.description: The primary technical subject matter discussed during the interaction (e.g., formulation support, application development, regulatory compliance, Safety Data Sheet (SDS) review, Certificate of Analysis (COA) query). Supports technical service analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity; ACC Responsible Care Technical Service

products.name: status_history
products.description: Audit trail of customer account lifecycle status transitions, capturing every change in account standing over time. Records transitions such as prospect→active, active→credit hold, credit hold→suspended, suspended→inactive, and reactivation events. Stores previous status, new status, effective date, change reason code, initiating user, approval reference, triggering business event (credit review outcome, M&A activity, insolvency filing, regulatory action), and reversal flag. Required for credit department audit compliance, customer lifecycle analytics, and regulatory inquiries into account standing history.
products.reference: SAP SD Customer Account Change Log / Salesforce CRM Audit Trail

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Primary key for status_history

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account whose status changed. Links this history record to the master customer account entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user or system account that initiated the status change. Used for audit trail and accountability tracking in credit department compliance reviews.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 - Internal Controls; ISO 27001 - Access Control

attributes.name: reversed_history_status_history_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original account_status_history_id that this record reverses or corrects. Null when is_reversal is False. Enables complete audit chain reconstruction for compliance inquiries.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Document Reversal

attributes.name: approval_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference to the approval workflow record or authorization document that sanctioned this status change. Required for credit department audit compliance and segregation of duties verification.

attributes.name: approval_reference_number
attributes.description: External or human-readable reference number of the approval document, workflow ticket, or authorization memo that sanctioned this status change. Complements the approval_reference_id for audit trail documentation and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Workflow Reference

attributes.name: billing_block_code
attributes.description: The SAP billing block code applied to or removed from the customer account as part of this status change. Null when no billing block change occurred. Supports accounts receivable and revenue recognition impact analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Billing Block (FAKSD); FASB ASC 606 - Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: blocked_order_count
attributes.description: The number of open sales orders that were blocked or released as a direct result of this status change. Captured as a snapshot at transition time to quantify the operational impact of credit hold and suspension events.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Order Block (AUFSD); SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Management

attributes.name: capa_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference to a CAPA record when the status change was triggered by a quality or compliance corrective action outcome. Links customer account standing changes to the quality management system for traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Section 10.2 - Corrective Action; SAP S/4HANA QM; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the status transition (e.g., CREDIT_REVIEW, INSOLVENCY, REACTIVATION, REGULATORY_ACTION, MA_ACTIVITY, PAYMENT_DEFAULT, CUSTOMER_REQUEST). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CREDIT_REVIEW|INSOLVENCY|REACTIVATION|REGULATORY_ACTION|MA_ACTIVITY|PAYMENT_DEFAULT|CUSTOMER_REQUEST|CAPA_OUTCOME — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Management; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the status change beyond the standardized reason code. Captures nuanced circumstances such as specific regulatory action details, M&A transaction references, or credit review findings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Change Reason Text; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: change_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the status change was recorded in the system. Serves as the EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this event log record. Distinct from effective_date which represents the business effective date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Change Document Timestamp; ISO 8601; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text commentary entered by the initiating user or approver providing supplementary context for the status change. May include credit analyst notes, legal counsel observations, or customer service remarks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Management Notes; Salesforce CRM - Activity Comments

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code associated with this status change record. Identifies the legal entity within the chemical manufacturing enterprise for which the customer account status was changed. Supports multi-entity financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Company Code (BUKRS); FASB ASC 810; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail completeness, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_at_change
attributes.business_glossary_term: Credit Exposure at Time of Change
attributes.description: The customer's total outstanding credit exposure (open orders + open invoices + deliveries) in the base currency at the time of this status change. Provides context for credit hold and suspension decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Exposure (FD33); FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: credit_limit_at_change
attributes.business_glossary_term: Credit Limit at Time of Change
attributes.description: The customer's approved credit limit in the base currency at the time of this status change. Captured as a snapshot to support credit department audit compliance and historical credit exposure analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Management (FD32); FASB ASC 310 - Receivables

attributes.name: credit_risk_category
attributes.description: The credit risk classification assigned to the customer at the time of this status change. Captured as a snapshot to support credit portfolio risk analysis and audit trail for credit hold decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Risk Category (FD32); FASB ASC 310; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the credit limit and credit exposure amounts captured in this status history record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 - Foreign Currency

attributes.name: days_in_previous_status
attributes.description: The number of calendar days the customer account remained in the previous status before this transition. Captured at the time of transition for customer lifecycle analytics and credit risk reporting. Not a calculated metric — stored as a business fact at transition time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Management Analytics; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: delivery_block_code
attributes.description: The SAP delivery block code applied to or removed from the customer account as part of this status change (e.g., 01 for credit block). Null when no delivery block change occurred. Supports supply chain impact analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Delivery Block (LIFSP); SAP EWM

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the new status became operationally effective. Used for customer lifecycle analytics, credit reporting, and regulatory inquiry responses. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Validity Date; FASB ASC 310 - Receivables

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this status record was superseded by a subsequent status change. Null if this is the current active status record. Enables point-in-time status reconstruction for audit and analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Validity End Date; ISO 8601

attributes.name: insolvency_filing_reference
attributes.description: Court case number, bankruptcy filing reference, or insolvency proceeding identifier when the status change was triggered by an insolvency filing. Null for non-insolvency transitions. Critical for accounts receivable risk management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 - Receivables; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Management

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status change record represents a reversal or correction of a previously recorded status transition. True when the record corrects an erroneous prior status change. Used for audit trail integrity and credit department compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 - Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Reversal Processing

attributes.name: ma_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the merger, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate restructuring event that triggered this status change. Null for non-M&A transitions. Supports customer hierarchy realignment and account consolidation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Hierarchy; Salesforce CRM - Account Merge

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The customer account status assigned as a result of this transition event. Captures the 'to' state in the status lifecycle transition pair (e.g., credit_hold in a transition from active→credit_hold).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Account Status; Salesforce CRM - Account Status

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer was formally notified of the status change. Null when notification_sent is False. Used to track compliance with contractual notification obligations and credit department procedures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Correspondence Date; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal notification was sent to the customer regarding this status change. Relevant for credit hold and suspension events where customer communication is required per contractual or regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Communication; Salesforce CRM - Activity Log

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The SAP payment terms code (e.g., NT30, NT60, ZB14) applicable to the customer at the time of this status change. Captures any payment terms adjustment associated with the status transition such as tightening terms on credit hold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Payment Terms (ZTERM); FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The customer account status immediately before this transition event. Captures the 'from' state in the status lifecycle transition pair (e.g., active in a transition from active→credit_hold).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Account Status; Salesforce CRM - Account Status

attributes.name: reach_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status change was triggered by or is associated with a REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) compliance issue with the customer. Supports ECHA regulatory reporting and EHS compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The governing body or regulatory authority whose action triggered this status change. Applicable when triggering_business_event is 'regulatory_action'. Supports regulatory inquiry responses and EHS compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPA|OSHA|ECHA|FDA|DOT|TSCA|ACC|NFPA|OTHER — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA - Environmental Protection Agency; OSHA 29 CFR; ECHA REACH Regulation; TSCA; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: External regulatory case number, enforcement action identifier, or compliance filing reference associated with this status change when triggered by a regulatory action (e.g., EPA enforcement, TSCA violation, OSHA citation). Null for non-regulatory transitions.
attributes.references: EPA - Enforcement and Compliance; TSCA Section 5; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which this status should be reviewed for potential change (e.g., credit hold review date, suspension expiry review). Supports proactive credit management and customer lifecycle workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Review Schedule; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: The SAP sales organization code under which this status change was processed. Relevant for multi-org chemical manufacturing enterprises where customer account status may vary by sales organization.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this status change event. Identifies whether the change was initiated in SAP S/4HANA credit management, Salesforce CRM, manual entry, or another integrated system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: source_system_change_reference
attributes.description: The native change document number or record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., SAP change document number, Salesforce record ID). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Change Document (CDHDR/CDPOS); Salesforce CRM - Audit Trail

attributes.name: transition_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the direction and nature of the status change. Distinguishes upgrades (e.g., prospect→active, credit_hold→active) from downgrades (e.g., active→credit_hold, active→suspended) and closures for lifecycle analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Lifecycle; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: triggering_business_event
attributes.description: Classification of the specific business event that triggered this status transition. Distinguishes between credit review outcomes, M&A activity, insolvency filings, regulatory actions, and other lifecycle events for customer analytics and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_review|ma_activity|insolvency_filing|regulatory_action|payment_default|customer_request|periodic_review|reactivation — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Management; Salesforce CRM - Account Events; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks corrections, reversals, or enrichment updates applied after initial ingestion.

products.name: customer_lead
products.description: Prospective customer leads and new business development targets in the chemical sales pipeline, representing potential customer identities before they become formal accounts. Captures lead source (trade show, referral, web inquiry, cold outreach), company name, contact name, industry vertical, chemical product interest, estimated annual volume potential, lead status (new, qualified, converted, disqualified), assigned sales rep, qualification date, and conversion to account date. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead object. Owned by the customer domain because a lead represents a prospective customer identity — distinct from a sales opportunity which tracks commercial deal progression.

attributes.name: customer_lead_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer lead record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the customer_lead data product. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead object.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign that generated or influenced this lead. Used for campaign ROI measurement, marketing attribution, and budget allocation decisions. References the Salesforce Campaign object.

attributes.name: converted_account_id
attributes.description: Salesforce Account ID of the customer account created upon lead conversion. Populated only when lead_status = 'converted'. Enables traceability from lead origin to active customer account for pipeline attribution and cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: converted_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Salesforce Opportunity ID created upon lead conversion. Populated only when lead_status = 'converted'. Links the lead origin to the downstream commercial deal for end-to-end pipeline attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: primary_customer_employee_id
attributes.description: Salesforce User ID of the sales representative currently responsible for working this lead. Used for workload balancing, performance reporting, and commission attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: annual_revenue_band
attributes.description: Estimated annual revenue band of the prospective customer's organization (e.g., '<$10M', '$10M–$50M', '$50M–$250M', '>$250M'). Used for strategic account tiering and prioritization. Sourced from third-party firmographic data or sales rep estimation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: <$10M|$10M-$50M|$50M-$250M|$250M-$1B|>$1B — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the prospective customer's primary operating location. Used for geographic clustering analysis and logistics proximity assessment for potential supply chain planning.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the prospective customer organization. Represents the business entity being targeted for chemical product sales. Used for account matching and deduplication prior to conversion.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: company_size_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the prospective customer's organization size. 'small' = <50 employees, 'medium' = 50–499, 'large' = 500–4999, 'enterprise' = 5000+. Used for segmentation, pricing strategy, and sales motion selection (transactional vs. strategic).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: contact_first_name
attributes.description: First name of the primary contact person at the prospective customer organization. Captured from trade show registrations, web inquiries, referrals, or cold outreach.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: contact_last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the primary contact person at the prospective customer organization. Combined with contact_first_name to form the full contact identity.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: contact_title
attributes.description: Professional job title or role of the primary contact at the prospective customer (e.g., Procurement Manager, R&D Director, Plant Engineer). Informs sales approach and technical engagement strategy.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead was converted into a formal customer account and/or sales opportunity in the CRM. Marks the end of the lead lifecycle and the beginning of the account/opportunity lifecycle. Used to calculate lead-to-conversion cycle time KPI.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the country of the prospective customer's primary operating location (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). Used for geographic segmentation, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and export compliance screening.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer lead record was first created in the source Salesforce CRM system. Represents the moment the lead entered the pipeline. Used for lead age calculation, SLA tracking, and pipeline velocity reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: crm_lead_code
attributes.description: Native Salesforce CRM Lead record identifier (18-character Salesforce ID). Used for traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.

attributes.name: disqualification_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the lead was disqualified from the pipeline (e.g., 'no budget', 'competitor locked in', 'wrong product fit', 'regulatory barrier', 'no decision maker access'). Populated only when lead_status = 'disqualified'. Used for pipeline quality analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the lead contact. Used for digital outreach, campaign tracking, and CRM communication logging. Subject to GDPR and CCPA consent requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: estimated_annual_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Estimated annual revenue potential from this lead expressed in US dollars. Derived from volume estimates and indicative pricing. Used for pipeline valuation, sales target tracking, and territory planning. Distinct from volume as it reflects commercial value.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; FASB; SOX

attributes.name: estimated_annual_volume_kg
attributes.description: Prospective annual purchase volume of chemical products expressed in kilograms. Used to prioritize lead qualification effort, assess strategic value, and forecast pipeline contribution. Captured during initial qualification conversation or estimated from industry benchmarks.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospective customer or the chemical products of interest are subject to export control regulations (e.g., EAR, ITAR, or dual-use chemical restrictions). When True, requires screening against denied party lists before conversion and shipment.
attributes.references: DOT; EPA; TSCA; EAR (Export Administration Regulations); ITAR

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The end-market industry sector of the prospective customer (e.g., Automotive, Construction, Electronics, Consumer Goods, Agriculture, Pharmaceuticals, Coatings). Used for market segmentation, product-to-market alignment, and territory planning. Aligns with NAICS/SIC classification.
attributes.references: NAICS Industry Classification; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: lead_source
attributes.description: The originating channel or method through which the lead was acquired. Used for marketing attribution, ROI analysis, and sales pipeline source reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trade_show|referral|web_inquiry|cold_outreach|distributor|conference|digital_campaign|inbound_call — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: lead_status
attributes.description: Current stage of the lead in the sales qualification lifecycle. 'new' = recently captured, 'working' = active outreach in progress, 'qualified' = meets criteria for conversion, 'converted' = promoted to formal account/opportunity, 'disqualified' = does not meet criteria, 'recycled' = re-entered pipeline after prior disqualification. Drives CRM workflow automation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the customer lead record in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for incremental data ingestion, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: next_follow_up_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next sales outreach or follow-up action with this lead. Used by sales representatives to manage their activity pipeline and ensure timely engagement. Drives CRM task and reminder generation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing qualitative context about the lead, including conversation summaries, specific application requirements, competitive intelligence, or special handling instructions. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead Description field.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number of the lead contact. Used for direct sales outreach and qualification calls.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: product_interest
attributes.description: The chemical product line, product family, or specific chemical compound the lead has expressed interest in (e.g., specialty polymers, performance coatings, agricultural intermediates, solvents). Drives assignment to the appropriate technical sales specialist.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead was formally assessed and determined to meet the minimum criteria for advancement in the sales pipeline (e.g., confirmed budget, authority, need, and timeline — BANT qualification). Marks transition from 'new' or 'working' to 'qualified' status.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: rating
attributes.description: Sales representative's qualitative assessment of the lead's near-term conversion likelihood. 'hot' = high urgency and fit, 'warm' = moderate interest, 'cold' = low engagement or long-horizon. Used to prioritize outreach cadence.

attributes.name: referral_source_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual, company, or partner who referred this lead. Populated when lead_source = 'referral'. Used for referral program tracking and partner relationship management.

attributes.name: regulatory_concern_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead involves products or applications subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny (e.g., REACH-restricted substances, TSCA new chemical notifications, EPA hazardous waste regulations, export-controlled chemicals). When True, triggers compliance review before conversion.

attributes.name: sales_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic or market-based sales territory to which this lead is assigned. Used for territory performance reporting, quota allocation, and rep assignment routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sample_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead contact has requested a product sample for laboratory evaluation or formulation testing. Sample requests indicate active technical qualification and are a key pipeline progression signal in chemical B2B sales.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP S/4HANA SD; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned by the CRM marketing automation engine reflecting the lead's engagement level and fit with ideal customer profile. Typically ranges 0–100. Inputs include email opens, web visits, content downloads, and firmographic match. Used to trigger automated nurture workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: sds_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead contact has requested a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for a chemical product of interest. SDS requests are a strong buying signal in chemical sales and indicate technical evaluation stage. Aligns with GHS SDS documentation requirements.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this lead record was sourced. For the customer_lead product, this is always 'salesforce_crm'. Supports data lineage tracking and multi-source reconciliation in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the prospective customer's primary operating location. Used for regional sales analysis, territory assignment, and regulatory jurisdiction mapping (e.g., state-level EPA or OSHA requirements).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; EPA; OSHA

attributes.name: technical_inquiry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead has submitted a technical inquiry requiring specialist response (e.g., formulation compatibility, regulatory compliance documentation, application engineering support). Triggers routing to technical sales or application development team.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: trade_show_name
attributes.description: Name of the trade show, industry conference, or event at which the lead was captured (e.g., 'ChemShow 2024', 'ACHEMA', 'ACS National Meeting'). Populated when lead_source = 'trade_show' or 'conference'. Used for event ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ACC Responsible Care Program

products.name: case
products.description: Customer service cases and support tickets covering the full spectrum of customer issues: technical assistance requests, order discrepancies, documentation requests (SDS, COA, COC), regulatory inquiries, and quality/OOS product complaints. This is the single source of truth for all customer-initiated issues and complaints. Captures case number, case type (technical support, order issue, SDS request, COA request, regulatory inquiry, quality complaint), priority, severity, status (open, in progress, resolved, closed), assigned service rep, SLA due date, resolution description, customer satisfaction rating. For quality complaints: product involved, lot number, batch reference, COA reference, complaint description, root cause investigation (RCI) status, CAPA reference, severity classification, credit note issued flag, and customer satisfaction outcome. Integrates with LabWare LIMS for OOS investigation, SAP QM for CAPA tracking, and Salesforce CRM Case object as system of record. Supports 8D problem-solving workflow for quality complaints.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the customer service case or support ticket. Primary key for the case data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that initiated or is associated with this case.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product involved in this case, particularly relevant for quality complaints, technical inquiries, and documentation requests (SDS, COA, COC).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; SAP QM

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer contact person who submitted or is the primary point of contact for this case.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal customer service representative or technical service engineer assigned to resolve this case.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Invoice Dispute Case Management requires linking each case to the specific invoice it concerns, enabling traceability for financial reconciliation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Order Issue Management report links each service case to the originating sales order for root‑cause analysis and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Allows linking support cases to related R&D projects, essential for issue escalation and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: The internal manufacturing batch reference number associated with the product involved in the case. Distinct from lot_number (which is the customer-facing identifier); batch_reference links to the production batch record in SAP PP and MES systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Batch; MES; GMP

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) record created in SAP QM in response to a quality complaint case. Links the customer case to the formal quality improvement workflow. Populated only when a CAPA has been initiated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM CAPA; ISO 9001 Clause 10.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: case_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the customer issue, request, or complaint as reported by the customer. For quality complaints, includes the customer's account of the product defect, observed symptoms, and business impact.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Description; ISO 9001 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable case reference number used in all customer communications and cross-system references. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Case Number field.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the case lifecycle. Open: newly created, awaiting assignment. In Progress: actively being worked. Pending Customer: awaiting customer response or information. Resolved: solution provided, awaiting confirmation. Closed: fully completed and confirmed.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Status; ISO 9001 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer case by business function. Technical Support covers formulation and application assistance; Order Issue covers shipment discrepancies and billing disputes; SDS (Safety Data Sheet) Request and COA (Certificate of Analysis) Request cover documentation fulfillment; Regulatory Inquiry covers REACH, TSCA, GHS compliance questions; Quality Complaint covers OOS (Out of Specification) product issues.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Type; GHS; REACH; TSCA; ISO 9001

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the customer submitted or initiated the case. Supports channel analytics and resource allocation for customer service operations.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the case was fully closed after customer confirmation of resolution. Distinct from resolved_date; a case may be resolved but remain open pending customer acknowledgment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Closed Date; ISO 9001

attributes.name: coa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) document associated with the product lot involved in the case. Used for quality complaints to cross-reference the analytical results at time of shipment against the customer's reported issue.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS COA; ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; GMP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the case record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker and is used for SLA calculation baseline.

attributes.name: credit_note_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial credit note has been issued to the customer as part of the resolution of a quality complaint or order discrepancy case. When True, a corresponding credit memo exists in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Credit Memo; SAP SD; SOX

attributes.name: credit_note_number
attributes.description: The SAP document number of the credit note issued to the customer for a quality complaint or order discrepancy resolution. Populated only when credit_note_issued is True. Enables financial reconciliation between the case and the accounting entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SAP SD Credit Memo; SOX; FASB

attributes.name: crm_case_code
attributes.description: The native case identifier from Salesforce CRM, the system of record for customer cases. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CRM system.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_outcome
attributes.description: Categorical outcome of the customer satisfaction assessment following case closure. Derived from the customer's qualitative feedback or survey response. Complements the numeric customer_satisfaction_rating for segmentation and reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; ISO 9001 Clause 9.1.2; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Numeric customer satisfaction score collected after case resolution, typically on a 1-5 scale (1=Very Dissatisfied, 5=Very Satisfied). Sourced from post-resolution customer survey. Used as a KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for customer service quality.

attributes.name: eight_d_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the 8D (Eight Disciplines) problem-solving report generated for a quality complaint case. The 8D methodology is the standard structured problem-solving workflow for quality complaints in chemical manufacturing. Populated when an 8D report has been formally initiated.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 10.2; SAP QM; AIAG 8D Standard; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: escalated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the case has been formally escalated beyond the initially assigned service representative, either due to SLA breach, severity, or customer request. Escalated cases trigger management notification workflows.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the case was formally escalated. Populated only when escalated is True. Used to measure escalation response time and identify systemic SLA failure patterns.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: The reason the case was escalated. SLA Breach: resolution deadline exceeded. Customer Request: customer demanded escalation. Safety Concern: potential EHS (Environment Health and Safety) implication. Regulatory Risk: potential regulatory non-compliance. Management Directive: escalated by management decision.

attributes.name: lims_investigation_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Investigation ID
attributes.description: The investigation record identifier in LabWare LIMS linked to this case for OOS (Out of Specification) product investigations. Populated when an OOS investigation has been initiated in the LIMS system in response to a quality complaint.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS OOS Investigation; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7; GMP

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing lot or batch lot number of the chemical product involved in a quality complaint or technical inquiry. Enables traceability back to the production batch for root cause investigation. Populated primarily for quality_complaint and technical_support case types.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Batch Management; LabWare LIMS; GMP; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the case record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse.

attributes.name: oos_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality complaint involves a product that has been confirmed as Out of Specification (OOS) against the product's Certificate of Analysis (COA) or specification sheet. When True, triggers mandatory OOS investigation workflow in LabWare LIMS.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS OOS Investigation; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7; GMP; FDA

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer case was officially opened and entered into the system. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) calculation and aging analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Created Date; ISO 9001

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the case, driving SLA (Service Level Agreement) response and resolution targets. Critical priority is reserved for safety-related quality complaints or regulatory non-compliance issues.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Priority; OSHA PSM; ISO 9001

attributes.name: rci_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Root Cause Investigation (RCI) triggered by a quality complaint. Tracks whether the investigation into the product defect or OOS (Out of Specification) condition has been initiated, is ongoing, or has been completed. Applicable only to quality_complaint case type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001 Clause 10.2; CAPA

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The specific regulatory framework or standard that is the subject of a regulatory inquiry case. Identifies whether the customer's inquiry relates to REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals), TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act), GHS (Globally Harmonized System), or other applicable regulation. Populated for regulatory_inquiry case type.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA; GHS; ECHA; EPA

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the actions taken and solution provided to resolve the customer case. For quality complaints, includes findings from the RCI (Root Cause Investigation) and corrective actions applied.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Resolution; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7; CAPA

attributes.name: resolved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the case was marked as resolved, meaning the solution or response was provided to the customer. Used to calculate actual resolution time against SLA targets.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Closed Date; ISO 9001

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: The document control number of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) provided or referenced in response to an SDS request case. Enables traceability of which SDS version was fulfilled. Applicable to sds_request case type.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) SDS Requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Article 31; ECHA

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the issue impact on the customer's operations or safety. Distinct from priority (which drives internal response urgency), severity reflects the actual business or safety impact of the reported issue. Critical severity triggers mandatory CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) and RCI (Root Cause Investigation) workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.7; SAP QM Defect Classification; OSHA

attributes.name: sla_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the case resolution exceeded the SLA due date, constituting an SLA breach. Used for service quality reporting, customer penalty tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual or policy-defined deadline by which the case must be resolved, based on case type, priority, and applicable customer SLA agreement. Drives escalation workflows when breached.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case SLA; ISO 9001 Clause 8.2

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this case record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce CRM; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief, descriptive title summarizing the customer issue or request. Used as the primary display label in case management queues and customer communications.

products.name: account_document
products.description: Repository of customer account-level documents and acknowledgments including signed agreements, customer qualification certificates, ISO certifications, EHS audit reports, import/export licenses, customer-specific labeling requirements, and Safety Data Sheet (SDS/MSDS) acknowledgment records. Captures document type, document title, file reference, version, effective date, expiry date, issuing authority, document status, acknowledgment method (for SDS: electronic, signed, portal), GHS revision, and regulatory jurisdiction. Provides audit trail for regulatory inspections, product liability defense, and GHS/OSHA HazCom compliance.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Files / SAP DMS Document Management

attributes.name: account_document_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer account document record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account to which this document belongs. Links the document to the customer master record.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Document creation audit requires linking to the employee who authored the account document for compliance and traceability.

attributes.name: superseded_by_document_account_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer account_document record that replaces this document when it has been superseded by a revised version. Enables document version chain traceability for audit and compliance purposes. Null if this is the current active version.

attributes.name: acknowledged_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the customer representative who acknowledged the document. Captured for audit trail and product liability defense purposes. Particularly important for SDS acknowledgments under OSHA HazCom.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer formally acknowledged receipt or acceptance of the document. Required for SDS acknowledgment audit trails under OSHA HazCom compliance. Null if acknowledgment has not yet been received.

attributes.name: acknowledgment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the customer acknowledged receipt of the document, particularly for SDS/MSDS acknowledgments. Electronic acknowledgment via digital signature, signed physical copy, customer portal confirmation, email confirmation, or fax. Null or not_applicable for documents that do not require acknowledgment.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS Rev 9; ESIGN Act

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the internal authority who approved this document record for use in customer account management. Required for SOX-compliant audit trails and quality management system documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.5; SOX Section 302; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the document record was formally approved by the designated internal authority. Provides precise audit trail for compliance inspections and product liability defense.

attributes.name: coa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document specifies or mandates that a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must accompany product shipments to this customer. Drives order fulfillment and quality documentation workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: coc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document specifies or mandates that a Certificate of Compliance (COC) must accompany product shipments to this customer. Supports quality assurance and regulatory compliance for customer deliveries.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this document record was first created in the system. Provides the foundational audit trail entry for the document lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.5; SOX Section 802 - Document Retention

attributes.name: customer_labeling_requirement
attributes.description: Description of customer-specific labeling requirements captured in this document, such as proprietary label formats, language requirements, GHS pictogram specifications, or private-label branding instructions. Relevant for product packaging and distribution compliance.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; IFRA; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: document_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the document for reporting and analytics. Enables segmentation across regulatory compliance, commercial agreements, quality certifications, safety documentation, trade compliance, and customer-specific requirements.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or reference number assigned to the document, such as a certificate number, agreement reference, or license number issued by the issuing authority or internal document management system.

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document. Active documents are valid and in force. Expired documents have passed their expiry date. Pending renewal documents are approaching expiry and renewal is in progress. Superseded documents have been replaced by a newer version. Revoked documents have been invalidated by the issuing authority.

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the document as it appears on the official record, such as 'ISO 9001 Quality Management Certificate', 'SDS Acknowledgment Agreement', or 'Customer EHS Audit Report'.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document by its business purpose. Drives workflow routing, retention rules, and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: signed_agreement|qualification_certificate|iso_certification|ehs_audit_report|import_export_license|sds_acknowledgment|labeling_requirement|coa_requirement|reach_declaration|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.5; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document becomes legally or operationally binding and valid. For certifications, this is the issuance date. For agreements, this is the contract start date.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document ceases to be valid or requires renewal. Null for open-ended documents with no defined expiration. Used to trigger renewal workflows and compliance alerts.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; DOT 49 CFR - Hazardous Materials

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Format of the stored document file. PDF is the standard for regulatory submissions and signed agreements. Used to determine rendering and archival requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PDF|DOCX|XLSX|JPG|PNG|XML|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: file_reference
attributes.description: Storage path, URL, or document management system reference pointing to the actual document file (e.g., SharePoint path, S3 URI, Salesforce ContentDocument ID). Enables retrieval of the source document for audit and inspection purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.5; SOX Section 802 - Document Retention

attributes.name: ghs_revision
attributes.description: The revision number of the Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals (GHS) standard under which the associated SDS was prepared (e.g., 'Rev 7', 'Rev 8', 'Rev 9'). Required to confirm SDS currency and compliance with current GHS requirements.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) - UN Rev 9; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: import_export_license_number
attributes.description: Official license number assigned by the relevant trade authority for import or export of controlled chemicals. Populated when document_type is import_export_license. Required for trade compliance and customs clearance documentation.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; EPA Import/Export Rules; TSCA Section 13; EAR (Export Administration Regulations)

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal comments, context, or instructions related to this document record. Not shared externally. Used by account managers, compliance teams, and customer service representatives to capture relevant context.

attributes.name: iso_standard_code
attributes.description: The specific ISO standard number referenced by this document (e.g., 'ISO 9001:2015', 'ISO 14001:2015', 'ISO 45001:2018'). Populated for ISO certification documents. Null for non-ISO documents.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the organization, regulatory body, or certification body that issued or authenticated the document (e.g., 'Bureau Veritas', 'TÜV Rheinland', 'EPA', 'ECHA', 'U.S. Customs and Border Protection'). Critical for validating document authenticity.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; EPA; ECHA REACH; DOT; FDA

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country in which the document was issued. Used for trade compliance, import/export license validation, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; DOT 49 CFR; ECHA REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the import/export license covers import activities, export activities, or both. Populated when document_type is import_export_license. Null or not_applicable for non-license documents.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; EAR (Export Administration Regulations); TSCA Section 13

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this document record was last updated in the system. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: ECHA-assigned REACH registration number associated with this document when the document relates to REACH compliance declarations or substance registration. Format follows ECHA numbering convention (e.g., '01-XXXXXXXXXX-XX-XXXX').

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction or geographic scope under which the document is valid (e.g., 'USA', 'EU', 'APAC', 'Global'). Determines which regulatory framework governs the document's requirements and enforcement.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; TSCA; EPA; ECHA; GHS

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_date
attributes.description: Date on which an automated or manual renewal reminder should be triggered, typically set a defined number of days before the expiry date. Supports proactive compliance management and prevents lapses in required documentation.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document requires periodic renewal before the expiry date. True for time-limited certifications, licenses, and agreements. Drives automated renewal reminder workflows and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was last reviewed internally for validity, completeness, and continued compliance. Supports periodic document review cycles required under ISO 9001 and regulatory frameworks.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the internal staff member who reviewed and validated this document for completeness and compliance. Part of the document control audit trail.

attributes.name: sds_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document record represents a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) acknowledgment from the customer. True when the document type is an SDS/MSDS receipt acknowledgment required under OSHA HazCom.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS Rev 9

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this document record originated. Salesforce CRM is the primary system of record for customer account documents. Supports data lineage and integration traceability.

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: The primary key or unique identifier of this document record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce ContentDocument ID, SAP document number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing.

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document serves as evidence of TSCA compliance for the customer account. True when the document is a TSCA certification, import certification, or compliance declaration under the Toxic Substances Control Act.
attributes.references: TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act) - 15 U.S.C. §2601; EPA

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier of the document as assigned by the issuing authority or internal document control system (e.g., '1.0', 'Rev B', '2024-v3'). Critical for document control and audit trail purposes.

products.name: supply_contract
products.description: Represents a contractual agreement between a customer account and a raw material, capturing the terms of supply such as start/end dates, price, and volume. Each record links one account to one material and stores attributes that belong to the contract itself.. Existence Justification: Customer accounts negotiate and manage supply contracts for raw materials. Each contract links one account to one material and records start/end dates, agreed price, and volume, allowing many accounts to contract for many materials and vice‑versa.

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the supply_contract association

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer account

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the raw material master

attributes.name: agreed_price
attributes.description: Unit price agreed for the material in this contract

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply contract expires

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply contract becomes effective

attributes.name: volume_kg
attributes.description: Total volume of material agreed for the contract (kilograms)

domains.name: production
domains.description: Core manufacturing execution domain managing batch and continuous chemical processes, reaction sequences, synthesis operations, and production runs. Includes production orders, batch records, process parameters (temperature, pressure, pH), DCS/PLC integration data (Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7), MES execution logs, yield tracking, lot genealogy, BOM consumption, MOC records, and production scheduling. Captures real-time process data from SCADA systems and maintains production history for traceability and process optimization (SPC, OEE).

products.name: manufacturing_order
products.description: Core execution entity authorizing and tracking the manufacture of a chemical product or intermediate, serving as the single ISA-95 Level 3 production order and ISA-88 batch control entity. Captures order number, order type (batch/continuous/semi-continuous), master recipe reference (PI sheet), process order type, planned and actual quantities, unit of measure, scheduled and actual start/finish dates, order status lifecycle (created, released, started, confirmed, technically complete, closed), priority, plant, work center assignment, BOM reference, routing/recipe reference, production version, MES integration ID, DCS control recipe destination, phase sequence, settlement rule, cost estimate vs actual cost, yield target, and variance analysis flags. The single source of truth for 'what are we making, when, and how much' — the central entity that batch records, BOM consumption, yield records, deviations, and campaigns all reference.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for manufacturing_order

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Required for order fulfillment: each manufacturing order must be linked to the customer account that placed the order, enabling production scheduling, invoicing, and customer‑specific reporting.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Bill of Materials defining the raw materials, intermediates, and components required for this production order.
attributes.references: SAP PP BOM, ISA-95 Material Definition

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this order to a multi-batch production campaign. Used for extended runs of the same product to optimize changeover and yield.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Production order execution needs product master to fetch specifications, SDS, and regulatory compliance for the material being produced.

attributes.name: control_recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the control recipe instance downloaded to the DCS (Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7) for automated execution of process phases and unit procedures.
attributes.references: ISA-88 Control Recipe, DCS Batch Management

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for Production Cost Allocation Report: each manufacturing order must be charged to a cost center for monthly cost accounting.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.demand_forecast. Business justification: Order release uses the demand forecast that generated the manufacturing order; linking enables the Order Release report.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or name of the production planner or system user who created the production order.
attributes.references: SAP User Master, SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: formula_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula. Business justification: Production Order Specification Report requires the exact formula to be produced; planners assign a formula to each manufacturing order.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Manufacturing Order Planning uses material_master for specs, hazard data, and costing; linking provides single source of truth for each order.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Margin tracking: each manufacturing order references the sales price list used for the customer order to align production cost with pricing.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Production planning ties each manufacturing order to the purchase order that supplies its raw materials, enabling material availability and cost tracking.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: PRODUCTION: Production orders are generated from approved sales quotes; linking enables traceability, cost accounting, and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Required for new‑product launch reporting linking each manufacturing order to its originating R&D project for cost allocation and regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the production routing or master recipe defining the sequence of operations, process steps, and control parameters.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing, ISA-88 Master Recipe

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Required for Production Order Material Allocation Report linking each order to the allocated stock position.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the primary work center (production line, reactor, blending unit) assigned to execute this order.
attributes.references: SAP PP Work Center Master, ISA-95 Equipment

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost incurred for this production order, settled from material consumption, labor confirmations, and activity allocations.
attributes.references: SAP CO Order Settlement, FASB Cost Accounting

attributes.name: actual_finish_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when production execution completed, including final operation confirmation and goods receipt posting.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Production Performance, MES Event Log

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of finished product manufactured and confirmed via goods receipt. Used for yield calculation and variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP PP Confirmation, ISA-95 Production Performance

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when production execution began, typically captured from MES or DCS system when the first operation started.
attributes.references: ISA-95 Production Performance, MES Event Log

attributes.name: actual_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated yield percentage achieved in this production run: (actual output / theoretical output) * 100. Key performance indicator for process efficiency.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Unique lot or batch number assigned to the output of this production order. Critical for traceability, COA issuance, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: cost_estimate
attributes.description: Planned total cost for this production order, including raw materials, labor, utilities, and overhead. Used for cost accounting and variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO Product Costing, FASB Cost Accounting

attributes.name: cost_variance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that actual cost exceeded planned cost by a threshold percentage, triggering variance investigation and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO Variance Analysis, Management Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the production order record was first created in the ERP system, marking the beginning of the order lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP PP Order Creation, Audit Trail

attributes.name: dcs_batch_reference
attributes.description: Batch identifier assigned by the DCS (Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7) for automated process control and SCADA data historian linkage.
attributes.references: ISA-88 Batch Control, DCS Batch Management

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicator that one or more process deviations, out-of-specification events, or quality exceptions occurred during production execution.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the quality inspection lot created for this production order output, linking to LIMS test results and Certificate of Analysis.
attributes.references: SAP QM Inspection Lot, LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the production order, supporting change tracking and accountability.
attributes.references: SAP User Master, SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the production order record, capturing any changes to quantities, dates, or status.

attributes.name: master_recipe_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the master recipe or Process Instruction (PI) sheet governing the synthesis, reaction conditions, and quality parameters for this product.

attributes.name: mes_integration_reference
attributes.description: External identifier used for integration with MES systems. Links ERP production order to MES work order for real-time execution tracking.

attributes.name: moc_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for any Management of Change request associated with this production order, documenting process deviations or recipe modifications.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the production order, externally visible and used across systems. Typically follows plant-specific numbering conventions.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Order, ISA-88 Batch Control

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production order: created (planned but not released), released (authorized for execution), started (production begun), in_progress (active manufacturing), confirmed (goods receipt posted), technically_complete (production finished, pending final settlement), closed (financially settled), cancelled (order voided). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|released|started|in_progress|confirmed|technically_complete|closed|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP PP Order Status, ISA-95 Production Performance

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the manufacturing process mode: batch (discrete lots), continuous (steady-state flow), semi-continuous (hybrid), campaign (extended multi-batch run), rework (reprocessing off-spec material), or trial (R&D pilot run).

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Target quantity of finished product to be manufactured, as specified in the production order. Expressed in the base unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP PP Order Quantity, ISA-95 Production Request

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or production facility where the order is executed.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Scheduling priority ranking for the production order. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by MES and DCS systems for sequencing and resource allocation.

attributes.name: process_order_type
attributes.description: Specific classification of the order purpose: standard (normal production), rework (reprocessing), trial (R&D pilot), validation (process qualification), cleaning (CIP campaign).
attributes.references: GMP Process Validation, SAP PP Order Type

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Four-digit version number linking the specific BOM and routing combination used for this order. Enables traceability of recipe changes over time.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicator that finished product must undergo quality control inspection and COA issuance before release to inventory or shipment.
attributes.references: SAP QM Inspection Lot, ISO 9001 Quality Control

attributes.name: scheduled_finish_date
attributes.description: Planned date for production order completion, including all manufacturing operations and goods receipt confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Scheduling, ISA-95 Schedule

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date for production order to begin execution, as determined by production scheduling and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Scheduling, ISA-95 Schedule

attributes.name: settlement_rule
attributes.description: Configuration defining how production order costs are settled to inventory, cost centers, or profitability segments upon order closure.
attributes.references: SAP CO Settlement, Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the production quantity: KG (kilograms), L (liters), MT (metric tons), GAL (gallons), LB (pounds), TON (short tons), M3 (cubic meters). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|L|MT|GAL|LB|TON|M3 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: yield_target_percentage
attributes.description: Expected yield percentage based on master recipe and historical performance. Used as benchmark for variance analysis and process optimization.
attributes.references: ISA-88 Batch Report, SPC Yield Analysis

products.name: batch_record
products.description: Electronic Batch Record (EBR) and complete MES execution audit trail serving as the authoritative manufacturing history for a single production batch (21 CFR Part 11 compliant). Captures batch number (LOT), batch size, batch status (in-process, released, rejected, quarantine), manufacturing date, expiry/retest dates, manufacturing order reference, formula/recipe version, and the full step-by-step execution log: MES transaction IDs, recipe phases executed, execution start/end timestamps per step, operator IDs, equipment IDs, actual parameter values entered, electronic signatures (21 CFR Part 11), instruction text displayed, operator responses/confirmations, exception flags, deviation count, review/approval signatures, GMP compliance flag, COA linkage, regulatory hold flags, and MES system version. The single authoritative document for batch genealogy tracing, regulatory audits, GMP batch release, electronic records compliance, and production floor execution verification.
products.reference: Electronic Batch Record (EBR) / SAP QM Batch

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the electronic batch record. Primary key for the batch record entity. Serves as the authoritative reference for all batch-level traceability, genealogy, and regulatory audit requirements.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Batch record must reference the specific chemical product to associate batch data with product specifications and compliance documents.

attributes.name: destination_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Needed for logistics and traceability: batch records must reference the customer site where the product will be delivered, supporting shipping plans, regulatory SDS/COA delivery, and site‑level yield

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Primary reactor, vessel, or processing unit used for this batch. Links to the equipment master for asset tracking and maintenance correlation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM (Plant Maintenance); ISO 55001 (Asset Management)

attributes.name: experimental_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_formulation. Business justification: Ensures batch traceability to the exact experimental formulation developed in R&D, needed for quality audits and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: formula_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master formula or recipe used for this batch. Captures the formulation version and Bill of Materials (BOM) applied during production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP (Recipe Management); GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: formula_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula_version. Business justification: Batch records must capture the exact formula version used for regulatory traceability and deviation analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: FK to quality.inspection_lot.inspection_lot_id — Batch-to-QC traceability is mandatory for cGMP compliance. Every batch record must link to its quality inspection lot for release decisions. Without this, cannot answer 'what QC results exist for batc

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Needed for Batch‑Level Expense Tracking: batches are billed against internal orders to capture project‑specific production costs.

attributes.name: line_item_id
