attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.line_item. Business justification: Batch‑to‑order line mapping enables batch traceability, invoicing, and regulatory batch‑lot reporting for each sold line item.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Enables batch traceability required by FDA/EMA regulations linking batch records to physical lots.

attributes.name: maintenance_notification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.notification. Business justification: Needed for Batch Execution Log to capture the maintenance notification that caused a batch hold, used in compliance and downtime analysis reports.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order that authorized this batch. Links the batch record to the planning and scheduling system (SAP PP Production Planning).

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to planning.mrp_run. Business justification: Each batch record originates from an MRP run; linking supports the Batch‑to‑MRP traceability audit.

attributes.name: primary_batch_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary operator or production technician responsible for executing this batch. Used for accountability, training tracking, and electronic signature compliance (21 CFR Part 11).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); ISO 9001

attributes.name: quaternary_batch_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authorized person (typically QA manager or production manager) who gave final approval for batch release. Required for GMP batch release authorization.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote_line. Business justification: BATCH: Each batch fulfills a specific quote line; FK supports batch‑level traceability to sales commitments and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: supply_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.goods_receipt. Business justification: REQUIRED: Quality and traceability reports link each batch record to the goods receipt that delivered the raw material lot.

attributes.name: tertiary_batch_reviewed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality assurance (QA) or quality control (QC) personnel who reviewed this batch record. Required for GMP compliance and electronic signature audit trail.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); 21 CFR Part 11; QA (Quality Assurance)

attributes.name: actual_yield_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity produced by this batch after completion. Used to calculate yield percentage, material efficiency, and production performance (OEE - Overall Equipment Effectiveness).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; ISO 22400 (Key Performance Indicators for Manufacturing)

attributes.name: actual_yield_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the actual yield quantity. Should match batch_size_uom for yield percentage calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 (Quantities and Units); SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the batch record received final approval for release to inventory. Part of the electronic signature audit trail and batch release documentation.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique batch identifier (LOT number) used for product traceability, customer communication, Certificate of Analysis (COA) issuance, and regulatory reporting. Must be globally unique across all production history.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 9001; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: batch_size_quantity
attributes.description: Planned or target quantity for this batch expressed in the base unit of measure. Used for yield calculation, material consumption planning, and production scheduling.

attributes.name: batch_size_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the batch size quantity (e.g., KG, L, MT, GAL). Must align with the formula base unit and inventory unit of measure.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 (Quantities and Units); SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the batch in the manufacturing execution workflow. Governs whether the batch can be released to inventory, requires quality review, or is blocked for regulatory or quality reasons.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); ISO 9001; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: coa_issued_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that a Certificate of Analysis (COA) has been issued for this batch. COA is required for customer shipments and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); COA (Certificate of Analysis)

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Certificate of Analysis issued for this batch. Links the batch record to the quality test results and customer documentation.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or supervisor comments, observations, or notes about the batch execution. Used for capturing contextual information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this batch record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for electronic records compliance (21 CFR Part 11).

attributes.name: dcs_batch_reference
attributes.description: Unique batch identifier from the Distributed Control System (Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7) that executed the process automation. Links the batch record to real-time process data historian (Aveva PI System).
attributes.references: Honeywell Experion DCS; Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7; Aveva PI System

attributes.name: deviation_count
attributes.description: Number of process deviations, exceptions, or Out of Specification (OOS) events recorded during batch execution. Triggers CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) and RCI (Root Cause Investigation) workflows.
attributes.references: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action); GMP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that one or more exceptions occurred during batch execution. Used to filter batches requiring quality review or management attention.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the batch is no longer suitable for use or sale. Calculated based on manufacturing date and product shelf-life specification. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); ISO 9001; FEFO Inventory Practice

attributes.name: formula_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the formula or recipe used for this batch. Critical for traceability when formulas are revised due to MOC (Management of Change) or process optimization.
attributes.references: MOC (Management of Change); ISO 9001; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this batch was produced under GMP-compliant conditions and meets all regulatory requirements for pharmaceutical or food-contact chemical production.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); FDA (Food and Drug Administration)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this batch record was last updated. Part of the audit trail for electronic records compliance and change tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of batch production. Used for shelf-life calculation, expiry date determination, and regulatory labeling (GHS - Globally Harmonized System).

attributes.name: manufacturing_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when batch production was completed and the batch was ready for quality inspection. Used for cycle time analysis and production scheduling.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA PP; Honeywell Experion DCS

attributes.name: manufacturing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when batch production was initiated on the manufacturing floor. Captured from MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or DCS (Distributed Control System) transaction log.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA PP; Honeywell Experion DCS

attributes.name: mes_system_version
attributes.description: Version of the MES or DCS system that recorded this batch. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and system validation audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); MES (Manufacturing Execution System)

attributes.name: mes_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the MES system that initiated or recorded this batch. Used for audit trail linkage and electronic records compliance (21 CFR Part 11).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); MES (Manufacturing Execution System)

attributes.name: process_ph_avg
attributes.description: Average pH level during the critical reaction phase. Key process parameter for chemical synthesis quality control and product specification compliance.
attributes.references: SPC (Statistical Process Control); ISO 9001; pH (Potential of Hydrogen)

attributes.name: process_pressure_avg
attributes.description: Average process pressure during the critical reaction phase, measured in bar. Key process parameter for quality control and process safety management (PSM).
attributes.references: PSM (Process Safety Management); SPC; Honeywell Experion DCS

attributes.name: process_temperature_avg
attributes.description: Average process temperature during the critical reaction phase, measured in degrees Celsius. Key process parameter for quality control and SPC (Statistical Process Control) analysis.
attributes.references: SPC (Statistical Process Control); ISO 9001; Honeywell Experion DCS

attributes.name: reaction_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the chemical reaction phase in minutes. Critical process parameter for yield optimization and product quality consistency.

attributes.name: recipe_phase_executed
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or summary of recipe phases executed during this batch (e.g., charging, heating, reaction, cooling, discharge). Provides high-level execution summary for batch genealogy.
attributes.references: ISA-88 (Batch Control Standard); SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this batch is under regulatory hold and cannot be released to inventory or shipped until regulatory clearance is obtained. May be set by EHS (Environment Health and Safety) or quality assurance.
attributes.references: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency); OSHA; EHS (Environment Health and Safety)

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date when the batch must be retested to confirm continued compliance with quality specifications. Common for raw materials and intermediate products with extended storage periods.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the batch record review and approval workflow. Governs whether the batch can be released to inventory or requires additional quality or management review.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); ISO 9001; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the batch record was reviewed and approved or rejected by quality assurance. Part of the electronic signature audit trail (21 CFR Part 11).

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated yield efficiency as a percentage of actual yield to planned batch size. Key performance indicator for production efficiency and process optimization (SPC - Statistical Process Control).
attributes.references: ISO 22400 (KPI for Manufacturing); SPC (Statistical Process Control)

products.name: process_order
products.description: SAP PP Process Order entity representing a discrete manufacturing execution instruction for a chemical synthesis or blending run. Distinct from production_order in that it is specifically tied to a master recipe (PI sheet) and process industry workflow. Captures process order number, recipe reference, process order type, plant, production version, scheduled quantities, actual confirmed quantities, phase sequence, control recipe destination (DCS/PLC system ID), MES integration status, settlement rule, and variance analysis flags. Used for batch and continuous chemical process manufacturing.

attributes.name: process_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process order. Primary key for the process order entity in the SAP PP (Production Planning) module.
attributes.references: SAP PP Process Order Master Data

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking multiple process orders in a production campaign. Used for extended manufacturing runs of the same product to minimize changeover, reduce CIP cycles, and optimize asset utilization.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Process order scheduling and quality checks depend on product master to obtain recipe, hazard class, and regulatory data.

attributes.name: control_recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the control recipe downloaded to the DCS (Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7) or PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) for automated execution. Links master recipe to real-time process control logic.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the production planner or scheduler who created the process order. Used for audit trail and SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance.

attributes.name: formula_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula_version. Business justification: Process Order Execution Sheet tracks the specific formula version executed for compliance and quality release.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Required for Production‑Maintenance Coordination Report that matches each process order with its scheduled maintenance work order to avoid line conflicts.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Process Order Execution requires raw‑material safety and quality data; FK enables real‑time compliance checks.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: Production scheduling dashboards require linking process orders directly to the originating sales order for capacity planning and KPI tracking.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote_line. Business justification: PROCESS_ORDER: Schedules execution of a quoted line item; linking enables alignment of production planning with sales commitments.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Supports Process Order Planned Inventory Allocation used in material planning dashboards.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when manufacturing execution completed and product was discharged, as confirmed by MES or operator. Triggers quality inspection workflow and lot release process.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when manufacturing execution began, as confirmed by MES or operator. Used for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation and schedule variance analysis.

attributes.name: batch_size_category
attributes.description: Classification of process order scale. Lab for R&D bench-scale (<10kg), pilot for scale-up trials (10-1000kg), commercial for standard production (>1000kg), full_scale for maximum reactor capacity utilization.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of finished product manufactured and confirmed by operator or MES. May differ from planned due to yield loss, reaction efficiency, or quality rejections.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center to which process order costs (raw materials, labor, utilities, overhead) are allocated. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation and OpEx (Operating Expenditure) tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the process order record was created in SAP PP. Marks the beginning of the order lifecycle for lead time analysis and planning cycle measurement.

attributes.name: dcs_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the DCS or SCADA system instance managing this process order. Maps to Honeywell Experion, Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7, or Aveva PI System historian for real-time data integration.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: EPA or state environmental permit number authorizing manufacture of this chemical. Required for VOC (Volatile Organic Compound), HAP (Hazardous Air Pollutant), and TRI reportable substances. Links to air quality monitoring and emissions reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Title V Permits

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification for the product being manufactured. Determines PSM (Process Safety Management) requirements, permit-to-work rules, and EHS monitoring. Aligns with SDS Section 2 hazard identification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_hazardous|flammable|corrosive|toxic|oxidizer|explosive|reactive — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: SAP QM inspection lot number created for quality testing. Links process order to LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) sample management and COA generation workflow.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the last person to update the process order. Tracks changes to quantities, dates, or status for change management and compliance audit.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the process order record. Used for data synchronization, incremental ETL, and change data capture in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Unique lot or batch number assigned to the finished product for traceability. Links to COA (Certificate of Analysis), lot genealogy, and regulatory reporting (TRI - Toxics Release Inventory, TSCA - Toxic Substances Control Act). Required for GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) compliance.

attributes.name: mes_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of process order synchronization with MES. Tracks order handoff from SAP PP to shop floor execution system. Failed status triggers manual intervention and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) workflow.

attributes.name: moc_number
attributes.description: Management of Change request number if this process order executes under modified conditions (new raw material supplier, revised process parameters, equipment substitution). Required for PSM compliance and HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study) review.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the process order. Created indicates planning stage, released means approved for execution, in_progress indicates active manufacturing, confirmed means operator has reported completion, completed indicates all confirmations and quality checks done, closed means financially settled, cancelled means order terminated, on_hold indicates temporary suspension pending MOC (Management of Change) or safety review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|released|in_progress|confirmed|completed|closed|cancelled|on_hold — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the process order based on manufacturing execution mode. Batch for discrete lot production, continuous for ongoing flow processes, campaign for extended multi-batch runs, rework for reprocessing OOS (Out of Specification) material, trial for R&D (Research and Development) scale-up, pilot for pre-commercial validation.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for process order completion and final product discharge. Used for capacity planning and customer delivery commitments.

attributes.name: planned_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp for scheduled process order completion. Includes reaction time, cooling, CIP (Clean In Place), and quality hold time.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Target quantity of finished product to be manufactured in this process order. Expressed in base unit of measure from material master (kg, L, MT).

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for process order release and initiation of manufacturing operations. Used for production scheduling, raw material staging, and resource allocation.

attributes.name: planned_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp for scheduled process order start. Critical for continuous processes and multi-stage reaction sequences requiring tight timing control.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant where the process order is executed. Maps to SAP plant master data and determines applicable EHS (Environment Health and Safety) regulations, DCS system instance, and local SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) library.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Scheduling priority for the process order. Urgent for customer expedite or safety stock replenishment, high for committed delivery dates, normal for standard production, low for inventory build.

attributes.name: process_order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the process order. Unique alphanumeric code used across SAP PP, MES (Manufacturing Execution System), and DCS (Distributed Control System) integration points.
attributes.references: SAP PP Process Order Master Data

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific production line, reactor train, or blending unit where the process order is scheduled. Links to P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) and SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) tag hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP PP Work Center Master Data

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Four-digit version number linking the material to a specific BOM and routing combination. Enables multiple manufacturing pathways for the same product (e.g., different catalyst systems, alternate raw materials under REACH compliance).

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that finished product requires QC (Quality Control) inspection and COA generation before lot release. True for GMP products, API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient), food-contact chemicals, and customer-specific quality agreements.

attributes.name: recipe_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the master recipe (PI sheet) that defines the synthesis pathway, reaction sequence, process parameters, and control strategy. Links to BOM (Bill of Materials), routing, and control recipe in DCS.

attributes.name: settlement_rule
attributes.description: Financial settlement method for process order costs. Standard for normal production, variance for cost deviation analysis, scrap for write-off of OOS material, rework for reprocessing cost allocation. Links to FI/CO (Finance and Controlling) cost center settlement.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for quantity fields. KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, GAL for gallons, LB for pounds, TON for short tons. Must align with material master UOM.

attributes.name: variance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that actual results (yield, cycle time, cost) deviated significantly from plan. True triggers variance analysis workflow and potential RCI (Root Cause Investigation) for process improvement.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated yield as percentage of actual output versus theoretical maximum based on stoichiometry and recipe. Used for process optimization, SPC (Statistical Process Control), and variance analysis. Formula: (confirmed_quantity / theoretical_quantity) * 100.

products.name: batch_genealogy
products.description: Tracks the parent-child lineage of chemical batches through multi-stage synthesis and blending operations. Records upstream raw material lot numbers, intermediate batch numbers, and downstream finished goods batch numbers involved in a production run. Captures relationship type (consumed, produced, split, merged), quantity transferred, transfer date, process step, and traceability chain depth. Enables full forward and backward lot traceability required by FDA, REACH, and customer COA requests. Links raw material batches through intermediates to finished product batches.

attributes.name: batch_genealogy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the batch genealogy record tracking parent-child lineage relationships between chemical batches.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the production operator who executed or confirmed the batch transfer creating this genealogy relationship.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.manufacturing_order. Business justification: Link batch genealogy to its manufacturing order for traceability; production_order_number is redundant once the FK exists.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Batch Genealogy traceability links each child batch to the originating raw material for audit and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: bom_item_number
attributes.description: The BOM item number from the production recipe that defines this parent-child material relationship. Links to SAP PP BOM structure.

attributes.name: child_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch number of the downstream child batch (intermediate or finished good) produced in this production relationship. Part of the lot genealogy traceability chain.

attributes.name: coa_reference_number
attributes.description: The COA reference number associated with this batch genealogy relationship, linking to quality test results and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, GMP Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: consumption_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the parent batch consumed to produce the child batch, enabling yield and material balance calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this batch genealogy record was first created in the system, providing audit trail for data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: customer_order_number
attributes.description: The customer order number if this batch genealogy relationship was created for a specific customer order, enabling customer-specific traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales and Distribution

attributes.name: dcs_batch_reference
attributes.description: The batch identifier from the DCS (Honeywell Experion or Siemens PCS 7) that recorded this batch relationship in real-time process control.
attributes.references: Honeywell Experion DCS, Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7

attributes.name: deviation_number
attributes.description: The deviation number if this batch relationship occurred under non-standard conditions requiring documentation and approval.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the child batch produced in this genealogy relationship, inherited or calculated from parent batch shelf life.
attributes.references: GMP Good Manufacturing Practice, FEFO First Expired First Out

attributes.name: genealogy_status
attributes.description: The current status of this batch genealogy record: active (normal traceability), archived (historical record), quarantined (batch under quality hold), recalled (batch subject to recall action).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, FDA Recall Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this batch genealogy record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: mes_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The MES transaction identifier that recorded this batch genealogy event, providing audit trail linkage to the execution system.
attributes.references: MES Manufacturing Execution System, ISA-95 Manufacturing Operations

attributes.name: moc_number
attributes.description: The MOC number if this batch genealogy relationship was created under a process change or deviation. Links to EHS Management of Change records.
attributes.references: PSM Process Safety Management, OSHA Process Safety Management

attributes.name: parent_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch number of the upstream parent batch (raw material or intermediate) consumed in this production relationship. Part of the lot genealogy traceability chain.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant code where this batch genealogy relationship was created. Links to SAP organizational structure.

attributes.name: process_step_code
attributes.description: The specific process step or operation code in the manufacturing route where this batch relationship occurred (e.g., synthesis, blending, filtration, drying). Maps to MES (Manufacturing Execution System) operation codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Planning, MES Manufacturing Execution System

attributes.name: process_step_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the process step where the batch relationship occurred, providing context for the genealogy link.

attributes.name: quality_status
attributes.description: The quality status of the batch relationship at the time of transfer: released (approved for use), blocked (quality hold), restricted (conditional use), inspection (pending QC).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Quality Management, ISO 9001

attributes.name: quantity_transferred
attributes.description: The quantity of material transferred from parent batch to child batch in this genealogy relationship. Measured in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this batch genealogy relationship meets all applicable regulatory traceability requirements (REACH, FDA, TSCA). True if compliant, False if non-compliant or pending verification.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, TSCA Toxic Substances Control Act

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: The type of genealogy relationship between parent and child batches: consumed (parent used to make child), produced (child created from parent), split (one parent divided into multiple children), merged (multiple parents combined into one child), blended (multiple parents mixed into child), reworked (defective batch reprocessed).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks or notes about this batch genealogy relationship, capturing any special conditions, observations, or contextual information.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The source system that created this batch genealogy record: SAP_PP (SAP Production Planning), MES (Manufacturing Execution System), DCS (Distributed Control System), LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System), MANUAL (manual entry).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA, MES, Honeywell Experion DCS, Siemens PCS 7, LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The storage location code where the batch transfer occurred or where the child batch was placed after production.

attributes.name: traceability_chain_depth
attributes.description: The depth level of this batch relationship in the overall genealogy chain, where 1 represents direct parent-child, 2 represents grandparent-grandchild, etc. Enables multi-level traceability queries.

attributes.name: traceability_direction
attributes.description: The direction of traceability this record supports: forward (parent to child), backward (child to parent), or bidirectional (both directions).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The date when the material transfer from parent to child batch occurred, establishing the temporal sequence in the genealogy chain.

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the material transfer from parent to child batch was recorded in the MES or DCS system, providing exact traceability timing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, MES Manufacturing Execution System

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity transferred: KG (kilogram), L (liter), MT (metric ton), GAL (gallon), LB (pound), TON (ton), M3 (cubic meter). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|L|MT|GAL|LB|TON|M3 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: work_center
attributes.description: The specific work center or production line where the batch relationship occurred. Maps to SAP PP work center master data.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: The yield percentage achieved in this batch transformation from parent to child, calculated as (actual output / theoretical output) * 100.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, SPC Statistical Process Control

products.name: process_parameter
products.description: Time-series record of critical process parameters (CPPs) measured or set during a chemical manufacturing operation. Captures parameter name (temperature, pressure, pH, flow rate, agitation speed, dissolved oxygen, viscosity, concentration), tag ID from DCS/SCADA (Honeywell Experion or Siemens PCS 7), measured value, engineering unit, set point value, upper control limit (UCL), lower control limit (LCL), upper specification limit (USL), lower specification limit (LSL), timestamp, measurement source (DCS, PLC, manual entry), operator ID, and SPC violation flag. Sourced from Aveva PI System historian integration.
products.reference: Critical Process Parameter (CPP) / Aveva PI Tag

attributes.name: process_parameter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process parameter record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production batch or lot during which this parameter was measured or controlled.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment or asset where this parameter was measured or controlled.

attributes.name: mes_recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process recipe or formula that defines the target parameter values and control limits.

attributes.name: primary_process_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator or technician who recorded or validated the parameter measurement, if applicable.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality assurance or process engineer who reviewed and approved this parameter record.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production work order under which this process parameter was recorded.

attributes.name: alarm_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the alarm triggered by this parameter measurement, if applicable.

attributes.name: alarm_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an alarm was triggered by the control system due to this parameter measurement (True if alarm triggered, False otherwise).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding the parameter measurement, deviations, or corrective actions.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken or planned in response to parameter deviation or violation.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective action is required based on this parameter measurement (True if action required, False otherwise).

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the quality or reliability of the measured data (e.g., Good, Questionable, Bad, Estimated).
attributes.references: Aveva PI System Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: deviation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage deviation of the measured value from the set point, calculated as (deviation_value / set_point_value) * 100.

attributes.name: deviation_value
attributes.description: Calculated deviation of the measured value from the set point (measured_value minus set_point_value).

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the parameter value (e.g., Celsius, Fahrenheit, bar, psi, pH units, liters per minute, RPM, percent, ppm).

attributes.name: historian_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the process historian system from which this parameter data was sourced (e.g., Aveva PI System, Honeywell PHD, OSIsoft PI).

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit for Statistical Process Control (SPC). Values below this threshold indicate the process may be out of statistical control.

attributes.name: lower_specification_limit
attributes.description: Lower specification limit defining the minimum acceptable value for the parameter. Values below this limit may result in out-of-specification (OOS) product.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Actual measured or observed value of the process parameter at the recorded timestamp.

attributes.name: measurement_source
attributes.description: Source system or method by which the parameter was measured or entered (e.g., DCS, PLC, SCADA, Manual Entry, LIMS, Historian).

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the parameter value was measured or recorded by the control system or operator. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the critical process parameter being measured or controlled (e.g., temperature, pressure, pH, flow rate, agitation speed, dissolved oxygen, viscosity, concentration).

attributes.name: parameter_status
attributes.description: Current status of the parameter measurement indicating whether it is within acceptable ranges or requires investigation.

attributes.name: parameter_tag_reference
attributes.description: Unique tag identifier from the DCS (Distributed Control System), SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), or PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) system that sources this parameter. Used for traceability to Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7, or Aveva PI System.

attributes.name: phase_name
attributes.description: Name of the batch phase or process step during which this parameter was measured (e.g., Charging, Reaction, Distillation, Cooling, Discharge).

attributes.name: quality_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this parameter measurement has potential impact on product quality (True if quality impact identified, False otherwise).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this process parameter record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this process parameter record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the parameter record was reviewed and approved by quality assurance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: sampling_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Time interval in seconds between consecutive parameter measurements or samples.

attributes.name: set_point_value
attributes.description: Target or desired value for the process parameter as defined by the process recipe or control system.

attributes.name: spc_violation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the measured value violated SPC control limits (True if violation detected, False otherwise).

attributes.name: specification_violation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the measured value violated specification limits (True if out-of-specification, False otherwise).

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit for Statistical Process Control (SPC). Values above this threshold indicate the process may be out of statistical control.

attributes.name: upper_specification_limit
attributes.description: Upper specification limit defining the maximum acceptable value for the parameter. Values exceeding this limit may result in out-of-specification (OOS) product.

products.name: reaction_step
products.description: Defines individual reaction or process steps within a chemical synthesis sequence or master recipe. Captures step number, step name, step type (charge, heat, react, cool, filter, distill, blend, transfer, clean), target duration, actual duration, sequence order, phase assignment, critical step flag, SOP reference, control recipe phase ID, required equipment type, and step completion status. Supports multi-step synthesis workflows and provides the operational backbone for process order execution and MES phase tracking.

attributes.name: reaction_step_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reaction step within the chemical synthesis sequence. Primary key for the reaction step entity.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment unit assigned to execute this reaction step. Links to the equipment master data for traceability.

attributes.name: formula_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master recipe or control recipe that defines this reaction step. Provides the template for the synthesis sequence.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent production order under which this reaction step is executed. Links the step to the overall manufacturing order.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Reaction Step records the specific raw material charged; linking to material_master ensures traceability and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Control recipe phase identifier from the Manufacturing Execution System (MES). Maps the step to the DCS or PLC phase for automation execution.

attributes.name: primary_reaction_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator or technician who executed or supervised the reaction step. Required for GMP batch record traceability.

attributes.name: synthesis_procedure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.synthesis_procedure. Business justification: Links each production reaction step to the validated R&D synthesis procedure, supporting SOP enforcement and deviation investigations.

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time for the reaction step execution in minutes. Captured from MES or DCS for process performance analysis and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculation.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this step requires supervisory or quality approval before proceeding to the next step. Used for critical process control points.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reaction step was approved. Captures the approval event for audit trail and batch record documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reaction step record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and record creation tracking.

attributes.name: critical_step_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this step is a critical control point requiring enhanced monitoring, verification, or approval. Used for Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Process Safety Management (PSM) compliance.

attributes.name: dcs_batch_reference
attributes.description: Batch identifier from the Distributed Control System (Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7) that executed this reaction step. Links MES data to process automation data.

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any process deviation, out-of-specification condition, or abnormal event that occurred during the reaction step execution. Used for Root Cause Investigation (RCI) and CAPA.

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any process deviation or out-of-specification (OOS) condition occurred during this reaction step. Triggers investigation and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes.

attributes.name: material_charge_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material charged or added during this reaction step. Applicable for charge-type steps and used for Bill of Materials (BOM) consumption tracking.

attributes.name: material_charge_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the material charge quantity (e.g., kg, L, mol). Ensures proper inventory consumption and yield calculation.

attributes.name: moc_reference
attributes.description: Reference to any Management of Change (MOC) record associated with modifications to this reaction step. Ensures controlled changes to the manufacturing process.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reaction step record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: required_equipment_type
attributes.description: Type or class of equipment required to execute this reaction step (e.g., reactor, distillation column, filter press, blender). Used for resource allocation and scheduling.

attributes.name: scada_tag_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Tag Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the SCADA or process historian (Aveva PI System) tag that captures real-time process data for this reaction step. Enables linkage to time-series process data.

attributes.name: sequence_order
attributes.description: Execution order within the overall synthesis sequence. May differ from step_number if parallel or conditional steps exist.

attributes.name: sop_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Standard Operating Procedure document governing the execution of this reaction step. Ensures compliance with documented procedures.

attributes.name: step_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reaction step execution completed. Used to calculate actual duration and for batch genealogy tracking.

attributes.name: step_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the reaction step (e.g., Charge Reactant A, Heat to Reflux, Cool and Filter). Provides human-readable identification of the process phase.

attributes.name: step_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the operator during the execution of this reaction step. Captures observations, adjustments, or contextual information for the batch record.

attributes.name: step_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this step within the reaction sequence. Defines the order of execution in the synthesis workflow.

attributes.name: step_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reaction step execution began. Captured from MES or DCS for process traceability and batch record documentation.

attributes.name: step_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of the reaction step. Tracks the lifecycle state of the step within the production order. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|in_progress|completed|paused|aborted|failed|skipped — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: step_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reaction step operation type. Defines the nature of the process activity being performed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: charge|heat|react|cool|filter|distill|blend|transfer|clean|sample|hold|neutralize|crystallize|dry — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_agitation_rpm
attributes.description: Target agitation or stirring speed in revolutions per minute (RPM). Controls mixing intensity for homogeneous reaction conditions.

attributes.name: target_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned or target duration for the reaction step in minutes as defined in the master recipe. Used for scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: target_ph
attributes.description: Target pH level for the reaction step. Critical for acid-base reactions, neutralization, and pH-sensitive synthesis processes.

attributes.name: target_pressure_bar
attributes.description: Target or setpoint pressure for the reaction step in bar. Critical process parameter for reactions requiring pressurized conditions.

attributes.name: target_temperature_c
attributes.description: Target or setpoint temperature for the reaction step in degrees Celsius. Critical process parameter for chemical synthesis control.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Actual yield achieved in this reaction step as a percentage of theoretical yield. Key performance indicator for process efficiency and optimization.

products.name: bom_consumption
products.description: Transactional record of actual raw material and intermediate component consumption against a production or process order BOM. Captures material number, component description, BOM line item, planned quantity, actual quantity consumed, unit of measure, lot number consumed, storage location, goods movement type (SAP MM 261/262), posting date, backflush flag, variance quantity, variance percentage, and cost impact. Enables yield analysis, material balance reconciliation, and COGS calculation per batch. Sourced from SAP PP goods movement postings.
products.reference: SAP PP Goods Movement / BOM Backflush (Movement Type 261)

attributes.name: bom_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM consumption transaction record.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: BOM consumption tracking needs product master reference to validate material codes, safety data, and costing.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who posted the consumption transaction in the system.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order against which this material consumption was posted.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material or intermediate component consumed in this transaction.

attributes.name: actual_quantity_consumed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material consumed and posted against the production order.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this consumption was posted automatically via backflushing at production confirmation.

attributes.name: bom_line_item_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bill of Materials (BOM) Line Item Number
attributes.description: Line item sequence number in the BOM structure indicating which component this consumption relates to.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS registry number of the consumed chemical substance for regulatory tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the material consumption cost is allocated.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for cost amounts.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date of the physical goods movement or consumption event.

attributes.name: goods_recipient
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or entity receiving the goods for production use.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consumption record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number of the consumed material, enabling full traceability and genealogy.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: Unique document number generated by SAP MM for the goods movement transaction.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year of the material document for archival and retrieval purposes.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP MM movement type code indicating the nature of the goods movement (e.g., 261 for goods issue to production order, 262 for reversal).

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Routing operation number to which this material consumption is allocated.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material planned to be consumed according to the BOM for this production order.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code where the consumption occurred.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the material consumption was posted in the system.

attributes.name: posting_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumption record was created in the system.

attributes.name: production_order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier of the production order for which materials were consumed.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for consumption variance or manual posting, if applicable.

attributes.name: reservation_item_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the reservation document.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Material reservation number linked to this consumption, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this consumption record is a reversal of a previous posting.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Material document number of the original transaction that this record reverses, if applicable.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating special stock type (e.g., consignment, project stock, sales order stock).

attributes.name: standard_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of measure for the consumed material at the time of posting.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the storage location from which the material was withdrawn.

attributes.name: total_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost impact of this consumption transaction, calculated as actual_quantity_consumed * standard_cost_per_unit.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the consumed quantity (e.g., KG, L, MT, GAL).

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: Physical location or point where the material was delivered for consumption.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Valuation type or split valuation category for the consumed material.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage variance between planned and actual consumption, calculated as (variance_quantity / planned_quantity) * 100.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between planned and actual consumed quantity (actual minus planned).

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Code of the work center where the material was consumed during production.

products.name: yield_record
products.description: Captures actual production yield data for each batch or production run, comparing theoretical yield to actual output. Records planned yield quantity, actual yield quantity, yield percentage, theoretical yield basis, yield loss quantity, loss reason code (evaporation, sampling, spillage, reaction inefficiency, filtration loss), unit of measure, by-product quantities, waste quantities, and yield variance flag. Supports process optimization, SPC trending, OEE calculation, and raw material efficiency reporting. Critical for cost accounting and process improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: yield_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the yield record. Primary key for the yield record entity.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Yield reporting ties actual yields to the product master for performance analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order or manufacturing order (SAP PP module) for which this yield was recorded. Links yield data to the specific production execution.

attributes.name: primary_yield_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee or operator identifier who confirmed the yield and completed the batch record. Used for accountability and training effectiveness tracking.

attributes.name: actual_yield_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of product produced and confirmed in the production run. This is the measured output after completion of the batch.
attributes.references: SAP PP - Production Planning, GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned to this production run. Critical for traceability, genealogy tracking, and Certificate of Analysis (COA) linkage.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: by_product_code
attributes.description: The material code or SKU for the by-product generated. References the by-product master data in the materials management system.

attributes.name: by_product_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of by-products or co-products generated during the production process. By-products may have commercial value or require disposal.
attributes.references: SAP PP - Production Planning, Environmental Reporting

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The source system from which the yield data was captured. Indicates whether data originated from SAP PP, MES, DCS (Honeywell Experion or Siemens PCS 7), LIMS, or manual entry.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The quality inspection lot number assigned to this batch for QC testing. Links yield records to quality inspection results and COA (Certificate of Analysis) data.
attributes.references: SAP QM - Quality Management, LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System)

attributes.name: loss_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the primary reason for yield loss. Used for root cause analysis, process improvement, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) initiatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: evaporation|spillage|sampling|reaction_inefficiency|filtration_loss|equipment_holdup|transfer_loss|quality_rejection|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action), RCI (Root Cause Investigation)

attributes.name: planned_yield_quantity
attributes.description: The theoretical or planned yield quantity expected from the production order based on the Bill of Materials (BOM) and process parameters. Represents the target output under ideal conditions.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or facility where the production occurred. Aligns with SAP plant master data.

attributes.name: process_order_type
attributes.description: The type of production process used for this yield record. Distinguishes between batch processing, continuous processing, semi-batch, or campaign manufacturing modes.
attributes.references: ISA-95 - Enterprise-Control System Integration, SAP PP

attributes.name: production_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production batch or run was completed and yield was confirmed. Used for cycle time analysis and OEE calculation.
attributes.references: ISA-95 - Enterprise-Control System Integration, OEE Standards

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the production line, reactor, or processing unit where the batch was manufactured. May reference DCS (Distributed Control System) or MES (Manufacturing Execution System) equipment identifiers.

attributes.name: production_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production batch or run was started. Captured from MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or DCS (Distributed Control System) logs.
attributes.references: ISA-95 - Enterprise-Control System Integration, SAP PP

attributes.name: quality_status
attributes.description: The quality control status of the batch. Indicates whether the batch has been approved for release, is pending QC testing, or has been rejected. Links to Certificate of Analysis (COA) and quality inspection results.
attributes.references: SAP QM - Quality Management, GMP, ISO 9001

attributes.name: raw_material_cost
attributes.description: The total cost of raw materials consumed in this production run. Used for cost accounting, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, and yield-based profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO - Controlling, FASB (Financial Accounting Standards Board)

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: The version of the production recipe or master formula used for this batch. Critical for traceability and Management of Change (MOC) compliance.
attributes.references: MOC (Management of Change), GMP, ISA-88 - Batch Control

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this yield record was first created in the data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this yield record was last modified. Critical for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or supervisor comments regarding yield performance, process deviations, or special conditions during production. Used for batch record documentation and deviation investigations.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), Batch Record Requirements

attributes.name: theoretical_yield_basis
attributes.description: The method or basis used to calculate the planned yield. Indicates whether the theoretical yield was derived from BOM standards, process simulation (e.g., Aspen HYSYS), historical averages, or lab/pilot scale data.
attributes.references: SAP PP - Production Planning, Process Engineering Standards

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for yield quantities (e.g., kilograms, liters, metric tons). Must align with product master data and BOM unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|L|mL|MT|lb|gal|ton|m3 — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000 - Quantities and Units, SAP MM

attributes.name: variance_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The acceptable variance threshold percentage used to determine if yield_variance_flag should be set. Typically defined in process control plans or SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures).
attributes.references: SPC (Statistical Process Control), SOP (Standard Operating Procedure)

attributes.name: waste_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the waste material for environmental and regulatory purposes. Indicates whether waste is hazardous, contains VOC (Volatile Organic Compounds), HAP (Hazardous Air Pollutants), or is recyclable.
attributes.references: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act), OSHA

attributes.name: waste_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of waste material generated during production that requires disposal or treatment. Critical for environmental reporting and TRI (Toxics Release Inventory) compliance.
attributes.references: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), TRI (Toxics Release Inventory), ISO 14001

attributes.name: yield_confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the actual yield quantity was confirmed and recorded in the system. May differ from production_end_timestamp if post-production weighing or measurement is required.

attributes.name: yield_efficiency_score
attributes.description: A normalized efficiency score (0-100) that factors in yield percentage, quality status, and process losses. Used for benchmarking and continuous improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), SPC (Statistical Process Control)

attributes.name: yield_loss_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity of material lost during the production process due to evaporation, spillage, sampling, filtration loss, reaction inefficiency, or other process losses. Represents unrecoverable material.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), Process Safety Management (PSM)

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: The yield efficiency expressed as a percentage, calculated as (actual_yield_quantity / planned_yield_quantity) * 100. Key performance indicator for process efficiency and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation.
attributes.references: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), SPC (Statistical Process Control)

attributes.name: yield_variance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the yield variance exceeds acceptable tolerance limits. True indicates an out-of-specification (OOS) or out-of-trend (OOT) condition requiring investigation.

attributes.name: yield_variance_quantity
attributes.description: The absolute difference between planned and actual yield (planned_yield_quantity - actual_yield_quantity). Positive values indicate under-production; negative values indicate over-production.
attributes.references: SAP CO - Controlling, Cost Accounting Standards

products.name: schedule
products.description: Master production schedule (MPS) record defining planned production runs across work centers and production lines for a planning horizon. Captures schedule ID, planning period, work center, product/material number, planned quantity, scheduled start datetime, scheduled end datetime, schedule status (planned, firmed, released, completed), capacity requirement, priority rank, campaign flag (for multi-batch campaigns), changeover time, and scheduling constraint notes. Integrates with SAP PP capacity planning and MES scheduling modules.
products.reference: Master Production Schedule (MPS) / SAP PP Planned Order

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Primary key for schedule

attributes.name: bill_of_materials_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials that defines the raw material components and quantities required for this scheduled production.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this schedule to a production campaign when campaign_flag is true. Multiple schedules may share the same campaign ID.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Production scheduling aligns planned quantities with product master data for capacity planning and compliance.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand forecast that is driving this production schedule, if this is make-to-stock production.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production planner or scheduler responsible for creating and maintaining this schedule.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent production order that this schedule is fulfilling.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer sales order that is driving this production schedule, if this is make-to-order production.

attributes.name: quality_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality control plan that defines the inspection points, test methods, and acceptance criteria for this scheduled production.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: SCHEDULE: Production schedules are driven by sales quotes; FK provides end‑to‑end visibility from quote to scheduled capacity.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Aligns production scheduling with R&D project timelines, critical for integrated planning, resource allocation, and milestone tracking.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing that defines the sequence of operations, work centers, and process parameters for manufacturing this product.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Links production schedules to the specific stock positions reserved for the scheduled quantities.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production line where the scheduled production will occur.

attributes.name: batch_size
attributes.description: The standard batch size for this production schedule. In batch chemical manufacturing, this represents the quantity produced in a single reactor charge or process cycle.

attributes.name: campaign_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is part of a multi-batch production campaign where the same product is manufactured continuously across multiple batches to optimize changeover time and yield.

attributes.name: capacity_requirement_hours
attributes.description: The total work center capacity required to complete this schedule, expressed in machine hours or labor hours.

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes
attributes.description: The estimated time in minutes required to changeover the work center from the previous product to this scheduled product, including cleaning (CIP), equipment reconfiguration, and line clearance.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this scheduled production was completed and confirmed in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference to the environmental permit or air quality permit required for this production, particularly for processes that emit VOCs (Volatile Organic Compounds) or HAPs (Hazardous Air Pollutants).
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Title V Operating Permits

attributes.name: expected_yield_percentage
attributes.description: The expected production yield as a percentage of theoretical maximum, accounting for normal process losses, waste, and off-spec material.

attributes.name: frozen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is frozen and locked from further changes, typically within the frozen planning horizon where changes require special approval.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this schedule record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: moc_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Management of Change record if this schedule involves a process change, new formulation, or deviation from standard operating procedures.

attributes.name: number_of_batches
attributes.description: The total number of batches required to fulfill the planned quantity for this schedule.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The target quantity of product to be manufactured in this schedule, expressed in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: planning_period
attributes.description: The planning horizon period for this schedule entry, expressed as year-quarter, year-month, or year-week (e.g., 2024-Q2, 2024-M06, 2024-W23).

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility where this production is scheduled.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for scheduling sequence, where lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for sequencing when multiple schedules compete for the same work center.

attributes.name: production_line
attributes.description: The specific production line or reactor train within the work center where this schedule will be executed.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this schedule was released for execution to the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) or shop floor.

attributes.name: run_time_minutes
attributes.description: The estimated production run time in minutes to manufacture the planned quantity, excluding setup and changeover.

attributes.name: safety_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule requires a safety review or Process Hazard Analysis (PHA) before execution, typically for new products, process changes, or hazardous materials.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the production schedule, externally visible and used for tracking and communication across planning and execution teams.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production schedule: planned (initial draft), firmed (committed but not released), released (authorized for execution), in_progress (actively running), completed (finished), cancelled (voided).

attributes.name: scheduled_end_datetime
attributes.description: The planned date and time when production is scheduled to complete for this schedule entry.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime
attributes.description: The planned date and time when production is scheduled to begin for this schedule entry.

attributes.name: scheduling_constraint_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing any special scheduling constraints, dependencies, or considerations such as raw material availability, regulatory windows, customer delivery commitments, or equipment maintenance windows.

attributes.name: scheduling_method
attributes.description: The scheduling algorithm used to create this schedule: forward (from earliest start), backward (from required delivery), finite (capacity-constrained), or infinite (capacity-unconstrained).

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: The time in minutes required to set up equipment, load raw materials, and prepare the work center before production can begin.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: The shift pattern during which this production is scheduled to run (day, night, swing, continuous 24/7, or weekend).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the planned quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|L|MT|GAL|LB|TON|M3|EA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: work_center
products.description: Master data for production work centers, reactors, vessels, blending units, and processing lines within the chemical plant. Captures work center ID, work center name, work center type (reactor, blender, distillation column, filtration unit, packaging line), plant, cost center reference, capacity category, available capacity (hours/day), efficiency factor, utilization rate, OEE target, DCS system ID (Honeywell Experion or Siemens PCS 7 node), equipment list, and operational status. SSOT for production capacity and equipment assignment within the production domain.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for work_center

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Overhead Allocation Process: work center overhead costs are allocated to a cost center for OEE and cost analysis reports.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.plant. Business justification: Work center is located at a plant; adding plant_id links to plant master and allows removal of redundant plant_code.

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.process_unit. Business justification: Work center belongs to a process unit type; adding process_unit_id creates parent reference and removes silo.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.resource. Business justification: Work center may be associated with a generic resource; adding resource_id creates proper reference.

attributes.name: responsible_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the supervisor responsible for this work center, used for accountability and reporting.

attributes.name: available_capacity_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Standard available operating hours per day for this work center, used in capacity planning and scheduling calculations.

attributes.name: batch_size_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for batch size specifications (minimum and maximum) for this work center.

attributes.name: capacity_category
attributes.description: Classification of capacity type used for production planning and scheduling calculations in SAP PP.

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_rate_percent
attributes.description: Current capacity utilization rate expressed as a percentage, indicating how much of available capacity is being used.

attributes.name: cip_clean_in_place_capable_flag
