attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center is equipped with CIP (Clean In Place) automated cleaning systems for sanitation between production runs.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when this work center was commissioned and put into operational service.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center master data record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crew_size_standard
attributes.description: Standard number of operators or crew members required to operate this work center during normal production.

attributes.name: dcs_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the DCS (Distributed Control System) node or controller managing this work center. Typically references Honeywell Experion or Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7 system nodes.

attributes.name: dcs_system_type
attributes.description: Type or vendor of the DCS system controlling this work center for process automation and monitoring.

attributes.name: efficiency_factor_percent
attributes.description: Standard efficiency factor applied to capacity calculations, representing the expected performance level relative to theoretical maximum.

attributes.name: ehs_permit_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Permit Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether EHS (Environment Health and Safety) permits or special authorizations are required to operate this work center.
attributes.references: OSHA Process Safety Management, EPA Operating Permits

attributes.name: gmp_classification
attributes.description: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) classification level for this work center, indicating compliance requirements for pharmaceutical or food-contact chemical production.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 GMP, ISO 22000 Food Safety

attributes.name: hazardous_area_classification
attributes.description: Electrical area classification indicating the level of explosion or fire hazard at this work center location per NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code).
attributes.references: NFPA 70 National Electrical Code, IEC 60079 Explosive Atmospheres

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major overhaul or significant maintenance activity performed on this work center.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center master data record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: maximum_batch_size
attributes.description: Maximum production batch size that can be processed at this work center, expressed in the standard unit of measure.

attributes.name: minimum_batch_size
attributes.description: Minimum production batch size that can be processed at this work center, expressed in the standard unit of measure.

attributes.name: next_psr_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Process Safety Review (PSR) Due Date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required Process Safety Review or PHA (Process Hazard Analysis) for this work center.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled preventive maintenance activity for this work center.

attributes.name: oee_target_percent
attributes.description: Target OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) percentage for this work center, combining availability, performance, and quality metrics.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the work center indicating availability for production scheduling and execution.

attributes.name: ph_control_capability_flag

products.name: dcs_event_log
products.description: Unified operational event log, shift record, and DCS/SCADA audit trail from production control systems (Honeywell Experion, Siemens PCS 7) capturing all production floor events, operator shift documentation, and handover records. Records alarms, interlocks, operator actions, system state changes, setpoint modifications, mode changes, shift handover entries, and shift summary narratives. Captures event timestamp, DCS node ID, tag ID, event type (alarm, interlock_trip, operator_override, setpoint_change, mode_change, shift_handover, shift_summary, shift_observation), event description, priority level, acknowledged flag, operator ID, duration, associated manufacturing order, shift date, shift type (day/afternoon/night), supervisor name, operator count, batches completed, batches in-progress, equipment issues, safety observations, environmental readings, material shortages, quality holds, and handover instructions. The single source of truth for production floor operational continuity, shift-to-shift communication, process safety analysis, alarm rationalization, incident investigation, and regulatory audit trail.
products.reference: DCS Alarm/Event Log / Aveva PI Event Frame

attributes.name: dcs_event_log_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distributed Control System (DCS) Event Log ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each DCS/SCADA event log entry. Primary key for the event log. Inferred role: EVENT_LOG.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the operator who acknowledged the event, performed the action, or authored the shift entry. Links to workforce/employee master data. Required for audit trail and accountability per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records, OSHA PSM, ISO 9001

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id

attributes.name: research_process_simulation_id

attributes.name: acknowledged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the event (typically an alarm or interlock) has been acknowledged by an operator. True if acknowledged, False if unacknowledged. Critical for alarm management and operator response tracking.

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event was acknowledged by an operator. Null if not yet acknowledged. Used to calculate alarm response time and operator performance metrics. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Management of Alarm Systems, 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: alarm_limit
attributes.description: Configured alarm threshold value that triggered the alarm for alarm-type events. Null for non-alarm events. Used for alarm rationalization and setpoint optimization.

attributes.name: alarm_state
attributes.description: Current state of the alarm for alarm-type events. Active: alarm condition present. Cleared: alarm condition resolved. Suppressed: alarm temporarily disabled. Shelved: alarm acknowledged but not yet cleared. Null for non-alarm events.

attributes.name: batches_completed
attributes.description: Number of production batches completed during the shift for shift summary events. Null for non-shift-summary events. Key performance indicator for shift productivity.

attributes.name: batches_in_progress
attributes.description: Number of production batches in progress at shift end for shift summary events. Null for non-shift-summary events. Critical for shift handover continuity.

attributes.name: control_mode_new
attributes.description: New control mode after a mode_change event. Null for non-mode-change events. Tracks transitions between automatic, manual, cascade, remote, and local control modes.

attributes.name: control_mode_previous
attributes.description: Previous control mode before a mode_change event. Null for non-mode-change events. Tracks transitions between automatic, manual, cascade, remote, and local control modes.

attributes.name: dcs_node_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the DCS/SCADA node or controller that generated the event. Maps to specific Honeywell Experion or Siemens PCS 7 controller instances within the distributed control architecture.

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the event in seconds. For alarms: time from activation to clearance. For interlocks: trip duration. For mode changes: time in transient state. Null for instantaneous events.

attributes.name: environmental_readings

attributes.name: equipment_issues

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the event. For alarms: alarm message text. For operator actions: action description. For shift handovers: handover notes and instructions. For shift summaries: comprehensive shift narrative.

attributes.name: event_timestamp

attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the event type. Discriminates between alarms, interlocks, operator actions, shift documentation, and system state changes. attributes.name: handover_instructions

attributes.name: interlock_reference

attributes.name: material_shortages

attributes.description: Quantity of material charged, consumed, or produced during this execution step. Used for Bill of Materials (BOM) reconciliation and yield calculation.

attributes.name: material_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the material quantity (e.g., kg, L, gal, lbs). Essential for accurate material accounting.

attributes.name: mes_system_version
attributes.description: Version number of the MES software system that recorded this execution log entry. Important for audit trail and system validation.

attributes.name: mes_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier generated by the MES system for this execution event. Used for audit trail and system-level traceability.

attributes.name: operation_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order number of this operation within the process order or batch. Defines the execution order of steps.

attributes.name: operator_response_text
attributes.description: Free-text response or confirmation entered by the operator in response to the instruction. May include observations, comments, or verification statements.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the process parameter recorded during this execution step (e.g., Temperature, Pressure, pH, Agitation Speed, Flow Rate). Identifies what was measured or controlled.

attributes.name: parameter_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the parameter value (e.g., Celsius, PSI, pH units, RPM, L/min). Essential for correct interpretation of parameter values.

attributes.name: parameter_value
attributes.description: Actual numeric value of the process parameter entered or recorded during execution. Represents the measured or set value for the parameter.

attributes.name: recipe_phase_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific recipe phase or operation step executed (e.g., CHARGE, HEAT, REACT, COOL, DISCHARGE). Corresponds to the master recipe definition.

attributes.name: recipe_phase_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the recipe phase or operation step executed. Provides business context for the phase code.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this execution log record was first created in the MES system. Part of the electronic batch record audit trail.

attributes.name: record_locked_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this execution log record is locked and cannot be modified. True indicates the record is finalized and part of the permanent batch record.

attributes.name: record_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this execution log record was last modified. Tracks changes to the electronic batch record for audit purposes.

attributes.name: signature_meaning
attributes.description: The meaning or intent of the electronic signature (e.g., performed, reviewed, approved, verified). Defines what the signature certifies.

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the electronic signature was applied by the operator. Part of the electronic signature audit trail.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target or setpoint value for the process parameter as defined in the master recipe. Used for comparison against actual parameter value.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper acceptable limit for the process parameter. Values above this threshold trigger Out of Specification (OOS) alerts.

products.name: campaign
products.description: Manages multi-batch production campaigns where the same product or product family is manufactured in consecutive runs to maximize equipment utilization and minimize changeover. Captures campaign ID, campaign name, product family, campaign type (dedicated, shared), planned batch count, actual batch count, campaign start date, campaign end date, work center assignment, total planned quantity, total actual quantity, campaign yield, CIP (Clean-In-Place) schedule between batches, and campaign status. Supports campaign planning, scheduling optimization, and OEE reporting.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Primary key for campaign

attributes.name: campaign_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production planner responsible for campaign planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: campaign_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production supervisor responsible for campaign execution oversight.

attributes.name: formula_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials used for raw material planning and consumption tracking across the campaign.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: FK to production.plant

attributes.name: pm_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.pm_plan. Business justification: Campaign planning includes the associated preventive maintenance plan for equipment, essential for the Production‑Maintenance Alignment Dashboard.

attributes.name: product_family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.product_family

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing or process flow used for all batches in the campaign. Defines the sequence of operations and work centers.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Primary work center or production line assigned to execute this campaign. References the work center master data.

attributes.name: actual_batch_count
attributes.description: Number of production batches actually executed within this campaign. Updated as batches are completed.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost incurred during campaign execution. Captured from production orders and settled to cost centers.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the last batch of the campaign was completed and equipment was released. Captured from MES or DCS systems.

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: Total actual production quantity achieved across all batches in the campaign. Updated as batches are completed and yield is confirmed.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the first batch of the campaign was started. Captured from MES or DCS systems.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the production campaign, typically indicating the product family or synthesis route being manufactured.

attributes.name: campaign_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the campaign, externally visible and used in production planning and scheduling systems. Typically follows plant-specific numbering conventions.

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production campaign. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|scheduled|in_progress|on_hold|completed|cancelled|aborted — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Classification of the campaign based on equipment utilization strategy. Dedicated campaigns run a single product exclusively; shared campaigns alternate between products in the same family; multi-product campaigns produce multiple SKUs; trial campaigns are for R&D validation.

attributes.name: changeover_time_hours
attributes.description: Total time in hours required for equipment changeover and setup at the start of the campaign. Includes line clearance, equipment configuration, and pre-production checks.

attributes.name: cip_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total time in hours allocated for CIP operations during the campaign. Used for OEE calculations and scheduling.

attributes.name: cip_schedule_type
attributes.description: Cleaning schedule strategy for the campaign. Between-batches requires CIP after each batch; end-of-campaign performs CIP only at campaign completion; as-needed is based on contamination risk assessment.

attributes.name: cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total cost for the campaign including raw materials, labor, utilities, and overhead. Used for financial planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: cost_variance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage variance between estimated and actual cost, calculated as ((actual_cost - cost_estimate) / cost_estimate) * 100. Key financial performance indicator.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the campaign record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the campaign record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any deviations from standard operating procedures occurred during the campaign. Triggers quality review and CAPA processes.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the campaign record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the campaign record was last updated. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: master_recipe_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the master recipe or process specification used for all batches in this campaign. Ensures consistency across campaign execution.

attributes.name: mes_campaign_reference
attributes.description: External identifier from the MES system used for integration and traceability. Links to MES execution logs and real-time process data.

attributes.name: moc_reference
attributes.description: Reference to any Management of Change documentation associated with this campaign. Required when process parameters, equipment, or materials differ from standard operations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the campaign, including special instructions, lessons learned, or operational observations.

attributes.name: oee_actual_percentage
attributes.description: Actual OEE percentage achieved during the campaign, calculated from availability, performance, and quality metrics. Key KPI for production efficiency.

attributes.name: oee_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target OEE percentage for the campaign, representing planned equipment utilization efficiency. Used for performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: planned_batch_count
attributes.description: Number of production batches planned for this campaign at the time of campaign creation.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Total planned production quantity for the campaign across all batches. Expressed in the campaign unit of measure.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the campaign for scheduling and resource allocation. Critical campaigns receive preferential treatment in capacity planning.

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campaign output is under quality hold pending final release by QA. Prevents shipment until cleared.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for the campaign. Used for production scheduling and delivery commitments.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the campaign. Used for production scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for campaign quantities. Typically mass (KG, MT, LB, TON) or volume (L, GAL) depending on product characteristics.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Overall yield percentage for the campaign, calculated as (actual_quantity / planned_quantity) * 100. Key performance indicator for campaign efficiency.

products.name: cip_record
products.description: Clean-In-Place (CIP) execution record documenting the cleaning and sanitization of reactors, vessels, pipelines, and processing equipment between production runs. Captures CIP record ID, equipment ID, CIP procedure reference, cleaning agent used, cleaning agent concentration (PPM), rinse water conductivity, temperature profile, duration, flow rate, operator ID, pass/fail result, next production clearance flag, and regulatory compliance status. Critical for preventing cross-contamination between chemical products and maintaining GMP/food-contact compliance.

attributes.name: cip_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CIP execution record. Primary key for the CIP record entity.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reactor, vessel, pipeline, or processing equipment that was cleaned. Links to the equipment master data.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Functional location identifier where the CIP operation was performed. Provides hierarchical plant structure context.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production order that preceded this CIP cycle. Links the CIP record to the manufacturing order for lot genealogy and traceability.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: FK to production.plant

attributes.name: previous_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: CIP scheduling needs the previous product's raw‑material details to validate cleaning effectiveness.

attributes.name: primary_cip_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator who executed or supervised the CIP cycle. Links to workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center (production line or area) where the CIP-cleaned equipment is located. Links to work center master data.

attributes.name: actual_finish_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the CIP cycle was completed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the CIP cycle began. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cip_cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential cycle number for this equipment. Tracks the number of CIP cycles performed on the equipment for maintenance and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: cip_procedure_reference
attributes.description: Reference code to the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) or master recipe used for this CIP execution. Defines the cleaning protocol, agent, temperature, duration, and acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: cip_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CIP execution: in_progress (cleaning underway), completed (successfully finished), failed (did not meet acceptance criteria), aborted (manually stopped), pending_review (awaiting QA approval).

attributes.name: cip_type
attributes.description: Type of CIP execution: manual (operator-driven), automatic (fully automated via DCS/PLC), or semi-automatic (operator-initiated, system-controlled).

attributes.name: cleaning_agent_code
attributes.description: Material code of the cleaning agent or detergent used in the CIP process (e.g., caustic soda, acid wash, sanitizer). Links to material master.

attributes.name: cleaning_agent_concentration_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cleaning Agent Concentration (PPM - Parts Per Million)
attributes.description: Concentration of the cleaning agent in parts per million (PPM) used during the CIP cycle. Critical for ensuring effective cleaning without residue.

attributes.name: cleaning_agent_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the cleaning agent used (e.g., Sodium Hydroxide Solution, Nitric Acid 10%, Hydrogen Peroxide Sanitizer).

attributes.name: cleaning_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the CIP cleaning cycle in minutes, from start of cleaning agent circulation to completion of final rinse.

attributes.name: cleaning_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the CIP cleaning cycle was executed. Temperature is critical for cleaning efficacy and must meet SOP specifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this CIP record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: dcs_batch_reference
attributes.description: Batch identifier from the DCS (Honeywell Experion or Siemens PCS 7) that executed the automated CIP cycle. Links to real-time process historian data.

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any deviations from the standard CIP procedure, including root cause and corrective actions taken.

attributes.name: deviation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any deviations from the CIP procedure occurred during execution. True triggers a deviation investigation workflow.

attributes.name: flow_rate_liters_per_minute
attributes.description: Flow rate of cleaning solution in liters per minute during the CIP cycle. Adequate flow rate ensures complete coverage and effective cleaning.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the CIP execution meets GMP requirements. True means compliant; False triggers corrective action.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this CIP record. Captured for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this CIP record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: mes_integration_reference
attributes.description: Integration identifier linking this CIP record to the MES system for production scheduling, lot genealogy, and traceability.

attributes.name: next_product_code
attributes.description: Material code of the chemical product scheduled to be manufactured in the equipment after this CIP cycle. Used to validate cleaning protocol adequacy for product changeover.

attributes.name: next_production_clearance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the equipment has been cleared for the next production run. True means equipment is approved for use; False means additional cleaning or inspection is required.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the operator who executed or supervised the CIP cycle. Captured for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: pass_fail_result
attributes.description: Final pass/fail result of the CIP execution based on acceptance criteria (rinse water conductivity, temperature profile, duration). Conditional_pass indicates minor deviations requiring management review.

attributes.name: qa_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments from the QA reviewer regarding the CIP execution, any deviations observed, or additional actions required.

attributes.name: qa_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the QA reviewer approved or rejected the CIP record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance status of the CIP execution with respect to GMP, FDA, and food-contact regulations. Compliant means all criteria met; non_compliant triggers investigation; pending_review awaits final determination.

attributes.name: rinse_water_conductivity_us_cm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rinse Water Conductivity (µS/cm - Microsiemens per Centimeter)
attributes.description: Electrical conductivity of the final rinse water in microsiemens per centimeter (µS/cm). Low conductivity indicates effective removal of cleaning agent residues. Typical acceptance threshold is below 20 µS/cm.

attributes.name: scada_integration_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration ID
attributes.description: Integration identifier linking this CIP record to SCADA system logs and real-time process data captured during the cleaning cycle.
attributes.references: SCADA Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the CIP cycle was scheduled to begin. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: equipment_effectiveness
products.description: Records unplanned and planned downtime events for production equipment and work centers, serving as the source data for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculations. Captures downtime event ID, work center, equipment ID, downtime start/end datetime, duration minutes, downtime category (mechanical failure, electrical failure, process upset, material shortage, changeover, planned maintenance, utility failure, operator shortage), root cause description, maintenance work order reference, production impact (batches delayed, quantity lost), recovery action, shift reference, planned production time, ideal cycle time, and availability/performance/quality component flags. Feeds OEE calculations (availability × performance × quality), TPM programs, maintenance prioritization, continuous improvement initiatives, and production KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: equipment_effectiveness_id
attributes.description: Primary key for equipment_effectiveness

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Downtime Cost Reporting: downtime impact is charged to a cost center for financial loss analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific equipment or asset that experienced downtime. Links to equipment master data in SAP PM.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the functional location in the plant hierarchy where the downtime occurred.

attributes.name: maintenance_notification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance notification that triggered investigation or repair. Links to SAP PM notification for issue tracking.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order created to address the downtime event. Links to SAP PM work order for repair tracking and cost capture.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production order that was interrupted by this downtime event. Links to manufacturing order for impact analysis.

attributes.name: primary_equipment_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator who reported or was on duty during the downtime event. Used for training needs analysis and accountability.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production shift during which the downtime event occurred. Used for shift-level OEE analysis and performance comparison.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: REQUIRED: Maintenance KPI reports need the equipment vendor to assess service contract performance and downtime root causes.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center where the downtime event occurred. Links to the production work center master data.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the product being manufactured when the downtime occurred. Supports lot genealogy and traceability.

attributes.name: capa_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event requires formal CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) investigation and documentation per quality management system.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context about the downtime event not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this downtime event record. Supports accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this downtime event record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dcs_alarm_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the DCS or SCADA alarm that triggered or was associated with the downtime event. Links to process control system alarm history.

attributes.name: downtime_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the downtime event type. Used for OEE availability loss categorization and root cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical_failure|electrical_failure|process_upset|material_shortage|changeover|planned_maintenance|utility_failure|operator_shortage|quality_issue|safety_incident — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: downtime_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the downtime event in minutes. Calculated as the difference between end and start timestamps. Used directly in OEE availability calculation.

attributes.name: downtime_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the equipment was restored to operational status and production resumed.

attributes.name: downtime_event_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the downtime event, typically generated by MES or DCS system.

attributes.name: downtime_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the downtime event began. Captured from DCS/SCADA system or manually recorded by operator.

attributes.name: downtime_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the downtime event record. Tracks progression from detection through resolution and closure.

attributes.name: downtime_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory or specific failure mode within the downtime category. Provides granular classification for maintenance and continuous improvement analysis.

attributes.name: environmental_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime event resulted in an environmental release or incident requiring EPA or regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: ideal_cycle_time_seconds
attributes.description: Theoretical minimum time to produce one unit of product under ideal conditions. Used for OEE performance calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this downtime event record. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this downtime event record was last updated. Tracks record change history for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: mes_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the MES system that recorded the downtime event. Supports integration and data lineage.

attributes.name: moc_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Management of Change record if the downtime was related to a recent process or equipment modification.

attributes.name: mtbf_inclusion_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) Inclusion Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event should be counted as a failure event in MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) calculation for reliability analysis.

attributes.name: mttr_inclusion_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: MTTR (Mean Time To Repair) Inclusion Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event should be included in MTTR (Mean Time To Repair) calculation for maintainability analysis.

attributes.name: oee_availability_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) Availability Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event should be included in the OEE availability component calculation (True) or excluded (False).

attributes.name: oee_performance_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) Performance Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event impacted the OEE performance component (speed losses) in addition to availability.

attributes.name: oee_quality_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) Quality Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event resulted in quality losses or defects that impact the OEE quality component.

attributes.name: planned_downtime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime was scheduled and planned (True) or unplanned/unscheduled (False). Critical for distinguishing availability losses in OEE calculation.

attributes.name: planned_production_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total planned production time for the period in which the downtime occurred. Used as the denominator in OEE availability calculation.

attributes.name: production_impact_batches_delayed
attributes.description: Number of production batches delayed or rescheduled as a result of this downtime event. Measures schedule adherence impact.

attributes.name: production_impact_quantity_lost
attributes.description: Quantity of product that could not be produced due to the downtime event, measured in the product's base unit of measure. Used for throughput loss calculation.

attributes.name: production_impact_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity lost (e.g., kg, liters, tons, units). Aligns with material master UOM.

attributes.name: recovery_action_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the type of recovery action performed (e.g., repair, replacement, adjustment, restart).

attributes.name: recovery_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions taken to restore equipment to operational status and resume production.

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the root cause category from the plant's failure mode taxonomy. Enables systematic analysis and trending.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the root cause identified through RCI (Root Cause Investigation) or failure analysis. Supports CAPA and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime event was associated with a safety incident requiring EHS reporting or investigation.

products.name: shift_log
products.description: Operational shift log maintained by production supervisors and operators documenting key events, observations, handover notes, and production status during each shift. Captures shift log ID, shift date, shift type (day, afternoon, night), work center or production area, supervisor name, operator count, production orders active, batches completed, batches in-progress, key events narrative, equipment issues noted, safety observations, environmental readings, material shortages flagged, quality holds noted, and handover instructions for next shift. Provides operational continuity and audit trail.

attributes.name: shift_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shift log record. Primary key for the shift log entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the supervisor who managed the shift.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific work center or production area covered by this shift log.

attributes.name: batches_completed
attributes.description: Number of production batches successfully completed during the shift.

attributes.name: batches_in_progress
attributes.description: Number of production batches that were in-progress at the end of the shift.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the shift log record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shift log record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dcs_system_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the Distributed Control System during the shift.
attributes.references: Honeywell Experion DCS / Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7 Standards

attributes.name: environmental_readings
attributes.description: Summary of environmental monitoring readings such as temperature, humidity, air quality, or emissions captured during the shift.

attributes.name: equipment_downtime_minutes
attributes.description: Total minutes of unplanned equipment downtime during the shift.

attributes.name: equipment_issues_noted
attributes.description: Description of any equipment malfunctions, breakdowns, or performance issues observed during the shift.

attributes.name: handover_instructions
attributes.description: Instructions and guidance provided to the next shift supervisor and operators for operational continuity.
attributes.references: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Shift Handover

attributes.name: key_events_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting significant events, observations, and activities that occurred during the shift.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the shift log record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shift log record was last updated.

attributes.name: material_shortages_flagged
attributes.description: Description of any raw material or component shortages identified during the shift that impacted production.

attributes.name: moc_activities
attributes.description: Documentation of any Management of Change activities or temporary process modifications implemented during the shift.

attributes.name: operator_count
attributes.description: Total number of operators working during the shift.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the manufacturing plant where the shift occurred.

attributes.name: process_deviations_noted
attributes.description: Description of any deviations from standard operating procedures or master recipes observed during the shift.

attributes.name: production_area
attributes.description: Name or designation of the production area or manufacturing zone covered during the shift.

attributes.name: production_orders_active
attributes.description: Count of production orders that were active or in-progress during the shift.

attributes.name: production_output_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of product manufactured during the shift.

attributes.name: production_output_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the production output quantity (e.g., kg, liters, tons, gallons).

attributes.name: quality_holds_noted
attributes.description: Documentation of any quality holds, Out of Specification (OOS) events, or quality concerns raised during the shift.

attributes.name: quality_issues_count
attributes.description: Number of quality-related issues or deviations identified during the shift.

attributes.name: safety_incidents_count
attributes.description: Number of safety incidents or near-miss events recorded during the shift.

attributes.name: safety_observations
attributes.description: Documentation of safety-related observations, near-misses, or incidents noted during the shift.

attributes.name: scada_alarms_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Alarms Count
attributes.description: Total number of SCADA system alarms triggered during the shift.

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the shift occurred. Principal business event timestamp for the shift log.

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shift officially ended.

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shift officially began.

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shift log record.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift period (day, afternoon, night, swing, graveyard, or rotating shift).

attributes.name: supervisor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the production supervisor responsible for the shift.

attributes.name: training_conducted

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative catalog of finished chemical products, formulations, grades, and SKUs offered to customers. Manages product specifications, technical data sheets, GHS classification, SDS document linkage, regulatory status (REACH, TSCA), application guidelines, packaging configurations, product lifecycle state, product hierarchies, and cross-references. Covers performance materials, plastics, agricultural solutions, and specialty chemicals.

products.name: chemical_product
products.description: Core master record for every finished chemical product, performance material, plastic, agricultural solution, or specialty chemical offered to customers. Captures authoritative product identity: product name, trade name, chemical name, CAS number, product family, product line, business unit, product type (bulk, packaged, specialty), physical form (liquid, solid, powder, gas), product lifecycle state (active, discontinued, developmental, phased_out), introduction date, discontinuation date, internal product code, storage temperature range, shelf life, and hazmat transport classification (UN number, hazard class, packing group). This is the SSOT for all product identity in the enterprise — SAP S/4HANA Material Master (MM) is the system of record.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chemical product. Primary key for the chemical product master record. This is the single source of truth for product identity across all enterprise systems.

attributes.name: cas_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.cas_registry. Business justification: Links product to authoritative CAS registry for hazard classification, REACH/TSCA reporting, and consistent chemical identification.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for product cost allocation and profitability reporting; finance tracks manufacturing costs per cost center.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Links product to default GL revenue account for journal entries; required for accurate posting of sales transactions.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Tracks R&D or capital project costs per product; internal orders are used to capture development expenditures.

attributes.name: originating_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Required for Product Launch Traceability report linking each product to the R&D project that created it, enabling cost allocation and regulatory filing.

attributes.name: primary_compound_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.compound_registry. Business justification: Needed for Regulatory Compliance Dashboard to map each product to its primary compound record for hazard classification and REACH reporting.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Procurement Planning uses a designated primary vendor per chemical product to generate purchase orders, cost analysis, and supplier performance reporting.

attributes.name: product_family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_family. Business justification: Chemical products belong to a product family for classification and reporting; adding product_family_id creates the necessary link and removes the silo.

attributes.name: product_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Product Manager assignment; used in product stewardship reports and regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Enables revenue attribution and margin analysis per profit center, essential for product-level financial statements.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Required for Regional Pricing and Regulatory Reporting linking product to its default sales territory.

attributes.name: standard_analytical_method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.analytical_method. Business justification: Critical for Quality Control Specification to reference the validated analytical method used for product release testing.

attributes.name: application_guidelines
attributes.description: Recommended use cases and application instructions for the product. Describes target industries, processes, and best practices for product utilization.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure for inventory, sales, and production transactions. KG: kilogram, L: liter, MT: metric ton, GAL: gallon, LB: pound, TON: short ton.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Organizational business unit responsible for the product lifecycle, P&L accountability, and go-to-market strategy.

attributes.name: chemical_name
attributes.description: IUPAC systematic chemical name or common chemical name describing the molecular composition. Used for regulatory reporting and technical documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the product master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and new product tracking.

attributes.name: density_kg_per_l
attributes.description: Product density in kilograms per liter at standard temperature and pressure. Used for volume-to-weight conversions in logistics and formulation calculations.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date the product was or will be withdrawn from active sale. Null for active products. Used for end-of-life planning and inventory liquidation.

attributes.name: fda_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Approval Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product requires FDA approval for food-contact, pharmaceutical, or cosmetic applications. True if FDA oversight applies.

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical for flammability classification, storage requirements, and fire safety planning.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification codes (e.g., H226 Flammable liquid, H302 Harmful if swallowed). Used for SDS authoring, label generation, and workplace safety communication.

attributes.name: ghs_pictograms
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS pictogram codes required on product labels (e.g., GHS02 Flame, GHS07 Exclamation Mark). Communicates hazards visually per global standards.

attributes.name: hap_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of EPA-listed hazardous air pollutants by weight. Triggers additional reporting and control requirements under Clean Air Act regulations.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard class for transportation (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives). Determines shipping requirements, packaging specifications, and carrier restrictions.

attributes.name: introduction_date
attributes.description: Date the product was first made available for commercial sale. Used for product age analysis, lifecycle planning, and portfolio management.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in the product master record. Critical for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lifecycle_state
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle. Active: available for sale. Discontinued: no longer manufactured but may have inventory. Developmental: in R&D phase. Phased Out: transitioning to discontinuation. Pending Approval: awaiting regulatory or internal approval. Obsolete: fully retired.

attributes.name: list_price_usd
attributes.description: Published list price per base unit in USD before discounts or negotiations. Starting point for customer pricing discussions. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP Material Master number. The authoritative business identifier for the product in SAP S/4HANA MM module. Used across procurement, production, sales, and inventory transactions.

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Standard packaging options available for the product (e.g., 55-gallon drum, 1000L IBC tote, bulk tanker, 25kg bag). Affects pricing, logistics, and customer ordering.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating degree of danger. I: high danger, II: medium danger, III: low danger. Determines packaging performance standards for hazmat transport.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH measurement indicating acidity or alkalinity on a 0-14 scale. Critical for corrosivity assessment, handling requirements, and application compatibility.

attributes.name: physical_form
attributes.description: Physical state of the product at standard temperature and pressure. Critical for storage requirements, handling procedures, and transportation classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: liquid|solid|powder|granular|gas|paste|emulsion|suspension — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: primary_chemical_sds_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking to the current SDS document in the document management system. SDS provides comprehensive safety, handling, and emergency information.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Mid-level product categorization within a product family. Used for sales planning, marketing campaigns, and business unit reporting.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Official commercial product name as marketed to customers. Primary human-readable identifier used in sales literature, technical data sheets, and customer communications.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of product by commercial offering model. Bulk: high-volume commodity. Packaged: pre-packaged finished goods. Specialty: high-value low-volume. Custom Blend: customer-specific formulation. Intermediate: used in further manufacturing.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: ECHA registration number for substances manufactured or imported into the EU above 1 tonne per year. Required for legal sale in EU markets.

attributes.name: reach_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Status
attributes.description: Current REACH compliance status. Registered: full dossier submitted. Pre-registered: intent declared. Exempt: below tonnage threshold or exempted substance. Not Applicable: not sold in EU. Pending: registration in progress.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product maintains specification quality under proper storage conditions from manufacturing date. Used for FEFO inventory management and expiration tracking.

attributes.name: standard_cost_usd
attributes.description: Standard manufacturing cost per base unit in USD. Used for inventory valuation, margin analysis, and financial reporting. Confidential business data.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum safe storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Exceeding this temperature may degrade product quality or create safety hazards.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum safe storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Critical for warehouse environmental controls and product quality preservation.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Registered trademark or brand name under which the product is sold. May differ from the technical product name for marketing purposes.

attributes.name: tsca_status
attributes.description: EPA TSCA inventory status for US market. Active: on inventory and commercially used. Inactive: on inventory but not currently manufactured. Exempt: polymer or other exemption. Not On Inventory: requires PMN before manufacture.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport. Required on shipping documents, labels, and placards per DOT and international transport regulations.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: viscosity_cps
attributes.description: Dynamic viscosity measured in centipoise at standard temperature. Affects pumping requirements, mixing behavior, and application characteristics.

attributes.name: voc_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of volatile organic compounds by weight. Subject to EPA and state air quality regulations. Critical for environmental compliance and emissions reporting.

products.name: sku
products.description: Stock Keeping Unit record representing a specific orderable and shippable configuration of a chemical product. Each SKU maps to a unique combination of product, grade, packaging type, pack size, and unit of measure. Captures SKU code, description, net weight, gross weight, unit of measure (kg, L, MT, drum, IBC, bag), packaging type, hazard class, UN number, shelf life (days), storage temperature range, minimum order quantity (MOQ), and SKU status. Links to the parent chemical_product and to packaging_config. SAP SD material variant is the system of record.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent chemical product that this SKU represents a specific orderable configuration of.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the current Safety Data Sheet document for this SKU. SDS provides hazard information and safe handling instructions.

attributes.name: tds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the Technical Data Sheet document containing product specifications, properties, and application guidelines.

attributes.name: application_area
attributes.description: Primary industry or application area where this SKU is used (e.g., Automotive, Construction, Electronics, Agriculture, Pharmaceuticals, Water Treatment).

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Machine-readable barcode identifier (UPC, EAN, or GS1-128) printed on product packaging for scanning in warehouse and logistics operations.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Used for regulatory reporting and SDS documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was or will be discontinued and removed from the active product catalog. Null for active SKUs.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU configuration became available for ordering and shipping. Used for product lifecycle management.

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors of the chemical will ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical safety parameter for flammable liquids.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification codes (e.g., H226, H302, H315) describing the chemical hazards of this product. Used for SDS and labeling.

attributes.name: grade
attributes.description: Chemical grade or quality level of the product in this SKU (e.g., Technical Grade, Reagent Grade, Pharmaceutical Grade, Industrial Grade).

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight including product and packaging materials per package, measured in kilograms. Used for freight calculations and shipping documentation.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying this SKU in the global supply chain. Used for EDI transactions and retail distribution.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT hazard classification for transportation (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 8 Corrosive). Required for shipping documentation and compliance.

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this chemical is a controlled substance requiring special licensing, reporting, and security measures under DEA or EPA regulations.

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this SKU is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation procedures.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered for this SKU. Used in sales order validation and customer quotations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SKU record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|l|mt|gal|lb|drum|ibc|bag|ea — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the chemical product content per package, excluding packaging materials, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Quantity of product contained in one package unit. Used with unit_of_measure to define the orderable quantity.

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of container or packaging used for this SKU configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drum|ibc|bag|bulk|tote|cylinder|pail|bottle|tank|railcar — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH measurement indicating acidity or alkalinity of the chemical product on a scale of 0-14. Important for handling, compatibility, and application.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: European REACH registration number for this chemical substance. Required for sales in EU markets.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days from manufacturing date that the product maintains its specified quality and performance characteristics under proper storage conditions.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this specific SKU configuration. Used in ordering, shipping, and inventory systems.

attributes.name: sku_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the SKU including product name, grade, packaging type, and size. Used on sales orders, shipping documents, and invoices.

attributes.name: sku_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU. Active SKUs are orderable; inactive and discontinued SKUs cannot be ordered; blocked SKUs are temporarily unavailable.

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Ratio of the density of the chemical to the density of water at a specified temperature. Used for volume-to-weight conversions and quality control.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius at which the product must be stored to maintain stability and quality.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius at which the product must be stored to maintain stability and quality.

attributes.name: tsca_status
attributes.description: Status of the chemical substance under US EPA TSCA inventory. Listed substances can be manufactured or imported in the US.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport. Required on shipping papers, labels, and placards.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the pack size (kilograms, liters, metric tons, gallons, pounds, drums, intermediate bulk containers, bags, each). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|l|mt|gal|lb|drum|ibc|bag|ea — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: grade
products.description: Defines the quality grades and purity tiers available for a chemical product (e.g., Technical Grade, Reagent Grade, Food Grade, Pharmaceutical Grade, Electronic Grade, Agricultural Grade). Captures grade code, grade name, grade description, minimum purity percentage, applicable regulatory standards (GMP, USP, EP, FCC), intended application sector, and grade-specific handling requirements. A single chemical product may have multiple grades, each with distinct specifications and pricing. Owned by the product domain as part of the product catalog.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product grade record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent chemical product for which this grade is defined. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: product_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Assigns a Grade Product Manager; supports grade‑specific cost and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: quality_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) document for this grade. Critical for EHS (Environment Health and Safety) compliance.

attributes.name: tds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the technical data sheet document containing detailed specifications, properties, and application guidelines for this grade.

attributes.name: acs_reagent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade meets American Chemical Society (ACS) reagent specifications for laboratory and analytical use.

attributes.name: application_sector
attributes.description: Primary industry sector or application area for which this grade is intended (e.g., pharmaceutical, food and beverage, electronics, agriculture, industrial manufacturing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pharmaceutical|food_beverage|electronics|agriculture|industrial|research_laboratory|cosmetics|automotive|construction — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: base_price_per_kg
attributes.description: Standard base price per kilogram for this grade in the default currency, used as a reference for pricing agreements and quotations. Subject to volume discounts and contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Master, Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS (Chemical Abstracts Service) Registry Number uniquely identifying the chemical substance for this grade. Standard format: XXXXXX-XX-X.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must be issued with each lot or shipment of this grade, typically required for pharmaceutical, food, and high-purity grades.

attributes.name: certificate_of_compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Compliance (COC) must be issued with shipments of this grade, certifying conformance to regulatory and customer specifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product grade record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this grade was discontinued or withdrawn from the catalog. Null for active grades. Used for product lifecycle tracking and phase-out management.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this grade became available for sale and production. Used for product lifecycle tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: ep_grade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade meets European Pharmacopoeia (EP) monograph standards for pharmaceutical use in European markets.

attributes.name: fcc_grade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade meets Food Chemicals Codex (FCC) standards for food-contact and food-additive applications.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard classification codes applicable to this grade (e.g., H302, H315, H319). Used for Safety Data Sheet (SDS) generation and labeling compliance.
attributes.references: GHS (UN Globally Harmonized System), OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade is manufactured under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards, required for pharmaceutical and food-contact applications.

attributes.name: grade_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the grade within the product catalog (e.g., TG, RG, FG, PG, EG, AG for Technical, Reagent, Food, Pharmaceutical, Electronic, Agricultural grades).

attributes.name: grade_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the grade, including its intended use, distinguishing characteristics, and typical applications.

attributes.name: grade_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the grade (e.g., Technical Grade, Reagent Grade, Food Grade, Pharmaceutical Grade, Electronic Grade, Agricultural Grade).

attributes.name: grade_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product grade in the catalog. Determines availability for sales and production.

attributes.name: handling_requirements
attributes.description: Special handling, storage, and safety requirements specific to this grade (e.g., temperature control, moisture sensitivity, inert atmosphere, light protection). References Safety Data Sheet (SDS) and Process Safety Management (PSM) protocols.
attributes.references: SDS (Safety Data Sheet), OSHA PSM, Internal EHS Procedures

attributes.name: intended_use_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the intended applications and use cases for this grade, including typical customer processes and end-product integration.
attributes.references: Product Technical Data Sheet, Application Guidelines

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product grade record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard production and delivery lead time in days for this grade, used for order promising and supply chain planning.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Planning, Supply Chain Policy

attributes.name: maximum_impurity_ppm
attributes.description: Maximum allowable impurity concentration in parts per million (PPM) for this grade. Used in quality specifications and Certificate of Analysis (COA).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Internal QC Standards

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity_kg
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) in kilograms for this grade, driven by production batch economics and packaging constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_purity_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum chemical purity level required for this grade, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.50 for 99.5% purity). Critical for Quality Control (QC) and Certificate of Analysis (COA) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Internal QC Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or comments related to this grade that do not fit in structured fields.

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Standard packaging options available for this grade (e.g., 25kg bags, 200L drums, 1000L IBC totes, bulk tanker). May list multiple configurations separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier classification for this grade, reflecting the quality level and market positioning. Higher purity and specialty grades typically command premium pricing.
attributes.references: Internal Pricing Strategy, SAP SD Pricing

attributes.name: reach_registered_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade is registered under the European REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation for sale in the EU.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Primary regulatory classification or standard applicable to this grade (e.g., GMP-compliant, USP Grade, EP Grade, FCC Grade, ACS Reagent). May reference multiple standards separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: FDA, USP (United States Pharmacopeia), EP (European Pharmacopoeia), FCC (Food Chemicals Codex), ACS (American Chemical Society)

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Expected shelf life of this grade in months under proper storage conditions, used for inventory management (FEFO - First Expired First Out) and lot tracking.
attributes.references: Product Stability Studies, Internal Quality Standards

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain grade specifications and product stability.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius required to maintain grade specifications and product stability.

attributes.name: tsca_listed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Listed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade is listed on the EPA TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act) inventory for commercial use in the United States.

attributes.name: usp_grade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade meets United States Pharmacopeia (USP) monograph standards for pharmaceutical use.

products.name: product_specification
products.description: Authoritative technical specification record for a chemical product, grade, or SKU, defining the quality parameters and acceptance criteria used in COA/COC generation and QC release. Captures specification version, effective date, expiry date, specification type (release, in-process, shelf-life, stability), parameter name (assay, pH, viscosity, moisture, color, density, particle size, heavy metals, residual solvents), test method reference (ASTM, ISO, USP, internal), minimum value, maximum value, target value, unit of measure, specification status, and approval authority. Versioned to support lifecycle changes and regulatory audit trail. Links to LabWare LIMS for test execution and to quality domain for COA generation.

attributes.name: product_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product specification record. Primary key for the product specification entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom this specification is defined. Nullable for standard specifications. Populated for customer-specific specifications that define unique quality requirements per contract or technical agreement.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product, grade, or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) that this specification applies to. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: superseded_specification_product_specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous specification version that this version replaces. Nullable for initial specifications. Supports version history tracking and regulatory audit trail for specification changes.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Textual description of the acceptance rule for this parameter. Used for qualitative assessments or complex criteria that cannot be expressed as simple numeric ranges (e.g., 'clear colorless liquid', 'no visible particulates', 'conforms to reference standard').
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Role or individual responsible for approving this specification version. Typically Quality Assurance (QA) manager, regulatory affairs director, or technical director. Required for audit trail and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and ISO 9001.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, 21 CFR Part 211 - GMP

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this specification version was formally approved. Establishes the audit trail for specification lifecycle management and supports Management of Change (MOC) processes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this specification version. Captured for regulatory audit trail and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) documentation requirements.
