attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for creating this specification version. Documents the reason for specification changes as required by Management of Change (MOC) processes. Examples include regulatory update, process improvement, customer requirement, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) response.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems, OSHA PSM 1910.119

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and regulatory compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) documentation requirements.

attributes.name: criticality_level
attributes.description: Classification of the parameter's importance to product quality and safety. Critical parameters directly impact safety or efficacy and trigger immediate batch rejection if Out of Specification (OOS). Major parameters affect product performance. Minor parameters are informational or aesthetic.

attributes.name: customer_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specification is tailored for a specific customer contract or represents the standard product specification. True if customer-specific, false if standard. Customer-specific specifications may have tighter limits or additional parameters.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Link to the full specification document stored in the document management system. Provides access to detailed test procedures, sampling instructions, and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this specification version becomes binding for quality control testing and release decisions. Used to determine which specification applies to a given production batch or lot.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this specification version is no longer valid for new testing. Nullable for specifications with indefinite validity. Superseded specifications retain expiry date for audit purposes.

attributes.name: ghs_classification_relevance
attributes.description: Describes how this specification parameter relates to Globally Harmonized System (GHS) hazard classification and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) content. For example, pH specifications may determine corrosivity classification; VOC content affects environmental hazard labeling.
attributes.references: GHS Rev. 9 - UN Globally Harmonized System

attributes.name: iso_standard_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) Standard Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) standard that governs this specification parameter or test method. Examples include ISO 9001 for quality management, ISO 14001 for environmental parameters, ISO 17025 for testing competence.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this specification record. Required for audit trail and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this specification record. Tracks changes for audit trail and supports Management of Change (MOC) processes.

attributes.name: lims_test_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Test Code
attributes.description: Test code or identifier in the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) used to execute this specification parameter. Links this specification to LabWare LIMS for test execution, result capture, and Certificate of Analysis (COA) generation.

attributes.name: maximum_value
attributes.description: Upper acceptance limit for the quality parameter. Test results above this value indicate Out of Specification (OOS) condition. Nullable for parameters with only lower limits.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: minimum_value
attributes.description: Lower acceptance limit for the quality parameter. Test results below this value indicate Out of Specification (OOS) condition. Nullable for parameters with only upper limits.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, instructions, or context for this specification parameter. May include special handling instructions, historical context, or clarifications for laboratory technicians and Quality Control (QC) personnel.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality parameter being specified. Examples include assay, pH (Potential of Hydrogen), viscosity, moisture content, color, density, particle size, heavy metals concentration, residual solvents, Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) content, and other chemical or physical properties.

attributes.name: reach_registration_relevance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Relevance
attributes.description: Describes how this specification parameter supports Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) registration and compliance. For example, impurity limits may be required to demonstrate substance identity and composition per REACH dossier.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parameter is mandated by regulatory authorities such as Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH), Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA), or Food and Drug Administration (FDA). True if regulatory-mandated, false if internal quality control only.

attributes.name: sampling_plan
attributes.description: Description of the sampling strategy for this parameter. Defines sample size, sampling frequency, and sampling points (e.g., 'three samples from top, middle, bottom of batch', 'composite sample from each reactor vessel'). Links to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 - Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: sds_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the section of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) where this specification parameter is documented. Supports linkage between quality specifications and safety documentation.
attributes.references: GHS Rev. 9 - UN Globally Harmonized System, OSHA HCS 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the specification document. Externally-known unique code used in Certificate of Analysis (COA) and Certificate of Compliance (COC) generation.

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the specification. Active specifications are used for Certificate of Analysis (COA) generation and Quality Control (QC) release decisions. Superseded specifications are retained for audit trail.

attributes.name: specification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specification based on its purpose in the quality control lifecycle. Release specifications define final product acceptance criteria; in-process specifications govern intermediate checkpoints; shelf-life and stability specifications define storage and aging limits.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A - Specifications: Test Procedures and Acceptance Criteria

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Ideal or nominal value for the quality parameter. Used for Statistical Process Control (SPC) and process optimization. Nullable for parameters defined only by acceptance ranges.

attributes.name: test_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this parameter must be tested. Per-batch and per-lot testing occur for every production run. Periodic testing (daily, weekly, monthly) applies to stability and shelf-life specifications. On-demand testing is triggered by specific events or investigations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: per-batch|per-lot|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|on-demand — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: test_method_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized or internal test method used to measure this parameter. May reference ASTM (American Society for Testing and Materials), ISO (International Organization for Standardization), USP (United States Pharmacopeia), or internal Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) codes.

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_relevance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Relevance
attributes.description: Describes how this specification parameter supports Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) compliance and reporting. For example, residual monomer content may be required for TSCA inventory listing or Chemical Data Reporting (CDR).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the parameter value is expressed. Examples include Parts Per Million (PPM), percent, pH units, centipoise (cP) for viscosity, grams per cubic centimeter (g/cm³) for density, microns for particle size. Must align with test method reference.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the specification to support lifecycle changes and regulatory audit trail. Follows major.minor versioning convention.

products.name: tds
products.description: Technical Data Sheet (TDS) document record for a chemical product, capturing the authoritative technical and application information published to customers and distributors. Stores TDS document number, version, effective date, language, product applications, physical and chemical properties summary, handling and storage guidance, recommended use concentrations, compatibility notes, performance data references, and document URL/path. Versioned and linked to the parent chemical_product. Supports customer technical sales and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: tds_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the technical data sheet record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent chemical product for which this TDS is published. Links to the chemical_product master data.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Visual appearance characteristics of the product such as color, clarity, and texture. Aids in quality verification and customer identification.

attributes.name: application_summary
attributes.description: Summary of recommended applications and use cases for the chemical product. Guides customers on appropriate usage scenarios.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the technical authority who approved this TDS version for publication. Ensures technical accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this TDS version received final technical approval. Part of document control and audit trail.

attributes.name: boiling_point_unit
attributes.description: Temperature unit for boiling point measurement, either Celsius or Fahrenheit.

attributes.name: boiling_point_value
attributes.description: Temperature at which the product transitions from liquid to vapor phase at standard atmospheric pressure. Important for process design and safety.

attributes.name: compatibility_notes
attributes.description: Information on material compatibility and incompatibility with other chemicals, substrates, or container materials. Prevents adverse reactions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TDS record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: document_file_path
attributes.description: Internal file system or content management system path to the TDS document. Used for document retrieval and version control.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique document number assigned to this TDS for customer and distributor reference. Follows company TDS numbering convention.

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Web URL or URI path to the published TDS document file (PDF or other format). Enables digital distribution and customer self-service access.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this TDS version becomes the authoritative technical reference for the product. Used to manage version transitions and customer communication.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this TDS version is no longer valid and should not be referenced. Nullable for current versions without planned obsolescence.

attributes.name: flash_point_unit
attributes.description: Temperature unit for flash point measurement, either Celsius or Fahrenheit.

attributes.name: flash_point_value
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical safety parameter for flammable materials.

attributes.name: handling_precautions
attributes.description: Safety precautions and best practices for handling the product including personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements and exposure controls.
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language in which this TDS is published. Supports multi-language TDS distribution for global markets.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this TDS record was last modified. Tracks data currency and supports change detection.

attributes.name: odor
attributes.description: Characteristic odor or scent of the chemical product. Important for safety identification and customer expectations.

attributes.name: performance_data_reference
attributes.description: Reference to supporting performance test data, technical bulletins, or case studies that demonstrate product efficacy and application results.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: Measured pH value of the product indicating acidity or alkalinity. Critical chemical property for application compatibility and safety.

attributes.name: physical_form
attributes.description: Physical state or form of the chemical product at standard conditions. Critical for handling and storage guidance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: liquid|solid|powder|granular|paste|gel|gas|emulsion|suspension — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the chemical product, its composition, and key characteristics as presented to customers in the TDS.

attributes.name: recommended_use_concentration
attributes.description: Guidance on typical or recommended concentration ranges for product application. May include dilution ratios or usage rates.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Summary of key regulatory compliance information including REACH registration status, TSCA listing, FDA approvals, and other jurisdiction-specific clearances.
attributes.references: REACH Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals

attributes.name: revision_notes
attributes.description: Summary of changes made in this TDS version compared to the previous version. Supports change management and customer communication.

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the associated Safety Data Sheet document number. Links TDS to the corresponding SDS for comprehensive safety information.

attributes.name: solubility_description
attributes.description: Description of product solubility characteristics in various solvents (water, organic solvents). Guides formulation and application decisions.

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Ratio of product density to water density at specified temperature. Used for volume-to-weight conversions and quality control.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Recommended storage conditions including temperature range, humidity control, and container requirements to maintain product quality and safety.
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: tds_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the TDS document. Controls visibility and usage in customer-facing channels.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this TDS document. Incremented with each revision to track document evolution and ensure customers reference the correct edition.

attributes.name: viscosity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the viscosity value. Common units include centipoise (cP), centistokes (cSt), and Pascal-seconds.

attributes.name: viscosity_value
attributes.description: Measured viscosity of the product indicating flow resistance. Critical for processing, pumping, and application equipment selection.

products.name: sds
products.description: Safety Data Sheet (SDS/MSDS) master record for a chemical product, compliant with GHS/OSHA HazCom 2012 and REACH Article 31. Captures SDS document number, revision number, revision date, GHS hazard classification, signal word (Danger/Warning), hazard statements (H-codes), precautionary statements (P-codes), pictogram codes, first aid measures, firefighting measures, accidental release measures, handling and storage requirements, exposure controls/PPE, physical and chemical properties, toxicological information, ecological information, disposal considerations, transport information (DOT, IATA, IMDG), regulatory information (TSCA, REACH, SARA 313), and SDS language/country. System of record: Intelex EHS Management.
products.reference: SDS / MSDS (GHS, OSHA HazCom 2012, REACH Art. 31)

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Safety Data Sheet record. Primary key for the SDS master data.

attributes.name: product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product for which this SDS is issued. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: accidental_release_measures
attributes.description: Personal precautions, protective equipment, emergency procedures, and methods for containment and cleanup of spills or leaks, as per GHS Section 6.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this SDS was formally approved for distribution and use.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or authority who approved this SDS for release.

attributes.name: boiling_point_c
attributes.description: Temperature at which the substance transitions from liquid to gas at standard atmospheric pressure, measured in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: california_prop65_listed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical is listed under California Proposition 65 as known to cause cancer, birth defects, or reproductive harm.
attributes.references: California Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act of 1986

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS Registry Number uniquely identifying the chemical substance. Format: XXXXXX-XX-X. May be a primary CAS or mixture identifier.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Visual color or appearance of the chemical product.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction to which this SDS applies (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDS record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disposal_considerations
attributes.description: Recommended methods for safe disposal of the substance and contaminated packaging, including waste treatment methods and applicable regulations, as per GHS Section 13.
attributes.references: GHS Section 13, EPA 40 CFR Part 261, RCRA

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique document number for the SDS, used for regulatory filing and customer reference. Format: SDS-XXXXXX.

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SDS document: Draft (under preparation), Active (current official version), Superseded (replaced by newer version), Archived (historical record).

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the full PDF or electronic version of the SDS document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: dot_hazard_class
attributes.description: US DOT hazard class for transportation of dangerous goods (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 8 Corrosive).

attributes.name: dot_packing_group
attributes.description: DOT packing group indicating the degree of danger: I (high danger), II (medium danger), III (low danger).

attributes.name: dot_un_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) United Nations (UN) Number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number assigned to the substance for international transport of dangerous goods. Format: UNXXXX.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172, UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: ec_number
attributes.description: EC Number (EINECS, ELINCS, or NLP) assigned by the European Chemicals Agency for substance identification under REACH. Format: XXX-XXX-X.

attributes.name: ecological_information
attributes.description: Environmental impact data including aquatic toxicity (LC50, EC50), persistence and degradability, bioaccumulative potential, and mobility in soil, as per GHS Section 12.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this SDS revision becomes the official version for regulatory and operational use.

attributes.name: exposure_limits
attributes.description: Occupational exposure limits including OSHA PEL (Permissible Exposure Limit), ACGIH TLV (Threshold Limit Value), and other applicable exposure standards, as per GHS Section 8.

attributes.name: firefighting_measures
attributes.description: Suitable extinguishing media, unsuitable extinguishing media, and special hazards arising from the substance or mixture during fire, as per GHS Section 5.

attributes.name: first_aid_measures
attributes.description: Summary of first aid instructions for exposure routes (inhalation, skin contact, eye contact, ingestion) as per GHS Section 4.

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors of the substance will ignite when exposed to an ignition source, measured in degrees Celsius. Critical for flammability classification.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: Complete GHS hazard classification string for the chemical product, including hazard classes and categories (e.g., Flam. Liq. 2, Acute Tox. 3, Skin Corr. 1B).
attributes.references: GHS Rev. 7, OSHA HazCom 2012, REACH CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008

attributes.name: handling_precautions
attributes.description: Safe handling advice including measures to prevent fire, explosion, and exposure, as per GHS Section 7.

attributes.name: hazard_statements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS hazard statement codes (H-codes) describing the nature of the hazards (e.g., H225, H302, H314, H400).
attributes.references: GHS Annex 3, OSHA HazCom 2012, REACH CLP

attributes.name: iata_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Shipping Name
attributes.description: Proper shipping name for air transport as per IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations.

attributes.name: imdg_shipping_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Shipping Name
attributes.description: Proper shipping name for sea transport as per IMDG Code.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the SDS is written (e.g., EN, DE, FR, ES).

attributes.name: melting_point_c
attributes.description: Temperature at which the substance transitions from solid to liquid at standard atmospheric pressure, measured in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDS record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: odor
attributes.description: Characteristic odor of the chemical product (e.g., pungent, sweet, odorless).

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH value of the chemical product or its aqueous solution, indicating acidity or alkalinity. Range: 0.00 to 14.00.

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical form of the chemical product at ambient conditions (e.g., solid, liquid, gas, powder).

attributes.name: pictogram_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS pictogram codes representing hazard symbols (e.g., GHS02 Flame, GHS05 Corrosion, GHS07 Exclamation Mark, GHS09 Environment).
attributes.references: GHS Annex 1, OSHA HazCom 2012, REACH CLP

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Recommended personal protective equipment for handling the substance, including respiratory protection, hand protection, eye protection, and skin protection, as per GHS Section 8.

attributes.name: precautionary_statements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS precautionary statement codes (P-codes) describing recommended measures to minimize or prevent adverse effects (e.g., P210, P280, P305+P351+P338).
attributes.references: GHS Annex 4, OSHA HazCom 2012, REACH CLP

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or department responsible for preparing or updating this SDS.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: REACH registration number issued by ECHA for substances manufactured or imported in the EU in quantities of 1 tonne or more per year.

attributes.name: regulatory_information
attributes.description: Additional regulatory information including national and regional regulations (TSCA, REACH, DSL, ENCS, IECSC, KECL, PICCS, AICS) and safety, health, and environmental regulations, as per GHS Section 15.
attributes.references: GHS Section 15, TSCA, REACH, EPA, OSHA

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date when this revision of the SDS was issued or last updated. Critical for regulatory compliance and version control.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number of the SDS document. Increments with each update to the safety data sheet.

attributes.name: sara_313_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act (SARA) 313 Reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical is subject to SARA Title III Section 313 Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SARA Title III Section 313, EPA 40 CFR Part 372

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: GHS signal word indicating the severity level of the hazard: Danger (more severe) or Warning (less severe).

attributes.name: solubility_in_water
attributes.description: Description of the substances solubility in water (e.g., soluble, insoluble, partially soluble, miscible) and quantitative data if available.

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Ratio of the density of the substance to the density of water at a specified temperature. Dimensionless value.

attributes.name: storage_requirements
attributes.description: Conditions for safe storage including incompatibilities, temperature limits, ventilation, and container specifications, as per GHS Section 7.

attributes.name: supersedes_date
attributes.description: Date of the previous SDS version that this revision replaces. Used for audit trail and version history.

attributes.name: toxicological_information
attributes.description: Summary of toxicological data including acute toxicity (LD50, LC50), skin corrosion/irritation, eye damage/irritation, sensitization, mutagenicity, carcinogenicity, reproductive toxicity, and target organ effects, as per GHS Section 11.

attributes.name: tsca_status
attributes.description: Regulatory status of the chemical substance under the US EPA TSCA Inventory. Indicates whether the substance is listed, exempt, or requires notification.

attributes.name: vapor_pressure_mmhg
attributes.description: Pressure exerted by the vapor of the substance in equilibrium with its liquid or solid form at a given temperature, measured in millimeters of mercury (mmHg).

attributes.name: voc_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage by weight of volatile organic compounds in the product. Critical for environmental and air quality regulations.

products.name: product_ghs_classification
products.description: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) hazard classification record for a chemical product, capturing the official classification outcome per GHS/CLP regulation. Stores classification version, classification date, classifying authority (self-classification, ECHA harmonized), physical hazard classes and categories (flammable liquid Cat 2, explosive, oxidizer), health hazard classes (acute toxicity, skin corrosion, CMR categories), environmental hazard classes (aquatic toxicity), hazard statement codes, precautionary statement codes, signal word, pictogram list, and classification basis (test data, read-across, QSAR). Supports REACH, CLP, and GHS label generation. Linked to Intelex EHS.
products.reference: GHS / UN Purple Book / EU CLP Regulation 1272/2008

attributes.name: product_ghs_classification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the GHS classification record.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product being classified under GHS.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this classification to the corresponding Safety Data Sheet document in the document management system.

attributes.name: superseded_by_classification_product_ghs_classification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer GHS classification record that supersedes this one, enabling classification version history tracking.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS Registry Number uniquely identifying the chemical substance (e.g., 67-64-1 for acetone).

attributes.name: classification_authority
attributes.description: Entity responsible for the classification: self-classification by manufacturer, ECHA harmonized classification, competent authority, or third-party assessor.

attributes.name: classification_basis
attributes.description: Methodology or data source used to determine the classification: experimental test data, read-across from analogous substances, QSAR (Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship) modeling, expert judgment, literature review, or bridging principles.
attributes.references: REACH Guidance on Information Requirements and Chemical Safety Assessment

attributes.name: classification_date
attributes.description: Date when the GHS classification was performed or last updated.

attributes.name: classification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special considerations for the classification decision.

attributes.name: classification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GHS classification record.

attributes.name: classification_version
attributes.description: Version number of the GHS classification (e.g., GHS Rev 7, GHS Rev 8) indicating which revision of the Globally Harmonized System was applied.

attributes.name: classifier_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team responsible for performing the GHS classification.

attributes.name: clp_notification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: CLP (Classification Labelling and Packaging) Notification Number
attributes.description: Notification number assigned by ECHA for substances notified under the CLP Regulation.

attributes.name: cmr_classification
attributes.description: Specific CMR classification categories if applicable (e.g., Carc. 1A, Muta. 1B, Repr. 2), indicating carcinogenic, mutagenic, or reproductive toxicity hazards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GHS classification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: ec_number
attributes.description: European Community number (EINECS, ELINCS, or NLP number) identifying the substance in the EU.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this GHS classification becomes effective and must be used for labeling and SDS purposes.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date until which this GHS classification remains valid; nullable for current active classifications.

attributes.name: environmental_hazard_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of environmental hazard categories corresponding to the classes (e.g., Acute 1, Chronic 2, Chronic 3).

attributes.name: environmental_hazard_classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of environmental hazard classes assigned (e.g., Hazardous to the Aquatic Environment, Hazardous to the Ozone Layer).

attributes.name: hazard_statement_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS hazard statement codes (e.g., H225, H302, H315, H319, H411) describing the nature and severity of hazards.

attributes.name: health_hazard_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of health hazard categories corresponding to the classes (e.g., Category 1, Category 2, Category 1A, Category 1B).

attributes.name: health_hazard_classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of health hazard classes assigned (e.g., Acute Toxicity, Skin Corrosion, Carcinogenicity, Reproductive Toxicity, Respiratory Sensitization).

attributes.name: label_generation_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a GHS-compliant label must be generated for this classification.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GHS classification record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the GHS classification to ensure ongoing compliance.

attributes.name: physical_hazard_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of physical hazard categories corresponding to the classes (e.g., Category 2, Category 1A, Category 3).

attributes.name: physical_hazard_classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of physical hazard classes assigned (e.g., Flammable Liquids, Explosives, Oxidizing Liquids, Corrosive to Metals).

attributes.name: pictogram_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS pictogram codes (e.g., GHS01, GHS02, GHS05, GHS07, GHS09) representing the hazard symbols required on labels.

attributes.name: precautionary_statement_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS precautionary statement codes (e.g., P210, P280, P301+P312, P501) describing recommended measures to minimize or prevent adverse effects.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: REACH registration number if the substance is registered under REACH regulation, linking the classification to the REACH dossier.

attributes.name: regulatory_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or jurisdiction for which this classification applies (e.g., EU, USA, Canada, China, Australia), as GHS implementation may vary by region.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the GHS classification was last reviewed for accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team who reviewed and approved the GHS classification.

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: GHS signal word indicating the relative level of severity of hazard: Danger (more severe), Warning (less severe), or None.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this classification record originated (e.g., Intelex EHS, SAP EHS, LIMS).

attributes.name: test_data_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific test reports, study numbers, or LIMS records that support the classification (e.g., study IDs, OECD guideline numbers).

attributes.name: tsca_inventory_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act) Inventory Status
attributes.description: Status of the substance on the TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory: active (commercial use), inactive (no current commercial use), or not listed.

products.name: regulatory_status
products.description: Regulatory compliance status record for a chemical product across applicable regulatory frameworks and jurisdictions. Captures regulation type (REACH, TSCA, SARA 313, California Prop 65, RoHS, SVHC, PFAS), jurisdiction (EU, US, China, Japan, Korea, Canada), registration or notification number, registration date, registration expiry, tonnage band (for REACH), substance role (manufacturer, importer, only representative), compliance status (registered, notified, exempt, restricted, prohibited), restriction conditions, and last review date. Enables regulatory reporting to EPA, ECHA, and ACC Responsible Care. System of record: Intelex EHS Management.
products.reference: REACH / TSCA / SARA 313 / CLP Regulatory Status

attributes.name: regulatory_status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory compliance status record.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product subject to this regulatory status record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory authority officially approved or accepted the registration or notification.

attributes.name: authorization_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the granted authorization expires and renewal application is required.

attributes.name: authorization_number
attributes.description: Authorization number granted by the regulatory authority for continued use of a restricted or SVHC substance under specific conditions.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance described in the open scientific literature. Format: XXXXXX-XX-X.
attributes.references: CAS Registry, TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or context regarding this regulatory status record, including any special conditions or pending actions.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state of the product under the specified regulation and jurisdiction. Registered (fully compliant and registered), Notified (notification submitted), Exempt (exemption granted), Restricted (use restrictions apply), Prohibited (banned), Pending (application in progress).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory status record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: ec_number
attributes.description: Seven-digit identifier assigned to chemical substances for regulatory purposes within the European Union. Format: XXX-XXX-X.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification codes assigned to this substance (e.g., H302, H315, H319). Multiple codes may be listed separated by commas.
attributes.references: GHS Purple Book, OSHA HCS 2012, CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic jurisdiction or regulatory region where this compliance status applies. USA (United States), EUR (European Union), CHN (China), JPN (Japan), KOR (South Korea), CAN (Canada).
attributes.references: EPA, ECHA, MEE China, METI Japan, MOE Korea, ECCC Canada

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this regulatory status record was last reviewed and verified for accuracy and currency.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory status record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this regulatory status record to ensure ongoing compliance.

attributes.name: pfas_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product contains PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances), subject to emerging regulatory restrictions.
attributes.references: EPA PFAS Strategic Roadmap, ECHA PFAS Restriction Proposal

attributes.name: pmn_number
attributes.description: EPA-assigned number for a Pre-Manufacture Notice submitted for a new chemical substance not on the TSCA Inventory.

attributes.name: prop_65_listing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substance is listed under California Proposition 65 as known to cause cancer, birth defects, or reproductive harm.

attributes.name: reach_registration_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Type
attributes.description: Type of REACH registration dossier submitted. Full (standard registration), Intermediate (on-site or transported isolated intermediate), Transported Isolated (intermediate transported between sites), Not Applicable (non-REACH regulation).

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was officially registered or notified under the applicable regulatory framework.

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current registration expires and renewal or re-notification is required. Nullable for regulations without expiry.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration or notification number issued by the regulatory authority for this product under the specified regulation.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Registration, EPA TSCA Inventory

attributes.name: regulation_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory framework applicable to this product. REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals), TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act), SARA 313 (Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act Section 313), Prop 65 (California Proposition 65), RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances), SVHC (Substance of Very High Concern).

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or regulatory body that issued or oversees this compliance status (e.g., EPA, ECHA, METI, MEE).
attributes.references: EPA, ECHA, METI Japan, MEE China, MOE Korea, ECCC Canada

attributes.name: responsible_party_email
attributes.description: Email address of the responsible party for regulatory compliance inquiries and notifications.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or organizational unit responsible for maintaining this regulatory status record and ensuring ongoing compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: restriction_conditions
attributes.description: Detailed description of any restrictions, limitations, or special conditions imposed on the manufacture, import, use, or sale of this product under the applicable regulation.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Annex XVII, EPA TSCA Section 6

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product complies with RoHS Directive restrictions on hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment.

attributes.name: sara_313_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act (SARA) 313 Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substance is subject to SARA Section 313 Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) reporting requirements.
attributes.references: EPA SARA Title III Section 313, TRI Program

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the registration, notification, or compliance dossier was submitted to the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: substance_role
attributes.description: Role of the organization in the supply chain for this substance under the regulatory framework. Manufacturer (produces the substance), Importer (imports into jurisdiction), Only Representative (non-EU manufacturer representative), Downstream User (uses the substance in formulations).

attributes.name: svhc_candidate_list_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) Candidate List Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substance is included on the ECHA Candidate List of Substances of Very High Concern for potential authorization under REACH.

attributes.name: tonnage_band
attributes.description: Annual production or import volume band for REACH registration purposes, measured in metric tonnes per year. Categories: 1-10 tonnes, 10-100 tonnes, 100-1000 tonnes, over 1000 tonnes, or not applicable for non-REACH regulations.

attributes.name: tsca_inventory_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Inventory Status
attributes.description: Status of the substance on the EPA TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory. Active (commercially active), Inactive (not currently manufactured or imported), Not on Inventory (requires PMN), Not Applicable (non-US regulation).

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Multi-level product classification hierarchy for commercial reporting, portfolio management, and SAP material grouping. Captures hierarchy node code, node name, hierarchy level (division > business unit > product family > product line > product group), parent node reference, hierarchy type (commercial, technical, regulatory), effective date, and node status. Supports EBITDA reporting by product line, sales analytics by business unit, regulatory grouping for TSCA/REACH submissions, and product application categorization. Managed in SAP S/4HANA product hierarchy configuration.
products.reference: SAP Product Hierarchy / Commercial Portfolio Structure

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product hierarchy node. Primary key for the product hierarchy entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Data Model

attributes.name: parent_node_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent node in the hierarchy structure. Null for top-level division nodes. Enables recursive hierarchy traversal and roll-up aggregations for EBITDA reporting and sales analytics.

attributes.name: application_category
attributes.description: Primary end-use application or industry segment for products in this node. Examples: Automotive Coatings, Construction Materials, Electronics Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Agriculture Crop Protection. Supports market segmentation and application-based analytics.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for hierarchy changes. Draft: under construction. Pending Approval: submitted for review. Approved: active and released. Rejected: change request denied. Supports Management of Change (MOC) processes.
attributes.references: Internal Change Management Standards, MOC Procedures

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved this hierarchy node or hierarchy change. Used for accountability and compliance with MOC procedures.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy node or change was approved. Used for audit trail and MOC compliance reporting.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit responsible for this product hierarchy node. Used for P&L reporting, EBITDA analysis by business unit, and organizational accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA distribution channel code for products in this node. Examples: 10=Direct Sales, 20=Distributor, 30=E-Commerce. Supports channel-specific pricing and analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel Configuration

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the top-level division. Examples: PERF (Performance Materials), AGRI (Agricultural Solutions), SPEC (Specialty Chemicals). Used for executive-level portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Structure

attributes.name: ebitda_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is used for EBITDA reporting and financial performance tracking. True for nodes that represent P&L responsibility centers.
attributes.references: FASB Accounting Standards, Internal Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node is no longer active for new product assignments. Null for open-ended nodes. Historical products retain their classification for reporting continuity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node becomes active and available for product classification. Supports time-based hierarchy changes for organizational restructuring and portfolio realignment.

attributes.name: external_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: External system or customer-facing hierarchy code used for EDI transactions, customer portals, or third-party integrations. May differ from internal SAP codes.

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_category
attributes.description: Predominant GHS hazard classification for products in this hierarchy node. Used for safety reporting, hazmat storage planning, and EHS compliance. Examples: Flammable Liquids Category 2, Acute Toxicity Category 3, Corrosive to Metals.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) UN Purple Book

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of the node within the hierarchy structure. Typically: 1=Division, 2=Business Unit, 3=Product Family, 4=Product Line, 5=Product Group. Supports drill-down analytics and aggregation logic.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchy purpose. Commercial: sales and EBITDA reporting. Technical: product formulation and R&D. Regulatory: TSCA, REACH, GHS grouping. Application: end-use industry segmentation. Geographic: regional product portfolio management.

attributes.name: is_leaf_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node is a leaf node (has no children) in the hierarchy. True for the lowest level nodes where individual SKUs are assigned. Used for validation and hierarchy integrity checks.

attributes.name: legacy_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Historical product hierarchy code from legacy ERP systems prior to SAP S/4HANA implementation. Retained for data lineage, historical reporting, and migration traceability.

attributes.name: level_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the hierarchy level. Standard values: division, business_unit, product_family, product_line, product_group, sub_group. Used for reporting labels and user interface display.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this hierarchy node record. Used for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy node record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards, SOX Compliance

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the hierarchy node. Used in SAP S/4HANA product hierarchy configuration and external reporting systems. Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the node within the hierarchy structure.

attributes.name: node_depth
attributes.description: Calculated depth of the node from the root of the hierarchy tree. Root nodes have depth 0. Used for hierarchy traversal algorithms and reporting level filtering.

attributes.name: node_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hierarchy node including scope, product categories included, and business purpose. Provides context for classification decisions and portfolio management.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the hierarchy node. Used for display in reports, dashboards, and user interfaces. Examples: Performance Materials, Agricultural Solutions, Specialty Chemicals, Industrial Polymers.

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hierarchy node. Active: in use for classification and reporting. Inactive: temporarily disabled. Pending: awaiting approval. Deprecated: scheduled for retirement. Archived: historical reference only.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Data Model

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the hierarchy node. Used for documenting classification decisions, special handling instructions, or historical context.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Full path from root to this node using node codes separated by forward slashes. Example: DIV01/BU05/FAM12/LINE34. Enables fast ancestor/descendant queries and breadcrumb navigation.

attributes.name: product_family_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the product family within the business unit. Groups related product lines with similar chemistry, applications, or market segments.

attributes.name: product_line_manager
attributes.description: Name of the product line manager or business owner responsible for this hierarchy node. Used for accountability, approval workflows, and organizational reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Primary regulatory status category for products in this hierarchy node. Used for TSCA submissions, REACH compliance reporting, and regulatory grouping. Supports filtering for regulatory audits and compliance analytics.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA sales organization code responsible for products in this hierarchy node. Used for sales analytics, commission calculations, and regional performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Configuration

attributes.name: sap_product_hierarchy_code
attributes.description: 18-character SAP S/4HANA product hierarchy code (PRODH field). Concatenated representation of the full hierarchy path used in SAP MM and SD modules for material grouping and sales reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master PRODH Field

attributes.name: sort_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display order of sibling nodes within the same parent. Lower values appear first. Used for consistent presentation in reports and user interfaces.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this hierarchy node record in SAP S/4HANA. Used for audit trail and data governance.

products.name: packaging_config
products.description: Packaging configuration master defining all approved packaging formats for chemical product SKUs. Captures packaging type (drum, IBC, bulk tanker, bag, cylinder, pail, tote, flexitank, isotank), material of construction (HDPE, steel, stainless steel, fiber, aluminum, lined), nominal capacity, fill weight, fill volume, tare weight, closure type, UN packaging certification code (4G, 1A1, 1H1, 31HA1), packaging group (I, II, III), label requirements (GHS, DOT, IATA), pallet configuration (units per pallet, pallet type, stack height), and packaging status. Supports DOT/IATA/IMDG hazmat packaging compliance, warehouse slotting in SAP EWM, and customer order fulfillment.
products.reference: DOT 49 CFR Packaging / UN Packaging Certification

attributes.name: chemical_product_id

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure

attributes.name: closure_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: customer_specific_flag

attributes.name: dot_label_required

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Validity Period

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this packaging configuration becomes effective and available for use in order fulfillment and warehouse operations.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Validity Period

attributes.name: fill_volume_liters
attributes.description: Maximum fill volume of the chemical product in liters that can be loaded into this packaging configuration.

attributes.name: fill_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum fill weight of the chemical product in kilograms that can be loaded into this packaging configuration.

attributes.name: food_grade_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging configuration is certified for food-contact chemicals and meets FDA (Food and Drug Administration) food-grade requirements.

attributes.name: ghs_label_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether GHS hazard communication labels are required on this packaging configuration.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight in kilograms of the packaging configuration when filled, including product, container, and closure. Used for transportation and logistics planning.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging configuration is certified for transporting hazardous materials under DOT, IATA, and IMDG regulations.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 178; UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: height_mm
attributes.description: Height of the packaging container in millimeters. Used for warehouse slotting, stacking calculations, and transportation planning.

attributes.name: iata_label_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: IATA (International Air Transport Association) Label Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether IATA dangerous goods air transport labels are required on this packaging configuration.

attributes.name: imdg_label_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) Label Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether IMDG Code maritime transport labels are required on this packaging configuration.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this packaging configuration record was last modified or updated.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: length_mm
attributes.description: Length of rectangular packaging (IBCs, totes, boxes) in millimeters. Used for warehouse slotting and transportation planning.

attributes.name: material_of_construction
attributes.description: Material used to construct the packaging container. Options include HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene), steel, stainless steel, fiber, aluminum, and lined containers.
attributes.references: GHS Packaging Requirements; REACH Annex XVII

attributes.name: nominal_capacity
attributes.description: Nominal or rated capacity of the packaging container, expressed in the unit specified by capacity_unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: outer_diameter_mm
attributes.description: Outer diameter of cylindrical packaging (drums, cylinders, pails) in millimeters. Used for warehouse slotting and space planning.

attributes.name: packaging_code

attributes.name: packaging_config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the packaging configuration. Active configurations are available for order fulfillment; inactive/obsolete are phased out; pending approval are under review; restricted require special authorization.

attributes.name: packaging_group
attributes.description: UN Packaging Group classification indicating the degree of danger: I (high danger), II (medium danger), III (low danger). Determines packaging performance requirements.

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging container used for the chemical product. Includes drum, IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container), bulk tanker, bag, cylinder, pail, tote, flexitank, and isotank. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drum|ibc|bulk_tanker|bag|cylinder|pail|tote|flexitank|isotank — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pharmaceutical_grade_flag

attributes.name: preferred_flag

attributes.name: region_restriction

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg

attributes.name: un_packaging_code

attributes.name: units_per_pallet
attributes.description: Number of packaging units (drums, IBCs, bags, etc.) that can be loaded on a single pallet for warehouse storage and transportation.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Warehouse Configuration; ISO 6780 Pallet Dimensions

attributes.name: width_mm
attributes.description: Width of rectangular packaging (IBCs, totes, boxes) in millimeters. Used for warehouse slotting and transportation planning.

products.name: composition

products.name: cross_reference
products.description: Cross-reference and substitution master record — the single source of truth (SSOT) for all product equivalence mappings, approved substitutions, and external reference linkages. Links a chemical product to equivalent products, approved substitutes (direct, conditional, emergency), competitor products, legacy product codes, customer-specific part numbers, and distributor catalog numbers. Captures reference type, external reference code, reference owner, equivalence type, substitution type, substitution conditions (stock-out, quality hold, customer approval required), substitution direction (bidirectional or one-way), approval authority, approval date, customer notification requirement, validity dates, and status. Supports customer order management, SAP SD availability check substitution logic, product substitution workflows during fulfillment, competitive intelligence, and supply chain continuity planning. This entity consolidates all substitution rules previously tracked separately — there is no other substitution entity in this domain.
products.reference: SAP SD Customer Material Info Record

products.name: reach_dossier
products.description: REACH registration dossier record — the single source of truth (SSOT) for substance registration under EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, including the full Chemical Safety Report (CSR) and all exposure scenarios. Captures REACH registration number, substance identity (IUPAC name, CAS, EC number), registrant role (lead registrant, member), SIEF membership, tonnage band, registration date, dossier update date, ECHA submission reference, CSR requirement flag, and dossier status. Contains all exposure scenarios as child records: scenario title, use descriptor codes (SU, PC, PROC, AC, ERC), contributing scenario name, operational conditions (temperature, duration, frequency, amount used), risk management measures (PPE, ventilation, containment), DNEL values, PNEC values, risk characterization ratios (RCR), and scenario validity dates. Supports extended SDS (eSDS) generation for downstream users. Managed in Intelex EHS and submitted to ECHA REACH-IT. This entity is the sole owner of exposure scenario data — there is no separate exposure scenario entity.

products.name: exposure_scenario
products.description: Chemical Safety Report (CSR) exposure scenario record defining the conditions of safe use for a chemical substance or mixture under REACH. Captures exposure scenario title, use descriptor codes (sector of use SU, product category PC, process category PROC, article category AC, environmental release category ERC), contributing scenario name, operational conditions (OC: temperature, duration, frequency, amount used), risk management measures (RMM: PPE, ventilation, containment), derived no-effect level (DNEL), predicted no-effect concentration (PNEC), risk characterization ratio (RCR), and scenario validity date. Appended to extended SDS (eSDS) for downstream users.
products.reference: REACH CSR / ECHA Guidance R.12 / eSDS Annex

products.name: product_order

Serves as the authoritative SSOT for all customer order commitments in the order-to-cash lifecycle. Links to quotation (source), blanket order (if call-off), and downstream confirmations, deliveries, and status events. Maps to SAP SD transaction VA01/VA02.

products.name: line_item
products.description: Individual line item within a customer sales order representing a specific chemical product SKU, grade, or formulation being ordered. Captures line number, material number (SAP), product description, ordered quantity, unit of measure (kg, L, MT, drums), confirmed quantity, net price, pricing conditions, requested delivery date per line, plant, storage location, batch determination flag, COA/COC requirement flag, and special handling instructions (e.g., hazmat class, temperature-controlled). Supports MOQ enforcement and partial delivery rules.

products.description: Outbound delivery document created in SAP EWM/SD to execute the physical shipment of chemical products against a sales order. Captures delivery number, delivery date, ship-to party, shipping point, total weight, total volume, hazardous material indicator, UN number, DOT hazard class, packing instructions, batch numbers assigned, COA/COC attachment status, and goods issue posting date. Integrates with Oracle Transportation Management for carrier assignment and freight execution.

products.name: status_event
products.description: Immutable event log capturing every status transition and fulfillment milestone in the sales order lifecycle from creation through delivery, invoicing, and closure. Records event timestamp, previous status, new status, milestone type (order created, order confirmed, credit check passed, production scheduled, batch released, quality released, goods issued, picked up, in transit, customs cleared, delivered, POD received, invoiced), planned date, actual date, variance in days, triggering user or system, event source (SAP SD, OTM, MES, WMS, manual), responsible party, and event notes. Supports full order lifecycle traceability, SLA monitoring, on-time delivery (OTD) KPI calculation, proactive customer communication, customer inquiry resolution, and regulatory audit trail for controlled substance shipment tracking.
products.reference: SAP SD Order Status / Change Document

products.name: product_hold

Captures hold ID, hold type (credit hold, quality hold, regulatory hold, export compliance hold, customer dispute hold), hold reason code, hold placed by, hold placed timestamp, hold release timestamp, release authorization, and resolution notes. products.name: certification
products.description: Product certification master record tracking all quality, safety, and regulatory certifications held by a chemical product or grade. Captures certification type (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, food-grade/FCC, pharmaceutical-grade/USP/EP, kosher, halal, NSF/ANSI 60, FDA FCN, organic, ISCC PLUS), certifying body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, scope of certification, audit date, renewal requirements, and certification status (active, expired, suspended, withdrawn). products.name: order_amendment

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Quality control and assurance domain managing laboratory testing, analytical results, COA/COC generation, and quality specifications. Includes QC test methods, sampling plans, inspection lots, quality notifications (OOS, OOT), CAPA workflows, quality hold/release decisions, SPC metrics, and GMP compliance records. Integrates with LabWare LIMS for test data and maintains quality history for regulatory audits and ISO 9001 compliance.

products.name: test_method

products.name: quality_deviation
products.description: Quality deviation and notification record capturing all types of quality events requiring investigation: OOS (Out of Specification), OOT (Out of Trend), non-conformance reports (NCR), customer complaints, internal deviations, and supplier quality issues. products.name: coc_record
products.description: Quality certificate master record (COA or COC) generated for a product batch upon quality release. Supports Certificate of Analysis (COA) listing individual test parameters with specification limits and actual measured values, and Certificate of Compliance (COC) attesting overall conformance to specifications without detailed test data. products.name: formula_contract
products.description: Represents a contractual agreement between a customer account and a chemical formulation. Each record captures the specific terms of the agreement, including effective dates, pricing tier, and contract status, linking one account to one formula.. Existence Justification: Customers (accounts) can hold contracts for multiple chemical formulas, and each formula can be sold to many customers under separate contracts. The contract itself carries attributes such as start/end dates, pricing tier, and status, which are managed by business users. Therefore the relationship is a true many‑to‑many operational entity.

Existence Justification: In chemical manufacturing, a single formulation can generate several distinct waste streams, and each waste‑stream type can be produced by many different formulations. Engineers actively record each formula‑waste pairing with quantities, the originating process, and disposal method, and the records are created, updated, and deleted as production changes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the blanket order record.

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the committed volume.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Manages real-time stock positions for raw materials, intermediates, finished goods, and packaging materials across all warehouse locations and tank farms. Governs FIFO/FEFO lot rotation, hazardous material storage compliance, lot numbers, expiration dates, inventory movements, stock transfers, inventory valuation, and quarantine status. Integrates with SAP EWM and WMS for warehouse operations.

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Real-time stock position master record for each material (raw material, intermediate, finished good, packaging) at each storage location, bin, or tank farm. Tracks on-hand quantity, available quantity, reserved quantity, blocked quantity, unit of measure, batch/lot number, stock category, and stock type (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked, returns). Serves as the primary SSOT for current inventory levels across all SAP EWM-managed warehouses and tank farms. Supports FIFO/FEFO lot rotation logic and hazardous material storage compliance. Valuation carried as reference attribute for inventory reporting; authoritative valuation owned by finance domain.
products.reference: SAP EWM Stock Overview / MM Stock

attributes.name: inventory_target_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each stock position record representing a material at a specific storage location, bin, or tank farm. Primary key for the stock_position data product.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Primary key for stock_position

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Needed for daily inventory balance reports linking each stock position to its master chemical product, enabling accurate valuation, SDS lookup, and REACH compliance.

attributes.name: compound_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.compound_registry. Business justification: Safety and regulatory reporting links inventory stock to the registered compound record for hazard classification and SDS retrieval.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for cost accounting reports that allocate inventory value to cost centers per plant, enabling accurate product cost roll‑up.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.equipment. Business justification: Spare parts allocation for equipment repairs; maintenance work orders consume inventory items per equipment, required for parts consumption reporting.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this stock position is held. Aligns with SAP organizational structure for plant-level inventory management.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Required for inventory valuation reports that pull the active price list to compute valuation_price per IFRS/GAAP.

attributes.name: primary_stock_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record identifying the specific raw material, intermediate, finished good, or packaging material held in this stock position. Sourced from SAP MM material master.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Required for traceability of on‑hand stock to the originating purchase order for regulatory recall and inventory valuation reports.

attributes.name: stock_material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to rawmaterial.material_master

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific warehouse storage location, bin, or tank farm where the material is physically stored. Managed within SAP EWM warehouse structure.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material available for unrestricted use, calculated as on-hand quantity minus reserved, blocked, and quality inspection quantities. Drives ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks in SAP SD and production planning in SAP PP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD ATP Logic; ISO 9001

attributes.name: blocked_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material placed in blocked stock status due to quality failures, regulatory holds, damage, or quarantine. Blocked stock is not available for production or shipment until released by QA or EHS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Blocked Stock; GMP; OSHA; REACH

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stock position record was first created in the source system (SAP EWM). Provides audit trail for record lineage and supports SOX compliance for inventory record integrity.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Audit Trail; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material lot expires and is no longer suitable for use. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) lot rotation logic, regulatory compliance, and preventing use of out-of-specification materials. Sourced from SAP batch classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; REACH

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material was received into the warehouse via a goods receipt posting in SAP MM. Used as the FIFO reference date for lot rotation when manufacture date is unavailable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; ISO 9001

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material in this stock position is classified as a hazardous material requiring special storage, handling, and reporting under OSHA, DOT, EPA, and REACH regulations. Triggers hazmat storage compliance checks in EHS management.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; DOT 49 CFR; EPA TSCA; REACH; GHS

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material currently in transit between storage locations, plants, or external suppliers. Represents stock that has been shipped but not yet received at the destination, tracked via SAP EWM transfer orders.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Transfer Orders; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: last_count_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count was performed for this stock position. Used to assess inventory accuracy and schedule next count per SOX and ISO 9001 audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent inventory movement (goods issue, goods receipt, transfer order, or stock transfer) affecting this stock position. Used to identify slow-moving or obsolete inventory for write-off analysis.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Inventory Movement History; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned during production or receipt of the material. Critical for FIFO/FEFO lot rotation, traceability, Certificate of Analysis (COA) linkage, and regulatory compliance under GMP and REACH.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: lot_rotation_method
attributes.description: The inventory rotation strategy applied to this stock position for picking and consumption sequencing. FIFO (First In First Out) is used for most materials; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is mandatory for materials with expiration dates per GMP requirements.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Lot Rotation; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; FEFO/FIFO Best Practice

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material lot was manufactured or produced. Used in conjunction with expiration_date to calculate shelf life and support FIFO/FEFO rotation. Sourced from SAP batch master or COA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Master; GMP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: maximum_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum allowable stock quantity for this material at this storage location, constrained by tank capacity, regulatory storage limits, or warehouse space. Enforced by SAP EWM capacity checks and EHS hazmat storage quantity limits under OSHA PSM.
