attributes.references: SAP EWM Capacity Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM; EPA RMP

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Total physical quantity of the material currently present at the storage location, including all stock types (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked). Represents the gross inventory position before any reservations or holds are applied.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material currently under quality inspection in the LIMS or SAP QM module. This stock is not available for use until the inspection lot is closed and the material is released to unrestricted stock.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Inspection Lots; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001; GMP

attributes.name: quarantine_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason this stock position has been placed in quarantine or blocked status. Examples include failed QC test, regulatory hold, contamination suspicion, or pending CAPA investigation. Populated when stock_status is quarantine or stock_type is blocked.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; GMP; OSHA; CAPA Process; ISO 9001

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The minimum stock level at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this material at this storage location. Used by SAP MRP (Material Requirements Planning) to generate purchase requisitions or production orders automatically.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; ISO 9001 Inventory Control

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material reserved against open production orders, sales orders, or transfer orders in SAP. Reserved stock is committed but not yet physically moved, reducing the available quantity for new demand.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Reservations; SAP PP Production Orders

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum buffer stock quantity maintained to protect against supply disruptions, demand variability, or lead time uncertainty. Defined in SAP MRP parameters and used in available quantity calculations for production planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Safety Stock; ISO 9001

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this stock position record was captured or last refreshed from the source system (SAP EWM/S4HANA). Represents the as-of time for the inventory snapshot, critical for real-time inventory reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Real-Time Inventory; Databricks Silver Layer Data Freshness

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock position represents a special stock type such as consignment inventory, project stock, sales-order-specific stock, or vendor-managed inventory (VMI). Drives distinct accounting and ownership rules in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Special Stock; FASB ASC 330

attributes.name: stock_category
attributes.description: Classification of the material type held in this stock position. Drives inventory valuation rules, storage compliance requirements, and reporting segmentation across raw materials, intermediates, finished goods, and packaging materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Type; ISO 9001

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock position record. Quarantine status is applied when material is pending investigation or regulatory hold. Expired indicates the material has passed its expiration date. Recalled indicates a product recall event has been triggered.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Stock Status; GMP; OSHA PSM; REACH

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: SAP stock type classification indicating the usability state of the inventory. Unrestricted stock is available for use; quality_inspection stock is pending QC release; blocked stock is not available for use; returns stock is from customer returns; in_transit stock is between locations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Types; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: The specific bin, rack position, or tank identifier within the storage location where the material is physically stored. Used by SAP EWM for directed putaway and picking operations in warehouse management.

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical storage infrastructure type where the material is held. Drives hazardous material storage compliance rules under OSHA PSM, NFPA, and DOT regulations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk_tank|drum_rack|pallet_rack|cold_storage|hazmat_cage|silo|ibc_bay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP EWM Storage Type; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; NFPA 30; DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which all quantity fields for this stock position are expressed. Chemical manufacturing uses weight (KG, MT), volume (L, GAL, M3), and count (EA, DRUM, IBC) units depending on material type. Aligns with SAP MM base UOM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|TON|EA|BAG|DRUM|IBC|M3|FT3 — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stock position record was last modified in the source system. Used for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Audit Trail; SOX Section 404; Databricks CDC

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: SAP valuation class code that determines the general ledger (GL) accounts to which inventory postings are made for this material. Links inventory movements to the correct COGS and balance sheet accounts per FASB and SOX requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Valuation Class; FASB ASC 330; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: valuation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the valuation_price is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR). Required for multi-currency inventory valuation reporting across global plant locations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: Reference unit price used to calculate the inventory valuation of this stock position, expressed in the valuation currency. Carried as a reference attribute for inventory reporting; authoritative valuation is owned by the Finance domain (SAP FI/CO). May reflect standard cost or moving average price per SAP valuation class.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Material Valuation; FASB ASC 330 Inventory; SOX

attributes.name: warehouse_number
attributes.description: The SAP EWM warehouse number identifying the physical warehouse complex managing this stock position. Used for multi-warehouse inventory segregation and reporting.

products.name: warehouse_location
products.description: Master record for all physical and logical storage locations within the warehouse network, including bulk tank farms, drum storage areas, cold storage rooms, hazmat segregation zones, quarantine bays, and finished goods warehouses. Captures location code, storage type, capacity (volume/weight), temperature range, humidity range, ventilation class, hazard class compatibility, NFPA fire diamond rating, incompatible hazard class segregation rules, maximum storage quantity per zone, fire zone, EPA/OSHA regulatory citations, and SAP EWM storage section mapping. Governs where specific chemical materials may be stored based on GHS/NFPA compatibility rules and required storage conditions.
products.reference: SAP EWM Storage Location / WM Storage Type

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Primary key for warehouse_location

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for safety audit reports; each warehouse must have a designated manager employee for OSHA compliance.

attributes.name: aisle
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier for the aisle within the warehouse where this storage location is physically situated. Used for warehouse navigation, pick path optimization, and physical inventory counting.

attributes.name: area_sqm
attributes.description: Physical floor area of this storage location in square meters. Used for capacity planning, fire load calculations, and regulatory reporting of storage area dimensions per EPA and OSHA requirements.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 264; NFPA 30; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse location master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Audit Log; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5 (Documented Information)

attributes.name: electrical_area_classification
attributes.description: NEC/NFPA 70 electrical area classification for this storage location, indicating the presence and likelihood of flammable vapors or combustible dust. Determines requirements for explosion-proof electrical equipment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unclassified|class_i_div1|class_i_div2|class_ii_div1|class_ii_div2|zone_0|zone_1|zone_2 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: epa_regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Applicable EPA regulatory citation(s) governing storage requirements at this location (e.g., '40 CFR Part 264 - Hazardous Waste Storage', '40 CFR Part 68 - RMP'). Used for environmental compliance documentation, permit management, and regulatory audit support.

attributes.name: fire_zone_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the fire protection zone in which this storage location resides. Fire zones define the boundaries of fire suppression systems (sprinkler zones, deluge systems), fire detection circuits, and emergency evacuation areas. Referenced in PSM and HAZOP documentation.
attributes.references: NFPA 13; NFPA 30; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 (PSM); EPA RMP

attributes.name: floor_load_capacity_kg_m2
attributes.description: Maximum allowable floor load in kilograms per square meter for this storage location. Ensures structural integrity of the warehouse floor when storing heavy drums, IBCs, or bulk containers. Referenced in facility engineering and OSHA compliance inspections.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.22; NFPA 1; Building Structural Engineering Standards

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_class_compatibility
attributes.business_glossary_term: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Hazard Class Compatibility
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of GHS hazard classes that are approved for storage at this location (e.g., 'Flammable Liquid|Oxidizer|Corrosive'). Governs which chemical materials may be placed here based on GHS classification. Used to enforce chemical segregation rules and prevent incompatible co-storage.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev 9; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: height_m
attributes.description: Clear storage height in meters for this location. Used to determine maximum pallet stack height, forklift clearance requirements, and sprinkler system design (in-rack vs. ceiling sprinklers per NFPA 13).

attributes.name: incompatible_hazard_classes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incompatible GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Hazard Classes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of GHS hazard classes that must NOT be co-stored at this location due to chemical incompatibility or regulatory segregation requirements (e.g., 'Oxidizer|Explosive'). Enforces NFPA and OSHA chemical segregation rules to prevent dangerous reactions.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9; NFPA 400; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; EPA 40 CFR Part 264

attributes.name: is_hazmat_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is approved and certified for the storage of hazardous materials per OSHA, EPA, and DOT regulations. True = approved for hazmat storage; False = not approved. Drives putaway rule enforcement in SAP EWM.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; DOT 49 CFR; EPA 40 CFR Part 264

attributes.name: is_quarantine_zone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated as a quarantine zone for materials under quality hold, regulatory hold, or investigation. True = quarantine zone; False = standard storage. Materials in quarantine zones are blocked from use in production or shipment per GMP and ISO 9001 requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; SAP QM Quarantine Stock

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location has active temperature control (refrigeration, heating, or climate control). True = temperature controlled; False = ambient storage. Drives material assignment rules for temperature-sensitive chemicals and cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection or safety audit conducted at this storage location. Used to track inspection frequency compliance per OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, and internal EHS management requirements. Triggers re-inspection workflows when overdue.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 (PSM); EPA 40 CFR Part 68 (RMP); ISO 45001; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse location master record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with SAP EWM, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Audit Log; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; SOX

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the storage location within the warehouse network. Corresponds to SAP EWM storage bin or storage section code used in warehouse operations, goods movements, and transfer orders.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Storage Bin Master; ISO 3166

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the storage location (e.g., 'Tank Farm A - Bay 3', 'Hazmat Drum Storage Zone 2', 'Cold Storage Room 1'). Used in operational reports, safety documentation, and warehouse management interfaces.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the storage location. 'quarantine' indicates the location is reserved for materials under quality hold. 'blocked' indicates the location is temporarily unavailable for putaway or picking. 'under_maintenance' indicates the location is undergoing inspection or repair.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Storage Bin Status; ISO 9001

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical storage location type within the warehouse network. Determines applicable storage rules, capacity constraints, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk_tank|drum_storage|cold_storage|hazmat_zone|quarantine_bay|finished_goods|intermediate_storage|open_yard — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP EWM Storage Type Configuration; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: max_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable relative humidity percentage for this storage location. Prevents moisture-induced degradation, corrosion, or microbial growth in stored materials. Expressed as a percentage (0–100).

attributes.name: max_quantity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum quantity in kilograms of hazardous material permitted in this storage zone per EPA, OSHA PSM, and NFPA regulations. Used to enforce Tier II reporting thresholds, RMP covered quantity limits, and NFPA maximum allowable quantities (MAQ) per control area.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 68 (RMP); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 (PSM); NFPA 400; EPCRA Section 312 Tier II

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this location. Prevents thermal degradation, spontaneous reaction, or ignition of stored chemicals. Enforced against material SDS storage condition requirements.
attributes.references: GHS Section 7 Storage Conditions; NFPA 30; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: max_volume_liters
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity in liters for this storage location. Particularly relevant for bulk tank farms and liquid chemical storage areas. Used to enforce maximum quantity limits per EPA and OSHA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 264; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; NFPA 30

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable weight in kilograms that this storage location can safely hold. Enforced during putaway to prevent structural overloading. Critical for rack integrity compliance and OSHA load rating requirements.

attributes.name: min_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Minimum allowable relative humidity percentage for this storage location. Relevant for hygroscopic chemicals, moisture-sensitive materials, and packaging integrity. Expressed as a percentage (0–100).

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this location. Enforces cold chain and temperature-sensitive chemical storage requirements. Materials requiring higher minimum temperatures must not be stored here.
attributes.references: GHS Section 7 Storage Conditions; ISO 9001; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the next physical inspection or safety audit of this storage location must be completed. Drives EHS compliance calendar and corrective action workflows in Intelex EHS Management.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 (PSM); EPA 40 CFR Part 68 (RMP); ISO 45001; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: nfpa_fire_diamond_flammability
attributes.business_glossary_term: NFPA (National Fire Protection Association) Fire Diamond Flammability Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 flammability hazard rating (red diamond) for the storage location. Scale: 0 (will not burn) to 4 (extremely flammable). Drives fire suppression system design, electrical classification, and hot work permit requirements.

attributes.name: nfpa_fire_diamond_health
attributes.business_glossary_term: NFPA (National Fire Protection Association) Fire Diamond Health Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 health hazard rating (blue diamond) for the storage location, indicating the degree of health hazard posed by materials stored here. Scale: 0 (no hazard) to 4 (deadly). Posted on location signage for emergency responder awareness.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for Identification of the Hazards of Materials for Emergency Response

attributes.name: nfpa_fire_diamond_reactivity
attributes.business_glossary_term: NFPA (National Fire Protection Association) Fire Diamond Reactivity Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 instability/reactivity hazard rating (yellow diamond) for the storage location. Scale: 0 (stable) to 4 (may detonate). Informs emergency response procedures and incompatible material segregation requirements.

attributes.name: nfpa_fire_diamond_special
attributes.business_glossary_term: NFPA (National Fire Protection Association) Fire Diamond Special Hazard
attributes.description: NFPA 704 special hazard symbol (white diamond) for the storage location. Common values: 'W' (water reactive), 'OX' (oxidizer), 'SA' (simple asphyxiant). Empty if no special hazard applies. Used in emergency response planning and SDS alignment.

attributes.name: osha_regulatory_citation
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) Regulatory Citation
attributes.description: Applicable OSHA regulatory citation(s) governing safety requirements at this storage location (e.g., '29 CFR 1910.106 - Flammable Liquids', '29 CFR 1910.119 - PSM'). Used for workplace safety compliance documentation and OSHA inspection readiness.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing or distribution facility to which this warehouse location belongs. Aligns with SAP MM/EWM plant-warehouse structure for inventory valuation and materials management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant Master; SAP EWM Warehouse Number

attributes.name: rack
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier for the rack or bay within the aisle where this storage location is physically situated. Used in conjunction with aisle and level to precisely identify the bin coordinate.

attributes.name: rotation_strategy
attributes.description: Inventory lot rotation strategy enforced at this storage location. FIFO (First In First Out) is standard for most materials; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is required for materials with expiration dates to prevent use of expired stock. Drives SAP EWM picking strategy configuration.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Picking Strategy; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: storage_condition_code
attributes.description: SAP MM/EWM storage condition code assigned to this location, used to match materials requiring specific storage conditions (e.g., flammable, corrosive, refrigerated, dry). Enforces material-location compatibility during putaway strategy execution.
attributes.references: SAP MM Storage Condition; GHS Section 7; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: storage_section_code
attributes.description: SAP EWM storage section code grouping this location within the warehouse. Storage sections define areas with similar storage conditions (e.g., flammable liquids section, refrigerated section) and drive putaway and picking strategies.

attributes.name: ventilation_class
attributes.description: Classification of the ventilation system installed at this storage location. Determines suitability for storing volatile organic compounds (VOCs), flammable vapors, and hazardous air pollutants (HAPs). Explosion-proof ventilation is required for Class I flammable liquid storage per NFPA 30.
attributes.references: NFPA 30; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.94; EPA 40 CFR Part 63 (HAP); GHS

attributes.name: warehouse_location_level
attributes.description: Vertical level or tier identifier within the rack or shelving structure (e.g., '01' for ground level, '02' for second tier). Used for ergonomic storage assignment and weight-bearing capacity management.

attributes.name: warehouse_number
attributes.description: SAP EWM warehouse number identifying the logical warehouse complex to which this location belongs. Used for warehouse-level inventory management, transfer order processing, and EWM configuration.

products.name: lot
products.description: Lot (batch) master record representing a discrete quantity of a chemical material produced or received under uniform conditions. Captures lot number, material reference, manufacturing date, expiration date, retest date, days-to-expiry threshold, COA reference, GMP status, quarantine flag, lot origin (internal production vs. external receipt), current disposition (released, quarantined, rejected, expired), shelf-life remaining calculation basis, and country-of-origin for regulatory reporting. Central to FIFO/FEFO rotation, full traceability, recall management, and regulatory compliance (FDA, REACH, TSCA). Integrates with LabWare LIMS for QC release status.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lot

attributes.name: supply_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lot (batch) master record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for all downstream joins and traceability chains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM / MM Batch Master; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.2 Identification and Traceability

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Lot traceability requires association with the chemical product for quality release, regulatory reporting, and batch‑level SDS reference.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: GMP quality system requires linking each lot to the chemist/technician who created it for batch release documentation.

attributes.name: experimental_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_formulation. Business justification: Scale‑up reporting ties each manufactured lot to the experimental formulation used, enabling cost and performance analysis.

attributes.name: formula_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula_version. Business justification: Traceability report & regulatory compliance require linking each produced lot to the specific formula version used for batch investigation and quality control.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order or process order under which this lot was manufactured. Null for externally procured lots. Maps to SAP Production Order (AUFNR) in PP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Order (AUFNR); GMP Batch Record; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.188

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the chemical substance, intermediate, finished good, or packaging material associated with this lot. Maps to SAP Material Number (MATNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master (MATNR); ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or receiving facility where this lot was produced or first received. Maps to SAP Plant (WERKS) in MM/PP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Plant (WERKS); ISO 14001:2015 Facility Identification

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Needed to link each production lot to its supplying purchase order, enabling lot‑level traceability for compliance audits and quality investigations.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Regulatory batch traceability requires linking each production lot to the originating R&D project for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external supplier or vendor from whom this lot was received, applicable when lot origin is external procurement. Null for internally produced lots. Maps to SAP Vendor (LIFNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LIFNR); REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Article 31 Supplier Identification

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse storage location or tank farm bin where this lot is currently physically stored. Maps to SAP Storage Location (LGORT) and SAP EWM storage bin.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Storage Location; SAP S/4HANA MM LGORT; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 Flammable Liquids Storage

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: The document reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued for this lot, confirming that the material meets all specified quality parameters. Provided to customers with shipments and required for regulatory submissions. Stored in LabWare LIMS and SAP QM.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS COA Module; SAP S/4HANA QM Inspection Lot; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.194

attributes.name: coc_number
attributes.description: The document reference number of the Certificate of Compliance (COC) issued for this lot, attesting conformance to customer-specified or regulatory requirements beyond standard QC testing (e.g., REACH compliance, RoHS, food-contact suitability). Distinct from COA which covers analytical results.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6; Customer Contract Requirements

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where this lot was manufactured or, for natural raw materials, where it was extracted. Required for customs declarations, import/export compliance, trade preference certificates, and REACH/TSCA regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; WTO Rules of Origin; US CBP Country of Origin Marking; REACH Regulation; TSCA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lot master record was first created in the source system (SAP MM Batch Master or LabWare LIMS), recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GMP record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Master Creation Timestamp; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; GMP ICH Q7 Section 6 Documentation; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the inventory_valuation_price (e.g., USD, EUR). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and FASB/IFRS compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; IFRS IAS 21; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: current_quantity
attributes.description: The remaining unreserved quantity of material currently available in this lot, updated with each inventory movement (goods issue, transfer, adjustment). Supports real-time stock position reporting and FIFO/FEFO allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Overview (MMBE); SAP EWM Available Stock; FIFO/FEFO Inventory Rotation

attributes.name: days_to_expiry_threshold
attributes.description: The number of days before expiration at which this lot should trigger an inventory alert for proactive disposition, customer notification, or markdown action. Configured per material type and customer contract requirements. Used by FEFO rotation and expiry management workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management Configuration; FEFO Inventory Management Best Practice; Customer Contract SLA

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current quality disposition of the lot governing whether it may be used, shipped, or must be held. Released: QC-approved for use/sale. Quarantined: held pending QC decision. Rejected: failed QC and must be destroyed or reworked. Expired: past expiration date. Under Review: Out-of-Specification (OOS) or Out-of-Trend (OOT) investigation in progress. Recalled: subject to active recall action. Maps to SAP QM Usage Decision (VRBWG).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Usage Decision; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.165 OOS; ICH Q7 Section 11 Rejected Materials; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which this lot must not be used, sold, or shipped. Calculated from manufacture date plus approved shelf-life period or assigned by QA based on stability data. Central to FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory rotation logic. Maps to SAP Batch Expiration Date (VFDAT).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Master VFDAT; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; ICH Q1A Stability Testing; FEFO Inventory Rotation

attributes.name: gmp_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot was manufactured under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) conditions as required for pharmaceutical-grade, food-contact, or regulated chemical applications. Drives customer-specific COA declarations and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 210-211 GMP; ICH Q7 Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) GMP; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date this lot was physically received into the warehouse or plant, recorded at goods receipt posting in SAP MM. For internally produced lots, this is the date the finished goods were transferred to the warehouse. Maps to SAP MIGO Goods Receipt Posting Date (BUDAT).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt BUDAT; SAP EWM Inbound Delivery; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.4.3

attributes.name: grade
attributes.description: Quality grade classification assigned to this lot based on QC test results and intended end-use application. Prime: meets full specification. Off-grade: meets reduced specification for alternative use. Technical/Pharmaceutical/Food/Agricultural grades reflect regulatory and customer-specific quality tiers. Drives pricing and customer allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Batch Classification; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.165; GMP ICH Q7

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is classified as a hazardous material requiring special storage, handling, labelling, and transport compliance under DOT, OSHA, and GHS regulations. Triggers hazmat storage location validation in SAP EWM.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180 Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication; GHS Rev.9; NFPA 400

attributes.name: initial_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity of material in this lot at the time of creation (production completion or goods receipt). Expressed in the base unit of measure of the material. Used as the denominator for yield calculations and lot consumption tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Stock Quantity; GMP Batch Record Yield Reconciliation; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.188

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_price
attributes.description: The per-unit valuation price applied to this lot for inventory accounting purposes, expressed in the company's functional currency. Used for COGS calculation, inventory write-down assessment, and financial reporting. Maps to SAP Moving Average Price or Standard Price (VERPR/STPRS) in FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Material Valuation (VERPR/STPRS); FASB ASC 330 Inventory; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories; SOX Section 404 Inventory Controls

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this lot master record in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trail compliance, and detecting stale records in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Master Change Timestamp; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; GMP ICH Q7 Section 6 Documentation

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric batch/lot identifier assigned at production or goods receipt. Used on Certificate of Analysis (COA), Certificate of Compliance (COC), shipping documents, and regulatory submissions. Maps to SAP Batch Number (CHARG) in MM/QM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM CHARG field; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.184; GMP Batch Record Requirements; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which production of this lot was completed or, for externally received lots, the date of manufacture as declared by the supplier. Basis for shelf-life and expiration date calculation. Maps to SAP Batch Manufacturing Date (HSDAT).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Master HSDAT; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137 Expiration Dating; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: moisture_content_percent
attributes.description: The measured moisture content of this lot expressed as a percentage by weight, as determined by QC testing (e.g., Karl Fischer titration, loss on drying). Critical for solid and powder chemical products where moisture affects stability, reactivity, and product performance.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS COA Analytical Results; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6; ASTM E203 Water Determination; ICH Q6A

attributes.name: nfpa_fire_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Fire Hazard Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 flammability hazard rating (0-4) for the material in this lot. 0 = will not burn; 4 = will rapidly vaporize at normal conditions. Used for storage location assignment, fire suppression system design, and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for Identification of the Hazards of Materials for Emergency Response; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: origin
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot was created through internal manufacturing, received from an external supplier, produced via rework/reprocessing of a non-conforming lot, or originated from a customer return. Drives traceability and regulatory reporting workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Batch Classification; GMP ICH Q7 Section 7 Materials Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.80

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: The measured pH (Potential of Hydrogen) of this lot as determined by QC laboratory testing. Critical quality parameter for chemical products; drives corrosivity classification, storage material compatibility, and regulatory classification under GHS/DOT. Sourced from LabWare LIMS COA results.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Analytical Results; GHS Rev.9 Corrosive Classification; DOT 49 CFR 173.136; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: purity_percent
attributes.description: The measured purity of the primary chemical substance in this lot expressed as a percentage by weight or volume, as determined by QC analytical testing. Key quality attribute for pricing, formulation accuracy, and regulatory compliance. Sourced from LabWare LIMS COA.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS COA Analytical Results; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6; ICH Q6A Specifications for Chemical Substances; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.165

attributes.name: qc_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Quality Assurance function formally released this lot from quarantine to unrestricted use following successful completion of all required QC testing. Populated from LabWare LIMS usage decision timestamp. Critical for lead-time and cycle-time analytics.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Usage Decision; SAP S/4HANA QM Usage Decision Date; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.165; GMP ICH Q7 Section 11

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this lot is currently under quarantine and must not be issued, shipped, or consumed until released by Quality Assurance. Complements disposition_status for rapid system-level blocking in SAP EWM and WMS pick operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Batch Restriction; SAP EWM Quarantine Management; GMP ICH Q7 Section 11.1

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is subject to an active product recall or market withdrawal action. When True, triggers immediate inventory blocking in SAP EWM, customer notification workflows, and regulatory reporting to FDA/EPA/ECHA as applicable.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 Recall Procedures; EPA TSCA Section 5(e) Recall; REACH Regulation Article 68; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7.1

attributes.name: restricted_substance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains substances subject to regulatory restriction or authorization under REACH SVHC (Substances of Very High Concern), TSCA, or RoHS. Triggers compliance review before shipment to regulated markets.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Annex XIV/XVII; TSCA Section 5/6; ECHA SVHC Candidate List

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: The date by which this lot must be retested by the QC laboratory to confirm continued conformance to specification before further use or shipment. Applicable to raw materials and intermediates with defined retest intervals. Maps to SAP Batch Next Inspection Date (PRÜFDATUM).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Batch Inspection; ICH Q7 Section 7.3 Retesting; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.166 Stability Testing

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The total approved shelf life of this lot expressed in days, as defined by the material specification or stability study. Used to validate expiration date assignment and to support shelf-life remaining calculations for customer order fulfillment. Maps to SAP Material Master Total Shelf Life (MHDRZ).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master MHDRZ; ICH Q1A Stability Testing Guidelines; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: supplier_lot_number
attributes.description: The original lot or batch number assigned by the external supplier, as printed on the supplier COA and shipping documents. Maintained alongside the internal lot_number for full traceability back to the supplier's manufacturing records. Null for internally produced lots.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Master External Batch Number; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.184 Supplier Traceability; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.4.3

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which lot quantities are expressed (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for litres, MT for metric tonnes). Aligns with SAP Base Unit of Measure (MEINS) on the material master. Required for all quantity-based calculations and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|G|M3|BBL|EA|BAG — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master MEINS; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units; UN/CEFACT Unit of Measure Codes

attributes.name: voc_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) Content (Parts Per Million)
attributes.description: The measured or declared Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) content of this lot expressed in Parts Per Million (PPM) by weight. Required for EPA air emissions reporting, state VOC regulations, and customer environmental product declarations. Sourced from QC analytical results in LabWare LIMS.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 51 VOC Regulations; EPA Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) Reporting; ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Reporting; LabWare LIMS Analytical Results

products.name: stock_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement event including goods receipts (GR), goods issues (GI), stock transfers, returns, scrapping, sampling, and revaluations. Captures movement type code (replacing the former movement_type reference table), material, lot number, quantity, unit of measure, source location, destination location, movement direction (inbound/outbound/internal), movement reason, reference document (PO, production order, sales order, delivery), posting date, posting user, and FIFO/FEFO lot selection validation result. Provides the complete audit trail for all inventory changes. Subsumes formerly separate goods_receipt and goods_issue records as movement subtypes.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Document / Movement Type

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each inventory movement event record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the stock_movement data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Document

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Needed for posting inventory movements to the correct cost center in the Cost Center Allocation report.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The SAP user ID (USNAM) of the person who posted the inventory movement in SAP S/4HANA MM. Critical for audit trail, SOX compliance, and accountability tracking. Represents the system user, which may be a human operator or an automated interface (e.g., MES integration, SCADA feed).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - USNAM; SOX; ISO 9001; GMP 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Stock movement must be linked to the lot it moves; replace string lot_number with FK lot_id for traceability.

attributes.name: outbound_delivery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.outbound_delivery. Business justification: Required for the Delivery Execution report to trace which stock movements belong to each outbound delivery for compliance and audit.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Supports profit center profitability analysis of inventory movements for internal management reporting.

attributes.name: transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.transfer_order. Business justification: Link stock movement to its originating transfer order for end‑to‑end tracking; replace free‑text field with FK.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse_location. Business justification: Stock movement must reference the source warehouse location entity for accurate location tracking and audit reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the stock movement record was first captured and persisted in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and FIFO/FEFO sequencing validation. Corresponds to SAP CPUDT + CPUTM fields combined.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - CPUDT/CPUTM; SOX; ISO 9001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the movement_amount valuation (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Corresponds to SAP WAERS field. Required for multi-currency chemical manufacturing operations with global procurement and sales.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - WAERS; ISO 4217; FASB; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: destination_storage_location
attributes.description: The SAP storage location code (Lagerort) to which the material is being moved or received. Represents the target warehouse area, tank farm zone, production staging area, or quarantine location. Null for pure outbound goods issues with no destination location within the plant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - LGORT (destination); SAP EWM; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the physical or external source document (e.g., vendor delivery note, production order confirmation) that triggered the inventory movement. May differ from posting_date when documents are processed with a lag. Corresponds to SAP BLDAT field.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or shelf-life end date of the lot/batch being moved. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) lot rotation enforcement, quarantine triggering for expired materials, and regulatory compliance. Corresponds to SAP VFDAT (shelf life expiration date) on the batch master. Critical for chemical raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods with defined shelf lives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - VFDAT; GMP; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; REACH

attributes.name: fifo_fefo_validation_result
attributes.description: The result of the FIFO (First In First Out) or FEFO (First Expired First Out) lot rotation validation check performed at the time of goods issue. Passed = correct lot selected per rotation policy; Failed = incorrect lot selected, violating rotation rules; Not Applicable = movement type does not require lot rotation validation (e.g., goods receipt); Overridden = FIFO/FEFO rule was manually overridden with documented justification. Critical for chemical product quality, shelf-life management, and GMP compliance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM; SAP S/4HANA MM; GMP; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: goods_receipt_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt movement was posted to GR blocked stock (Wareneingang gesperrt), meaning the material has been physically received but not yet released for use pending inspection or documentation review. True = posted to blocked GR stock; False = posted directly to unrestricted or inspection stock. Corresponds to SAP movement type 103/105 scenario.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 9001 Incoming Inspection; GMP

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material being moved is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, or transport compliance. True = hazardous material subject to EHS regulations (GHS, DOT, OSHA, EPA); False = non-hazardous material. Triggers hazmat storage compliance checks and EHS reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GHS; DOT 49 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; EPA TSCA; REACH; NFPA

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP material document number (Materialbelegs-nummer) assigned by SAP S/4HANA MM upon posting the inventory movement. Serves as the primary business identifier linking back to the source system transaction. Equivalent to MBLNR in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MBLNR; SAP EWM

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the material document was posted in SAP S/4HANA MM. Combined with material_document_number forms the unique SAP document key (MBLNR + MJAHR).

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number (Materialnummer - MATNR) uniquely identifying the chemical substance, raw material, intermediate, finished product, or packaging material being moved. Links to the material master record which contains CAS number, GHS classification, and SDS references.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MATNR; CAS Registry; GHS; REACH

attributes.name: movement_amount
attributes.description: The inventory valuation amount (in local currency) associated with this stock movement, representing the financial impact on inventory accounts. Calculated as quantity multiplied by the moving average price or standard price at time of posting. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) reporting, inventory valuation, and FI/CO integration. Corresponds to SAP DMBTR field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - DMBTR; FASB ASC 330; SOX; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: movement_category
attributes.description: High-level business classification of the inventory movement event. Goods Receipt (GR) covers inbound receipts from vendors or production; Goods Issue (GI) covers consumption or outbound shipments; Stock Transfer covers location-to-location moves; Return covers vendor or customer returns; Scrapping covers material write-offs; Sampling covers quality lab withdrawals; Revaluation covers price or valuation adjustments. Subsumes formerly separate goods_receipt and goods_issue records as movement subtypes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: goods_receipt|goods_issue|stock_transfer|return|scrapping|sampling|revaluation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 9001; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: movement_direction
attributes.description: Directional classification of the inventory movement relative to the plant or warehouse: inbound (stock entering the facility, e.g., goods receipt), outbound (stock leaving the facility, e.g., goods issue to customer or production), or internal (stock moving within the facility, e.g., storage location transfer). Used for net stock position calculations and directional reporting.

attributes.name: movement_reason_code
attributes.description: A coded reason explaining why the inventory movement occurred, beyond what the movement type conveys. Examples include: production consumption, quality rejection, customer return, vendor return, cycle count adjustment, process loss, sampling withdrawal, spillage/waste, regulatory disposal. Corresponds to SAP GRUND field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production_consumption|quality_rejection|customer_return|vendor_return|cycle_count_adjustment|process_loss|sampling|spillage|regulatory_disposal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - GRUND; ISO 9001; EPA TRI Reporting; OSHA

attributes.name: movement_reason_text
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context or explanation for the inventory movement reason, supplementing the movement_reason_code. Used for exception documentation, CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) linkage, and audit trail narratives. Corresponds to SAP text fields associated with GRUND.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 9001 CAPA; GMP

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stock movement record. Posted = successfully committed to inventory books; Reversed = cancelled by a subsequent reversal posting; Blocked = movement is on hold pending approval or investigation; Pending Approval = movement requires workflow approval before final posting (e.g., high-value scrapping). Supports workflow management and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX; ISO 9001; GMP

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: SAP movement type code (Bewegungsart) that classifies the inventory transaction. Standard codes include 101 (Goods Receipt for PO), 122 (Return to Vendor), 201 (Goods Issue to Cost Center), 261 (Goods Issue for Production Order), 301 (Transfer Posting), 551 (Scrapping), 601 (Goods Issue for Delivery), 701 (Inventory Difference). Replaces the former movement_type reference table as an embedded code per product design. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 101|122|201|261|301|551|601|701|... — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - BWART; ISO 9001 Inventory Control

attributes.name: order_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure used in the reference order document (purchase order, sales order, or production order) for this movement. Corresponds to SAP ERFME field. Enables reconciliation between order quantities and inventory quantities when UOM conversion applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - ERFME; UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code (Werk) identifying the manufacturing or distribution facility where the inventory movement occurred. In chemical manufacturing, plants correspond to production sites, tank farms, or distribution centers. Serves as the primary organizational unit for inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - WERKS; ISO 14001; EPA Facility Reporting

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the inventory movement was officially posted to the books in SAP S/4HANA MM (Buchungsdatum - BUDAT). This is the date used for inventory valuation, financial period assignment, and regulatory reporting. Distinct from the document creation timestamp.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - BUDAT; FASB ASC 330 Inventory; SOX

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material involved in the inventory movement, expressed in the base unit of measure. Positive values represent inbound or internal movements; negative values represent outbound or consumption movements per SAP convention. Supports up to 4 decimal places for precision chemical measurements (e.g., kg, L, mol).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MENGE; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: quantity_in_order_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quantity in Order Unit of Measure
attributes.description: The movement quantity expressed in the order unit of measure (e.g., purchase order UOM or sales order UOM), which may differ from the base unit of measure. For example, a material ordered in drums (DR) but managed in kilograms (KG). Corresponds to SAP ERFMG field.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material involved in this movement is under quarantine status at the time of the movement. True = material is quarantined (e.g., pending QC release, OOS investigation, regulatory hold, contamination suspicion); False = material is not under quarantine. Supports hazardous material storage compliance and GMP quality hold management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; GMP; ISO 9001; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; OSHA

attributes.name: reference_document_item
attributes.description: The line item number within the reference document (e.g., PO line item, production order component line) associated with this inventory movement. Combined with reference_document_number provides precise traceability to the originating document line. Corresponds to SAP EBELP (PO item) field.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: The number of the originating reference document (e.g., Purchase Order number, Production Order number, Sales Order number, Delivery number) that triggered this inventory movement. Provides the complete audit trail linking inventory movements back to procurement, production, or sales transactions. Corresponds to SAP EBELN (PO) or AUFNR (order) depending on context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - EBELN; PP - AUFNR; SD - VBELN; SOX

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: The type of the originating business document that triggered this inventory movement. Purchase Order (PO) for vendor receipts; Production Order or Process Order for manufacturing consumption/receipt; Sales Order for customer-specific stock; Delivery for outbound shipments; Transfer Order for warehouse transfers; Reservation for planned withdrawals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase_order|production_order|sales_order|delivery|transfer_order|process_order|reservation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock movement record is a reversal (cancellation) of a previously posted movement. True = this document is a reversal posting that negates a prior movement; False = original movement. Essential for net inventory position calculations and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - STBLG; SOX; ISO 9001

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number of the original movement that this record reverses, when reversal_flag is True. Enables bidirectional audit trail linking between original and reversal postings. Corresponds to SAP STBLG field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - STBLG; SOX; GMP

attributes.name: source_plant_code
attributes.description: The SAP plant code of the sending plant for inter-plant stock transfer movements (STO - Stock Transfer Orders). Populated only for cross-plant transfers. Corresponds to SAP UMWRK field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - UMWRK; SAP EWM

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special stock indicator (SOBKZ) identifying non-standard stock ownership or custody arrangements. E = Sales Order Stock (make-to-order), K = Consignment Stock at Customer, Q = Project Stock, V = Consignment Stock from Vendor, W = Returnable Transport Packaging. Empty for standard own stock. Critical for chemical toll manufacturing and consignment inventory scenarios.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The SAP stock type category indicating the usability status of the inventory being moved. Unrestricted stock is available for use; Quality Inspection stock is under QC hold pending COA approval; Blocked stock is restricted from use (e.g., OOS - Out of Specification); Restricted stock has conditional use limitations; Returns stock is customer-returned material awaiting disposition. Corresponds to SAP SOBKZ / INSMK fields.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - INSMK; ISO 9001 QMS; GMP; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for the movement quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, EA for each, DR for drums, IBC for intermediate bulk containers). Corresponds to SAP MEINS (base UOM) field. Critical for chemical inventory accuracy and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MEINS; ISO 80000; UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the stock movement record was last modified in the source system or lakehouse silver layer. Supports incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: SAP valuation type (Bewertungsart - BWTAR) used when a material is managed with split valuation — for example, differentiating between domestic-sourced and imported raw materials, or between different quality grades of the same chemical. Enables separate inventory valuation for the same material number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - BWTAR; FASB ASC 330; SOX

products.name: transfer_order
products.description: Warehouse transfer order issued within SAP EWM to physically move stock from one storage bin or location to another within the same warehouse complex. Captures transfer order number, source bin, destination bin, material, lot, quantity, transfer type (replenishment, putaway, pick, internal transfer), priority, assigned operator, confirmation status, and execution timestamps. Distinct from inter-plant stock transfer orders which are logistics-domain events.

attributes.name: transfer_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the warehouse transfer order record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns inter‑warehouse transfer orders to cost centers for budgeting and expense tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse operator or forklift driver assigned to execute this transfer order. Used for labor tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: handling_unit_id
attributes.description: SAP EWM handling unit identifier (pallet, IBC, drum, container) being physically moved. Links the transfer order to the physical packaging unit for scan-based confirmation and traceability.

attributes.name: line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.line_item. Business justification: Inter‑plant transfer orders are often created to fulfill a particular sales order line; linking enables the Transfer Fulfillment tracking report.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material (raw material, intermediate, finished good, or packaging) being physically moved by this transfer order. Aligns with SAP MM material master.

attributes.name: transfer_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.transfer_price. Business justification: Needed for interplant transfer pricing calculations used in profitability analysis and tax compliance.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse complex within which this transfer order is executed. Scopes the source and destination bins to a single warehouse facility.

attributes.name: warehouse_task_id
attributes.description: SAP EWM warehouse task identifier linked to this transfer order. A transfer order may be decomposed into one or more warehouse tasks for execution by operators or automated systems (e.g., conveyor, AGV).

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operator physically began executing the transfer order (e.g., first scan of source bin or handling unit). Enables measurement of queue wait time and operator response time.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for cancellation of the transfer order (e.g., material not found at source bin, bin blocked, production order cancelled, duplicate order). Supports root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order was cancelled in SAP EWM. Populated only when transfer_order_status = 'cancelled'. Used for exception reporting and warehouse efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: confirmation_method
attributes.description: Method used by the operator or system to confirm execution of the transfer order. 'rf_scan' = RF barcode/RFID scanner; 'manual' = paper-based or keyboard entry; 'automated_conveyor' = conveyor system auto-confirmation; 'voice_picking' = voice-directed warehouse system; 'agv' = automated guided vehicle.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity confirmed as physically moved by the operator upon transfer order completion. May differ from transfer_quantity due to partial picks, short picks, or discrepancies discovered during execution.

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order was fully confirmed in SAP EWM, triggering the inventory goods movement posting. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Transfer Order Confirmation; SAP MM Goods Movement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transfer order was first created in SAP EWM. Represents the record audit creation time and the start of the transfer order lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Transfer Order Header; ISO 8601

attributes.name: destination_bin
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier of the specific storage bin, rack location, or tank to which the material is being moved. Represents the physical destination within the warehouse complex.

attributes.name: destination_storage_section
attributes.description: SAP EWM storage section within the destination storage type, providing logical grouping of target bins.

attributes.name: destination_storage_type
attributes.description: SAP EWM storage type code for the target location. Used to validate compatibility with material hazard classification and storage requirements (e.g., flammable, corrosive, oxidizer segregation per OSHA PSM and NFPA codes).
attributes.references: SAP EWM Storage Type; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; NFPA 30

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or shelf-life expiry date of the material lot being transferred. Used to enforce FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation rules and prevent movement of expired material to active storage. Critical for GMP compliance.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 211; SAP QM Batch Classification; ISO 9001

attributes.name: goods_movement_document
attributes.description: SAP MM material document number generated upon posting of the inventory goods movement triggered by transfer order confirmation. Links the physical warehouse movement to the financial inventory posting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Document; SAP FI/CO Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight in kilograms of the material quantity being transferred, including packaging (drums, IBCs, pallets). Used for load planning, equipment capacity validation, and DOT hazmat transport documentation.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; SAP MM Material Master Weight

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: GHS/DOT hazard classification of the material being transferred (e.g., Flammable Liquid Class 3, Corrosive, Oxidizer, Toxic). Drives storage segregation rules and emergency response procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flammable_liquid|corrosive|oxidizer|toxic|explosive|compressed_gas|environmental_hazard|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); DOT 49 CFR 172; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material being transferred is classified as hazardous under DOT, OSHA, or GHS regulations. When True, additional handling protocols, PPE requirements, and segregation rules apply. Supports EHS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS; TSCA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to the transfer order record in SAP EWM (e.g., quantity change, operator reassignment, status update). Supports audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Transfer Order Header; ISO 8601

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing or receiving lot number associated with the material being transferred. Critical for FIFO/FEFO lot rotation compliance, COA traceability, and GMP batch genealogy. Aligns with SAP QM batch management.
attributes.references: SAP QM Batch Management; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: SAP EWM/WM movement type code (e.g., 311, 312, 321) that drives the inventory posting logic and account determination in SAP FI/CO. Provides granular classification beyond the high-level transfer_type.

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the physical movement is planned to begin. Used for warehouse resource scheduling, shift planning, and SLA monitoring against production order requirements.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority level assigned to the transfer order for warehouse queue management. Lower values indicate higher urgency (e.g., 1 = urgent production replenishment, 10 = routine reorganization). Used by SAP EWM task interleaving and resource optimization.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material lot being transferred is under quarantine status (e.g., pending QC release, OOS investigation, CAPA hold). When True, the transfer may only move material to a designated quarantine storage area. Aligns with SAP QM usage decision.
attributes.references: SAP QM Usage Decision; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Number of the upstream triggering document that initiated this transfer order (e.g., production order number, delivery note, stock transport order, replenishment request). Provides end-to-end traceability from warehouse movement back to business process.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of the upstream document that triggered this transfer order. Enables classification of warehouse movements by business process origin for analytics and KPI reporting.

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the material lot must be retested by the QC laboratory before continued use. Distinct from expiration_date; a lot may be within shelf life but require periodic requalification per LIMS-managed testing schedules.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: source_bin
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier of the specific storage bin, rack location, or tank from which the material is being moved. Represents the physical origin within the warehouse complex.

attributes.name: source_storage_section
attributes.description: SAP EWM storage section within the source storage type, providing a logical grouping of bins (e.g., flammable liquids section, ambient section, cold storage section).

attributes.name: source_storage_type
attributes.description: SAP EWM storage type code for the origin location (e.g., bulk storage, high-rack, tank farm, hazardous material cage, quarantine area). Determines handling rules and equipment requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this transfer order record was extracted. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and distinguishes between SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management), legacy SAP WM, or manually created records.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP MM special stock type indicator identifying ownership or allocation of the material (e.g., consignment stock, project stock, sales-order-specific stock). Affects inventory valuation and availability checks.

attributes.name: stock_category
attributes.description: SAP EWM/MM stock category of the material being transferred. Determines whether the stock is available for consumption or shipment. 'unrestricted' = freely available; 'quality_inspection' = pending QC release; 'blocked' = not available for use; 'returns' = returned goods; 'restricted' = conditionally available.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition code for the material (e.g., ambient, refrigerated, frozen, temperature-controlled, humidity-controlled, inert atmosphere). Validates that the destination bin meets material storage requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|refrigerated|frozen|temperature_controlled|humidity_controlled|inert_atmosphere|flammable_cabinet — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Storage Conditions; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; NFPA 30

attributes.name: to_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric transfer order number assigned by SAP EWM. This is the business-facing identifier used in warehouse operations, printed on pick/put-away documents, and referenced in MES and WMS communications.

attributes.name: transfer_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transfer order within SAP EWM. 'created' = issued but not yet started; 'in_progress' = operator has begun movement; 'partially_confirmed' = partial quantity confirmed; 'confirmed' = fully executed and goods movement posted; 'cancelled' = voided before execution.

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Planned quantity of material to be moved as specified on the transfer order at creation time. Expressed in the base unit of measure of the material (e.g., KG, L, EA, MT).

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warehouse movement purpose. 'replenishment' = restocking a pick face from reserve storage; 'putaway' = placing newly received goods into a bin; 'pick' = retrieving goods for outbound delivery; 'internal_transfer' = bin-to-bin move for reorganization or hazmat segregation; 'return_to_stock' = returning goods from staging or production back to storage.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the transfer and confirmed quantities (e.g., KG = kilograms, L = litres, MT = metric tonnes, EA = each, M3 = cubic metres). Aligns with SAP MM material master UOM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|L|EA|MT|G|M3|LB|GAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1

products.name: quarantine_hold
products.description: Record of a quarantine or quality hold placed on a specific lot or stock quantity, preventing it from being issued or shipped until disposition is resolved. Captures hold reference number, material, lot, quantity affected, hold reason (OOS result, customer complaint, regulatory hold, damage), hold initiator, hold date, target resolution date, CAPA reference, and release or rejection outcome. Integrates with LabWare LIMS and Intelex EHS for hold initiation triggers.
products.reference: SAP QM Usage Decision / Quarantine Stock

attributes.name: quarantine_hold_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the quarantine or quality hold record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the raw material, intermediate, finished good, or packaging material placed under quarantine hold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SAP EWM

attributes.name: primary_quarantine_initiator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (QA analyst, EHS officer, production supervisor, or regulatory affairs specialist) who formally initiated the quarantine hold. Party reference for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; GMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier/vendor master record when the quarantined material was externally procured. Used for supplier quality performance tracking and return-to-supplier disposition workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or tank farm location where the quarantined stock is physically stored. Links to the warehouse master in SAP EWM.
attributes.references: SAP EWM; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the quarantine hold was resolved through release, rejection, or administrative closure. Compared against target resolution date for performance reporting.

attributes.name: affected_quantity_rejected
attributes.description: Quantity of the originally held material that was condemned, destroyed, or returned to supplier following disposition. Together with affected_quantity_released, accounts for the full hold quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; SAP EWM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: affected_quantity_released
attributes.description: Quantity of the originally held material that was ultimately released for use or shipment following disposition. May be less than hold_quantity if partial release was approved (e.g., after rework or resampling).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; SAP EWM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Production batch number associated with the quarantined material, as recorded in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) or SAP PP. May differ from lot number when multiple batches are consolidated into a single lot.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; MES; GMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: capa_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record in the quality management system or Intelex EHS. Links the quarantine hold to the root cause investigation and corrective actions being taken.
attributes.references: Intelex EHS; SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; GMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the quarantine hold record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_complaint_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the customer complaint (from Salesforce CRM or SAP QM) that triggered the quarantine hold. Null for non-customer-complaint holds. Enables traceability from complaint to hold to disposition.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2.1

attributes.name: disposition_decision
