attributes.description: Final disposition outcome for the quarantined material: 'released' = approved for use or shipment; 'rejected' = condemned and removed from usable stock; 'rework' = returned to production for reprocessing; 'retest' = additional testing required before final decision; 'return_to_supplier' = returned to vendor; 'destroy' = material to be destroyed per EHS protocols; 'conditional_release' = released with documented restrictions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: released|rejected|rework|retest|return_to_supplier|destroy|conditional_release — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.204

attributes.name: disposition_justification
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the technical and business rationale for the disposition decision. Required for GMP compliance and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 211.204; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; ECHA REACH

attributes.name: disposition_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the disposition decision was formally approved and recorded. Distinct from actual resolution date; captures the precise moment of authorization.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 211; 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records); ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quarantine hold was escalated to senior management or regulatory affairs. Null if escalation_flag is false.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quarantine hold has been escalated to senior QA management, regulatory affairs, or executive leadership due to severity, regulatory implications, or breach of target resolution date.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; Intelex EHS; GMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or retest date of the quarantined lot as assigned during manufacturing or receipt. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management and determining if material has expired during the hold period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/QM; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.137; FEFO inventory standard

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_class
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification of the quarantined material (e.g., 'Flammable Liquid Cat 2', 'Acute Toxicity Cat 3', 'Corrosive'). Required for safe storage and handling during quarantine and for EHS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; ECHA CLP Regulation

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quarantined material is classified as hazardous under GHS, DOT, or OSHA standards. Drives special handling, storage segregation, and disposal requirements during the hold period.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); DOT 49 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; TSCA

attributes.name: hold_date
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when the quarantine hold was formally placed on the material or lot. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: hold_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the quarantine hold was active, calculated from hold_date to actual_resolution_date. Used for inventory aging analysis, SLA compliance reporting, and process improvement KPIs.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the quarantine hold at initiation (e.g., QH-2024-000123). Used in cross-functional communications, LIMS, and EHS systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: hold_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material placed under quarantine hold. Represents the principal quantitative fact of this hold record. Must be expressed in the base unit of measure for the material.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; SAP EWM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: hold_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the hold quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, DRUM for drum containers). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure (MEINS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|TON|EA|BAG|DRUM|IBC — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the quarantine hold. OOS = Out of Specification; OOT = Out of Trend; CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT = customer-reported quality issue; REGULATORY_HOLD = regulatory agency directive; DAMAGE = physical damage; CONTAMINATION = cross-contamination or foreign material; LABEL_ERROR = incorrect or missing labeling; PENDING_COA = Certificate of Analysis (COA) not yet received. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OOS|OOT|CUSTOMER_COMPLAINT|REGULATORY_HOLD|DAMAGE|CONTAMINATION|LABEL_ERROR|PENDING_COA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; GMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific reason for placing the material under quarantine hold. Provides context beyond the hold reason code, including test failure details, complaint summary, or regulatory directive reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the quarantine hold. 'open' indicates active restriction; 'released' indicates disposition approved for use/shipment; 'rejected' indicates material condemned or destroyed; 'pending_review' awaits disposition decision; 'escalated' requires senior QA or regulatory review; 'closed' is administratively finalized.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; GMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quarantine hold by originating function: 'quality' for QC/QA-initiated holds; 'regulatory' for holds triggered by EPA, OSHA, or ECHA directives; 'safety' for EHS-initiated holds; 'customer' for customer complaint-driven holds; 'environmental' for environmental compliance holds; 'administrative' for documentation or system-related holds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; Intelex EHS; ISO 9001:2015; ISO 14001:2015; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: initiating_system
attributes.description: Source system that triggered or originated the quarantine hold (e.g., LIMS = LabWare LIMS for OOS results; EHS = Intelex EHS for safety incidents; SAP_QM = SAP Quality Management for inspection lot failures; MES = Manufacturing Execution System; MANUAL = manually initiated by QA personnel). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LIMS|EHS|SAP_QM|MES|MANUAL|SCADA|ERP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Intelex EHS; SAP S/4HANA QM; MES

attributes.name: initiator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person who initiated the quarantine hold. Retained for audit trail and regulatory reporting purposes where employee ID alone is insufficient.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: lims_inspection_lot_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Inspection Lot Number
attributes.description: Inspection lot number from LabWare LIMS that triggered the quarantine hold due to an Out of Specification (OOS) or Out of Trend (OOT) result. Enables direct cross-reference to the laboratory test record.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; SAP S/4HANA QM; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.192

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number (LOT) of the material placed under quarantine hold. Enables full lot traceability from production through disposition. Aligns with SAP QM batch management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the material under quarantine hold, as maintained in the material master (e.g., 'Polyethylene Resin Grade A', 'Sulfuric Acid 98%').

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number (MATNR) identifying the specific chemical, intermediate, or finished product under hold. Enables cross-reference with ERP and WMS systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; SAP EWM

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing or storage facility where the quarantined material is physically located (e.g., 'PLANT01', 'TX02').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; SAP EWM

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase Order (PO) number associated with the quarantined material if it was received from an external supplier. Used for supplier quality management, return-to-supplier disposition, and debit memo processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_reference
attributes.description: External regulatory agency reference number or directive identifier when the hold is initiated by a regulatory body (e.g., EPA enforcement action number, OSHA citation reference, FDA warning letter number, ECHA restriction notice). Null for non-regulatory holds.
attributes.references: EPA; OSHA; ECHA; FDA; TSCA; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: sds_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) applicable to the quarantined material. Ensures proper handling, storage, and emergency response procedures are accessible during the hold period.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS; ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: SAP storage location (LGORT) or warehouse bin where the quarantined material is physically held. Includes tank farm designations, warehouse zones, and quarantine bays.
attributes.references: SAP EWM; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the quarantine hold disposition must be resolved (released or rejected). Used for SLA tracking, escalation management, and inventory planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.7; GMP 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the quarantine hold record was last modified. Tracks changes to disposition, status, or hold details.

products.name: physical_inventory_count
products.description: Record of a physical inventory count event (cycle count, annual wall-to-wall count, or triggered count) for a specific material at a specific storage location or bin. Captures count document number, count date, counter identity, book quantity at time of count, counted quantity, variance quantity, variance percentage, recount flag, count method (blind vs. informed), posting status, and approval chain for variance write-off. Supports regulatory and SOX-compliant inventory reconciliation and feeds inventory_adjustment records for variance postings. Integrates with SAP MM physical inventory module.

attributes.name: physical_inventory_count_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each physical inventory count record in the lakehouse silver layer. Maps to SAP MM physical inventory document item.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the manager or supervisor who approved the variance write-off. Required for SOX segregation of duties — the approver must be different from the counter.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA MM Approval Workflow

attributes.name: count_session_id
attributes.description: Identifier grouping multiple count document items that were counted together as part of the same physical inventory session or cycle count run. Enables session-level reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SAP EWM Cycle Counting

attributes.name: primary_physical_counter_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person who physically performed the count. Required for accountability, SOX segregation of duties, and audit trail. References the workforce/HR system.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Physical inventory count should reference the stock position record that aggregates quantity and location; removes duplicated attributes.

attributes.name: approval_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the approver explaining the rationale for approving the variance write-off. Supports audit documentation and Root Cause Investigation (RCI) for recurring discrepancies.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the variance write-off was approved by the authorized approver. Part of the SOX-compliant approval chain audit trail for inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: book_quantity
attributes.description: System-recorded (book) quantity of the material at the storage location at the time the count document was created, as per SAP MM inventory records. Represents the expected quantity before physical verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; FASB ASC 330

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the physical count was performed. Used for inventory valuation cutoff, regulatory reporting, and SOX period-end reconciliation.

attributes.name: count_document_item
attributes.business_glossary_term: Physical Inventory Count Document Item Number
attributes.description: Line item number within the SAP physical inventory document, distinguishing individual material-storage location combinations within the same count document.

attributes.name: count_document_number
attributes.description: SAP MM physical inventory document number (MI01/MI04) that uniquely identifies the count event in the source system. Used for reconciliation and audit trail back to SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory (Transaction MI01)

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the count was performed blind (counter not shown book quantity, reducing bias) or informed (counter shown book quantity). Blind counting is preferred for SOX-compliant inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the count document: open (count not yet performed), counted (count entered, pending posting), recounted (recount completed), posted (variance posted to inventory), cancelled (count voided).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Workflow

attributes.name: count_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the physical count was recorded, including timezone offset. Used for intraday reconciliation and audit trail in continuous process manufacturing environments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the count event: cycle_count (periodic scheduled count of a subset of materials), annual_wall_to_wall (full facility count), triggered_count (initiated due to discrepancy or event), or recount (second count to resolve variance).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Inventory Controls

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: Actual physical quantity of the material counted and recorded by the counter. This is the primary measurement outcome of the count event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory (Transaction MI04); ISO 9001

attributes.name: counter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who performed the physical count. Stored for audit readability and SOX compliance reporting without requiring a join to HR systems.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the physical inventory count record was first created in the source system (SAP MM). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX record retention compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the inventory valuation amount (e.g., USD, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations across global chemical manufacturing sites.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or shelf-life expiry date of the lot/batch being counted. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) lot rotation compliance and identification of expired stock during physical counts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; GMP Shelf Life Management; FEFO

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting period (month) within the fiscal year during which the count was performed (e.g., 001 through 012). Used for period-end inventory cutoff and financial close processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the physical inventory count was performed. Used for period-end financial reporting, SOX compliance, and year-over-year inventory accuracy trend analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material being counted is classified as hazardous under GHS, OSHA, or DOT regulations. Drives additional safety protocols during physical counting and storage compliance checks.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; DOT 49 CFR; TSCA

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the inventory variance calculated as variance_quantity multiplied by the standard or moving average price of the material. Used for financial impact assessment and COGS adjustment. Expressed in local currency.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 330; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Inventory Valuation; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the physical inventory count record. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer and change data capture tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short description of the material being counted as maintained in the SAP material master. Provides human-readable context for reporting without requiring a join to the material master.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: SAP material document number generated when the inventory variance is posted (Transaction MI07). Links this count record to the resulting inventory_adjustment material document for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Accounting date on which the inventory variance was posted to the general ledger in SAP FI/CO. Critical for period-end cutoff, COGS calculation, and SOX financial reporting compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 330; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Status of the variance posting to the SAP general ledger: not_posted (pending), posted (successfully posted), posting_failed (error during posting), reversed (posting reversed for correction).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Integration; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: quarantine_status
attributes.description: Stock status of the material at time of count: unrestricted (available for use), quarantine (held pending investigation), blocked (restricted from use), quality_inspection (held for QC testing). Aligns with SAP MM stock categories.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Types; GMP Quality Hold Procedures; ISO 9001

attributes.name: recount_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount has been triggered for this count item, typically due to variance exceeding the tolerance threshold. True = recount required or performed; False = no recount needed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Inventory Controls

attributes.name: recount_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which recount iteration this record represents (1 = first recount, 2 = second recount, etc.). Zero or null indicates the original count. Supports multi-round recount audit trails.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the ownership or allocation type of the stock being counted: own (company-owned), consignment (customer-owned at our facility), project (allocated to a project), sales_order (reserved for a sales order), vendor_consignment (vendor-owned at our facility).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Special Stock Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the book, counted, and variance quantities are expressed (e.g., KG, L, MT, EA, DR for drums). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure from the material master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ISO 80000 Units

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance quantity expressed as a percentage of book quantity. Used to determine whether variance exceeds tolerance thresholds requiring management approval or recount. Key KPI for inventory accuracy reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Inventory Controls

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between counted quantity and book quantity (counted_quantity minus book_quantity). Positive value indicates surplus; negative value indicates shortage. Drives inventory adjustment postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; FASB ASC 330; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: variance_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Allowable variance percentage threshold configured for this material or material group. Variances exceeding this threshold require management approval for write-off. Supports SOX-compliant variance authorization controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Tolerance Groups

attributes.name: warehouse_number
attributes.description: SAP EWM warehouse number identifying the logical warehouse complex. Used when the count is managed at the warehouse management level rather than simple storage location level.

attributes.name: within_tolerance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variance percentage is within the configured tolerance threshold. True = variance is acceptable and can be auto-posted; False = variance exceeds tolerance and requires manual approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; SOX Section 404

products.name: hazmat_storage_rule
products.description: Reference record defining hazardous material storage compatibility and segregation rules per GHS, NFPA, and UN hazard classification systems. Captures hazard class, sub-risk, NFPA fire diamond rating, incompatible hazard class pairs (segregation matrix), required storage conditions (temperature range, ventilation class, secondary containment type), maximum storage quantity per fire zone, EPA/OSHA regulatory citation, and applicable SDS section references. Governs automated putaway validation ensuring incompatible chemicals are never co-located in the same storage zone.

attributes.name: hazmat_storage_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each hazardous material storage compatibility and segregation rule record. Primary key for the hazmat_storage_rule reference entity. [_canonical_skip_reason: Entity role classified as REFERENCE_LOOKUP — defines a codified regulatory/operational rule set governing chemical storage compatibility; no per-role minimum categories apply, but comprehensive coverage is still provided for enterprise utility.]
attributes.references: SAP EWM; GHS; NFPA 400; UN Model Regulations

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage rule was formally approved by the designated EHS authority. Part of the MOC documentation chain. Required for OSHA PSM compliance audits and ISO 9001 document control records.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ISO 9001; ISO 45001; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the EHS Manager, Process Safety Engineer, or Regulatory Affairs Officer who formally approved this storage rule for operational use. Required for MOC (Management of Change) documentation and regulatory audit trails per OSHA PSM and ISO 45001.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ISO 45001; ISO 9001; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: classification_system
attributes.description: Primary hazard classification system under which this storage rule is defined (e.g., GHS for global chemical classification, NFPA for US fire codes, UN for transport, IMDG for maritime, CLP for EU). Determines which regulatory framework governs the rule's applicability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GHS|NFPA|UN|DOT|IMDG|IATA|CLP|WHMIS — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GHS Purple Book; NFPA 704; UN Model Regulations; IMDG Code; CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hazmat storage rule record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for rule origination. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this storage rule version becomes enforceable in warehouse operations. Rules with a future effective date are loaded into SAP EWM in draft status and activated on the effective date. Supports regulatory transition periods.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; Intelex EHS Management; SAP EWM; OSHA; EPA

attributes.name: epa_regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific EPA regulatory citation (CFR part and section) that mandates or informs this storage rule (e.g., '40 CFR Part 112', '40 CFR Part 68 RMP', '40 CFR Part 264 Subpart I'). Used in environmental compliance reporting and audit documentation submitted to EPA.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112; EPA 40 CFR Part 68; EPA 40 CFR Part 264; TSCA

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage rule version expires or is superseded. Null indicates the rule is open-ended with no planned expiry. When populated, the system automatically transitions the rule to 'superseded' status and activates the replacement rule version.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; Intelex EHS Management; SAP EWM

attributes.name: fire_suppression_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automatic fire suppression system (sprinkler, deluge, foam, or dry chemical) is required at the storage location for chemicals governed by this rule. Drives facility engineering requirements and influences NFPA 400 maximum allowable quantity multipliers.
attributes.references: NFPA 400; NFPA 13; NFPA 30; IFC Chapter 50; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.159

attributes.name: fire_zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fire zone or control area type to which the maximum quantity limit applies. NFPA 400 and IFC allow higher MAQ in sprinklered buildings versus unprotected control areas. Drives differentiated quantity limits in SAP EWM storage type configuration.
attributes.references: NFPA 400; IFC Chapter 50; NFPA 30; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_statement_codes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Globally Harmonized System (GHS) Hazard Statement Codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS H-statement codes applicable to chemicals governed by this rule (e.g., H225,H302,H314). Drives SDS Section 2 alignment and label generation. Used in REACH and CLP regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GHS Purple Book; ECHA CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008; REACH

attributes.name: grounding_bonding_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether electrical grounding and bonding equipment is required at the storage location for chemicals governed by this rule. Mandatory for flammable liquids with flash points below 100°F to prevent static discharge ignition per NFPA 77 and OSHA standards.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Primary GHS/UN hazard class of the chemical governed by this rule (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 5.1 Oxidizing Substances, Class 8 Corrosives, Class 6.1 Toxic Substances). Aligns with UN Model Regulations and GHS classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Class 1|Class 2|Class 3|Class 4|Class 5.1|Class 5.2|Class 6.1|Class 6.2|Class 7|Class 8|Class 9 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GHS Purple Book; UN Model Regulations; DOT 49 CFR 172; IAEA

attributes.name: hazard_sub_risk
attributes.description: Secondary hazard classification or division providing additional specificity within the primary hazard class (e.g., Division 1.1 for mass explosion risk, Packing Group I/II/III, sub-risk 6.1 on a Class 3 flammable). Captures multi-hazard chemical profiles per GHS and UN regulations.
attributes.references: GHS Purple Book; UN Model Regulations; DOT 49 CFR 172.101

attributes.name: incompatibility_consequence
attributes.description: Primary hazardous consequence that would result from co-locating the two incompatible hazard classes defined in this rule. Used in risk assessment, PHA/HAZOP documentation, and emergency response planning. Informs the severity weighting in automated putaway violation alerts.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; NFPA 400; EPA RMP 40 CFR Part 68; HAZOP methodology

attributes.name: incompatible_hazard_class_a
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incompatible Hazard Class — Side A (Segregation Matrix)
attributes.description: First hazard class in the incompatible pair defined by this segregation rule. Together with incompatible_hazard_class_b, forms the segregation matrix entry that prohibits co-location of chemicals from these two hazard classes in the same storage zone. Aligns with NFPA 400 Table 10.3.2 and UN segregation table.
attributes.references: NFPA 400; UN Model Regulations Chapter 7.2; IMDG Code; DOT 49 CFR 177.848

attributes.name: incompatible_hazard_class_b
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incompatible Hazard Class — Side B (Segregation Matrix)
attributes.description: Second hazard class in the incompatible pair defined by this segregation rule. Together with incompatible_hazard_class_a, forms the segregation matrix entry. The automated putaway validation engine in SAP EWM checks both directions of this pair to prevent co-location of incompatible chemicals.
attributes.references: NFPA 400; UN Model Regulations Chapter 7.2; IMDG Code; DOT 49 CFR 177.848

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hazmat storage rule record was last updated. Supports change detection in downstream ETL pipelines and provides audit trail for rule modifications. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; SOX; Intelex EHS Management; SAP EWM

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage rule was last reviewed for continued regulatory accuracy and operational relevance. ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 require periodic review of EHS controls. Triggers a review workflow in Intelex EHS Management when overdue.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ISO 45001; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: max_quantity_per_fire_zone_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Storage Quantity Per Fire Zone (Kilograms)
attributes.description: Maximum allowable quantity in kilograms of chemicals governed by this rule that may be stored within a single fire zone or control area. Derived from NFPA 400 maximum allowable quantities (MAQ) tables and local fire code. Enforced by SAP EWM inventory capacity checks.
attributes.references: NFPA 400 Table 4.3.1; IFC Chapter 50; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: max_quantity_per_fire_zone_l
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Storage Quantity Per Fire Zone (Liters)
attributes.description: Maximum allowable quantity in liters of liquid chemicals governed by this rule that may be stored within a single fire zone or control area. Complements the kilogram-based limit for liquid hazmat categories where volume is the regulatory basis (e.g., NFPA 30 flammable liquids).
attributes.references: NFPA 30; NFPA 400; IFC Chapter 50; EPA 40 CFR Part 112

attributes.name: max_storage_temp_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for chemicals governed by this rule. Exceeding this threshold may cause decomposition, polymerization, or ignition. Monitored via Aveva PI System historian and triggers automated EHS alerts in Intelex.
attributes.references: GHS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; NFPA 400; SDS Section 7

attributes.name: min_storage_temp_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for chemicals governed by this rule. Below this threshold, the chemical may solidify, become unstable, or lose efficacy. Monitored via Aveva PI System historian for real-time compliance alerting.
attributes.references: GHS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; ISO 9001; SDS Section 7

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date by which this storage rule must next be reviewed for regulatory currency and operational accuracy. Calculated based on review frequency policy (typically annual for high-hazard rules). Drives compliance calendar in Intelex EHS Management.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ISO 45001; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: nfpa_flammability_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Fire Diamond Flammability Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 fire diamond flammability rating (0–4) for chemicals governed by this rule. Rating 4 indicates materials that will rapidly vaporize at normal pressure and temperature. Used in fire zone maximum quantity calculations and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: nfpa_health_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Fire Diamond Health Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 fire diamond health hazard rating (0–4) for chemicals governed by this rule. Rating 4 indicates materials that can cause death or major residual injury on short exposure. Used in PPE requirements and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: nfpa_reactivity_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Fire Diamond Reactivity Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 fire diamond instability/reactivity rating (0–4) for chemicals governed by this rule. Rating 4 indicates materials capable of detonation or explosive decomposition at normal temperatures and pressures.

attributes.name: nfpa_special_hazard_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) Fire Diamond Special Hazard Code
attributes.description: NFPA 704 special hazard symbol code for chemicals governed by this rule (e.g., W = water-reactive, OX = oxidizer, SA = simple asphyxiant, BIO = biological hazard, CRY = cryogenic). Governs special storage precautions and emergency response procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: W|OX|SA|BIO|COR|POI|RAD|CRY|ACID|ALK — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: osha_regulatory_citation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Regulatory Citation
attributes.description: Specific OSHA regulatory citation (CFR part and section) that mandates or informs this storage rule (e.g., '29 CFR 1910.119 PSM', '29 CFR 1910.106 Flammable Liquids', '29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom'). Used in PSM compliance documentation and OSHA inspection readiness.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: UN packing group designation (I = great danger, II = medium danger, III = minor danger) for the hazardous material governed by this rule. Determines packaging requirements for transport and influences storage quantity limits and segregation requirements.
attributes.references: UN Model Regulations; DOT 49 CFR 173; IMDG Code; IATA DGR

attributes.name: reach_regulation_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Regulation Reference
attributes.description: REACH regulation article or annex reference applicable to this storage rule (e.g., 'REACH Annex XVII Restriction Entry 3', 'REACH Article 56 Authorization'). Required for EU operations and ECHA compliance reporting. Populated for chemicals on the SVHC candidate list.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA; CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this storage rule within the enterprise rule catalog (e.g., HSR-001, FLAM-OX-SEG-01). Used as the human-readable business key in SAP EWM putaway strategies and EHS management systems.
attributes.references: SAP EWM; Intelex EHS Management; NFPA 400; GHS

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the storage rule, including the rationale for the segregation or storage condition requirement, the chemical hazard interaction being prevented, and any operational guidance for warehouse personnel.
attributes.references: GHS; NFPA 400; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; TSCA; REACH

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive short name for the storage rule (e.g., 'Flammable-Oxidizer Segregation', 'Corrosive-Reactive Incompatibility'). Used in warehouse management UI labels and EHS compliance reports.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the storage rule record. 'active' rules are enforced in automated putaway validation. 'superseded' rules have been replaced by a newer version. 'under_review' rules are pending regulatory or internal re-assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; Intelex EHS Management; SAP EWM

attributes.name: rule_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this storage rule record (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Supports rule versioning when regulatory updates require rule revisions. Enables audit trail of rule changes over time and ensures warehouse systems reference the current approved version.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control; Intelex EHS Management; SAP EWM

attributes.name: sds_section_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SDS section numbers that provide the source data for this storage rule (e.g., '7,8,10,14'). Section 7 = Handling and Storage, Section 8 = Exposure Controls, Section 10 = Reactivity, Section 14 = Transport. Enables traceability from rule to SDS source documentation per GHS.
attributes.references: GHS Purple Book SDS Format; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: secondary_containment_type
attributes.description: Type of secondary containment structure required for storage locations holding chemicals governed by this rule. Prevents spill migration to drains and groundwater. Mandatory for EPA SPCC-regulated quantities and OSHA PSM-covered chemicals. Validated during SAP EWM putaway.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112 (SPCC); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119; NFPA 400; ISO 14001

attributes.name: segregation_distance_m
attributes.description: Minimum physical separation distance in meters required between storage locations holding chemicals from the two incompatible hazard classes defined in this rule. Used by SAP EWM bin assignment logic to enforce spatial separation within the warehouse or tank farm.
attributes.references: NFPA 400; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; UN Model Regulations

attributes.name: storage_location_type
attributes.description: Type of physical storage location required for chemicals governed by this rule. Drives SAP EWM storage type determination during putaway. 'tank_farm' applies to bulk liquid chemicals. 'refrigerated_room' applies to temperature-sensitive hazmat. Validated against warehouse master data.
attributes.references: NFPA 400; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; SAP EWM Storage Type Configuration

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: UN four-digit identification number for the hazardous substance or article governed by this rule (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline, UN1824 for sodium hydroxide solution). Used in DOT transport documentation, emergency response, and cross-referencing with the UN Model Regulations segregation table.
attributes.references: UN Model Regulations; DOT 49 CFR 172.101; IMDG Code; IATA DGR

attributes.name: ventilation_class
attributes.description: Required ventilation classification for storage areas holding chemicals governed by this rule. 'local_exhaust' indicates dedicated fume extraction is required. 'explosion_proof' indicates ATEX/NEC-rated ventilation systems are mandatory. Aligns with OSHA industrial hygiene requirements and NFPA 30.

products.name: storage_bin
products.description: Master record for individual storage bins within a warehouse location, representing the smallest addressable unit of storage in SAP EWM. Captures bin code, warehouse number, storage type, storage section, bin capacity (weight and volume), bin type (fixed, random, bulk, tank), current occupancy status, maximum weight, and allowed material types. Enables precise bin-level inventory tracking and directed putaway/picking strategies.

attributes.name: storage_bin_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the storage bin master record in the SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) system. Serves as the primary key for all bin-level inventory tracking and directed putaway/picking operations.

attributes.name: hazmat_storage_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.hazmat_storage_rule. Business justification: Hazardous storage rules are defined centrally; link bin to rule and remove duplicated class info.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse_location. Business justification: Storage bin belongs to a warehouse location; replace free‑text warehouse_number with FK for proper hierarchy.

attributes.name: aisle
attributes.description: Aisle identifier within the warehouse where the storage bin is physically located. Used for warehouse navigation, slotting optimization, and pick path sequencing.

attributes.name: allowed_material_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SAP material type codes (e.g., ROH for raw materials, FERT for finished goods, HALB for semi-finished, VERP for packaging) permitted to be stored in this bin. Enforces material segregation rules for chemical compatibility and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: bin_access_type
attributes.description: Type of material handling equipment required to access this storage bin. Determines equipment assignment during transfer order creation and supports warehouse resource planning. Critical for safety compliance in chemical warehouses where certain hazmat bins require specialized handling equipment.

attributes.name: bin_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the physical storage bin within a warehouse number and storage type. Corresponds to the SAP EWM Lgpla field. Used in directed putaway, picking, and bin-level inventory queries.

attributes.name: bin_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the storage bin providing additional context about its physical characteristics, special use restrictions, or operational notes. May include information about dedicated chemical families, special handling requirements, or historical usage notes.

attributes.name: bin_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name or label for the storage bin, used in warehouse operations, signage, and reporting. May include aisle, row, and level descriptors (e.g., 'Aisle-A Row-03 Level-02') to aid physical navigation.

attributes.name: bin_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the storage bin. Active bins are available for putaway and picking. Blocked bins are temporarily unavailable. Quarantine status is applied when contents are under quality hold per QM procedures. Maintenance status indicates the bin is undergoing physical inspection or repair.

attributes.name: bin_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical bin configuration. Fixed bins are dedicated to specific materials (e.g., hazardous chemicals); random bins accept any compatible material; bulk bins hold large quantities; tank bins represent liquid storage vessels in tank farms; floor bins are ground-level pallet positions; rack bins are elevated rack locations.

attributes.name: containment_type
attributes.description: Type of secondary containment infrastructure present at this storage bin to prevent chemical spills from reaching drains or the environment. Secondary bund and tank bund are used for bulk liquid chemical storage; spill pallets for drum storage; lined floor for general chemical areas. Required for EPA SPCC compliance and ISO 14001 environmental management.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112 (SPCC); ISO 14001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storage bin master record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for bin lifecycle management and supports data governance requirements.

attributes.name: current_quantity
attributes.description: Current number of handling units (pallets, drums, IBCs) physically present in the bin. Reflects the real-time stock count as maintained by SAP EWM goods movements.

attributes.name: current_volume_m3
attributes.description: Current total volume in cubic meters occupied by stock in the bin. Compared against max_volume_m3 to determine available capacity for putaway decisions.

attributes.name: current_weight_kg
attributes.description: Current total gross weight in kilograms of all stock currently stored in the bin. Updated upon each goods movement. Used to monitor bin load against maximum weight capacity and support structural safety compliance.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the storage bin was or is scheduled to be deactivated and removed from active warehouse operations. Null for currently active bins. Supports bin lifecycle management and warehouse restructuring projects.

attributes.name: fire_protection_zone
attributes.description: NFPA fire protection zone or compartment designation assigned to the storage bin. Used to enforce fire load limits, sprinkler system coverage mapping, and emergency response planning for flammable and combustible chemical storage areas.

attributes.name: is_fixed_bin
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bin is a fixed bin permanently assigned to a specific material or material group, as opposed to a random bin available for any compatible material. True = fixed bin assignment; False = random bin. Drives SAP EWM putaway strategy determination.

attributes.name: is_hazmat_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage bin has been formally approved and certified for the storage of hazardous materials in compliance with OSHA PSM, EPA RMP, and GHS regulations. True = approved for hazmat storage; False = not approved.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119; EPA 40 CFR Part 68; GHS

attributes.name: is_quarantine_bin
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bin is designated as a quarantine storage location for materials under quality hold, out-of-specification (OOS) status, or pending Certificate of Analysis (COA) release. True = quarantine bin; False = standard bin. Integrates with SAP QM quality inspection workflows.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical safety or structural inspection of the storage bin, including rack integrity checks, containment integrity, and hazmat compliance verification. Supports OSHA PSM and ISO 45001 occupational health and safety compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the storage bin master record. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail purposes in compliance with ISO 9001 document control requirements.

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count was performed for this storage bin. Used to track inventory accuracy compliance, schedule future counts, and support SOX financial reporting requirements for inventory valuation.

attributes.name: max_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum number of handling units (pallets, drums, IBCs, or containers) that can be stored in the bin simultaneously. Enforced during directed putaway to prevent overfilling.

attributes.name: max_stacking_height_m
attributes.description: Maximum allowable stacking height in meters for materials stored in this bin. Enforced to prevent structural overload and comply with OSHA stacking safety regulations. Particularly relevant for drum and IBC storage of liquid chemicals.

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this bin. Prevents thermal degradation, polymerization, or hazardous decomposition of stored chemicals. Critical for compliance with SDS storage requirements.

attributes.name: max_volume_m3
attributes.description: Maximum storage volume in cubic meters available within the bin. Used for volumetric capacity planning, putaway feasibility checks, and tank farm liquid volume management.

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable gross weight in kilograms that the storage bin can safely hold, including packaging and handling units. Critical for structural safety compliance and overload prevention in chemical warehouses storing dense raw materials or bulk liquids.

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this bin. Enforced for temperature-sensitive chemical raw materials, intermediates, and finished goods to prevent degradation, crystallization, or phase separation.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory safety or structural inspection of the storage bin. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling and ensures continuous compliance with OSHA, NFPA, and ISO 45001 inspection frequency requirements.

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Real-time occupancy state of the storage bin indicating whether the bin is empty, fully occupied, partially occupied, or reserved for an incoming transfer order. Drives directed putaway logic in SAP EWM and supports inventory accuracy reporting.

attributes.name: picking_point
attributes.description: SAP EWM picking point bin code associated with this storage bin. For bulk or reserve storage bins, identifies the forward pick face bin from which order picking is executed. Supports two-step picking workflows common in chemical distribution operations.

attributes.name: putaway_strategy
attributes.description: SAP EWM putaway strategy assigned to this bin that determines how incoming stock is directed to storage locations. Fixed strategy assigns stock to pre-defined bins; open storage allows any compatible bin; bulk strategy consolidates large quantities; near-picking places fast-movers close to pick areas; addition-to-existing consolidates partial bins.

attributes.name: rotation_strategy
attributes.description: Inventory lot rotation strategy applied to this bin for picking sequence determination. FIFO (First In First Out) is standard for most chemicals; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is mandatory for materials with expiration dates to prevent use of expired lots; LIFO and LEFO are used in specific bulk storage scenarios. Aligns with GMP and ISO 9001 inventory management requirements.

attributes.name: row_number
attributes.description: Row number within the aisle that identifies the horizontal position of the storage bin. Combined with aisle and level, provides the full physical coordinate of the bin within the warehouse.

attributes.name: storage_bin_level
attributes.description: Vertical level or tier of the storage bin within a rack structure. Level 1 is ground floor; higher numbers indicate elevated rack positions. Used for equipment assignment (e.g., forklift vs. reach truck) and weight distribution planning.

attributes.name: storage_section_code
attributes.description: SAP EWM storage section (Lgber) code that subdivides a storage type into logical groupings, such as fast-moving, slow-moving, or temperature-controlled sections. Used to optimize putaway strategies for chemical raw materials and finished goods.

attributes.name: storage_type_code
attributes.description: SAP EWM storage type (Lgtyp) code that classifies the physical area of the warehouse where this bin resides, such as high-rack storage, bulk storage, tank farm, or hazardous material area. Drives putaway and picking strategies.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature-controlled storage zone classification for the bin. Ambient bins operate at room temperature; refrigerated bins maintain 2–8°C for temperature-sensitive chemicals or intermediates; heated bins prevent solidification of high-melting-point materials; controlled bins maintain a specific validated temperature range per product specification.

attributes.name: ventilation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage bin requires dedicated ventilation or is located in a ventilated area to manage volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions or hazardous air pollutant (HAP) concentrations. True = ventilation required; False = no special ventilation needed. Supports EHS compliance with EPA and OSHA air quality standards.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 63; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.94; TSCA

products.name: stock_reservation
products.description: Record of a stock reservation that earmarks a specific quantity of a material and lot for a future planned consumption event such as a production order, customer delivery, or maintenance work order. Captures reservation number, material, lot, reserved quantity, unit of measure, requirement date, consuming order or delivery reference, reservation status (open, partially fulfilled, fulfilled, cancelled), and expiry date. Prevents double-allocation of limited or expiring chemical stock.

attributes.name: stock_reservation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the stock reservation record in the inventory management system.
attributes.references: SAP EWM / SAP MM Internal Object Key

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Supports Customer Allocation Report by linking each inventory reservation to the customer account that requested the reservation, enabling order fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Enables reconciliation of reserved inventory to the specific invoice that fulfills the reservation, required for financial closing and audit reports.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific inventory lot or batch being earmarked. Supports FIFO/FEFO lot rotation and prevents double-allocation of expiring chemical stock.
attributes.references: SAP MM Batch Management (MCH1); GMP Lot Traceability

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the chemical, raw material, intermediate, finished good, or packaging material being reserved.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Needed for allocation reports: reserving stock for a specific sales opportunity ensures availability and supports the Opportunity‑to‑Inventory allocation process.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order, customer delivery order, or maintenance work order that will consume the reserved stock. Establishes the demand source driving the reservation.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Order / SAP SD Delivery / SAP PM Work Order

attributes.name: reserved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Inventory allocation reports need the employee who performed the reservation to track accountability and labor costing.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse location or tank farm where the reserved stock is physically stored.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Reservation of inventory for a specific maintenance work order; needed for parts reservation and work order cost tracking.

attributes.name: auto_release_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation should be automatically released back to available stock upon reaching the expiry date without fulfillment. Supports automated inventory management and prevents indefinite stock lock-up.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Reservation Management; Chemical Mfg Inventory Policy

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis must be verified and attached before the reserved stock can be issued to the consuming order. Enforces quality gate compliance for regulated chemical products.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; LabWare LIMS COA Workflow

attributes.name: consuming_order_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of the consuming order document. Distinguishes between production orders, process orders (for batch chemical manufacturing), sales delivery orders, maintenance orders, and project orders to support domain-specific analytics.
attributes.references: SAP PP/SD/PM Order Category; SAP MM Reservation Item Category (RSPOS)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the stock reservation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SLA tracking, and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP MM Change Document; ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the reservation is no longer valid and the earmarked stock is automatically released back to available inventory. Critical for preventing indefinite stock lock-up of expiring chemical materials.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation Expiry; FEFO Inventory Management; GMP Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: fulfilled_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of the reservation that has already been issued or withdrawn against the consuming order. Used to calculate the remaining open quantity and determine partial fulfillment status.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Issue (WAMNG); SAP EWM

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved material is classified as hazardous. When true, additional handling, storage compliance, and transport regulations apply per OSHA, DOT, and REACH requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; DOT 49 CFR; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; GHS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the stock reservation record was most recently modified, such as a quantity change, status update, or date revision. Supports change tracking and data reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Change Document; ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The ERP material number (SAP material number) of the chemical or material being reserved. Serves as the externally-known business identifier for cross-system reference and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master (MATNR); Chemical Mfg SKU Catalog

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: SAP goods movement type code that will be used when the reservation is fulfilled (e.g., 261 for goods issue to production order, 601 for goods issue to customer delivery). Determines the accounting and inventory impact of the eventual withdrawal.
attributes.references: SAP MM Movement Type (BWART); SAP FI/CO Integration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or comments entered by the planner or warehouse operator at the time of reservation creation or update.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation Text; Chemical Mfg Warehouse SOP

attributes.name: oos_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved lot has been flagged as Out of Specification (OOS) by the quality management system. An OOS reservation is blocked from fulfillment pending CAPA resolution.
attributes.references: SAP QM OOS Management; LabWare LIMS; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: partial_fulfillment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consuming order can accept a partial goods issue against this reservation, or whether the full reserved quantity must be issued in a single transaction. Relevant for batch chemical processes with minimum charge quantities.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation; Chemical Mfg Production Planning SOP

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility or distribution center where the reserved stock is located and where the consuming event will occur. Aligns with SAP organizational structure.
attributes.references: SAP MM Plant (WERKS); SAP Organizational Structure

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking of the reservation used to resolve allocation conflicts when available stock is insufficient to fulfill all open reservations. Lower values indicate higher priority (e.g., 1 = highest priority).
attributes.references: SAP EWM Warehouse Task Priority; Chemical Mfg Production Planning Policy

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved lot is currently under quarantine hold (e.g., pending quality release, Out of Specification investigation, or regulatory hold). A quarantined reservation cannot be fulfilled until the hold is lifted.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Inspection; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved material lot has been verified as compliant with REACH regulation requirements at the time of reservation. Prevents issuance of non-compliant chemical stock to production.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA Substance Registration

attributes.name: requirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reserved material is required for consumption by the planned event (production start date, delivery date, or maintenance execution date). Drives FEFO/FIFO lot selection and warehouse picking scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation Requirement Date (BDTER); SAP PP MRP

attributes.name: reservation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the stock reservation was created and the stock was earmarked. Represents the principal real-world event time for the reservation transaction.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation Header Date; SAP EWM

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reservation document number assigned by the ERP or WMS system (e.g., SAP reservation number). Used for cross-system reference and communication with warehouse operations.

attributes.name: reservation_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason code explaining why the reservation was created (e.g., scheduled production run, emergency maintenance, customer priority order, safety stock replenishment). Supports demand analysis and inventory planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled_production|emergency_maintenance|customer_priority|safety_stock|quality_sample|r_and_d_trial|regulatory_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation Reason; Chemical Mfg Inventory Management SOP

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the stock reservation. 'open' indicates no goods movement has occurred; 'partially_fulfilled' indicates some quantity has been issued; 'fulfilled' indicates full quantity has been issued; 'cancelled' indicates the reservation was voided before consumption.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation Status; SAP EWM

attributes.name: reservation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the demand event driving the reservation. Distinguishes between production order consumption, customer delivery fulfillment, maintenance work order material staging, project-based withdrawal, or manually created reservations.
attributes.references: SAP MM Movement Type Classification; SAP PP/SD/PM Integration

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of the material and lot earmarked for the planned consumption event, expressed in the base unit of measure. Prevents double-allocation of limited or expiring chemical stock.
attributes.references: SAP MM Reservation Quantity (BDMNG); ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: sds_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for the reserved material has been verified as up-to-date and accessible prior to reservation fulfillment. Required for hazardous chemical handling compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication; GHS SDS Requirements; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated the reservation document (e.g., SAP EWM, SAP MM, SAP PP, SAP SD, SAP PM, or manually created). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Integration Architecture; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the stock category from which the reservation will be fulfilled. Distinguishes between unrestricted-use stock, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, restricted-use stock, consignment stock, or project stock. Critical for chemical inventory where quarantine and quality holds are common.
attributes.references: SAP MM Special Stock (SOBKZ); SAP QM Quality Inspection

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: SAP storage location code within the plant identifying the specific physical area (e.g., raw material warehouse, tank farm, hazmat storage, quarantine area) where the reserved stock is held.
attributes.references: SAP MM Storage Location (LGORT); SAP EWM

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the reserved and fulfilled quantities (e.g., KG, L, MT, EA, BAG, DRUM). Aligns with the material master unit of measure in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000-1; UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20

attributes.name: valuation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the valuation price is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR). Required for multi-currency inventory valuation in global chemical manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI/CO Currency Configuration; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: The standard or moving average price per unit of measure used to value the reserved stock at the time of reservation creation. Used for inventory valuation reporting and COGS calculation in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP MM Valuation (VERPR/STPRS); FASB ASC 330 Inventory; IFRS IAS 2

products.name: tank_farm_level
products.description: Real-time and historical level measurement records for bulk liquid chemical storage tanks in tank farms. Captures tank identifier, material stored, measurement timestamp, level in meters, volume in liters or cubic meters, mass in kg, temperature at measurement, density, ullage (available headspace), high-level alarm status, low-level alarm status, and data source (Aveva PI System historian tag). Supports continuous inventory tracking for bulk chemicals without discrete lot tracking.

attributes.name: tank_farm_level_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tank farm level measurement record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The employee or operator identifier who entered or confirmed this measurement record when data_collection_method is manual. Provides accountability and audit trail for manually recorded tank gauge readings. Populated only for manual entries; null for automatic historian records.
attributes.references: SAP PM - Personnel; ISO 9001 - Record Traceability; OSHA PSM - Operator Qualification

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.equipment. Business justification: Link tank level measurements to the tank equipment record for maintenance monitoring and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or site where the tank farm is located. Supports multi-site inventory tracking.

attributes.name: primary_tank_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record identifying the bulk liquid chemical currently stored in the tank at the time of measurement.

attributes.name: tank_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage tank asset record that this level measurement belongs to. Links to the tank master data entity in the inventory or asset domain.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Storage Unit Management; SAP PM - Equipment Master

attributes.name: tank_material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to rawmaterial.material_master

attributes.name: below_reorder_point_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current tank inventory mass is at or below the defined reorder point threshold (True = replenishment required, False = adequate stock). Enables real-time inventory replenishment alerting and integration with SAP MM MRP processes.
attributes.references: SAP MM - MRP; SAP EWM - Replenishment; ISO 9001 - Supply Chain Management

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: The Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registry number uniquely identifying the chemical substance stored in the tank. Critical for regulatory reporting (TSCA, REACH, TRI), SDS linkage, and hazardous material compliance tracking.
attributes.references: CAS Registry; TSCA Section 8; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; EPA TRI Reporting

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Describes how this measurement record was collected: automatic (real-time instrument feed via PI historian), manual (operator-entered gauge reading), or interpolated (value estimated between two valid readings). Supports data quality governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System - Data Collection Configuration; ISA-88; ISO 9001 - Measurement Traceability

attributes.name: density_kg_m3
attributes.description: The density of the stored liquid at the measurement temperature, expressed in kilograms per cubic meter (kg/m³). Used to convert volume measurements to mass for inventory valuation and material balance. May be measured in-line or derived from temperature-corrected reference data.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1; Aveva PI System - Density Tag; ISO 3675 - Density Measurement

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_category
attributes.description: The GHS hazard category code for the stored chemical (e.g., Flammable Liquid Cat 1, Acute Toxicity Cat 3). Supports SDS compliance, emergency response documentation, and regulatory reporting under REACH, TSCA, and EPA requirements.
attributes.references: GHS - Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling; ECHA REACH Regulation; TSCA Section 8(b)

attributes.name: hazmat_storage_class
attributes.description: The hazardous material storage class designation for the chemical stored in the tank, based on GHS/DOT classification (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 8 Corrosive). Used for EHS compliance, emergency response planning, and segregation requirement enforcement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: class_1_explosive|class_2_gas|class_3_flammable_liquid|class_4_flammable_solid|class_5_oxidizer|class_6_toxic|class_7_radioactive|class_8_corrosive|class_9_misc — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR - Hazardous Materials Regulations; GHS - UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods; NFPA 30; EPA RMP

attributes.name: high_level_alarm
attributes.description: Indicates whether the high-level alarm setpoint was active (True) or inactive (False) at the time of measurement. A high-level alarm signals that the tank level has reached or exceeded the high alarm threshold, requiring immediate operational attention to prevent overfill.
attributes.references: IEC 61511 - Functional Safety; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; API 2350 - Overfill Protection

attributes.name: instrument_tag
attributes.description: The P&ID instrument tag identifier for the level transmitter or gauge device that produced this measurement (e.g., LT-101, LIT-2204). Enables traceability to the physical instrument for calibration records, maintenance history, and instrument reliability analysis.
attributes.references: ISA-5.1 - Instrumentation Symbols and Identification; P&ID Engineering Standards; SAP PM - Functional Location

attributes.name: inventory_value_usd
attributes.description: The estimated financial value of the bulk chemical inventory in the tank at the time of measurement, expressed in US Dollars. Calculated from mass_kg and the current standard or moving average cost from SAP FI/CO. Used for inventory valuation reporting and financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Inventory Valuation; FASB ASC 330 - Inventory; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: level_m
attributes.description: The measured liquid level height in the tank expressed in meters, as reported by the level transmitter instrument and captured in the Aveva PI System historian. This is the primary raw measurement value for continuous inventory tracking.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System - Level Tag; ISA-75 Instrumentation Standards; API 650 Tank Standards

attributes.name: level_percent
attributes.description: The current tank fill level expressed as a percentage of the tank's maximum working capacity (0-100%). Provides an intuitive operational view of tank utilization for dashboards, alerts, and capacity planning without requiring knowledge of tank dimensions.
attributes.references: API 650; SAP EWM - Storage Bin Capacity; Aveva PI System

attributes.name: low_level_alarm
attributes.description: Indicates whether the low-level alarm setpoint was active (True) or inactive (False) at the time of measurement. A low-level alarm signals that the tank level has dropped to or below the low alarm threshold, indicating potential supply shortage or pump cavitation risk.
attributes.references: IEC 61511 - Functional Safety; Honeywell Experion DCS - Alarm Management; ISA-18.2

attributes.name: mass_kg
attributes.description: The calculated mass of the liquid inventory in the tank expressed in kilograms, derived from volume and density. Used for material balance, production accounting, and regulatory emission calculations (e.g., EPA TRI, VOC reporting).
attributes.references: EPA TRI Reporting; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; API MPMS Chapter 11

attributes.name: measurement_quality
attributes.description: The data quality indicator for this measurement record as reported by the Aveva PI System historian (e.g., Good, Bad, Uncertain, Substituted). Reflects instrument health, communication status, or manual data substitution. Used to filter unreliable readings in analytics and reporting.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System - Data Quality Codes; OPC UA Part 8 - Data Access Quality; ISA-88

attributes.name: measurement_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating source system or method for this level measurement record. Distinguishes between automated PI historian readings, manual gauge readings entered by operators, DCS/SCADA system feeds, calculated values from strapping tables, or estimated values.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System; Honeywell Experion DCS; Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7; ISA-88

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the tank level measurement was recorded by the process historian or instrumentation system. This is the principal real-world event time for this observation record.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System - Tag Timestamp; ISA-88 Batch Control Standard

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The Aveva PI System historian tag identifier (e.g., SITE01.TK-101.LEVEL) that is the source of this measurement record. Enables traceability back to the originating instrument data stream in the process historian.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System - Tag Configuration; ISA-88

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tank farm level record was first created or ingested into the Silver Layer data lakehouse. Distinct from measurement_timestamp (the real-world event time). Used for data pipeline auditing, latency monitoring, and record lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Record Management; Databricks Lakehouse - Silver Layer Audit

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tank farm level record was last modified in the Silver Layer, for example due to a data quality correction, manual override, or reprocessing event. Supports change tracking and data lineage auditing.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Record Management; Databricks Lakehouse - Silver Layer Audit

attributes.name: reorder_point_kg
