attributes.description: The inventory mass threshold in kilograms at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this tank. When mass_kg falls at or below this value, procurement or supply chain teams are alerted to initiate a purchase order or transfer. Supports continuous inventory management for bulk chemicals.
attributes.references: SAP MM - MRP Reorder Point Planning; SAP EWM - Replenishment Management

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum allowable storage temperature for the chemical in this tank, expressed in degrees Celsius, as specified in the material SDS (Safety Data Sheet). Exceeding this threshold may indicate a safety hazard, product degradation risk, or regulatory non-compliance.
attributes.references: GHS - Safety Data Sheet Section 7; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM; NFPA 30 - Flammable Liquids Code

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum allowable storage temperature for the chemical in this tank, expressed in degrees Celsius, as specified in the material SDS (Safety Data Sheet). Used to trigger temperature deviation alerts and ensure regulatory compliance with safe storage requirements.
attributes.references: GHS - Safety Data Sheet Section 7; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM; NFPA 30 - Flammable Liquids Code

attributes.name: tank_capacity_m3
attributes.description: The nominal or maximum working capacity of the tank in cubic meters as defined in the tank design specification and strapping table. Stored with the measurement record to enable percentage calculations and capacity utilization reporting without requiring a join to the tank master.
attributes.references: API 650 - Welded Tanks for Oil Storage; ISO 7507 - Tank Calibration; SAP PM - Equipment Master

attributes.name: tank_farm_name
attributes.description: The name or designation of the tank farm area or storage cluster where the tank is physically located (e.g., North Tank Farm, Solvent Storage Area). Supports area-level inventory aggregation and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Warehouse Structure; EPA RMP - Facility Siting

attributes.name: tank_number
attributes.description: The human-readable functional identifier of the storage tank as designated in the plant P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) and SAP PM equipment master (e.g., TK-101, T-2204). Used for operational reference and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PM - Equipment Master; P&ID Engineering Standards; ISA-5.1

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: The temperature of the liquid in the tank at the time of measurement, expressed in degrees Celsius. Temperature is required for density correction, volume-to-mass conversion, and monitoring of temperature-sensitive chemicals to ensure safe storage conditions.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System - Temperature Tag; API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Temperature Correction; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: temperature_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured temperature at the time of this record was outside the defined safe storage temperature range (True = deviation detected, False = within range). Supports EHS compliance monitoring and automated alerting for temperature-sensitive chemical storage.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; GHS SDS Section 7; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: ullage_m
attributes.description: The available headspace (ullage) in the tank expressed in meters, calculated as the difference between the maximum allowable working level and the current measured level. Critical for safe filling operations, overfill prevention, and scheduling inbound deliveries.
attributes.references: API 650 - Welded Tanks for Oil Storage; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; EPA RMP 40 CFR Part 68

attributes.name: ullage_volume_m3
attributes.description: The available headspace volume in the tank expressed in cubic meters, representing the remaining capacity available for additional material. Used for logistics planning, delivery scheduling, and overfill risk management.
attributes.references: API 650; EPA RMP 40 CFR Part 68; SAP EWM - Capacity Management

attributes.name: valuation_currency
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the inventory value is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR). Supports multi-currency reporting for global operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 - Foreign Currency; SAP FI/CO

attributes.name: volume_liters
attributes.description: The calculated volume of liquid in the tank expressed in liters, derived from the level measurement and tank strapping table. Used for inventory quantity reporting and material balance calculations.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 2 - Tank Calibration; SAP MM - Inventory Management

attributes.name: volume_m3
attributes.description: The calculated volume of liquid in the tank expressed in cubic meters (m³). Provides SI unit representation for regulatory reporting, engineering calculations, and international trade documentation.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 2; ISO 7507 - Calibration of Vertical Cylindrical Tanks; EPA Tier II Reporting

products.name: inventory_adjustment
products.description: Record of inventory adjustments made to correct stock quantities outside of normal goods movement transactions, including write-offs, write-ups, count variance postings, and damage adjustments. Captures adjustment document number, material, lot, location, adjustment quantity (positive or negative), adjustment reason code, approver, approval date, financial impact value, and SAP MM material document reference. Requires dual authorization for adjustments above threshold values per SOX controls.

attributes.name: inventory_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each inventory adjustment record in the Chemical Mfg lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Adjustments affect financial valuation per product; linking to chemical_product enables audit trails, cost allocation, and regulatory impact analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Links adjustments to cost centers for variance analysis and internal cost control reporting.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.equipment. Business justification: Adjustments caused by equipment failures or repairs; needed for audit trail linking inventory adjustments to affected equipment.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Ensures each inventory adjustment posts to the appropriate GL account for financial statements and audit trails.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production or procurement lot (batch) whose stock is being adjusted. Critical for FIFO/FEFO lot rotation compliance and traceability in chemical manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Batch Management; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material (raw material, intermediate, finished good, or packaging material) whose stock quantity is being adjusted. Corresponds to the SAP MM material master record.

attributes.name: original_adjustment_inventory_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original inventory adjustment record that this record reverses. Populated only when reversal_flag is True. Enables full reversal chain traceability for audit and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); SAP S/4HANA MM – Reversal

attributes.name: primary_inventory_requested_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (warehouse operator, inventory controller, or production planner) who initiated and submitted the inventory adjustment request. Required for SOX dual-authorization controls and audit trail.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse storage location, tank farm, or bin where the adjusted stock resides. Integrates with SAP EWM for warehouse operations and hazardous material storage compliance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management); SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inventory adjustment record, tracking progression from initial draft through dual-authorization approval (required for SOX-controlled threshold adjustments) to final posting or reversal in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls

attributes.name: adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event timestamp recording when the inventory adjustment was physically executed or the stock correction was applied. Distinct from the record creation audit timestamp. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Posting Date; ISO 9001

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory adjustment indicating the business reason category: write-off (stock reduction for loss/destruction), write-up (stock increase for found goods), count_variance (physical inventory count discrepancy posting), damage (goods damaged in storage or handling), obsolescence (expired or out-of-spec material), or revaluation (value correction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: write_off|write_up|count_variance|damage|obsolescence|revaluation|transfer_correction|system_correction — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Movement Types; ISO 9001 Inventory Control

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the inventory adjustment received its final required authorization. Used for SOX compliance reporting and aging analysis of pending adjustments. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number linking this inventory adjustment to an associated CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) record when the adjustment triggers or is part of a quality or process improvement action. Supports ISO 9001 quality management traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 – CAPA; LabWare LIMS; Intelex EHS Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this inventory adjustment record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, SOX audit trails, and lakehouse ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the financial impact value is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency financial reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the inventory adjustment document, typically matching the SAP MM material document number generated at the time of posting. Used for cross-referencing with ERP and audit trails.

attributes.name: ehs_incident_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: EHS (Environment Health and Safety) Incident Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number linking this inventory adjustment to an associated EHS incident record in Intelex EHS Management (e.g., a spill, fire, or contamination event that caused material loss). Null when the adjustment is not related to an EHS incident.
attributes.references: Intelex EHS Management; OSHA; EPA; ISO 45001

attributes.name: financial_impact_value
attributes.description: The monetary value impact of the inventory adjustment on the balance sheet, calculated as adjustment quantity multiplied by the standard or moving average price of the material. Positive for write-ups, negative for write-offs. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) reporting and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – Material Valuation; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FASB ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the material being adjusted is classified as hazardous under GHS, OSHA, or DOT regulations. When True, additional EHS (Environment Health and Safety) reporting and disposal compliance requirements apply to the adjustment.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA; DOT (Department of Transportation); TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act)

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the material being adjusted, as maintained in the SAP MM material master. Supports reporting and analytics without requiring a join to the material master table.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP MM material number (alphanumeric code) identifying the specific chemical, raw material, intermediate, or finished good subject to the inventory adjustment. Enables direct cross-reference to SAP S/4HANA without relying solely on the surrogate key.

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: SAP MM movement type code that classifies the goods movement transaction (e.g., 551 for scrapping, 701 for physical inventory difference posting). Determines the accounting entries and stock update logic in SAP.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, instructions, or context provided by the requestor or approver regarding the inventory adjustment. Supports operational communication and audit documentation.

attributes.name: physical_inventory_document
attributes.description: SAP MM physical inventory document number associated with this adjustment when the adjustment originates from a physical inventory count (cycle count or annual count). Null for non-count-related adjustments such as damage write-offs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Physical Inventory; ISO 9001

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing site or distribution center where the inventory adjustment is being made. Supports multi-site inventory management and plant-level financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Plant; ISO 14001 Site Management

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date on which the inventory adjustment is recorded in the general ledger and stock accounts in SAP FI/CO. May differ from the adjustment timestamp if adjustments are posted retroactively within an open period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – Posting Date; FASB ASC 330

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material being adjusted, expressed as a positive value for stock increases (write-ups, found goods) or negative value for stock reductions (write-offs, damage, count shortages). Stored in the base unit of measure of the material.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Goods Movement; ISO 9001 Inventory Control

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the material lot being adjusted was in quarantine status (OOS – Out of Specification or OOT – Out of Trend hold) at the time of the adjustment. Supports QM (Quality Management) traceability and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – Quality Management; GMP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code classifying the root cause or business justification for the inventory adjustment (e.g., PHYS_INV_DIFF for physical inventory difference, DAMAGE_STORAGE for storage damage, EXPIRY for expired material). Drives financial posting rules and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Reason Codes; ISO 9001 CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action)

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description providing additional context for the inventory adjustment beyond the standardized reason code. Captures specific circumstances such as spill details, damage cause, or discrepancy explanation for audit and CAPA purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this inventory adjustment record is a reversal of a previously posted adjustment. True = this record reverses a prior adjustment; False = original adjustment. Supports audit trail integrity and double-entry accounting reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Reversal; SOX; FASB

attributes.name: sap_material_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP MM material document number generated when the inventory adjustment is posted in SAP S/4HANA. Serves as the primary cross-reference between the lakehouse silver layer record and the ERP system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: sap_material_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year associated with the SAP MM material document number. Required because SAP material document numbers are unique only within a fiscal year; combined with sap_material_document_number provides a globally unique ERP reference.

attributes.name: sox_threshold_exceeded
attributes.business_glossary_term: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Dual-Authorization Threshold Exceeded Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the financial impact value of this adjustment exceeds the SOX dual-authorization threshold, triggering the requirement for a secondary approver. True = dual authorization required and applied; False = single authorization sufficient.

attributes.name: sox_threshold_value
attributes.description: The monetary threshold value above which a second approver is required per SOX internal control policy. Stored on the record for audit traceability as thresholds may be updated over time.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: SAP storage location code (e.g., warehouse zone, tank farm area, quarantine area) within the plant where the adjusted material is stored. Supports hazardous material segregation compliance and EWM warehouse operations.
attributes.references: SAP EWM; SAP S/4HANA MM; OSHA PSM (Process Safety Management)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the adjustment quantity is expressed (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, DRUM for drum containers). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure for the material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|EA|BAG|DRUM|IBC|TON — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Unit of Measure; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this inventory adjustment record was last modified, supporting change tracking and SOX dual-authorization audit requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: The unit price (standard cost or moving average price) used to calculate the financial impact value of the adjustment at the time of posting. Captured for audit traceability as prices may change over time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – Material Valuation; FASB ASC 330

products.name: consignment_stock
products.description: Record tracking vendor-owned consignment stock held at the chemical manufacturer's premises but not yet financially owned. Captures consignment agreement reference, vendor, material, lot, quantity on consignment, storage location, receipt date, agreed consumption trigger, valuation price, liability transfer date, and aging days. Enables accurate financial reporting by distinguishing owned stock from consignment stock in SAP MM special stock management. Supports vendor-managed inventory (VMI) arrangements common in chemical feedstock supply.
products.reference: SAP MM Consignment Stock / Special Stock K

attributes.name: consignment_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consignment stock record in the Chemical Mfg inventory system. Primary key for the consignment_stock data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Special Stock Management

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Consignment reporting and liability transfer depend on knowing the exact chemical product, supporting inventory valuation and compliance checks.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the chemical raw material, intermediate, or packaging material held on consignment. Corresponds to SAP MM material master.

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Liability transfer and audit of consignment stock require a responsible employee for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Needed for Consignment Stock Management to record the customer site where consigned inventory is stored, supporting inventory visibility and billing.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) who legally owns the consignment stock until the agreed consumption trigger is met. Corresponds to the SAP MM vendor master record.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse storage location or tank farm bin where the consignment stock is physically held at the chemical manufacturer's premises. Corresponds to SAP EWM storage location.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Storage Location; SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Location (LGORT)

attributes.name: aging_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the consignment stock has been held at the manufacturer's premises since receipt date. Used for vendor-managed inventory (VMI) performance monitoring, slow-moving stock identification, and consignment agreement compliance (maximum holding period enforcement).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Special Stock Reporting; VMI Agreement Terms

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known reference number of the consignment agreement governing this vendor-owned stock arrangement. Links to the contractual terms under which the vendor retains ownership until consumption trigger is met. Sourced from SAP MM purchasing info record or outline agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Outline Agreement / Scheduling Agreement

attributes.name: coa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the vendor-provided Certificate of Analysis (COA) accompanying the consignment lot. Confirms the material meets agreed quality specifications. Linked to LabWare LIMS for incoming quality verification.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS - COA Management; ISO 9001; GMP

attributes.name: consignment_quantity
attributes.description: Current quantity of vendor-owned consignment stock on hand at the manufacturer's premises, expressed in the base unit of measure. Represents the unreceived (not yet financially owned) stock balance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Special Stock Quantity (MSKU-KULAB); ISO 9001

attributes.name: consignment_stock_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consignment stock record. 'active' = vendor-owned stock available for consumption; 'consumed' = fully consumed and liability transferred; 'partially_consumed' = partially drawn down; 'returned' = returned to vendor; 'expired' = past expiration date; 'quarantine' = held pending quality disposition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Special Stock (MSKU); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: consignment_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the current consignment stock on hand, calculated as consignment_quantity multiplied by valuation_price. Used for balance sheet disclosure of vendor-owned stock, financial reporting, and off-balance-sheet liability tracking under FASB ASC 330 and SOX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Inventory Valuation; FASB ASC 330; SOX

attributes.name: consumed_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of consignment stock that has been consumed (goods-issued to production or other cost centers) and for which financial liability has been transferred to the manufacturer. Used for settlement reconciliation and VMI performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Consignment Goods Issue (MIGO 201K); MRKO Settlement

attributes.name: consumption_trigger
attributes.description: The agreed business event that triggers financial liability transfer from vendor to manufacturer for consignment stock. Defines when ownership and payable obligation are created. Aligned with SAP MM consignment settlement process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Consignment Settlement (MRKO); Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI) Agreement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the consignment stock record was first created in the system, typically upon goods receipt posting in SAP MM. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Document; SOX; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the valuation price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and foreign exchange revaluation under FASB and SOX.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; SOX

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the consignment material is no longer suitable for use per quality specifications or regulatory requirements. Drives FEFO lot rotation, quarantine triggers, and vendor return decisions. Critical for GMP and chemical stability compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Batch Management (MCH1); GMP; ISO 9001; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: SAP material document number generated when the consignment stock was physically received at the plant (MIGO goods receipt against consignment PO). Used for traceability and audit trail of stock movements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Document (MSEG/MKPF); MIGO

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignment stock material is classified as hazardous under GHS, DOT, or OSHA regulations. Drives storage compliance requirements, SDS documentation obligations, and EHS reporting under TSCA and REACH.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); DOT 49 CFR; OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200); TSCA; REACH

attributes.name: last_consumption_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue (consumption) from this consignment stock lot. Used for slow-moving stock analysis, VMI replenishment planning, and consignment agreement compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Issue (MIGO); VMI Agreement

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the consignment stock record (e.g., quantity adjustment, status change, quarantine flag update). Supports data lineage, change audit, and Silver layer delta processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX; ISO 9001 Record Control; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: liability_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which financial ownership and payable liability for the consignment stock transferred from the vendor to the manufacturer, triggered by the agreed consumption event. Used for accounts payable accrual and financial period-end reporting under SOX and FASB ASC 330.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Accounts Payable; SOX Compliance; FASB ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Vendor-assigned or internally assigned batch/lot number for the consignment stock. Critical for FIFO/FEFO lot rotation, traceability, Certificate of Analysis (COA) linkage, and regulatory compliance under GMP and REACH.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Batch Management; GMP; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: maximum_holding_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the consignment stock may be held at the manufacturer's premises per the consignment agreement before automatic return or forced consumption. Breach of this threshold may trigger penalty clauses or mandatory settlement.
attributes.references: Consignment Agreement Terms; SAP S/4HANA MM - Outline Agreement

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of consignment stock permitted at the manufacturer's premises per the VMI or consignment agreement. Prevents over-stocking of hazardous chemicals and ensures compliance with site storage limits under OSHA PSM and EPA RMP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP / VMI; OSHA PSM (29 CFR 1910.119); EPA RMP (40 CFR Part 68)

attributes.name: minimum_stock_level
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of consignment stock that must be maintained at the manufacturer's premises per the VMI agreement to ensure uninterrupted production supply. Triggers vendor replenishment when consignment_quantity falls below this threshold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MRP / VMI Replenishment; Consignment Agreement

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing site or facility where the consignment stock is physically located. Used for plant-level inventory reporting and regulatory site compliance.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number associated with the consignment stock receipt. For consignment arrangements, this is typically a consignment PO (order type KE or KB in SAP MM) that governs the replenishment and settlement terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Purchase Order (EKKO/EKPO); Consignment PO

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignment stock lot is currently placed under quality quarantine and restricted from consumption pending laboratory testing or quality disposition. Integrates with LabWare LIMS quality hold status and SAP QM usage decision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Usage Decision; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001; GMP

attributes.name: quarantine_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for placing the consignment stock under quarantine. OOS (Out of Specification), OOT (Out of Trend), vendor deviation, physical damage, contamination suspicion, pending COA (Certificate of Analysis), or regulatory hold. Supports CAPA initiation and quality investigation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oos_result|oot_result|vendor_deviation|damaged|contamination_suspect|pending_coa|regulatory_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001; GMP; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor-owned consignment stock was physically received and placed at the manufacturer's premises. Used for aging calculation, FIFO/FEFO rotation, and consignment agreement compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Receipt (MIGO); FIFO/FEFO Inventory Management

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the consignment lot must be retested by the quality laboratory to confirm continued conformance to specification before use. Common for chemical raw materials with defined shelf-life stability windows. Sourced from LabWare LIMS batch records.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS - Batch Retest; GMP; ISO 9001; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of consignment stock returned to the vendor without consumption, typically due to quality rejection, expiration, or excess inventory. Recorded as a consignment return movement in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Consignment Return (MIGO 122K); ISO 9001 CAPA

attributes.name: settlement_document_number
attributes.description: SAP document number generated by the consignment settlement run (transaction MRKO) when consumed consignment stock is invoiced and liability is transferred to accounts payable. Used for financial reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Consignment Settlement (MRKO); FI Accounts Payable

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: Specific warehouse bin, tank number, or silo identifier within the storage location where the consignment material is physically stored. Supports hazardous material segregation and OSHA PSM compliance.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Storage Bin; OSHA PSM (29 CFR 1910.119)

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum permitted storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the consignment material as specified in the SDS or vendor COA. Critical for flammable, reactive, or thermally unstable chemical feedstocks.
attributes.references: GHS SDS Section 7 (Handling and Storage); OSHA HazCom; NFPA; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the consignment material as specified in the SDS or vendor COA. Ensures compliant storage conditions for temperature-sensitive chemicals and prevents degradation or hazardous reactions.
attributes.references: GHS SDS Section 7 (Handling and Storage); OSHA HazCom; NFPA

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the consignment quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for litres, MT for metric tonnes, DRUM for drum containers). Aligned with SAP MM base UOM and chemical industry standard packaging units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|TON|M3|BAG|DRUM|IBC — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: valuation_price
attributes.description: Agreed unit price at which the consignment stock will be valued upon consumption and liability transfer. Used for inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and accounts payable settlement. Sourced from SAP MM purchasing info record or consignment agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI - Valuation (MBEW); FASB ASC 330 Inventory; SOX

products.name: interplant_transfer
products.description: Inter-plant or inter-warehouse stock transfer order record for moving materials between different plant locations, distribution centers, or external warehouses. Captures transfer order number, sending plant, receiving plant, material, lot, transfer quantity, unit of measure, requested delivery date, transport mode, carrier reference, in-transit quantity, and transfer status (created, in-transit, received, confirmed). Distinct from intra-warehouse transfer orders managed in SAP EWM.
products.reference: SAP MM Stock Transport Order / STO

attributes.name: interplant_transfer_id
attributes.description: Primary key for interplant_transfer

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Transfer orders must reference the chemical product to calculate hazard handling, track REACH status, and generate correct shipping documentation.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: EPA traceability mandates recording which employee created the inter‑plant transfer for audit trails.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Inter‑plant transfer is tied to a specific lot; replace free‑text lot_number with FK for traceability.

attributes.name: sending_warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse_location. Business justification: Inter‑plant transfer originates from a warehouse location; replace string with FK.

attributes.name: transfer_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.transfer_price. Business justification: Links transfer order to approved transfer price for cost allocation in interplant shipments.

attributes.name: actual_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the goods issue posting was made in SAP MM, confirming physical departure of material from the sending plant. Used for transit time analysis and on-time shipment KPI reporting.

attributes.name: actual_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the goods receipt posting was made in SAP MM at the receiving plant, confirming physical arrival and acceptance of the transferred material. Used for transit time calculation and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Official bill of lading document number issued for the shipment. Serves as the legal contract of carriage and is required for hazardous material transport documentation under DOT regulations and customs compliance.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; Oracle Transportation Management; IMDG Code

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier or transport service provider responsible for moving the material between plants. Used for carrier performance tracking and freight cost allocation.

attributes.name: carrier_reference_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned reference number (e.g., bill of lading number, waybill number, or pro number) for the shipment. Used to cross-reference with Oracle Transportation Management and carrier tracking systems.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created the stock transfer order in SAP S/4HANA. Required for audit trail, authorization control, and SOX compliance documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stock transfer order was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA). Represents the business event of order initiation, not the ETL load time.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transfer value (e.g., USD, EUR). Required for multi-currency inter-company transfer valuation and financial reporting under FASB and SOX.

attributes.name: delivery_document_number
attributes.description: SAP outbound delivery document number created in SAP EWM/SD for the physical shipment execution of this stock transfer order. Links the STO to the warehouse execution and shipping documents.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Shelf-life expiration date of the transferred lot. Governs FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory rotation logic and ensures expired or near-expiry materials are flagged before transfer. Mandatory for regulated chemicals and pharmaceutical-grade materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Shelf Life; GMP; FEFO; FDA

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the transferred material is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, labeling, and transport documentation under DOT, GHS, and IMDG regulations. Triggers mandatory SDS/MSDS documentation and emergency response procedures.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; GHS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; IMDG Code

attributes.name: intransit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently in transit between the sending and receiving plants — goods issued but not yet goods-receipted. Represents the stock-in-transit position used for real-time inventory visibility and financial valuation of in-transit inventory.

attributes.name: issued_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material physically issued (goods issued) from the sending plant's inventory at the time of transfer. May differ from transfer_quantity due to partial shipments or measurement variances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Goods Issue; SAP EWM

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the stock transfer order record in the source system. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the material being transferred as maintained in the SAP material master. Provides human-readable identification for operational and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material master number uniquely identifying the chemical, raw material, intermediate, finished good, or packaging material being transferred. Serves as the primary material reference across SAP MM, PP, and QM modules.

attributes.name: planned_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which goods are scheduled to be issued from the sending plant's inventory. Derived from the requested delivery date and transit lead time in SAP MM planning.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the stock transfer order, used to sequence fulfillment and logistics scheduling. Urgent transfers may be triggered by production line stoppages or critical inventory shortfalls.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number associated with this stock transfer order for cross-company or third-party warehouse transfers. Links the STO to the procurement document for financial settlement and accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: quarantine_status
attributes.description: Quality management status of the transferred material lot indicating whether it is available for unrestricted use or held under quarantine/quality hold pending inspection or testing. Integrates with SAP QM and LabWare LIMS quality disposition workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001; GMP; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material confirmed as received (goods received) at the destination plant. Used to calculate transfer variances, identify transit losses, and trigger inventory reconciliation. Populated upon goods receipt posting in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-Goods Receipt; SAP EWM

attributes.name: receiving_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the destination plant, distribution center, or external warehouse that will receive the transferred material. Corresponds to the receiving plant in SAP MM stock transfer processing.

attributes.name: receiving_plant_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the destination plant or facility receiving the stock transfer. Provides human-readable context for reporting and operational dashboards without requiring a join to the plant master.

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location
attributes.description: SAP storage location code within the receiving plant where the material will be placed upon arrival. Identifies the target warehouse area, tank farm, or storage bin at the destination facility.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the transferred material is required to arrive at the receiving plant. Used for production planning, supply chain scheduling, and on-time delivery performance measurement.

attributes.name: sap_movement_type
attributes.description: SAP MM movement type code governing the inventory and accounting postings for this transfer (e.g., 641 for goods issue for STO, 101 for goods receipt). Determines the financial and inventory impact in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: sending_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the originating plant or manufacturing facility from which the material is being transferred. Corresponds to the issuing plant in SAP MM stock transfer processing.

attributes.name: sending_plant_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the originating plant or facility issuing the stock transfer. Provides human-readable context for reporting and operational dashboards without requiring a join to the plant master.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special stock type indicator identifying whether the transferred material is standard unrestricted stock or a special stock category such as consignment, project stock, or sales order stock. Affects inventory valuation and availability checking.

attributes.name: transfer_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known SAP stock transfer order document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA MM module. Used as the primary business reference across ERP, WMS, and logistics systems for tracking the inter-plant movement.

attributes.name: transfer_quantity
attributes.description: Ordered quantity of material to be transferred from the sending plant to the receiving plant, expressed in the base unit of measure. Represents the planned transfer amount at order creation.

attributes.name: transfer_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for initiating the inter-plant stock transfer (e.g., production replenishment, inventory rebalancing, quality rework, customer order fulfillment). Used for operational analytics and cost allocation.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inter-plant stock transfer order. Tracks progression from creation through in-transit movement to receipt confirmation at the destination plant. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|in_transit|partially_received|received|confirmed|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inter-plant transfer indicating the nature of the movement (e.g., plant-to-plant, plant-to-distribution center, cross-company transfer). Determines the SAP movement type and accounting treatment in FI/CO.

attributes.name: transfer_value
attributes.description: Monetary value of the transferred material quantity based on the standard or moving average price at the sending plant. Used for inter-company or inter-plant inventory valuation and financial settlement in SAP FI/CO. Expressed in the company currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 330; SOX

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used to move the material between plants (e.g., road tanker, rail car, pipeline, barge). Relevant for hazardous material transport compliance under DOT 49 CFR and IATA/IMDG regulations for chemical shipments.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management; DOT 49 CFR; IMDG Code; NFPA

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: UN four-digit identification number assigned to hazardous materials for transport classification (e.g., UN1993 for flammable liquids). Required on shipping documents and placards for hazardous chemical transport under DOT 49 CFR and IMDG regulations.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; IMDG Code; GHS; OSHA

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the transfer quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, DRUM for drum containers). Aligns with SAP MM unit of measure configuration and chemical industry standard packaging units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|EA|BAG|DRUM|IBC|TON — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: lot_genealogy
products.description: Association record capturing parent-child lot relationships for full traceability of chemical materials through production, blending, and repackaging operations. Captures parent lot, child lot, material transformation type (split, merge, conversion, repack), quantity consumed from parent, quantity produced in child, production order reference, transformation date, and plant. Enables upstream and downstream lot traceability for recall management, COA lineage, and regulatory reporting.
products.reference: SAP MM Batch Classification / Batch Where-Used

attributes.name: lot_genealogy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lot genealogy association record. Primary key for this parent-child lot traceability record in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; SAP EWM

attributes.name: child_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the downstream (child) lot produced or created from the parent lot. Enables downstream traceability for recall management and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP PP production order or process order under which the lot transformation was executed. Links genealogy record to the manufacturing execution event.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; MES Integration

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the child lot material produced. Identifies the chemical compound, intermediate, or finished good resulting from the transformation.

attributes.name: parent_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the upstream (parent) lot from which material was consumed or transformed. Enables upstream traceability for recall management and Certificate of Analysis (COA) lineage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where the lot transformation occurred. Used for site-level traceability and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure; EPA Site Reporting

attributes.name: actual_yield_pct
attributes.description: Actual yield percentage achieved in this transformation, calculated as (child_quantity_produced / parent_quantity_consumed) * 100. Compared against theoretical yield to identify process deviations requiring CAPA or Root Cause Investigation (RCI).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Yield Confirmation; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.192; SPC

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Bill of Materials (BOM) or recipe used for this transformation. Ensures traceability to the exact formulation specification applied during production, supporting change control and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.186; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registry number uniquely identifying the chemical substance of the child lot material. Used for regulatory reporting (TSCA, REACH, TRI), SDS documentation, and hazardous material classification.
attributes.references: CAS Registry; TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory; ECHA REACH; EPA TRI Reporting

attributes.name: child_material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number of the child lot material produced. Denormalized for direct traceability reporting. Identifies the chemical product, formulation, or intermediate resulting from the transformation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; CAS Registry

attributes.name: child_quantity_produced
attributes.description: Quantity of material produced in the child lot as a result of the transformation operation. Expressed in the base unit of measure of the child material. Used for yield analysis, COA quantity declaration, and inventory receipt posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Confirmed Quantity; GMP Batch Record; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: child_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the child lot quantity produced (e.g., KG, LB, L, GAL, MT). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure for the child material to ensure accurate yield reporting and inventory valuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|G|TON|M3 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: coa_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Certificate of Analysis (COA) for the child lot has been issued by the Quality Assurance (QA) function. Used to track COA fulfillment status for customer shipment readiness.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; LabWare LIMS COA Module; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.194

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must be generated for the child lot resulting from this transformation. Driven by customer contract requirements, regulatory mandates, or internal quality standards.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.194; Customer COA Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lot genealogy record was first created in the system of record (SAP PP or MES). Supports audit trail requirements under GMP 21 CFR Part 11 and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5 Documented Information

attributes.name: genealogy_record_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this genealogy association record, formatted as LG-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in COA lineage documentation, recall notifications, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material involved in this lot transformation is classified as hazardous under GHS, OSHA, or DOT regulations. Triggers additional compliance checks for storage, handling, and transport documentation.
attributes.references: GHS Globally Harmonized System; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials

attributes.name: is_multi_parent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child lot was produced from multiple parent lots (True) or a single parent lot (False). Relevant for blend and merge transformation types where multiple input lots contribute to one output lot.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Batch Classification; GMP Batch Record

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this lot genealogy record. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trail compliance, and identifying records modified after a recall event is triggered.
attributes.references: GMP 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: parent_material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number of the parent lot material. Denormalized for direct traceability reporting without joining to the material master. Identifies the chemical substance or intermediate consumed in the transformation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; CAS Registry

attributes.name: parent_quantity_consumed
attributes.description: Quantity of material consumed from the parent lot during the transformation operation. Expressed in the base unit of measure of the parent material. Critical for mass balance verification, yield calculations, and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Goods Movement; GMP Batch Record; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: parent_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the parent lot quantity consumed (e.g., KG, LB, L, GAL, MT). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure for the parent material to ensure accurate mass balance and inventory valuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|L|GAL|MT|G|TON|M3 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Quality Management (QM) inspection status of the child lot produced in this transformation. Not_inspected: awaiting QC sampling. In_inspection: under laboratory testing in LIMS. Released: passed all QC tests and approved for use/shipment. Rejected: failed QC and quarantined. Restricted: conditionally released pending further review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Inspection Lot; LabWare LIMS; ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.192

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child lot is currently under quarantine and blocked from use, shipment, or further processing. Set when quality inspection fails, an Out of Specification (OOS) result is detected, or a recall investigation is initiated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Batch Restriction; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) REACH registration number for the chemical substance involved in this lot transformation. Required for EU market compliance and supply chain traceability under REACH Article 31.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; REACH Article 31 SDS Requirements

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot genealogy record is implicated in an active product recall or withdrawal event. Enables rapid upstream and downstream lot identification for recall scope determination and regulatory notification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 Recall Procedures; REACH Article 37; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: sds_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) / Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) applicable to the child lot material at the time of transformation. Ensures traceability to the correct hazard communication document per GHS and OSHA HazCom requirements.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom Standard; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this lot genealogy record originated (e.g., SAP_PP for SAP Production Planning, MES for Manufacturing Execution System, LIMS for LabWare). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; SAP S/4HANA PP; SAP EWM; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., SAP batch classification document number, MES batch record ID). Enables back-referencing to the source system for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; SAP S/4HANA PP; GMP 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: SAP EWM storage location code where the child lot was placed after transformation. Used for warehouse traceability, hazardous material storage compliance verification, and FIFO/FEFO rotation management.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Storage Location; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 Flammable Liquids Storage

attributes.name: theoretical_yield_pct
attributes.description: Expected yield percentage of child material relative to parent material consumed, as defined in the Bill of Materials (BOM) or recipe. Used as the baseline for actual yield variance analysis and process performance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.192 Yield Reconciliation

attributes.name: transformation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the lot transformation operation was performed. Used for FIFO/FEFO lot rotation analysis, shelf-life calculations, and regulatory batch record dating.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Batch Record; GMP 21 CFR Part 211.188

attributes.name: transformation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording operational notes, deviations, or observations associated with the lot transformation. May include process deviations, equipment substitutions, or Management of Change (MOC) references that affected the transformation.
attributes.references: GMP Batch Record 21 CFR Part 211.188; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2; MOC Process

attributes.name: transformation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lot genealogy transformation record. Pending: transformation initiated but not yet executed. In_progress: transformation underway in MES/DCS. Completed: transformation fully executed and confirmed. Cancelled: transformation voided before completion. Reversed: completed transformation subsequently reversed via correction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; MES Workflow; GMP Change Control

attributes.name: transformation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the lot transformation was recorded in the system of record (SAP PP or MES). Provides sub-day precision for process sequencing, DCS event correlation, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Honeywell Experion DCS; GMP Audit Trail 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: transformation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material transformation operation that created the parent-child lot relationship. Split: one lot divided into multiple child lots. Merge: multiple parent lots combined into one child lot. Conversion: chemical reaction or synthesis producing a new material. Repack: same material repackaged into new containers. Blend: two or more materials combined to produce a formulated product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Process Order; GMP Batch Record Requirements

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: SAP PP work center or production unit code where the transformation operation was physically performed (e.g., reactor, blending vessel, filling line). Supports equipment-level traceability and OEE analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center; MES Equipment Tracking

products.name: inventory_lot_allocation
products.description: Association linking a chemical lot to an invoice line, capturing the quantity and unit of measure of material shipped for regulatory traceability. Each record represents a specific allocation of a lot to a line item.. Existence Justification: A chemical lot can be split across multiple invoice lines (partial shipments) and an invoice line can be fulfilled by material from multiple lots. The business records the quantity and unit of measure for each lot‑line pairing for regulatory traceability, making the relationship a managed many‑to‑many entity.

products.name: lot_shipment_allocation
products.description: Represents the allocation of inventory lots to outbound/inbound shipments. Each record links one lot to one shipment and stores attributes that are specific to that allocation such as shipped quantity, weight, and temperature control requirements.. Existence Justification: A chemical lot (batch) can be split across multiple outbound shipments for partial deliveries, and a single shipment can contain material from multiple lots to consolidate loads. The relationship is actively managed for traceability, regulatory reporting, and inventory reconciliation, and it carries its own attributes such as quantity and temperature control requirements.

attributes.description: Code of the warehouse or tank farm where the handling unit is currently stored.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the unit requires temperature‑controlled storage.

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: External business code used to reference the handling unit in operational systems (e.g., SAP EWM).

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name or label for the handling unit.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Measurement unit for the quantity (kilograms, liters, pieces).

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Category of the handling unit indicating its physical form.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the handling unit record.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the empty handling unit in kilograms.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: External width of the handling unit in centimeters.

attributes.name: parent_handling_unit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on handling_unit (parent_handling_unit_id)

products.name: warehouse_task
products.description: Master reference table for warehouse_task. Referenced by warehouse_task_id.

attributes.name: warehouse_task_id
attributes.description: Primary key for warehouse_task

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee responsible for executing the task.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of equipment (e.g., forklift, conveyor) used to perform the task.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Specific sub‑location (aisle, rack, bin) within the warehouse.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the raw material, intermediate, or finished good involved in the task.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or tank farm where the task is performed.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Real completion time when the task finished.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Real start time when the task began execution.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing batch identifier associated with the material.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the task record was first created in the data lake.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free‑text description providing details about the purpose and scope of the task.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact time the task was initiated in the warehouse.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the material is no longer usable or must be quarantined.

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory hazard class of the material per GHS.

attributes.name: is_critical
attributes.description: True if the task is deemed critical for production continuity or safety.

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: True if the task involves hazardous chemicals requiring special handling.

attributes.name: is_queued
attributes.description: True if the task is waiting in a queue for resources.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch/lot identifier for traceability of the material.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free‑form comments entered by operators.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business‑defined priority level indicating urgency.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units (or volume) moved or processed by the task.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned completion time for the task.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned start time for the task as per the work schedule.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system that created the task record (e.g., SAP_EWM, WMS).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the warehouse task.

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Free‑text explanation for the current status, especially when not completed.

attributes.name: task_category
attributes.description: High‑level grouping of the task for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: task_code
attributes.description: External code used to reference the task in operational systems such as SAP EWM.

attributes.name: task_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time from actual start to actual end, expressed in minutes.

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: Category of the warehouse operation performed by the task.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Aggregate weight of the quantity moved, calculated as quantity × unit_weight_kg.

attributes.name: unit_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of a single unit of material in kilograms.

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the quantity field.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the task record.

attributes.name: predecessor_warehouse_task_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on warehouse_task (predecessor_warehouse_task_id)

domains.name: sales
domains.description: Commercial sales domain managing sales opportunities, quotes, contracts, pricing agreements, customer negotiations, sales pipeline, territory management, distributor channel data, and sales performance metrics. Supports technical sales with product application guidance and customer-specific formulations. Integrates with Salesforce CRM and SAP SD to drive revenue growth and customer acquisition.

products.name: opportunity
products.description: Core sales opportunity record tracking prospective deals with industrial chemical customers, distributors, and end-users. Captures opportunity stage progression, estimated deal value, probability of close, target close date, and owning sales representative. Includes opportunity-level product associations (per-product quantity, estimated revenue, competitive status) for pipeline visibility. Records structured win/loss outcome on closure (close reason, competitor displaced/displacing, decision criteria, deal value at close) for competitive intelligence. Sourced from Salesforce CRM. Primary pipeline management and forecasting entity for commercial sales.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sales opportunity record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (industrial buyer, distributor, or end-user) associated with this opportunity. Links to the customer/account master data product.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP SD Customer Master

attributes.name: competitor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.competitor. Business justification: Standardizes competitor reference for opportunity; replaces free‑text competitor_name and status columns with a proper FK to competitor.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary customer contact person (e.g., procurement manager, technical buyer) associated with this opportunity. Links to the contact master data product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager who owns and is responsible for progressing this opportunity. Links to the workforce/employee data product.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User Object; SAP SD Sales Representative

attributes.name: formula_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula. Business justification: Custom formulation requests from sales opportunities must be linked to the created formula for traceability and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: When an opportunity converts to production, an internal order is created to track costs, linking opportunity to internal order.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Compliance check: opportunity creation must verify REACH/TSCA/SDS status of the specific material, requiring direct link to material_master.

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_specification. Business justification: Opportunity qualification requires checking the product's quality specification to ensure regulatory compliance and customer requirements.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: New product development request from a sales opportunity triggers an R&D project; linking enables tracking of opportunity-to‑project pipeline.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Opportunity delivery planning uses the Customer Site to calculate logistics, compliance (REACH/SDS) and shipping terms.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory to which this opportunity is assigned. Supports territory-based pipeline reporting, quota management, and regional performance analytics.

attributes.name: actual_close_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the opportunity was closed (won or lost). Populated upon opportunity closure. Used for sales cycle analysis, win/loss reporting, and period attribution. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Close Date; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: application_segment
attributes.description: The end-use application or industry segment for which the chemical product is being evaluated (e.g., Automotive Coatings, Electronics Manufacturing, Construction Adhesives, Consumer Goods). Supports technical sales targeting and market segmentation analytics.
attributes.references: ACC Industry Segmentation; SAP SD Industry Sector

attributes.name: close_probability_pct
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0.00–100.00%) that this opportunity will be won, as assessed by the sales representative or derived from stage-based defaults. Used in weighted pipeline calculations and revenue forecasting models.

attributes.name: close_reason
attributes.description: Structured reason code explaining why the opportunity was won or lost. Captures the primary decision criterion at closure. Used for competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, and sales strategy refinement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Price|Technical Fit|Relationship|Competitor|Timeline|Budget|No Decision|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Win/Loss Reason; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: closed_amount
attributes.description: Actual deal value at the time of opportunity closure (won or lost). May differ from estimated_amount due to negotiation, scope changes, or competitive pricing adjustments. Used for win/loss revenue analysis and competitive intelligence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Amount; FASB ASC 606; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pricing agreement or sales contract associated with this opportunity, if applicable. Links to the contract master data product. Populated when the opportunity is tied to a framework or long-term supply agreement.
attributes.references: SAP SD Outline Agreement; Salesforce CRM Contract Object

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the opportunity record was first created in the source CRM system (Salesforce). Used for pipeline aging, sales cycle duration measurement, and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CreatedDate; SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_code
attributes.description: Native opportunity identifier from Salesforce CRM (e.g., 006XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation with the source system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; SAP SD Integration

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated and closed deal amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency pipeline reporting and FX conversion in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: decision_criteria
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the customer's primary evaluation criteria for this opportunity (e.g., price, technical performance, regulatory compliance, delivery reliability, sustainability). Supports win/loss analysis and sales strategy development.

attributes.name: estimated_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total deal value (revenue) for this opportunity in the transaction currency. Represents the gross revenue expected if the opportunity is won. Used for pipeline valuation, quota tracking, and revenue forecasting. Aligns with SAP SD pricing and SAP FI/CO revenue planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Amount; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: estimated_volume_kg
attributes.description: Estimated annual or deal-period volume of chemical product(s) in kilograms associated with this opportunity. Used for supply chain capacity planning, raw material procurement forecasting, and production scheduling alignment with SAP PP.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quantity; SAP MM Material Planning

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter in which the opportunity is expected to close, formatted as Q[1-4]-YYYY (e.g., Q3-2024). Used for period-based pipeline reporting, quota attainment tracking, and financial forecasting aligned with SAP FI/CO fiscal calendar.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Fiscal Calendar; FASB ASC 606; SOX Quarterly Reporting

attributes.name: forecast_category
attributes.description: Sales forecast classification assigned to the opportunity, indicating the confidence level for revenue recognition in the current period. Used in executive revenue forecasting and financial planning aligned with SAP FI/CO reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Forecast Category; FASB Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: is_key_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opportunity is associated with a strategically designated key account (True) requiring executive sponsorship, dedicated account management, and priority resource allocation. Used for key account management reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Tier; ACC Responsible Care Customer Engagement

attributes.name: is_won
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the opportunity was closed as won (True) or lost/abandoned (False). Null if the opportunity is still open. Used for win rate calculations and pipeline conversion reporting.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sales activity (call, email, meeting, task) logged against this opportunity in Salesforce CRM. Used for pipeline hygiene monitoring, stale opportunity identification, and sales rep engagement tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the opportunity record was last updated in the source CRM system (Salesforce). Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate; SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: lead_source
