attributes.description: Channel or origin through which this opportunity was identified or generated. Used for marketing attribution, channel effectiveness analysis, and sales pipeline sourcing analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Inbound|Trade Show|Referral|Cold Outreach|Distributor|Web|Other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: next_step
attributes.description: Free-text description of the immediate next action required to advance this opportunity (e.g., 'Schedule technical demo', 'Submit COA for customer qualification', 'Negotiate pricing terms'). Used by sales representatives for pipeline management and CRM activity tracking.

attributes.name: opportunity_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the opportunity context, customer requirements, technical application details, and strategic importance. Supports sales team knowledge sharing and opportunity review meetings.

attributes.name: opportunity_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the sales opportunity, typically describing the customer, product line, and deal context (e.g., 'Acme Corp - Specialty Solvents Q3 2024'). Used for pipeline reporting and sales team communication.

attributes.name: opportunity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the opportunity by business development type. Distinguishes new customer acquisition from expansion of existing accounts, contract renewals, win-back of lost customers, and channel type (distributor vs. direct). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: New Business|Existing Business Expansion|Renewal|Win-Back|Distributor|Direct — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Type; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The primary chemical product line or portfolio segment associated with this opportunity (e.g., Specialty Solvents, Performance Polymers, Agricultural Chemicals, Adhesives). Used for product-level pipeline and revenue mix reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Material Group; SAP MM Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: reach_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity involves chemical substances subject to REACH registration, evaluation, or authorization requirements under EU regulation. Triggers regulatory compliance review and ECHA documentation workflow.

attributes.name: requires_custom_formulation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opportunity requires a customer-specific chemical formulation or product development engagement (True) versus a standard catalogue product (False). Triggers R&D and technical sales involvement when True.
attributes.references: SAP SD Special Customer Requirements; R&D Project Initiation

attributes.name: requires_sds
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has requested or requires a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) / Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) as part of the sales process. Relevant for GHS compliance and REACH regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The commercial channel through which this opportunity is being pursued. Distinguishes direct sales from distributor-mediated, agent-based, e-commerce, or tender/bid processes. Used for channel performance analytics and margin analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SD Distribution Channel; Salesforce CRM Channel

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this opportunity record was sourced (e.g., Salesforce CRM, SAP SD, Manual entry). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; SAP SD Integration

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the opportunity in the sales pipeline lifecycle. Drives pipeline forecasting, stage-gate reviews, and funnel conversion analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Prospecting|Qualification|Needs Analysis|Proposal|Negotiation|Closed Won|Closed Lost — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Stage; ACC Responsible Care Sales Practices

attributes.name: target_close_date
attributes.description: Expected date by which the opportunity will be won or lost. Drives pipeline aging analysis, period-end forecasting, and sales cycle duration reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Close Date; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opportunity involves chemical substances subject to TSCA inventory listing, reporting, or restriction requirements under US EPA regulation. Triggers regulatory compliance review.
attributes.references: TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act); EPA Chemical Data Reporting

products.name: quote
products.description: Formal price quotation issued to a customer or distributor for chemical products, including header-level terms (validity, incoterms, payment terms) and line-level detail (product/grade, quantity, UOM, per-line pricing, discounts, surcharges, COA/COC requirements). Supports RFQ response workflows and technical sales negotiations. Linked to SAP SD quotation and Salesforce CRM quote object. Enables granular margin analysis at the product-grade level.
products.reference: SAP SD Quotation / Salesforce CRM Quote

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the price quotation record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the quote entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or distributor to whom this quotation is issued. Links to the customer master record.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master pricing agreement or sales contract under which this quotation is issued, linking spot quotes to long-term contractual frameworks.
attributes.references: SAP SD Outline Agreement; FASB ASC 606 Contract with Customer

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal sales representative or technical sales engineer who owns and manages this quotation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Employee; Salesforce CRM User Object

attributes.name: formula_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula_version. Business justification: Quotes for regulated chemicals need to reference the exact formulation version to ensure compliance and accurate pricing.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Quote generation attaches SDS, REACH, TSCA compliance data; linking to material_master provides authoritative source for those attributes.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Salesforce CRM sales opportunity from which this quotation was generated, enabling pipeline-to-revenue traceability and win/loss analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; ACC Responsible Care Commercial Practices

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Quote creation selects a price list to price items; essential for accurate quoting in chemical sales.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating Request for Quotation (RFQ) that triggered this quote, enabling traceability from customer inquiry to formal offer.
attributes.references: SAP SD RFQ Object; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: sales_organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD sales organization responsible for issuing this quotation, defining the legal selling entity and pricing hierarchy.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Quotes must reference the specific Customer Site for accurate pricing, tax, incoterms and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Analysis (COA) to accompany the chemical product shipment, confirming that the product meets specified quality parameters. Drives LabWare LIMS documentation workflow.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Records; LabWare LIMS COA Module; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: coc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Compliance (COC) confirming the product meets regulatory, contractual, or customer-specific specification requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Records; ACC Responsible Care Product Stewardship

attributes.name: converted_order_number
attributes.description: SAP SD sales order document number created when this quotation is accepted and converted to a binding sales order, enabling end-to-end quote-to-cash traceability.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order; FASB ASC 606 Performance Obligation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this quotation record was first captured in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: crm_quote_number
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM quote object identifier, enabling bidirectional traceability between the CRM pipeline and the SAP SD quotation document.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values on this quotation are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: Customer's own Purchase Order (PO) reference number provided with the RFQ or acceptance, required for invoice matching and customer accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer PO Number; FASB ASC 606 Contract Identification

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code indicating the route to market for this quotation (e.g., direct, distributor, e-commerce), affecting pricing and availability determination.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: SAP SD division code representing the product line or business unit (e.g., Performance Materials, Agricultural Solutions, Plastics) responsible for this quotation.

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any product in this quotation is subject to export control regulations, triggering mandatory compliance review before order conversion (e.g., EAR, ITAR, dual-use chemical controls).
attributes.references: TSCA Export Notification Requirements; DOT 49 CFR; EAR 15 CFR 730-774

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross value of the quotation before application of discounts, surcharges, and taxes, expressed in the quotation currency. Supports margin analysis and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Procedure; FASB ASC 606 Transaction Price

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quoted products are classified as hazardous materials under DOT, IATA, or IMDG regulations, requiring special packaging, labeling, and transport documentation.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA DGR; GHS Classification; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost allocation between seller and buyer for chemical product shipments.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; DOT Hazardous Materials Transport Regulations; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port associated with the Incoterms code, specifying the exact point of delivery or risk transfer (e.g., 'FOB Houston Port'). Required for complete Incoterms specification per ICC rules.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Incoterms Location

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this quotation record, supporting change tracking and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net total value of the quotation after all discounts and surcharges but before tax, representing the agreed commercial value. Core metric for margin analysis at the quote level.
attributes.references: SAP SD Net Value; FASB ASC 606 Transaction Price

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP SD payment terms key defining the agreed payment schedule, early payment discount conditions, and due date calculation for the customer invoice (e.g., NT30, 2/10NET30).
attributes.references: SAP SD Payment Terms; FASB ASC 606 Significant Financing Component

attributes.name: price_list_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing basis applied to this quotation, determining which SAP SD condition records and pricing procedures are used for calculation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Price List; ACC Responsible Care Pricing

attributes.name: pricing_date
attributes.description: The reference date used to determine applicable price lists, condition records, and raw material index values for pricing calculation. May differ from quote_date for forward-priced contracts.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Date; FASB ASC 606 Contract Modification

attributes.name: quote_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the quotation was formally issued to the customer or distributor. Represents the principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quotation Creation Date; FASB Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: quote_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the quotation, tracking progression from initial draft through customer acceptance or expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|expired|converted|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Status; Salesforce CRM Quote Stage

attributes.name: quote_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quotation by commercial purpose: standard customer quote, spot market offer, contract pricing, distributor channel, intercompany transfer, or product sample. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|spot|contract|distributor|intercompany|sample — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Type; ACC Responsible Care Commercial Practices

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all chemical substances in this quotation are registered and compliant under REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 for the destination market, required for EU export.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; ECHA Guidance on Registration

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for quotation rejection or loss, populated when quote_status transitions to rejected or cancelled. Supports win/loss analysis and competitive intelligence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_too_high|competitor_selected|spec_mismatch|delivery_terms|no_decision|budget_cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Rejection Reason; Salesforce CRM Close Lost Reason

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested delivery date for the quoted chemical products, used for production scheduling, ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks, and logistics planning.
attributes.references: SAP SD Requested Delivery Date; SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: sales_district_code
attributes.description: SAP SD sales district code identifying the geographic territory assignment for this quotation, used for territory management, sales performance reporting, and commission calculation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales District; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: sap_quotation_number
attributes.description: The externally-known 10-digit SAP SD quotation document number used for cross-system reference and customer-facing communication.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Type QT

attributes.name: sds_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) applicable to the quoted chemical products at the time of quotation, ensuring regulatory compliance documentation is current.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9 SDS Requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for chemical product delivery. Drives export control screening, REACH compliance checks, and hazardous material transport regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; TSCA Export Notification

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the quotation, including VAT, GST, or applicable excise duties on chemical products, calculated per the customer's tax jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP SD Tax Condition; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; EPA Excise Tax Regulations

attributes.name: technical_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing technical sales notes, application guidance, customer-specific formulation requirements, or special handling instructions relevant to the quoted chemical products.
attributes.references: SAP SD Header Text; ACC Responsible Care Product Stewardship

attributes.name: total_discount_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate monetary discount applied across all line items on the quotation, including volume rebates, customer-specific pricing adjustments, and promotional discounts.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Type RA00; FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: total_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate surcharges applied at the header level, including energy surcharges, raw material index surcharges, hazardous material handling fees, and freight surcharges.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Type ZSU1; ACC Responsible Care Pricing Transparency

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The start date from which the quoted prices, terms, and conditions are binding and may be accepted by the customer.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quotation Validity Start; FASB ASC 606 Contract Identification

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The expiry date after which the quoted prices and terms are no longer binding. Drives automated expiry workflows and renewal alerts.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quotation Validity End; FASB ASC 606 Contract Identification

attributes.name: win_probability_pct
attributes.description: Sales representative's estimated probability (0.00–100.00%) that this quotation will be accepted and converted to a sales order, used for pipeline forecasting and revenue planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Probability; ACC Responsible Care Sales Forecasting

products.name: quote_line
products.description: Individual line item within a customer quote, representing a specific chemical product, grade, or SKU with its own pricing, quantity, unit of measure (kg, MT, L, drums), and technical specification reference. Captures per-line discount, surcharges (e.g., hazmat handling, small-order), and COA/COC requirements. Enables granular margin analysis at the product-grade level.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual line item within a customer quote. Primary key for the quote_line entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) - Quotation Item

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product, grade, or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) being quoted on this line. Links to the product master for full material specifications.
attributes.references: SAP MM - Material Master (MATNR); SAP SD - Sales Order Item

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Audit: Quote line creation must be traceable for SOX compliance; linking to employee records who created each line.

attributes.name: experimental_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_formulation. Business justification: Custom quote lines are priced based on an experimental formulation; the FK allows quote‑to‑formulation cost analysis.

attributes.name: formula_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula_version. Business justification: Each quoted line may be tied to a specific formulation version for line‑level pricing, safety data, and compliance checks.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or distribution center designated to fulfill this quote line. Determines production scheduling, inventory sourcing, and applicable plant-level pricing.
attributes.references: SAP MM/PP - Plant (WERKS); SAP SD - Delivering Plant

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue posting requires each quote line to map to a GL account for accurate financial reporting and downstream invoicing.

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer-specific pricing agreement, contract price list, or framework agreement that governs the unit price on this quote line. Links to long-term supply agreements and volume rebate contracts.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Pricing Condition Record (VK11); Salesforce CRM - Price Book

attributes.name: price_list_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list_item. Business justification: Each quote line pulls price from a specific price‑list item; needed for traceability of quoted prices.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customer quote header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-detail relationship between the quote and its individual line items.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales Quotation (VA21/VA22); Salesforce CRM - Quote

attributes.name: rawmaterial_sds_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.sds_record. Business justification: Each quoted line must reference the exact SDS version for the material; linking to sds_record ensures correct regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: batch_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical product on this quote line is subject to batch management and lot traceability requirements. Batch-managed products require Certificate of Analysis (COA) per lot and full GMP traceability.
attributes.references: SAP MM - Batch Management; GMP 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registry number uniquely identifying the chemical substance being quoted. Required for regulatory compliance, Safety Data Sheet (SDS) cross-referencing, and REACH/TSCA substance tracking.
attributes.references: CAS Registry; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA Section 8; GHS

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Analysis (COA) to accompany the shipment for this quote line. COA documents the actual quality test results for the specific production lot against specification limits.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GMP Guidelines; LabWare LIMS - COA Generation

attributes.name: coc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Compliance (COC) confirming the product meets all specified regulatory and contractual requirements. Common for food-contact, pharmaceutical, and automotive-grade chemicals.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; FDA 21 CFR; IATF 16949 Automotive Quality

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Seller-confirmed delivery date for this quote line after Available-to-Promise (ATP) check and production capacity validation. May differ from the requested delivery date.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Confirmed Delivery Date; SAP PP - Capacity Planning

attributes.name: contribution_margin
attributes.description: Gross contribution margin for this quote line, calculated as line net amount minus total standard cost. Expressed in the transaction currency. Enables profitability analysis at the product-grade level during the quoting process. Commercially sensitive.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Profitability Analysis (CO-PA); FASB ASC 606; EBITDA reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quote line record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, quote aging analysis, and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Creation Date/Time; SOX Section 302 Audit Trail; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this quote line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency quoting for international chemical trade.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP SD - Document Currency (WAERK); FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of calendar days from order confirmation to delivery at the agreed delivery point for this quote line. Accounts for production scheduling, inventory availability, and logistics transit time.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Delivery Date Determination; SAP PP - Lead Time Scheduling

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary value of the discount applied to this quote line in the transaction currency. Derived from discount_percent applied to line_gross_amount. Stored explicitly for audit and margin reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Discount Condition Value; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to this quote line, representing negotiated price reductions from the list price. Includes volume discounts, customer-specific pricing agreements, and promotional discounts. Commercially sensitive.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Discount Condition (K007/K005); Salesforce CRM - Discount

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Globally Harmonized System (GHS) hazard classification for the chemical product on this quote line (e.g., Flammable Liquid Class 3, Corrosive, Toxic). Drives hazmat surcharge applicability, packaging requirements, and transport documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FLAMMABLE_LIQUID|FLAMMABLE_SOLID|OXIDIZER|TOXIC|CORROSIVE|EXPLOSIVE|COMPRESSED_GAS|ENVIRONMENTAL_HAZARD|NON_HAZARDOUS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GHS Rev.9; DOT 49 CFR 172; IATA DGR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: hazmat_surcharge
attributes.description: Additional surcharge applied to this quote line for hazardous chemical handling, packaging, labeling, and transport compliance costs. Applicable for products classified under DOT, IATA, or IMDG dangerous goods regulations.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA DGR; IMDG Code; GHS

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between seller and buyer for this quote line. Affects freight cost allocation and logistics planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; Oracle Transportation Management; SAP SD - Incoterms

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this quote line record, in ISO 8601 format. Tracks revisions during negotiation cycles and supports change audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Change Date; SOX Section 302; ISO 8601

attributes.name: line_gross_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of this quote line before any discounts or surcharges, calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price in the transaction currency. Used as the baseline for margin and discount analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Net Value (NETWR); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: line_net_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value of this quote line after applying all discounts and surcharges (gross amount minus discounts plus surcharges) in the transaction currency. Represents the actual quoted value to the customer for this line.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Net Value (NETWR); FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this line item within the parent quote, used for ordering and referencing individual items. Corresponds to SAP SD item number (e.g., 10, 20, 30).

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this individual quote line item. Allows partial acceptance or rejection of lines within a multi-line quote. Draft: under preparation; Open: submitted to customer; Revised: updated after customer feedback; Accepted: customer confirmed; Rejected: customer declined; Cancelled: withdrawn by seller.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Quotation Item Status; Salesforce CRM - Quote Line Status

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number (MATNR) identifying the specific chemical product or grade being quoted. Used for cross-referencing with SAP MM and PP modules for production planning and inventory availability.
attributes.references: SAP MM - Material Master (MATNR); SAP SD - SD Item

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging or container in which the chemical product will be delivered for this quote line. Affects pricing, hazmat compliance, logistics planning, and customer handling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BULK|DRUM|IBC|BAG|CYLINDER|TOTE|FLEXIBAG|TANKER|PAIL|CARTON — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Packaging Requirements; UN Dangerous Goods Packaging; SAP MM - Packaging

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure basis for the unit price (e.g., price per KG, price per MT). May differ from the sales UOM when pricing is expressed per metric ton but sold in drums. Required for accurate line value calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|L|GAL|LB|DRUM|IBC|BAG|TON|M3 — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the chemical product or grade being quoted, including trade name, grade designation, and key specification identifiers as presented to the customer.
attributes.references: SAP MM - Material Description; Salesforce CRM - Product Name

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade or specification tier of the chemical product being quoted (e.g., Technical Grade, Reagent Grade, Food Grade, Pharmaceutical Grade, Industrial Grade). Determines applicable quality standards and pricing tier.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; GMP Guidelines; SAP MM - Material Classification

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the chemical product being quoted on this line. Expressed in the unit of measure specified in the uom field. Supports bulk chemical quantities in kg, MT, L, or container counts.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Quotation Item Quantity (KWMENG); ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical product on this quote line is compliant with REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation for the destination market. Required for EU export quoting.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA Substance Registration

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested delivery date for the product quantity on this quote line. Used for production planning, Available-to-Promise (ATP) checking, and logistics scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Requested Delivery Date (VDATU); SAP PP - MRP

attributes.name: sds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) must be provided to the customer with this quote line. Mandatory for hazardous chemical substances under GHS/OSHA HazCom 2012 and REACH regulations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; GHS Rev.9; REACH Regulation Article 31; ECHA

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit code identifying the specific packaged form, container size, and grade of the chemical product being quoted (e.g., 200L drum, 1MT IBC, bulk tanker). Enables granular margin analysis at the product-grade-packaging level.
attributes.references: SAP MM - Material Master; SAP SD - Sales Order Item

attributes.name: small_order_surcharge
attributes.description: Additional surcharge applied when the quoted quantity falls below the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) threshold for this product. Covers incremental handling and packaging costs for sub-MOQ orders.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Surcharge Condition; Internal Pricing Policy

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Internal standard cost per unit of measure for the chemical product on this line, sourced from SAP CO (Controlling). Used to calculate contribution margin and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) at the quote line level. Commercially sensitive internal data.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Standard Cost Estimate (CK11N); FASB ASC 330 Inventory

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: SAP storage location code within the delivering plant from which the chemical product will be sourced for this quote line. Relevant for inventory reservation and warehouse management.
attributes.references: SAP EWM - Storage Location (LGORT); SAP MM - Storage Location

attributes.name: technical_spec_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or document number for the customer-specific or internal technical specification that the quoted product must meet. Links to product specification sheets, customer qualification documents, or internal quality standards.
attributes.references: SAP QM - Inspection Plan; LabWare LIMS - Specification; ISO 9001

attributes.name: tsca_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical substance on this quote line is listed on the TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory and compliant with applicable TSCA requirements for US domestic sales.
attributes.references: TSCA Section 8(b) Chemical Substance Inventory; EPA TSCA Compliance

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: United Nations dangerous goods number (e.g., UN1090 for Acetone) assigned to the hazardous chemical on this quote line. Required for transport documentation, hazmat labeling, and emergency response planning under DOT and IMDG regulations.
attributes.references: UN Model Regulations; DOT 49 CFR 172.101; IMDG Code; IATA DGR

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Quoted price per unit of measure for the chemical product on this line, expressed in the transaction currency. Represents the base list or negotiated price before surcharges and discounts. Commercially sensitive pricing data.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Condition Value (KBETR); Salesforce CRM - Unit Price

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quoted quantity (e.g., KG - kilograms, MT - metric tons, L - litres, GAL - gallons, LB - pounds, DRUM - 200L drum units, IBC - intermediate bulk containers, BAG - bag units, TON - short tons, M3 - cubic meters). Critical for chemical pricing and logistics planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|L|GAL|LB|DRUM|IBC|BAG|TON|M3 — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD - Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000-1; UN/CEFACT Unit Codes

products.name: price_agreement
products.description: Negotiated pricing agreement (contract price, volume rebate, or long-term supply agreement) with a customer or distributor. Includes header terms (validity, currency, escalation clauses, approval status) and per-product/grade pricing conditions (unit price, volume break tiers, UOM, surcharges). Maps to SAP SD condition records and pricing contracts. SSOT for customer-specific contracted pricing within the sales domain.
products.reference: SAP SD Pricing Contract / Condition Record

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the negotiated pricing agreement record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Contract / Pricing Agreement

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or distributor with whom this pricing agreement is established. Links to the customer master in the sales domain.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager who owns and negotiated this pricing agreement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User / SAP SD Sales Employee

attributes.name: formula_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula_version. Business justification: Pricing agreements are frequently based on a specific formulation version to lock in cost, yield, and regulatory status.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Pricing contracts are material‑specific; linking price_agreement to material_master enables material‑based price terms and regulatory clauses.

attributes.name: sales_organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD sales organization responsible for this pricing agreement, defining the legal selling entity and regional scope.

attributes.name: strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.pricing_strategy. Business justification: Price agreements are executed under a defined pricing strategy; required for compliance and margin control.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the pricing agreement as referenced internally and in customer negotiations (e.g., 'FY2025 Polyethylene Supply Agreement - Acme Corp').
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Contract; Salesforce CRM Contract

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the pricing agreement, typically matching the SAP SD condition contract number or Salesforce CRM contract number. Used in customer-facing communications and purchase orders.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Contract (KONA); Salesforce CRM Contract Object

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing agreement. Draft = under preparation; Pending Approval = submitted for internal authorization; Active = in force and applicable to orders; Suspended = temporarily halted; Expired = past effective end date; Terminated = ended before expiry by mutual or unilateral action; Cancelled = voided before activation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|expired|terminated|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Contract Status; Salesforce CRM Contract Status

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing agreement by commercial structure. Contract Price = fixed negotiated unit price; Volume Rebate = retrospective rebate based on volume thresholds; Long-Term Supply = multi-year supply commitment with pricing; Spot Price = short-term market-based pricing; Distributor Price = channel partner pricing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: contract_price|volume_rebate|long_term_supply|spot_price|distributor_price|framework — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Type (KONP); ACC Responsible Care Commercial Practices

attributes.name: annual_volume_commitment
attributes.description: The total annual volume the customer has committed to purchase under this agreement, expressed in the price UOM. Used to validate volume rebate eligibility and supply planning. Corresponds to long-term supply agreement volume commitments.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quantity Contract (VBAK.BSTKD); FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal authorization status of the pricing agreement through the commercial approval workflow. Pending = awaiting review; Approved = authorized by required approvers; Rejected = declined; Revision Required = returned for amendment. Distinct from agreement_status which reflects the commercial lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP SD Release Strategy; Salesforce CRM Approval Process; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the internal approver (e.g., Sales Director, Commercial Manager) who authorized this pricing agreement. Required for SOX audit trail and pricing governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls; SAP SD Release Strategy

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pricing agreement received final internal approval and was authorized for commercial use.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls; SAP SD Release Strategy

attributes.name: base_unit_price
attributes.description: The negotiated base price per unit of measure for the primary product or grade covered by this agreement, expressed in the agreement currency. For volume-rebate agreements, this represents the list price before rebate calculation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Amount (KONP.KBETR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pricing agreement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for record origination.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all prices and amounts within this agreement are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with SAP SD document currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP SD Pricing (KONP.WAERS)

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel through which the product is sold under this agreement. Direct = sold directly to end customer; Distributor = sold through channel partner; Toll Manufacturing = customer-owned feedstock processing; Export = cross-border sales.
attributes.references: SAP SD Distribution Channel (TVTW); ACC Responsible Care Distribution

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pricing agreement ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Corresponds to SAP SD condition validity end date (DATBI).
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Record Validity (KONH.DATBI); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the pricing agreement becomes binding and applicable to customer orders. Corresponds to SAP SD condition validity start date (DATAB).
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Record Validity (KONH.DATAB); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: escalation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which price escalation reviews and adjustments are performed under the escalation clause. Null if no escalation clause applies.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Supplement; FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: escalation_index
attributes.description: Name or code of the external index used to calculate price escalations under the escalation clause (e.g., 'ICIS Ethylene Index', 'US CPI', 'Henry Hub Natural Gas', 'Platts Benzene'). Null if no escalation clause applies.
attributes.references: ICIS Chemical Pricing Indices; US Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI; Platts Chemical Benchmarks

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery and risk transfer point for shipments under this agreement (e.g., DAP = Delivered at Place, FOB = Free on Board, CIF = Cost Insurance Freight). Impacts freight cost allocation and pricing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Incoterms (VBAK.INCO1); Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port associated with the Incoterms code (e.g., 'Houston, TX' for FOB Houston). Required by Incoterms 2020 to complete the delivery term specification.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Incoterms Location (VBAK.INCO2)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this pricing agreement record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: min_order_qty
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity (MOQ) the customer must place per order to qualify for the contracted price. Expressed in the price UOM. Below this threshold, standard list pricing may apply.
attributes.references: SAP SD Minimum Order Quantity; ACC Responsible Care Supply Chain

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional commercial terms, negotiation context, special conditions, or internal commentary related to this pricing agreement that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Contract Text; Salesforce CRM Contract Notes

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days' advance notice required by either party to terminate or not renew this pricing agreement. Critical for supply chain continuity planning and customer retention management.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Contract Terms; FASB ASC 606 Contract Modification

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP SD payment terms code defining the agreed payment schedule for invoices under this agreement (e.g., 'NT30' = net 30 days, 'Z001' = 2/10 net 30). Governs cash discount eligibility and due date calculation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Payment Terms (T052); FASB ASC 606; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: price_escalation_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains a price escalation clause allowing periodic price adjustments based on raw material indices, energy costs, or inflation benchmarks (e.g., CPI, feedstock index). True = escalation clause present.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Supplement; ACC Responsible Care Commercial Practices; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: price_per_qty
attributes.description: The quantity denominator for the unit price (e.g., price per 100 KG, price per 1000 LB). Corresponds to SAP SD condition pricing quantity (KONP.KPEIN). Enables accurate per-unit price calculation when price is expressed per batch or bulk quantity.

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure to which the base unit price applies (e.g., KG = kilogram, MT = metric ton, LB = pound, L = liter, GAL = gallon, EA = each, BAG = bag, DR = drum, IBC = intermediate bulk container). Aligns with SAP SD condition pricing unit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|LB|L|GAL|EA|BAG|DR|IBC — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Pricing Unit (KONP.KMEIN); ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Specific chemical product grade or specification covered by this pricing agreement (e.g., 'Polyethylene HD-5502', 'Benzene 99.9% Pure', 'Sulfuric Acid Technical Grade'). Aligns with SAP SD material number or product hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP SD Material Master (MARA.MATNR); ISO 9001 Product Specification

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the products covered by this pricing agreement are compliant with EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation. True = REACH compliant; False = non-compliant or compliance not confirmed. Relevant for export agreements to EU customers.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; EU CLP Regulation

attributes.name: rebate_pct
attributes.description: Retrospective volume rebate percentage applied to the customer's total purchases when volume thresholds are met. Expressed as a percentage of net sales value. Applicable for volume rebate agreement types. Null for contract price agreements.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement (KONA); FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: rebate_threshold_qty
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative purchase quantity (in volume_commitment_uom) the customer must reach within the agreement period to qualify for the rebate percentage. Used in volume rebate agreement types.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Condition Scale (KONP); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Defines how the pricing agreement is renewed at expiry. Auto Renew = automatically extends for the same term unless cancelled; Manual Renew = requires explicit renegotiation; No Renewal = single-term agreement with no renewal provision.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Contract; Salesforce CRM Contract Renewal; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: sap_condition_contract_no
attributes.description: The SAP SD condition contract number (KONA.KNUMA_AG) that is the system-of-record identifier for this pricing agreement in SAP S/4HANA. Enables traceability back to the operational source system.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Contract (KONA.KNUMA_AG); SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Fixed surcharge amount per price UOM added to the base unit price. Expressed in the agreement currency. Null if surcharge_type is 'none' or if surcharge is percentage-based.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Amount (KONP.KBETR); DOT 49 CFR Hazmat Surcharge

attributes.name: surcharge_type
attributes.description: Type of surcharge applicable to this agreement in addition to the base unit price. Energy = energy cost surcharge; Freight = logistics/transport surcharge; Raw Material = feedstock cost pass-through; Hazmat = hazardous materials handling surcharge per DOT/IATA; None = no surcharge. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy|freight|raw_material|hazmat|regulatory|currency|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Type Surcharge (KONP); DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR; IATA DGR

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Sales territory code identifying the geographic or account-based territory to which this pricing agreement is assigned. Used for territory management, sales performance reporting, and commission calculations in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; SAP SD Sales Territory

attributes.name: tsca_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical products covered by this agreement are listed on the TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act) Chemical Substance Inventory and compliant with EPA TSCA requirements. Required for domestic US chemical sales agreements.
attributes.references: EPA TSCA 15 U.S.C. §2601; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: volume_commitment_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the annual volume commitment quantity (e.g., MT = metric ton, KG = kilogram). May differ from price UOM for large-volume chemical supply agreements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|LB|L|GAL|EA|BAG|DR|IBC — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Quantity Contract UOM; ISO 80000-1

products.name: price_agreement_line
products.description: Individual product-level pricing condition within a price agreement, specifying the agreed unit price, volume break tiers, UOM, validity dates, and applicable surcharges or rebate percentages for a specific chemical product or grade. Enables multi-product pricing agreements with per-SKU terms.

attributes.name: price_agreement_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual product-level pricing line within a price agreement. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or account for whom this product-level pricing line is negotiated. Supports customer-specific pricing analytics and contract compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master (KNA1); Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Pricing governance requires a sign‑off employee for each price‑agreement line; enables approval audit reports.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product or grade covered by this pricing line. Identifies the specific SKU, formulation, or material for which the agreed price applies.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master (MARA); SAP SD

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Cost accounting for contracted pricing needs a GL account to post expense and COGS when price agreements are applied.

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent price agreement header under which this line is defined. Establishes the header-to-line relationship for multi-product pricing agreements.
attributes.references: SAP SD Contract (VBAK/VBAP); Salesforce CRM Price Book Entry

attributes.name: agreed_unit_price
attributes.description: Negotiated price per unit of measure for the chemical product on this pricing line. Represents the base contractual price before surcharges, rebates, or volume discounts are applied.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Amount (KBETR); FASB ASC 606; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: annual_volume_commitment
attributes.description: Contractually committed annual purchase volume for this product line in the agreement UOM. Used to track customer compliance with take-or-pay or volume commitment clauses common in chemical supply contracts.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quantity Contract (VBAK-VBTYP=G); ACC Chemical Supply Agreements; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: condition_type_code
attributes.description: SAP SD pricing condition type code identifying the nature of the pricing condition on this line (e.g., PR00 for base price, ZK01 for customer-specific price, RA01 for rebate). Drives pricing determination in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Type (KSCHL/KONP); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price agreement line record was first created in the system, capturing the audit trail for contract origination. Sourced from SAP SD or Salesforce CRM record creation time.
attributes.references: SAP SD ERDAT/ERZET; SOX Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the agreed unit price and all monetary values on this pricing line are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP SD WAERK; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this product-level pricing line becomes valid and applicable for customer orders. Aligns with the SAP SD condition record validity start date.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Validity (DATAB); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this product-level pricing line ceases to be valid. After this date, the agreed price is no longer applicable unless the agreement is renewed. Aligns with SAP SD condition validity end date.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Validity (DATBI); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: grade_specification
attributes.description: Chemical product grade or specification qualifier for this pricing line (e.g., 'Technical Grade', 'Reagent Grade', 'Food Grade', 'Pharmaceutical Grade'). Differentiates pricing for the same base chemical at different purity or quality levels.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Product Specification; GMP; FDA Food Contact Chemicals; REACH

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery and risk transfer point for this pricing line (e.g., FOB, CIF, DAP). Affects the all-in cost to the customer and is a standard field in SAP SD. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Incoterms (INCO1); DOT; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port associated with the Incoterms code for this pricing line (e.g., 'Houston, TX' for FOB Houston). Specifies the exact point of risk and cost transfer.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD Incoterms Location (INCO2)

attributes.name: index_adjustment_formula
attributes.description: Description or formula defining how the price index is applied to adjust the agreed unit price (e.g., 'Base price + 0.85 * (current month ICIS ethylene - reference ethylene price)'). Captures the contractual price escalation mechanism.
attributes.references: ACC Chemical Industry Pricing Practices; FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this price agreement line record, supporting audit trail and change management requirements for pricing governance.
attributes.references: SAP SD AEDAT; SOX Audit Trail; ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this pricing line within the parent price agreement, used for ordering and referencing individual product terms within a multi-SKU agreement.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this pricing line. Controls whether the agreed price is applicable for order processing. Active lines are used in SAP SD pricing determination.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Record Status; ISO 9001 Contract Review

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number or internal SKU code identifying the chemical product or grade on this pricing line. Used for cross-referencing with ERP production and inventory records.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master (MATNR); SAP SD

attributes.name: min_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity the customer must order per transaction to qualify for the agreed price on this line. Enforces contractual MOQ commitments common in chemical supply agreements.
attributes.references: SAP SD Minimum Order Quantity; ACC Responsible Care Supply Chain

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Packaging format for the chemical product on this pricing line. Pricing often varies by packaging type in chemical sales (e.g., bulk tanker vs. 200L drum vs. IBC tote). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk|drum|ibc|bag|cylinder|tote|flexibag|railcar|isotank — promote to reference product if more values needed]
attributes.references: SAP SD Packaging Material; DOT Hazmat Packaging Regulations; UN Packaging Standards

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the payment terms applicable to orders placed under this pricing line (e.g., 'NET30', 'NET60', '2/10NET30'). Aligns with SAP SD payment terms (ZTERM) and customer credit management.
attributes.references: SAP SD Payment Terms (ZTERM); FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing or distribution facility from which the chemical product on this pricing line is to be supplied. Determines sourcing, logistics costs, and applicable freight surcharges.

attributes.name: price_index_linked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreed unit price on this line is linked to a commodity or raw material price index (e.g., ethylene cracker margin, benzene spot price, crude oil index). Common in long-term chemical supply contracts.
attributes.references: ACC Chemical Industry Pricing Practices; ICIS Chemical Price Indices

attributes.name: price_index_name
attributes.description: Name or code of the commodity or raw material price index to which this pricing line is linked (e.g., 'ICIS Ethylene NWE', 'Platts Benzene FOB Korea', 'WTI Crude Oil'). Populated only when price_index_linked is true.
attributes.references: ICIS Chemical Price Indices; Platts Chemical Pricing; ACC

attributes.name: price_per_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity base (denominator) for the agreed unit price, indicating how many units the price applies to (e.g., price per 1 KG, price per 100 KG, price per 1000 L). Corresponds to SAP SD condition pricing unit (KPEIN).

attributes.name: rebate_basis
attributes.description: The calculation basis on which the rebate percentage is applied: invoice value, net sales value, volume in kilograms, or volume in metric tons. Determines how rebate accruals are computed in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement Condition Basis; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: rebate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rebate to be credited back to the customer on purchases of this product line, typically settled periodically (monthly, quarterly, annually). Supports SAP SD rebate agreement processing.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement (VBOF); FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration; SOX

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: SAP sales organization code under which this pricing line is managed. Determines the legal entity, currency, and pricing procedures applicable to the agreement line.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Organization (VKORG); SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary surcharge amount per UOM added to the agreed unit price for this line. Used when the surcharge is a flat fee rather than a percentage (e.g., $0.05/KG energy surcharge).
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Amount (KBETR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: surcharge_percent
attributes.description: Percentage-based surcharge applied to the agreed unit price for this line. Used when the surcharge is calculated as a proportion of the base price (e.g., 2.5% raw material index surcharge).
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Rate (KBETR with KMEIN=%); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: surcharge_type
attributes.description: Type of surcharge applicable to this pricing line, reflecting cost pass-through mechanisms common in chemical contracts (e.g., energy surcharge, freight surcharge, raw material index surcharge, hazardous material handling surcharge).
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Type (KSCHL); ACC Chemical Industry Pricing Practices; DOT Hazmat Surcharge

attributes.name: take_or_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing line is subject to a take-or-pay clause, requiring the customer to purchase the committed volume or pay a penalty for the shortfall. Common in long-term chemical feedstock agreements.
attributes.references: ACC Chemical Industry Contract Practices; FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: tier_1_min_qty
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity threshold for the first volume break tier. Orders at or above this quantity qualify for the Tier 1 discounted unit price.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Scale (KONPS); ACC Chemical Supply Agreements

attributes.name: tier_1_unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed unit price applicable when the order quantity meets or exceeds the Tier 1 minimum quantity threshold. Represents the first volume discount price break.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Scale Amount (KBETR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: tier_2_min_qty
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity threshold for the second volume break tier. Orders at or above this quantity qualify for the Tier 2 discounted unit price.

attributes.name: tier_2_unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed unit price applicable when the order quantity meets or exceeds the Tier 2 minimum quantity threshold. Represents the second volume discount price break.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Scale Amount (KBETR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: tier_3_min_qty
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity threshold for the third volume break tier. Orders at or above this quantity qualify for the Tier 3 discounted unit price.

attributes.name: tier_3_unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed unit price applicable when the order quantity meets or exceeds the Tier 3 minimum quantity threshold. Represents the third volume discount price break.
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Scale Amount (KBETR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure against which the agreed unit price is expressed (e.g., KG for kilogram, MT for metric ton, L for liter, GAL for gallon). Aligns with SAP SD sales unit and chemical industry standard packaging units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|LB|L|GAL|EA|DRM|IBC|BAG|TON — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Unit (VRKME); UN/CEFACT Unit of Measure Codes; ISO 80000

attributes.name: volume_tier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing line has volume break tiers defined, where the unit price decreases as order quantity increases. When true, volume tier records are associated with this line.
attributes.references: SAP SD Scale Pricing (Condition Scales); Salesforce CRM Price Book

attributes.name: volume_tier_type
attributes.description: Basis on which volume break tiers are calculated: by order quantity (units/weight), by order value (monetary), or by weight (metric tons). Determines how SAP SD scale pricing is evaluated.

products.name: territory
products.description: Sales territory definition, hierarchy, and representative assignment record. Defines geographic regions, industry verticals, or named-account segments with territory hierarchy (global/regional/local) and assigned product line scope. Includes full sales representative assignment history with role type (primary, backup, overlay), effective dates, and coverage scope. Supports territory planning, sales force alignment, quota attribution, and commission allocation for chemical sales organizations.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sales territory record. Primary key for the territory data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) - Territory Master

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Territory expense allocation report tracks costs per cost center, linking territory to its responsible cost center.

attributes.name: parent_territory_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent territory in the hierarchy. Enables rollup of sales performance, quota, and commission data from local to regional to global levels. Null for top-level global territories.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Hierarchy; SAP SD Sales Organization

attributes.name: primary_rep_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the primary sales representative assigned to this territory. Links to HR/workforce records for commission calculation, performance management, and territory coverage reporting. Classified as confidential PII as it identifies an individual employee.
attributes.references: SAP HCM Employee Master; Salesforce CRM User Management; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: territory_backup_rep_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the backup (secondary) sales representative assigned to cover this territory in the absence of the primary rep. Supports territory coverage continuity and commission split calculations.
attributes.references: SAP HCM; Salesforce CRM Territory Assignment; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: territory_overlay_rep_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the overlay (specialist) sales representative assigned to this territory for technical sales support, product application guidance, or specific chemical product line expertise. Common in chemical sales for technical specialists.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Assignment; SAP SD

attributes.name: territory_sales_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the sales manager responsible for overseeing this territory. Used for escalation routing, performance review, and management reporting in the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: SAP HCM; Salesforce CRM; SAP SD Sales Office

attributes.name: annual_quota_usd
attributes.description: Annual revenue quota assigned to this territory in US Dollars. Used for sales performance measurement, commission calculation, and territory planning. Represents the revenue target the territory is expected to achieve within the fiscal year.
attributes.references: SAP SD; Salesforce CRM Quota Management; SOX Financial Reporting; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Primary sales channel model for this territory. Direct indicates company-employed sales reps selling directly to end customers; distributor indicates third-party channel partners; agent indicates commissioned agents; e_commerce indicates digital self-service; hybrid combines multiple channels.
attributes.references: SAP SD Distribution Channel; Salesforce CRM Channel Management

attributes.name: commission_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the commission plan applicable to this territory. Determines how sales revenue generated within the territory is translated into commission payments for assigned representatives. Managed in SAP FI/CO and HR incentive compensation systems.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Incentive and Commission Management; SOX; FASB ASC 340-40

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the primary country covered by this territory (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'CHN'). Used for regulatory compliance reporting (REACH, TSCA, EPA) and international sales analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this territory record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for territory master data governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8601; SAP SD Audit Trail

attributes.name: customer_count
attributes.description: Number of active customer accounts assigned to this territory at the time of last update. Used for territory sizing, workload balancing, and sales force planning in the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Territory Assignment; SAP SD Customer Master

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code applicable to this territory, indicating how chemical products are sold (e.g., direct sales, distributor, e-commerce). Drives pricing, order management, and commission rules.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: SAP SD division code representing the product division or business unit whose products are sold within this territory (e.g., specialty chemicals, performance materials, agricultural solutions).
attributes.references: SAP SD Division Configuration; SAP MM Materials Management

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this territory definition ceases to be operationally effective. Null for currently active territories. Supports historical territory analysis and commission dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX Financial Reporting Compliance

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this territory definition became operationally effective. Used for time-bounded quota attribution, commission calculation, and sales force alignment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX Financial Reporting Compliance

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2024) for which the territory quota and performance targets are defined. Aligns with the company's SAP FI/CO fiscal year configuration.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Fiscal Year Configuration; FASB; SOX

attributes.name: hazmat_handling_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales activities in this territory involve hazardous chemical products requiring special handling, DOT transport compliance, GHS labeling, or OSHA PSM considerations. Drives compliance training requirements for assigned reps.
attributes.references: DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; GHS; OSHA

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Position of this territory within the sales territory hierarchy. Global is the top-level rollup; regional covers multi-country or multi-state zones; area covers sub-regional clusters; local is the lowest-level individual rep territory.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Hierarchy; SAP SD Sales Organization Structure

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: Target customer industry vertical served by this territory (e.g., 'Automotive', 'Construction', 'Electronics', 'Consumer Goods', 'Agriculture', 'Pharmaceuticals'). Supports industry-specific sales strategy and product application guidance for chemical products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|construction|electronics|consumer_goods|agriculture|pharmaceuticals|coatings|food_beverage|oil_gas|textiles — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Industry Classification; ACC Industry Segmentation

attributes.name: last_realignment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent territory realignment or restructuring event. Territory realignments in chemical sales organizations occur during annual planning cycles, mergers, or strategic pivots. Used to track territory stability and assess impact on quota attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; SAP SD; SOX Change Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this territory record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture, data lineage tracking, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: named_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory is defined as a named-account territory (True) rather than a geographic or vertical territory (False). Named account territories in chemical sales are assigned to specific strategic customers regardless of geography.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; ACC Key Account Management

attributes.name: product_line_scope
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or description of chemical product lines assigned to this territory (e.g., 'Specialty Resins, Performance Coatings', 'Agricultural Herbicides'). Defines which product categories the territory rep is authorized to sell. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: specialty_chemicals|performance_materials|agricultural_solutions|plastics|coatings|adhesives|solvents|catalysts — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Material Group; SAP MM Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: quota_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the territory quota (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'CNY'). Supports multi-currency quota management for international chemical sales territories.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI/CO Currency Configuration; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: reach_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory operates under European REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation, requiring compliance documentation for chemical substances sold. Relevant for EU/EEA territories.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA; European Chemicals Agency

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Standardized geographic region code for the territory (e.g., 'NOAM', 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'LATAM'). Used for geographic rollup reporting and multi-regional sales performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SD; Salesforce CRM; ISO 3166 Geographic Standards

attributes.name: rep_assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current primary sales representative assignment to this territory ends or ended. Null for currently active assignments. Supports historical assignment tracking and commission dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Assignment History; SAP SD; SOX

attributes.name: rep_assignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current primary sales representative assignment to this territory became effective. Used for commission attribution, quota proration, and sales force alignment history tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Assignment History; SAP SD; SOX

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: SAP SD Sales Organization code to which this territory belongs. Defines the legal entity and organizational unit responsible for selling chemical products within this territory (e.g., '1000' for North America Chemicals).
