attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Organization Configuration; FASB Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: salesforce_territory_code
attributes.description: Native Salesforce CRM Territory2 object identifier (15 or 18-character Salesforce ID) for this territory. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and Salesforce CRM source system.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory2 Object; Salesforce Platform API

attributes.name: sap_sales_district_code
attributes.description: SAP SD Sales District code corresponding to this territory. The sales district is the SAP organizational unit that maps most directly to a geographic sales territory and is used in SAP order management, pricing, and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales District Configuration (T171); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 state or province code for sub-national geographic territories (e.g., 'US-TX', 'DE-BY'). Applicable for local-level territories; null for regional or global territories.

attributes.name: strategic_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory contains one or more strategic (key) accounts that require dedicated executive-level sales engagement. Strategic territories in chemical manufacturing typically involve large-volume contracts and custom formulation agreements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; ACC Responsible Care Key Account Program

attributes.name: technical_sales_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory requires dedicated technical sales support (True), such as application engineers or chemists who provide product application guidance, formulation support, or SDS/COA documentation assistance to customers.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; ACC Responsible Care Technical Service Standards

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the sales territory, as maintained in SAP SD and Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system reference and reporting (e.g., 'NA-CHEM-NE-01', 'EMEA-AG-DE-02').
attributes.references: SAP SD Territory Configuration; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: territory_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the territory scope, coverage boundaries, special conditions, or strategic context. May include notes on key customer segments, chemical product focus areas, or competitive landscape relevant to the territory.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; SAP SD

attributes.name: territory_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the sales territory (e.g., 'Northeast Specialty Chemicals', 'Germany Agricultural Solutions'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and sales force communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; SAP SD

attributes.name: territory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the territory record. Active territories are currently assigned and operational; pending territories are being set up; inactive territories have been temporarily suspended; archived territories are closed and retained for historical reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; SAP SD

attributes.name: territory_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the territory is defined and segmented. Geographic territories are defined by physical region; industry_vertical by customer industry sector; named_account by specific key accounts; product_line by chemical product category; hybrid combines multiple dimensions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; ACC Responsible Care Sales Practices

attributes.name: tsca_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory operates under US TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act) regulation, requiring compliance with EPA chemical substance reporting and restriction requirements for products sold in this territory.
attributes.references: TSCA 15 U.S.C. §2601; EPA; US Environmental Protection Agency

products.name: territory_assignment
products.description: Association record linking a sales representative or account manager to a specific territory, capturing assignment start/end dates, role type (primary, backup, overlay), and coverage scope. Enables historical tracking of territory ownership changes and supports commission and quota attribution in chemical sales organizations.

attributes.name: territory_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each territory assignment record in the chemical sales organization. Primary key for this association entity linking a sales representative or account manager to a specific territory.
attributes.references: SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) - Territory Management

attributes.name: predecessor_assignment_territory_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous territory assignment record that this assignment supersedes. Enables historical tracking of territory ownership changes, succession planning, and audit trail of coverage transitions in the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Territory History; Salesforce CRM - Territory Assignment History

attributes.name: primary_territory_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales manager or regional director responsible for overseeing this territory assignment. Supports management hierarchy reporting, approval workflows, and escalation routing in the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales Manager; Salesforce CRM - Territory Hierarchy

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory being assigned. A territory defines a geographic or account-based coverage scope within the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales Territory; Salesforce CRM - Territory Management

attributes.name: tertiary_territory_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or manager who formally approved this territory assignment. Supports governance, audit trail, and Management of Change (MOC) compliance requirements in the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Approval Workflow; Salesforce CRM - Approval Process; SOX - Internal Controls

attributes.name: account_count_target
attributes.description: The planned number of customer accounts the sales representative is expected to manage within this territory assignment. Used for workload balancing, territory sizing, and sales capacity planning in the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Territory Account Assignment; SAP SD - Customer Master

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the territory assignment was formally approved by the designated authority. Required for SOX compliance and internal audit trail of territory ownership changes.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls; SAP SD - Approval Workflow

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the territory assignment record, used in SAP SD and Salesforce CRM for cross-system reference and audit trail. Format: TA-YYYYMMDD-XXXX.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales Territory Assignment; Salesforce CRM - Territory Assignment

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the territory assignment. Drives commission eligibility, quota attribution, and CRM routing logic. Active indicates the rep is currently responsible for the territory.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Territory Management; Salesforce CRM - Territory Assignment Status

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the basis on which the territory is defined and assigned. Geographic assignments cover a physical region; account-based assignments cover named accounts; product-based assignments cover specific chemical product lines (e.g., specialty polymers, agrochemicals); channel-based assignments cover distributor or direct channels.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Territory Type; SAP SD - Sales Territory

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Indicates the go-to-market channel through which the sales representative engages customers in this territory. Direct indicates direct customer engagement; distributor indicates sales through channel partners; OEM indicates original equipment manufacturer accounts; hybrid indicates mixed channel coverage.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Distribution Channel; Salesforce CRM - Channel Type

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission rate (expressed as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.0350 = 3.50%) applicable to the sales representative for sales generated within this territory assignment. Used for incentive compensation calculation and financial accruals.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Commission Management; SOX - Compensation Reporting; FASB - Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary country covered by this territory assignment. Used for regulatory compliance reporting (REACH, TSCA, EPA), tax jurisdiction determination, and international sales analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 - Country Codes; REACH - Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals; TSCA - Toxic Substances Control Act

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Indicates the geographic or organizational breadth of the territory assignment. Supports hierarchical territory reporting and sales performance aggregation across the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Territory Hierarchy; SAP SD - Sales Organization

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this territory assignment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements for the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls; ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems; SAP SD - Change Log

attributes.name: crm_assignment_code
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM system identifier for this territory assignment record. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the Salesforce CRM territory model and the SAP SD sales organization structure.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code associated with this territory assignment (e.g., direct sales, distributor, OEM). Determines pricing conditions and order processing rules for chemical product sales in the territory.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: SAP SD division code representing the product division (e.g., specialty chemicals, performance materials, agrochemicals) covered by this territory assignment. Supports product-line-level sales reporting.

attributes.name: effective_fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter within the effective fiscal year for which this territory assignment and associated quota are applicable. Supports quarterly sales performance reporting and commission accrual calculations.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Fiscal Period; FASB - Quarterly Reporting; SOX - Revenue Controls

attributes.name: effective_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this territory assignment is active and quota-bearing. Aligns territory assignments with annual sales planning cycles, budget periods, and financial reporting requirements under SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Fiscal Year; FASB - Financial Reporting; SOX - Revenue Controls

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sales representative's responsibility for the territory ends. Null indicates an open-ended assignment with no planned termination. Used for historical tracking and commission cutoff.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Territory Validity End; Salesforce CRM - Territory Assignment End Date

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or sub-region covered by this territory assignment (e.g., Northeast US, EMEA, APAC). Supports regional sales reporting, territory planning, and logistics coordination for chemical product distribution.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales District; Salesforce CRM - Territory Geography

attributes.name: industry_segment_focus
attributes.description: The target end-market industry segment (e.g., automotive, construction, electronics, consumer goods, agriculture) that this territory assignment is focused on. Supports vertical market analytics and customer acquisition strategy for chemical product sales.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Industry; SAP SD - Customer Classification

attributes.name: is_commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sales representative is eligible to earn commission on sales generated within this territory assignment. Backup and overlay roles may have different commission eligibility rules in chemical sales organizations.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO - Commission Eligibility; SOX - Compensation Controls

attributes.name: is_primary_assignment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary territory assignment for the sales representative. A representative may have multiple territory assignments; this flag identifies the principal one for reporting and commission attribution purposes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Primary Territory; SAP SD - Territory Management

attributes.name: is_quota_bearing
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal sales quota is assigned to this territory assignment. Overlay and backup roles may not carry independent quotas. Drives quota attainment reporting and KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Quota Assignment; SAP SD - Sales Quota

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context about the territory assignment, such as special coverage arrangements, transition instructions, or customer-specific handling notes relevant to chemical product sales.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Territory Notes; Salesforce CRM - Territory Assignment Notes

attributes.name: product_line_focus
attributes.description: Describes the specific chemical product line or portfolio segment (e.g., specialty polymers, performance coatings, agrochemicals, industrial solvents) that the sales representative is primarily responsible for within this territory. Supports product-line-level sales analytics and technical sales alignment.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Material Group; Salesforce CRM - Product Family

attributes.name: quota_amount
attributes.description: The revenue quota assigned to the sales representative for this territory during the assignment period, expressed in the functional currency. Used for sales performance measurement, KPI reporting, and incentive compensation calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales Quota; Salesforce CRM - Quota Management; SOX - Revenue Reporting

attributes.name: quota_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the quota amount assigned to this territory (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency chemical sales organizations operating across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes; SAP FI/CO - Currency Configuration

attributes.name: quota_period_type
attributes.description: Defines the measurement period for the territory quota. Determines how quota attainment is calculated and reported for commission and incentive compensation purposes in the chemical sales organization.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales Quota Period; Salesforce CRM - Quota Period

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Defines the nature of the sales representative's responsibility for the territory. Primary indicates full ownership; backup covers absence; overlay provides specialist support (e.g., technical sales for specialty chemicals); interim covers temporary gaps; co-primary indicates shared ownership.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Territory Role; SAP SD - Sales Territory

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: SAP SD Sales Organization code under which this territory assignment is managed. Defines the legal entity and pricing/distribution rules applicable to the territory in the chemical manufacturing enterprise.

attributes.name: sap_sd_assignment_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Assignment ID
attributes.description: The SAP SD system identifier for the territory assignment record. Supports cross-system data lineage, reconciliation, and integration between Salesforce CRM and SAP SD for territory management in the chemical manufacturing enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Sales Territory; SAP S/4HANA Integration

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sales representative's responsibility for the territory becomes effective. Used for commission calculation, quota proration, and historical territory ownership tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SD - Territory Validity Start; Salesforce CRM - Territory Assignment Start Date

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 state or province code for the primary sub-national jurisdiction covered by this territory assignment. Supports state-level sales reporting, tax compliance, and EPA/OSHA regulatory jurisdiction tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 - Subdivision Codes; EPA - Environmental Reporting; OSHA - Workplace Safety

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the territory assignment was ended. Supports workforce analytics, territory planning, and historical audit of sales coverage changes in the chemical manufacturing sales organization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resignation|reassignment|restructuring|performance|retirement|transfer|contract_end — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: SAP SD - Territory Management; Salesforce CRM - Territory Assignment History

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this territory assignment record was last modified. Tracks changes to assignment status, role type, quota, or coverage scope for audit and data governance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls; ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems; SAP SD - Change Log

products.name: target
products.description: Annual or periodic revenue and volume targets assigned to sales territories, product lines, or individual sales representatives. Captures target value (revenue in USD, volume in MT/kg), product category scope, period granularity (year/quarter/month), attainment tracking (actual vs. target with variance), and stretch/floor thresholds. Supports sales performance management, incentive compensation calculations, and management reporting for chemical sales teams.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Quota / SAP CO Sales Planning

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Primary key for target

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Chemical Mfg business unit or division responsible for this target (e.g., Agrochemicals Division, Specialty Chemicals BU, Performance Materials). Aligns with SAP FI/CO profit center hierarchy for management reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual sales representative to whom this target is assigned. Populated when assignment_level is 'sales_rep'. Links to the workforce/employee master for incentive compensation calculations. Sourced from SAP HCM / Salesforce CRM user records.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product line or product family covered by this target (e.g., Specialty Polymers, Agrochemicals, Performance Coatings). Populated when assignment_level is 'product_line' or when the target is scoped to a specific product category. Sourced from SAP MM material group hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: incentive_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the incentive compensation plan under which this target is tracked. Links the sales target to the specific commission or bonus plan structure, enabling calculation of payouts based on attainment levels (floor, target, stretch). Sourced from HR/compensation management system.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory to which this target is assigned. Populated when assignment_level is 'territory'. Territories in chemical manufacturing are typically defined by geography (e.g., North America, EMEA) and customer segment. Sourced from Salesforce CRM territory management.

attributes.name: actual_revenue_usd
attributes.description: The actual realized revenue in USD for the target period, sourced from SAP SD billing documents and FI/CO revenue postings. Used to calculate revenue attainment variance against the target. Updated periodically via ERP integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; SAP S/4HANA SD; FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: actual_volume_mt
attributes.description: The actual sales volume in metric tons (MT) realized during the target period, sourced from SAP SD delivery and billing records. Used to calculate volume attainment variance against the volume target.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this sales target was formally approved by the designated manager or business unit leader. Required for SOX compliance documentation and incentive compensation plan administration.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the sales manager or business unit leader who formally approved this target. Required for SOX compliance and incentive compensation audit trails. Sourced from Salesforce CRM approval workflow.
attributes.references: SOX; Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: assignment_level
attributes.description: The organizational or commercial dimension at which this target is assigned. Sales_rep targets are individual; territory targets cover a geographic sales zone; product_line targets cover a chemical product family; business_unit targets cover a division (e.g., Agrochemicals, Specialty Chemicals); channel targets cover distributor or direct sales channels.

attributes.name: baseline_year
attributes.description: The prior fiscal year used as the baseline reference for target-setting calculations (e.g., prior year actuals used to derive growth targets). Supports year-over-year growth analysis and target justification documentation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country-level scope of this target (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). Used for country-specific sales performance reporting and regulatory compliance tracking under REACH, TSCA, and EPA requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; SAP S/4HANA SD; REACH; TSCA; EPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this sales target record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and data lineage tracking in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary target values in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency chemical sales operations across global territories. Aligns with SAP FI/CO currency configuration.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal posting period number (1–12) to which this target applies. Populated only when period_granularity is 'monthly'. Aligns with SAP FI/CO posting period numbers for monthly attainment reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter to which this target applies (Q1–Q4). Populated only when period_granularity is 'quarterly'. Null for annual or monthly targets. Supports quarterly sales performance reviews and incentive compensation calculations.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this sales target applies, expressed as a four-digit integer (e.g., 2025). Aligns with Chemical Mfg's SAP FI/CO fiscal year calendar for financial reporting and EBITDA planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 280; SOX

attributes.name: floor_revenue_usd
attributes.description: The minimum revenue threshold (floor) below which no incentive compensation is earned. Typically 70–80% of the base target. Used in incentive compensation calculations to define the minimum attainment level required for commission eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic sales region to which this target applies (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC, LATAM). Aligns with SAP SD sales organization regional hierarchy and Salesforce CRM territory management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: north_america|emea|apac|latam|mea|greater_china — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: growth_rate_pct
attributes.description: The planned year-over-year or period-over-period growth rate embedded in this target, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 = 8.00% growth). Derived from strategic planning assumptions and used to validate target reasonableness in management reviews.

attributes.name: last_revised_date
attributes.description: The date on which this target was most recently revised or adjusted. Mid-year target revisions may occur due to market conditions, M&A activity, or force majeure events. Supports audit trail for target change management.
attributes.references: SOX; Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: margin_pct
attributes.description: The planned gross margin percentage target for the period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3250 = 32.50%). Used for profitability management and incentive compensation plans that include margin-based components. Populated when target_type is 'margin'.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: The end-use market or industry segment targeted by this sales target (e.g., Automotive, Construction, Electronics, Agriculture, Consumer Goods, Pharma). Supports market-level performance analysis and strategic planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|construction|electronics|agriculture|consumer_goods|pharma|coatings|packaging — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; ACC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, or qualifications associated with this sales target. May include notes on market conditions, excluded accounts, special pricing agreements, or target-setting assumptions documented by the sales manager.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the target measurement period ends. For annual targets this is typically December 31 or the fiscal year end date. Aligns with SAP FI/CO posting period close dates.

attributes.name: period_granularity
attributes.description: The time granularity at which this target is set and tracked. Annual targets cover a full fiscal year; quarterly targets align to SAP posting periods Q1–Q4; monthly targets align to individual SAP posting periods for detailed attainment tracking.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the target measurement period begins. For annual targets this is typically January 1 or the fiscal year start date. Aligns with SAP FI/CO posting period open dates.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The chemical product category or market segment covered by this target (e.g., Specialty Chemicals, Agrochemicals, Performance Polymers, Industrial Chemicals, Coatings & Adhesives). Sourced from SAP MM material group classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: specialty_chemicals|agrochemicals|performance_polymers|industrial_chemicals|coatings_adhesives|plastics|solvents|catalysts — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; ACC Responsible Care; TSCA

attributes.name: revenue_attainment_pct
attributes.description: The ratio of actual revenue to target revenue for the period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9250 = 92.50% attainment). Calculated as actual_revenue_usd / target_revenue_usd. Used for sales performance management, KPI dashboards, and incentive compensation calculations. NOTE: This is a stored attainment snapshot, not a real-time computed metric, to support point-in-time reporting and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Salesforce CRM; SOX

attributes.name: revenue_usd
attributes.description: The planned revenue target value denominated in US Dollars (USD) for the defined period. Represents the gross revenue goal before deductions. Used for EBITDA planning, COGS analysis, and sales performance management. Populated when target_type is 'revenue' or 'margin'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for the most recent revision to this target. Market_conditions covers demand shifts; portfolio_change covers product additions/removals; territory_realignment covers sales org restructuring; acquisition covers M&A impacts; force_majeure covers unforeseeable events; correction covers data entry errors.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The commercial channel through which sales against this target are expected to be realized. Direct indicates sales to end-use customers; distributor covers third-party distribution partners; OEM covers original equipment manufacturer accounts; ecommerce covers digital order channels; agent covers commissioned sales agents.

attributes.name: setting_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to establish this sales target. Top_down targets are allocated from corporate/BU level; bottom_up targets are built from rep-level forecasts; negotiated targets result from manager-rep agreement; statistical targets are derived from historical trend analysis and SPC methods.

attributes.name: stretch_revenue_usd
attributes.description: The aspirational upper-bound revenue target (stretch goal) in USD, set above the base target to incentivize overperformance. Typically 110–120% of the base target. Used in incentive compensation plans to calculate accelerated commission rates for above-target performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the sales target record, used in management reporting, incentive compensation plans, and cross-system references between SAP SD and Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the sales target, such as 'FY2025 Q1 Specialty Chemicals - North America' or 'Annual Volume Target - Agrochemicals - Rep Smith'. Used in dashboards and management reports.

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sales target record. Draft targets are under review; active targets are in-period and being tracked; approved targets have passed management sign-off; closed targets have reached period end; cancelled targets were withdrawn before period start.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; SOX

attributes.name: target_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sales target by the primary metric being tracked. Revenue targets are denominated in USD; volume targets in MT or kg; margin targets as gross margin percentage; new_business for new customer acquisition; account_growth for existing account expansion.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care; SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this sales target record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on any change to target values, status, or attainment data. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline.

attributes.name: volume_attainment_pct
attributes.description: The ratio of actual volume to target volume for the period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0500 = 105.00% attainment). Calculated as actual_volume_mt / target_volume_mt. Used for supply chain planning alignment and sales volume KPI reporting.

attributes.name: volume_mt
attributes.description: The planned sales volume target expressed in metric tons (MT). Used for chemical manufacturing capacity planning, raw material procurement forecasting, and supply chain management. Populated when target_type is 'volume'. Aligns with SAP SD delivery quantity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; SAP S/4HANA PP; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the volume target. MT (metric tons) is standard for bulk chemicals; KG for specialty/fine chemicals; L (liters) for liquid products; GAL (gallons) for US market; LB (pounds) for certain North American contracts. Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure.

products.name: distributor
products.description: Master record for authorized chemical distributors and channel partners, including the governing distribution agreement terms. Captures distributor identity, tier classification, geographic coverage, credit limit, and compliance certifications (REACH, TSCA, responsible distribution, SDS distribution obligations). Embeds agreement details: type (exclusive/non-exclusive), authorized product categories, territory scope, MOQ, minimum purchase commitments, rebate structure, compliance obligations, and agreement validity period. SSOT for channel partner identity, commercial relationship, and contractual terms within the sales domain.
products.reference: SAP SD Partner Function / Salesforce CRM Account (Partner)

attributes.name: distributor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the authorized chemical distributor or channel partner record. Primary key for the distributor master in the sales domain.

attributes.name: sales_rep_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Each distributor is managed by a specific sales rep; linking enables distributor performance dashboards per employee.

attributes.name: salesforce_account_id
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM Account record identifier for this distributor. Enables cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer distributor master and the Salesforce CRM system of record for opportunity and activity management.

attributes.name: agreement_effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the distribution agreement becomes legally binding and commercially effective. Marks the start of authorized distribution rights and contractual obligations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Contract Start Date; FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: agreement_expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the distribution agreement expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null indicates an open-ended agreement. Used for renewal tracking and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Contract End Date; FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number of the governing distribution agreement document. Used for contract management, audit trails, and legal reference. Prefixed 'DA-' per internal convention.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Sales Contract; SOX

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution agreement governing the commercial relationship. Exclusive grants sole territorial rights; Non-exclusive allows multiple distributors; Preferred grants priority pricing; Consignment transfers risk only upon sale.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Contract Type; SOX; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: annual_purchase_commitment
attributes.description: Contractually agreed minimum annual purchase value (in agreement currency) that the distributor commits to purchasing from Chemical Mfg. Used for rebate tier qualification and agreement compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Rebate Agreement; FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: authorized_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories or chemical product lines that the distributor is contractually authorized to sell under the distribution agreement (e.g., 'Specialty Solvents,Performance Coatings,Agricultural Intermediates'). Enforced during order processing in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Material Authorization; TSCA; REACH

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution agreement automatically renews upon expiry unless explicitly terminated. True = auto-renews; False = requires affirmative renewal action.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Contract Renewal Rule

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Earliest expiry date among the distributor's active compliance certifications (e.g., ISO 9001, Responsible Distribution, REACH). Used to trigger recertification workflows and flag distributors with lapsing credentials.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; ACC Responsible Care; ECHA REACH

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Indicates the go-to-market channel through which the distributor operates. Direct channels involve direct resale; indirect may involve additional intermediaries; hybrid combines both models.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the distributor's primary registered business address. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination (REACH, TSCA, EPA) and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) recording when the distributor master record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: credit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit and financial terms are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the agreement currency for consistent financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance (in agreement currency) extended to the distributor by Chemical Mfg. Enforced in SAP SD credit management to block orders exceeding the limit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Credit Management; FASB ASC 310; SOX

attributes.name: distributor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the distributor in SAP SD / Salesforce CRM. Used on purchase orders, invoices, and channel communications as the canonical reference code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Account Group

attributes.name: distributor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the distributor master record. Active = approved and trading; Suspended = temporarily blocked (e.g., compliance hold); Pending Approval = onboarding in progress; Terminated = agreement ended.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Account Block; Salesforce CRM - Account Status

attributes.name: distributor_tier
attributes.description: Commercial tier classification of the distributor based on sales volume, strategic importance, and service level. Drives rebate eligibility, pricing tiers, and support resource allocation. Tier 1 = highest volume/strategic; Tier 3 = emerging/low volume.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care; Salesforce CRM - Account Rating

attributes.name: distributor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distributor relationship type. Exclusive distributors hold sole rights in a territory; master distributors may appoint sub-distributors; agents act on behalf without taking title to goods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Partner Function; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number uniquely identifying the distributor's legal entity globally. Used for credit risk assessment, supplier qualification, and third-party data enrichment.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM - Vendor Master

attributes.name: ghs_classification_acknowledged
attributes.business_glossary_term: Globally Harmonized System (GHS) Classification Acknowledgement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor has formally acknowledged receipt and understanding of GHS hazard classification and labelling requirements for all authorized product categories. Required for EHS compliance onboarding.
attributes.references: GHS (UN Rev. 9); OSHA HazCom 2012; ECHA CLP Regulation

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the agreed delivery and risk transfer point for shipments to the distributor. Governs freight responsibility, insurance obligations, and customs clearance duties. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD - Incoterms; DOT; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor holds a current ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Used as a quality assurance criterion in distributor qualification and tier classification.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) recording when the distributor master record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture, incremental loads, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the distributor entity as recorded in the distribution agreement and government business registry. Used for contract execution, invoicing, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Customer Master; TSCA; REACH

attributes.name: moq_kg
attributes.description: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) in kilograms that the distributor must place per order under the distribution agreement. Enforced in SAP SD order entry to ensure commercial viability of each transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Minimum Order Quantity; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the distributor completed the formal onboarding process and was approved as an authorized channel partner. Marks the start of the commercial relationship lifecycle.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Created Date; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key defining the agreed payment schedule for the distributor (e.g., 'NT30' = Net 30 days, 'Z001' = 2/10 Net 30). Governs invoice due dates and early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Payment Terms; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the distributor's key account contact. Used for order confirmations, SDS/COA distribution, regulatory notifications, and commercial communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM - Contact Email

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the distributor organization responsible for managing the commercial relationship with Chemical Mfg.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Contact Name; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary business telephone number for the distributor's key account contact. Used for urgent order management, compliance escalations, and technical sales support.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM - Contact Phone

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) REACH registration number confirming the distributor's compliance with Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006. Required for distributors operating in EU/EEA markets.

attributes.name: rebate_structure_code
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the rebate or volume incentive program applicable to this distributor as defined in the SAP SD rebate agreement. Determines the rebate calculation method, thresholds, and payout schedule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Rebate Agreement (BO01/BO02); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to agreement expiry by which either party must provide written notice of non-renewal or termination. Contractually mandated and used to trigger renewal workflow alerts.

attributes.name: responsible_distribution_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor holds current certification under the National Association of Chemical Distributors (NACD) Responsible Distribution program, demonstrating commitment to EHS, security, and product stewardship standards.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care; NACD Responsible Distribution; ISO 45001

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD customer master number assigned to the distributor. Used for order-to-cash processing, credit management, and financial reconciliation between the lakehouse and SAP ERP.

attributes.name: sds_distribution_obligation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Distribution Obligation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor is contractually and regulatory obligated to distribute Safety Data Sheets (SDS) to downstream customers per GHS/OSHA HazCom 2012 requirements. True = obligated; False = exempt (e.g., agent not taking title).
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200); GHS; REACH Article 31

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Government-issued Tax Identification Number (TIN) or VAT registration number of the distributor legal entity. Required for invoicing, customs documentation, and tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - Tax Number; SOX; FASB; EPA TRI

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the distribution agreement was formally terminated or the distributor relationship was ended. Null if the relationship is active or the agreement has not been terminated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Contract End Date; SOX

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic territory or market scope authorized under the distribution agreement, expressed as country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), regions, or named market segments (e.g., 'USA,CAN,MEX' or 'EMEA-Industrial'). Defines the boundaries of authorized distribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Sales Territory; REACH; TSCA

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Operating or 'doing business as' (DBA) trade name of the distributor, which may differ from the legal entity name. Used in commercial communications and sales reporting.

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor has confirmed compliance with the Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) requirements for chemical distribution in the United States. True = confirmed compliant; False = non-compliant or unconfirmed.

products.name: distributor_agreement
products.description: Formal distribution agreement governing the commercial relationship between Chemical Mfg and an authorized distributor. Captures agreement type (exclusive, non-exclusive), authorized product categories, territory scope, minimum purchase commitments (MOQ), rebate structure, compliance obligations (SDS distribution, REACH downstream user reporting), and agreement validity period.

attributes.name: distributor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the distributor agreement record in the Chemical Mfg lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Distributor agreement costs are allocated to a specific cost center for budgeting and rebate accounting.

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM opportunity or contract record identifier that originated or is linked to this distributor agreement. Enables traceability from sales pipeline to executed agreement.

attributes.name: distributor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authorized distributor (customer/business partner) who is party to this agreement. Links to the distributor master record in the customer domain.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Chemical Mfg sales account manager (employee) responsible for managing the commercial relationship with this distributor under this agreement. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account ownership.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Owner; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Representative

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Distribution agreements authorize a distributor to sell particular chemicals; need FK to material_master to enforce product scope and compliance.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contracted price list or pricing agreement applicable to this distributor. Governs the base pricing for all orders placed under this agreement in SAP SD condition records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Pricing Condition (VK11); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: sales_organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Chemical Mfg sales organization responsible for managing and executing this distributor agreement, as defined in SAP SD organizational structure.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable agreement reference number assigned by SAP SD (Sales and Distribution) at contract creation. Used in all correspondence, purchase orders (POs), and regulatory submissions with the distributor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Contract Number

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the distributor agreement. Draft: under negotiation; Active: fully executed and binding; Suspended: temporarily halted (e.g., compliance breach); Terminated: ended before natural expiry; Expired: reached end date without renewal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Status; ISO 9001 Contract Review

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution arrangement: exclusive (sole distributor in territory), non_exclusive (multiple distributors permitted), master (umbrella agreement with sub-agreements), sub (child of a master agreement), or trial (limited-term evaluation agreement).
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care Program; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Category

attributes.name: agreement_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the distributor agreement, incremented each time the agreement is formally amended (e.g., price renegotiation, territory expansion, MOQ revision). Version 1 is the original executed agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Amendment; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal amendment to this distributor agreement. Null if no amendments have been made since original execution. Used with agreement_version for change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: amendment_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the most recent amendment to this distributor agreement, summarizing the key changes made (e.g., 'Territory expanded to include CAN; MOQ increased to USD 500,000'). Supports audit trail and Management of Change (MOC) documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ISO 9001 Document Control; SOX

attributes.name: authorized_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Chemical Mfg product category codes or names that the distributor is authorized to sell under this agreement (e.g., 'Performance Coatings, Agricultural Chemicals, Specialty Polymers'). Governs which SKUs can be ordered against this agreement in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Material Group; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distributor agreement automatically renews upon expiry unless either party provides written notice of termination within the notice period. Drives renewal workflow automation in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must accompany each product shipment to the distributor under this agreement, confirming that the batch meets specification. Supports GMP and ISO 9001 quality documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice); LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distributor agreement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Populated at insert time and never updated. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 9001 Record Control; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable credit extended to the distributor under this agreement, denominated in USD. Enforced in SAP SD credit management (FD32) to control financial exposure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Credit Management (FD32); FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all financial terms of this agreement (MOQ, rebates, pricing) are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency reporting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Currency Configuration; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving disputes arising under this distributor agreement: arbitration (binding third-party arbitration), litigation (court proceedings), mediation (non-binding third-party mediation), or negotiation (direct party negotiation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Terms; SOX

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the distributor agreement becomes legally binding and commercially operative. Aligns with SAP SD contract validity start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Validity Start; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: ehs_training_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Training Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether distributor personnel are required to complete Chemical Mfg-mandated EHS (Environment Health and Safety) training on product handling, storage, and emergency response as a condition of this agreement.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; Intelex EHS Management; ISO 45001

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of exclusivity granted to the distributor within the authorized territory: full_portfolio (all Chemical Mfg products), product_category (specific product categories only), single_product (one product or SKU), or none (non-exclusive arrangement).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Terms; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the distributor agreement naturally expires. Nullable for open-ended evergreen agreements. Used to trigger renewal workflows and compliance reviews.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contract Validity End; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of this distributor agreement (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR). Critical for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; SOX; REACH (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between Chemical Mfg and the distributor for shipments under this agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD — Incoterms; DOT Hazardous Materials Transport

attributes.name: moq_annual_usd
attributes.description: Minimum annual purchase commitment in US dollars that the distributor must achieve to maintain agreement terms and qualify for contracted pricing and rebates. Failure to meet MOQ may trigger agreement renegotiation or termination. Aligns with SAP SD minimum order value configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Minimum Order Value; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP SD payment terms key (e.g., 'NT30', 'NT60', '2/10NT30') governing invoice due dates and early payment discount conditions for orders placed under this agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Payment Terms (ZTERM); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: product_application_support
attributes.description: Indicates whether Chemical Mfg provides technical sales and product application guidance support to the distributor under this agreement, including customer-specific formulation assistance and technical documentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Technical Sales; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: reach_downstream_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor must fulfill REACH downstream user reporting obligations, including use notifications and exposure scenario communication, as required under ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Title V.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 — Title V Downstream Users; ECHA Guidance on Downstream Users

attributes.name: rebate_rate_pct
attributes.description: Base rebate percentage (0.00–100.00) applied to eligible purchases under this agreement. For volume_tiered structures, this represents the base tier rate; tier thresholds are managed in the rebate schedule. Stored in SAP SD rebate agreement condition records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Rebate Condition Rate; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: rebate_structure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate mechanism applicable to this distributor agreement: volume_tiered (rebate percentage increases with purchase volume tiers), flat_rate (fixed percentage on all purchases), growth_incentive (rebate tied to year-over-year growth targets), or none (no rebate applicable).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Rebate Agreement (BO); FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date by which a renewal decision must be made or the agreement auto-renews. Drives CRM (Salesforce) renewal opportunity creation and account manager notifications.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Management; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to expiry_date by which either party must provide written notice of non-renewal or termination. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days as negotiated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: responsible_care_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor is contractually required to adhere to the ACC (American Chemistry Council) Responsible Care program standards as a condition of this distribution agreement.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care Program; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: sap_contract_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD contract document number (transaction VA41/VA42) corresponding to this distributor agreement. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the CRM pipeline and ERP order management.

attributes.name: sds_distribution_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distributor is contractually obligated to distribute Safety Data Sheets (SDS) to downstream customers for all chemical products sold under this agreement. Mandatory under GHS, REACH, and OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200).
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200); ECHA REACH Article 31

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date on which both parties executed (signed) the distributor agreement. May differ from effective_date when agreements are backdated or post-dated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the agreement was terminated early (before natural expiry). Null if the agreement has not been terminated. Distinct from expiry_date which represents the scheduled end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Status; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for early termination of the distributor agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mutual_agreement|breach_of_contract|moq_failure|compliance_violation|business_exit|acquisition|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Intelex EHS Management (compliance_violation); ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: territory_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the primary country of the authorized distribution territory. Used for REACH downstream user reporting and EPA/TSCA jurisdictional compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope within which the distributor is authorized to sell Chemical Mfg products under this agreement. May be expressed as country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), regions, or named sales territories (e.g., 'USA,CAN,MEX' or 'EMEA-West'). Supports territory management analytics in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; REACH Downstream User Reporting (ECHA)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this distributor agreement record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every modification. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Databricks Delta Lake CDC; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

products.name: technical_inquiry
products.description: Customer or prospect technical inquiry capturing requests for product application guidance, formulation recommendations, regulatory documentation (SDS, COA, REACH dossier), or compatibility assessments. Tracks inquiry type, product of interest, application end-use, response status, and assigned technical sales engineer. Supports pre-sales application engineering and technical differentiation in chemical sales.

attributes.name: technical_inquiry_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each technical inquiry record in the chemical sales domain. Serves as the primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP SD / Salesforce CRM internal object identifier

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or prospect organization that submitted the technical inquiry. Links to the customer master record in SAP SD / Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product or material of interest that is the subject of the technical inquiry. Links to the product/material master in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master; SAP SD Product Catalog

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual contact person at the customer or prospect organization who submitted the technical inquiry. Links to the contact master in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technical sales engineer or application engineer assigned to handle and respond to this inquiry. Links to the workforce/employee master.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Representative; Salesforce CRM User

attributes.name: formula_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula. Business justification: Technical inquiries often concern a particular custom formulation; linking enables engineers to retrieve formulation details quickly.

attributes.name: linked_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity in Salesforce CRM that this technical inquiry is associated with. Enables pipeline attribution and conversion tracking from technical inquiry to commercial opportunity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; SAP SD Sales Quotation

attributes.name: linked_quote_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales quotation generated as a result of or in conjunction with this technical inquiry. Supports pre-sales to commercial conversion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SD Quotation Document; Salesforce CRM Quote Object

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_specification. Business justification: Technical inquiries verify product suitability against the official quality specification before providing technical advice.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Technical inquiries that require deeper study are assigned to an R&D project; the FK supports inquiry‑to‑project assignment reports.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory associated with this technical inquiry, used for territory management, workload distribution, and performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Area; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Links shipments generated to resolve technical inquiries, allowing analysis of inquiry-to-shipment lead times and cost attribution.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Technical inquiries are tied to the plant/site where the issue occurs, needed for safety and product formulation support.

attributes.name: application_end_use
attributes.description: Description of the customer's intended end-use application for the chemical product (e.g., automotive coating, adhesive formulation, agricultural spray, electronic encapsulant). Critical for application engineering and product recommendation accuracy.
attributes.references: REACH Article 7 End-Use Declaration; ECHA Substance Information Exchange Forum (SIEF)

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the technical inquiry was formally closed, either by customer confirmation of resolution or by the sales engineer marking it complete. Used for cycle time analytics. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Closed Date; ISO 9001 Nonconformance Resolution Tracking

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the competitor whose product was referenced in the inquiry, when competitor_product_mentioned is True. Classified as confidential business intelligence. Used for competitive analysis and win/loss reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitor Object; SOX Section 302 Competitive Disclosure Controls

attributes.name: competitor_product_mentioned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer referenced a competitor's product in the inquiry, signaling a competitive displacement or conversion opportunity. Used for competitive intelligence and sales strategy analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitive Intelligence; ACC Responsible Care Market Engagement

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the customer's location relevant to this inquiry. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination (REACH for EU, TSCA for US, etc.) and territory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 Country Codes; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Jurisdiction; TSCA US Jurisdiction

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this technical inquiry record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit trail creation timestamp for data governance and lineage purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Records Management; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: crm_case_number
attributes.description: External case number assigned by Salesforce CRM for this technical inquiry. Used for cross-system traceability between the data lakehouse silver layer and the operational CRM system.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Object; SAP SD-CRM Integration

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Customer-provided satisfaction rating for the technical inquiry response, on a scale of 1 (very dissatisfied) to 5 (very satisfied). Collected via post-inquiry survey. Used for technical service quality KPI reporting per ISO 9001 customer satisfaction requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction; ACC Responsible Care Customer Feedback

attributes.name: end_use_industry
attributes.description: Industry segment of the customer's end-use application. Used for market segmentation, product positioning, and regulatory compliance scoping (e.g., food-contact FDA requirements, pharmaceutical API standards). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|construction|electronics|agriculture|consumer_goods|coatings|adhesives|pharmaceuticals|food_contact|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: REACH End-Use Sector Classification; FDA 21 CFR (food-contact); ISO 9001 Customer Focus

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this technical inquiry has been escalated to a senior technical expert, R&D team, or management due to complexity, urgency, or customer dissatisfaction. Triggers escalation workflow in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Escalation Rules; ISO 9001 Nonconformance and CAPA Process

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for escalating the technical inquiry beyond the initially assigned sales engineer. Applicable when escalation_flag is True. Values: complexity, regulatory_urgency, key_account, customer_dissatisfaction, rd_involvement, none.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Escalation Reason; ISO 9001 CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) Process

attributes.name: first_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the first substantive technical response was delivered to the customer. Used to measure first-response SLA compliance and technical service performance KPIs. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM First Response Time; ISO 9001 Customer Satisfaction Measurement

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_class_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Globally Harmonized System (GHS) Hazard Classification Relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inquiry involves a substance with GHS hazard classification considerations, triggering mandatory SDS provision and GHS-compliant labeling guidance in the response.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals); OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200)

attributes.name: inquiry_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the customer's technical question, application challenge, or documentation request. Captures the detailed context needed for the technical sales engineer to formulate a response.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Description; SAP SD Inquiry Text

attributes.name: inquiry_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the technical inquiry. Used in customer communications, email correspondence, and cross-system tracking. Format: TI-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP SD Inquiry Document; Salesforce CRM Case Number

attributes.name: inquiry_source
attributes.description: Channel or origin through which the technical inquiry was received. Used for channel analytics and resource allocation. Values: email, web_portal, phone, trade_show, distributor, direct_sales.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Source; ACC Responsible Care Customer Engagement

attributes.name: inquiry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the technical inquiry workflow. Tracks progression from initial receipt through technical review, customer follow-up, response delivery, and closure. Values: new, in_review, pending_customer, responded, closed, cancelled.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Status; SAP SD Inquiry Status

attributes.name: inquiry_subject
attributes.description: Brief subject line or title summarizing the technical inquiry, as provided by the customer or entered by the sales engineer. Used for quick identification and search.

attributes.name: inquiry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the technical inquiry. Drives routing, SLA assignment, and response workflow. Values include product application guidance, formulation recommendation, regulatory documentation (SDS/COA/REACH dossier), compatibility assessment, technical specification request, and sample request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_application|formulation_recommendation|regulatory_documentation|compatibility_assessment|technical_specification|sample_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Type; ACC Responsible Care Technical Service Guidelines

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the inquiry submission and required response language (e.g., en, de, fr, zh-CN). Used for routing to multilingual technical sales engineers and for SDS/COA document language selection.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; GHS SDS Language Requirements

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the technical inquiry, determining response SLA and resource allocation. Critical inquiries may involve key accounts, regulatory deadlines, or active sales opportunities.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Priority; ACC Responsible Care Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: product_cas_number
attributes.description: CAS Registry Number of the chemical substance of interest in the inquiry. Provides unambiguous chemical identity for regulatory cross-referencing, SDS lookup, and REACH dossier retrieval. Format: XXXXXXX-XX-X per CAS standard.
attributes.references: CAS Registry (Chemical Abstracts Service); TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory; REACH Annex VI

attributes.name: rd_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this technical inquiry has been referred to the R&D team for new compound development, custom formulation feasibility assessment, or advanced application engineering support.
attributes.references: SAP SD / R&D Integration; ACC Responsible Care Product Stewardship

attributes.name: reach_registration_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substance of interest requires REACH registration documentation to be provided to the customer, applicable for EU-destined shipments or EU-based customers under REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA Substance Registration Requirements

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the technical inquiry was officially received and logged in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp used for SLA measurement and response time KPI calculation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Created Date; SAP SD Inquiry Creation Date

attributes.name: recommended_product_grade
attributes.description: Specific product grade or formulation variant recommended by the technical sales engineer in response to the customer's application inquiry. Supports product application engineering and upsell/cross-sell tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Classification; SAP SD Product Catalog Grade

attributes.name: regulatory_doc_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory or compliance document requested by the customer as part of this inquiry. Applicable when inquiry_type is regulatory_documentation. Values: SDS (Safety Data Sheet), COA (Certificate of Analysis), COC (Certificate of Compliance), REACH_dossier, TDS (Technical Data Sheet), none.
attributes.references: GHS/UN Globally Harmonized System (SDS format); REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ISO 9001 QM Documentation

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the technical sales engineer must deliver a response to the customer, based on the assigned SLA for the inquiry type and priority level. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case SLA; ACC Responsible Care Customer Commitment Standards

attributes.name: response_summary
attributes.description: Concise summary of the technical response provided to the customer, capturing key recommendations, product guidance, or regulatory information delivered. Supports knowledge management and future inquiry deflection.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Resolution; ACC Responsible Care Technical Service Documentation

attributes.name: sample_quantity_kg
