attributes.description: Quantity of product sample requested by the customer, expressed in kilograms. Applicable when sample_requested is True. Used for sample fulfillment planning and inventory allocation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sample Order Quantity; SAP MM Unit of Measure

attributes.name: sample_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has requested a product sample as part of or following the technical inquiry. Triggers sample order creation workflow in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sample Management; Salesforce CRM Opportunity Stage

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technical inquiry response was delivered within the agreed SLA timeframe (response_due_date). Derived at record closure and stored for KPI reporting and service quality analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2 Customer Requirements; Salesforce CRM SLA Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inquiry requires TSCA compliance documentation or inventory confirmation for the US market, per EPA TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory requirements.
attributes.references: TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act) 15 U.S.C. §2601; EPA TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this technical inquiry record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Records Management; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

products.name: sample_request
products.description: Record of a product sample request submitted by a customer or prospect for evaluation of a chemical product, formulation, or specialty material. Captures requested product/grade, quantity, application purpose, requested delivery date, sample approval status, and outcome (converted to order, rejected, pending evaluation). Supports new business development and product qualification workflows in technical sales.
products.reference: SAP SD Free-of-Charge Delivery / Salesforce CRM Opportunity

attributes.name: sample_request_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the product sample request record. Primary key for the sample_request data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer or prospect organization submitting the sample request. Links to the customer master record in SAP SD / Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the chemical product or specialty material being requested for sampling, as maintained in the SAP MM material master.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual contact person at the customer or prospect organization who submitted the sample request, as maintained in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the technical sales representative or account manager responsible for managing this sample request, as maintained in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: formula_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to formulation.formula. Business justification: When customers request samples of a custom formulation, the request must reference the exact formula for traceability and batch tracking.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Sample requests are linked to the originating inspection lot to trace sample provenance and ensure compliance.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot. Business justification: Required for traceability: sample requests must reference the exact inventory lot to meet REACH and SDS compliance and enable lot‑level tracking.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated sales opportunity in Salesforce CRM that this sample request supports, enabling pipeline tracking and conversion analysis.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Tracks which shipment delivered a requested sample, supporting sample fulfillment KPI and customer satisfaction reporting.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Sample shipments are sent to a designated Customer Site; linking enables tracking, compliance, and delivery performance.

attributes.name: trial_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.trial_batch. Business justification: Sample requests are fulfilled by a specific trial batch; linking enables traceability from request to batch production and QC.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the sample was physically shipped to the customer from the manufacturing site or warehouse, as recorded in SAP EWM.
attributes.references: SAP EWM Outbound Delivery; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: application_purpose
attributes.description: Description of the intended end-use application or technical purpose for which the customer is evaluating the sample (e.g., adhesive formulation, coating binder, agricultural adjuvant, polymer additive). Critical for technical sales and R&D alignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Product; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sample request was formally approved by the authorized approver (e.g., sales manager, technical sales director) prior to sample preparation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Release Strategy; Salesforce CRM Approval Process

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status indicating whether the sample request has been authorized for fulfillment by the designated approver. Distinct from request_status which tracks the overall lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP SD Release Strategy; Salesforce CRM Approval Process

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual (e.g., sales manager, technical director) who approved the sample request for fulfillment.
attributes.references: SAP SD Release Strategy; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the freight carrier or courier service used to transport the sample to the customer (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL). Recorded for logistics tracking and carrier performance analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management; DOT 49 CFR Hazmat Transport

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: The CAS Registry Number uniquely identifying the chemical substance being sampled, as assigned by the American Chemical Society Chemical Abstracts Service. Required for regulatory compliance (TSCA, REACH) and SDS documentation.
attributes.references: CAS Registry; TSCA Section 8; REACH Article 119; GHS SDS Section 1

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Analysis (COA) to accompany the sample shipment, confirming the product meets specified quality parameters as tested by the QC laboratory.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Section 8.6; LabWare LIMS COA Module; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the sample request record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated_conversion_value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customer_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text feedback provided by the customer following their evaluation of the sample, including performance observations, test results, or reasons for acceptance or rejection. Supports product development and CAPA processes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Notes; ISO 9001 Section 9.1.2 Customer Satisfaction

attributes.name: end_use_industry
attributes.description: The target industry segment in which the customer intends to use the sampled chemical product. Supports market segmentation analytics and new business development reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|construction|electronics|agriculture|consumer_goods|coatings|adhesives|pharmaceuticals|food_contact|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACC Industry Classification; Salesforce CRM Industry Field

attributes.name: estimated_conversion_value
attributes.description: The estimated annual revenue value (in the business's base currency) if the sample evaluation converts to a commercial order. Used for sales pipeline valuation and prioritization of sample requests.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Amount; FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: evaluation_due_date
attributes.description: The agreed-upon date by which the customer is expected to complete their product evaluation and provide feedback or a qualification decision.

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_class
attributes.description: The GHS hazard classification of the sampled chemical (e.g., Flammable Liquid Cat 2, Acute Toxicity Cat 4, Skin Corrosion Cat 1). Required for proper labelling, packaging, and DOT/IATA transport compliance when shipping samples.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9 Chapter 1.3; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; DOT 49 CFR 172; IATA DGR

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The final or current outcome of the customer's product evaluation following receipt of the sample. Tracks conversion to commercial order, rejection, or ongoing qualification status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: converted_to_order|pending_evaluation|rejected_by_customer|no_response|lost_to_competitor|ongoing_qualification — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Stage; ACC Responsible Care Customer Satisfaction

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the sample request, used to schedule sample preparation and shipping resources. Critical priority may indicate a strategic account or time-sensitive qualification.
attributes.references: SAP SD Delivery Priority; Salesforce CRM Priority

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: The specific grade, specification tier, or variant of the chemical product being sampled (e.g., technical grade, reagent grade, food-contact grade, pharmaceutical grade). Aligns with the SAP MM material classification.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Classification; ISO 9001 Product Specification

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the requested sample quantity (e.g., kg, g, L, mL). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure for the material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|L|mL|lb|oz|MT|gal — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-4 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: reach_registered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical substance in the sample is registered under the EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation, required for shipment to EU customers.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA Registration Database

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided when a sample request is rejected (internally) or when the customer rejects the sample after evaluation. Supports CAPA and product improvement processes.
attributes.references: SAP QM Defect Reason; Salesforce CRM Close Reason

attributes.name: request_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the sample request was submitted (e.g., web portal, email, direct sales representative, distributor, trade show). Supports channel effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the customer or prospect formally submitted the sample request. This is the principal real-world event date for the transaction.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the sample request, used in customer communications, shipping documents, and SAP SD order references. Format: SR-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sample request workflow, from initial submission through evaluation outcome. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending_approval|approved|in_preparation|shipped|under_evaluation|converted_to_order|rejected|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order Status; Salesforce CRM Opportunity Stage

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sample request by business purpose: new product evaluation, reformulation support, competitive product replacement, regulatory qualification, or customer-specific specification development.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Type; SAP SD Sales Document Type

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer requires the sample to be delivered for their evaluation or qualification testing program.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of sample material requested by the customer for evaluation purposes, expressed in the unit of measure specified in quantity_uom.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order Quantity; ISO 9001

attributes.name: sds_version
attributes.description: The version number of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) applicable to the sampled chemical product at the time of the request. Ensures the correct GHS-compliant SDS is dispatched with the sample per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Annex II; DOT 49 CFR 172

attributes.name: shipping_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the delivery destination of the sample shipment. Required for logistics planning in Oracle Transportation Management and SAP EWM outbound delivery.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management; SAP EWM Outbound Delivery; DOT 49 CFR 172

attributes.name: shipping_city
attributes.description: City of the sample shipment delivery destination.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management; SAP EWM Outbound Delivery

attributes.name: shipping_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the sample shipment destination. Drives export compliance checks (REACH, TSCA, export control regulations) and freight routing in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; DOT 49 CFR; ECHA REACH; EPA TSCA

attributes.name: technical_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing technical guidance, application recommendations, formulation notes, or special handling instructions provided by the technical sales team or R&D to support the customer's evaluation of the sample.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Notes; SAP SD Text Management

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the sample shipment, enabling real-time delivery status monitoring and proof of delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: Oracle Transportation Management; DOT 49 CFR Hazmat Shipping

attributes.name: tsca_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical substance in the sample is listed on the TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory and compliant with applicable TSCA requirements for US commercial distribution.
attributes.references: TSCA Section 5 and 8; EPA TSCA Inventory

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the sample request record was most recently modified, supporting change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

products.name: sales_rebate_agreement
products.description: Volume-based or performance-based rebate agreement with a customer or distributor, defining rebate tiers, calculation basis (revenue or volume), accrual method, settlement frequency, and eligible product scope. Captures rebate type (volume rebate, growth incentive, market development fund), threshold levels, and payout currency. Maps to SAP SD rebate processing (BO01/BO02). Distinct from price_agreement — rebates are retrospective settlements, not upfront pricing.

attributes.name: sales_rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sales rebate agreement record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or distributor party with whom this rebate agreement is established. Links to the customer master.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; Salesforce CRM Account

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product hierarchy or product group that defines the eligible product scope for this rebate agreement (e.g., specialty chemicals, performance materials, agricultural solutions).

attributes.name: primary_sales_rep_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal sales representative or account manager responsible for negotiating and managing this rebate agreement. Used for sales performance attribution and commission calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Employee (PERNR); Salesforce CRM Owner

attributes.name: sales_organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD sales organization responsible for administering this rebate agreement, defining the selling entity and currency context.

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated Salesforce CRM opportunity or contract record that originated or tracks this rebate agreement. Enables cross-system traceability between CRM pipeline and SAP SD rebate execution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; SAP SD Integration

attributes.name: accrual_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rebate Accrual General Ledger (GL) Account Code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP FI/CO to which rebate accruals are posted as a liability. Ensures correct financial reporting of variable consideration under FASB ASC 606 and SOX-compliant accrual tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO GL Account (SAKNR); FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to recognize and accrue rebate liability over the agreement period. Accrual-based: rebate liability is recognized as sales occur; Cash basis: recognized only upon settlement payment; Manual: accruals are posted manually by finance. Aligns with SAP FI/CO accrual posting logic.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Accrual Engine; FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: accrued_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative rebate liability accrued to date under this agreement based on eligible customer purchases. Updated periodically via SAP SD rebate settlement runs. Expressed in payout currency. Represents the current outstanding rebate obligation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Accrual (KBETR); FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: agreement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing commercial negotiation context, special conditions, customer-specific terms, or exceptions not captured in structured fields. Used by sales and finance teams for agreement administration.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement Text; Salesforce CRM Notes

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the rebate agreement, typically sourced from SAP SD rebate agreement number (BO01/BO02 agreement number field). Used in customer-facing communications and settlement documents.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement (KNUMA_BO); ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rebate agreement. Draft: under negotiation; Active: binding and accruing; Suspended: temporarily paused; Settled: final settlement completed; Expired: past end date without renewal; Cancelled: terminated before end date.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement Status (BOSTA); ISO 9001 Contract Management

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate agreement by commercial incentive type. Volume rebate rewards cumulative purchase volume; growth incentive rewards year-over-year growth; market development fund (MDF) supports distributor marketing activities; distributor rebate applies to channel partners; loyalty rebate rewards long-term customers; performance rebate ties payout to KPI achievement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_rebate|growth_incentive|market_development_fund|distributor_rebate|loyalty_rebate|performance_rebate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement Type (BOART); ACC Responsible Care Commercial Practices

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rebate agreement was formally approved by the authorized approver. Marks the transition from draft to active status and establishes the audit trail for financial commitment.

attributes.name: baseline_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the reference period used to establish the baseline purchase volume or revenue for growth incentive rebate measurement. Together with baseline_period_start, defines the comparison window.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: baseline_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the reference period used to establish the baseline purchase volume or revenue against which growth performance is measured for growth incentive rebate agreements.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: Defines the metric used to measure customer performance and calculate rebate entitlement. Revenue: net invoiced sales value; Volume: quantity of product units; Quantity: number of orders or transactions; Weight (kg): metric weight of chemical products shipped; Mixed: combination of revenue and volume thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Condition Basis (KSCHL); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Commercial channel through which the customer purchases eligible products. Direct: sold directly by Chemical Mfg sales force; Distributor: sold through authorized chemical distributors; Dealer: regional dealer network; OEM: original equipment manufacturer purchasing for incorporation; Ecommerce: digital channel purchases.
attributes.references: SAP SD Distribution Channel (VTWEG); Salesforce CRM Account Type

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center code to which the rebate expense is allocated for internal management accounting and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization) reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center (KOSTL); FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rebate agreement record was first created in the system, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Provides audit trail for record origination and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP SD Change Document

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the rebate agreement becomes binding and eligible purchases begin accruing toward rebate thresholds. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement Validity Start (DATAB); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the rebate agreement expires and no further accruals are recognized. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement Validity End (DATBI); FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: eligible_product_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of products eligible for rebate accrual under this agreement. All products: entire customer portfolio; Product group: defined SAP material group; Specific SKUs: enumerated Stock Keeping Units (SKUs); Product line: a named chemical product line; Material type: SAP material type classification (e.g., FERT, HALB).
attributes.references: SAP SD Material Group (MATKL); SAP MM Material Type (MTART)

attributes.name: growth_target_percent
attributes.description: Year-over-year revenue or volume growth percentage target that the customer must achieve to qualify for growth incentive rebate tiers. Applicable only when agreement_type is growth_incentive. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 10.0000 = 10%).
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Condition; Salesforce CRM Opportunity Target

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rebate is applied retroactively to all eligible purchases once a higher tier threshold is crossed (retroactive/step rebate), as opposed to applying only to incremental purchases above the threshold (incremental rebate). Critical for SAP SD rebate condition type configuration.
attributes.references: SAP SD Retroactive Rebate (BOART); FASB ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: is_tiered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rebate agreement uses a tiered scale structure where different rebate rates apply at different purchase volume or revenue thresholds. True: multiple tiers defined in the rebate tier child product; False: single flat rate applies.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Scale (STAFFEL); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this rebate agreement record, formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP SD Change Document; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: last_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent rebate settlement was completed and credit memo or payment was issued to the customer. Used to track settlement history and validate settlement frequency compliance.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Settlement (VBO2); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: max_rebate_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total rebate payout amount allowed under this agreement regardless of actual purchase performance. Protects Chemical Mfg from uncapped rebate liability exposure. Null if no cap applies. Expressed in payout currency.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Condition Upper Limit; FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: next_settlement_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next rebate settlement run for this agreement. Drives SAP SD settlement processing calendar and finance accrual review cycles.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Settlement Schedule (VBO2); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: payout_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the rebate settlement is denominated and paid to the customer or distributor (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency rebate programs for global chemical distribution.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP SD Currency (WAERS); FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: rebate_amount_fixed
attributes.description: Fixed monetary rebate amount payable upon achievement of agreement conditions, used for flat-fee rebate structures (e.g., market development funds with a fixed payout). Null when the agreement uses a percentage-based rate. Expressed in the payout currency.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Condition Value (KWERT); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: rebate_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to the calculation basis to determine the rebate payout amount for a given tier. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 2.5000 = 2.5%). For tiered agreements, this represents the base or entry-level rate; tier-specific rates are captured in the rebate tier product.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Condition Rate (KBETR); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: sap_rebate_agreement_number
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this rebate agreement in SAP SD (BO01/BO02 agreement number). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the SAP S/4HANA system of record.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Agreement (KNUMA_BO); SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: settled_amount
attributes.description: Total rebate amount that has been paid or credited to the customer through completed settlement runs. The difference between accrued_amount and settled_amount represents the outstanding rebate payable. Expressed in payout currency.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Settlement (VBO2); FASB ASC 606; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the accrued rebate is settled and paid to the customer or distributor. Determines the cadence of SAP SD rebate settlement runs and credit memo generation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Settlement (VBO2); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the rebate is paid to the customer or distributor. Credit memo: applied against future invoices in SAP SD; Check: physical payment instrument; Bank transfer: electronic funds transfer; Product credit: rebate applied as credit toward future product purchases.
attributes.references: SAP SD Credit Memo (KSCHL); SAP FI Payment Processing

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Sales territory code identifying the geographic or organizational sales territory responsible for managing this rebate agreement. Aligns with Salesforce CRM territory management and SAP SD sales area configuration.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Area; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: threshold_basis_amount
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative purchase value (in payout currency) or volume that the customer must achieve to qualify for the rebate. Represents the entry-level threshold for single-tier agreements. For multi-tier agreements, this is the lowest tier threshold.
attributes.references: SAP SD Rebate Scale Base Value (STAFFEL); FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: threshold_basis_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the rebate threshold basis amount. For revenue-based agreements, this is the ISO 4217 currency code. For volume-based agreements, this is the unit of measure (MT = metric ton, KG = kilogram, L = liter, EA = each) aligned with chemical product measurement standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|MT|KG|L|EA| — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

products.name: sales_lead
products.description: Unqualified sales lead representing a prospective customer or new business opportunity in the chemical industry. Captures lead source (trade show, web inquiry, referral, cold outreach), company name, contact details, industry segment (automotive, agriculture, electronics, construction), product interest, application end-use, lead score, qualification status, and conversion date to opportunity. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead object. Entry point to the sales pipeline preceding opportunity creation.

attributes.name: sales_lead_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the sales lead record in the Chemical Mfg lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key generated at ingestion from Salesforce CRM Lead object.

attributes.name: assigned_sales_rep_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Assigned Sales Rep Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Lead assignment to a sales rep is a core process; FK supports lead conversion metrics and rep performance tracking.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign that generated or influenced this lead (e.g., trade show campaign code, digital ad campaign ID). Links lead generation to marketing spend for ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Salesforce Campaign Object

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Lead capture records specific material interest; replace free‑text product_interest with FK to material_master for accurate routing and analytics.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM Opportunity ID created upon lead conversion. Provides traceability from the originating lead to the resulting sales opportunity for pipeline lineage reporting.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Estimated or reported annual revenue of the prospect company in US dollars. Used for lead qualification, account sizing, and prioritisation of high-value opportunities.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: application_end_use
attributes.description: Specific end-use application or process for which the prospect intends to use the chemical product (e.g., automotive primer adhesion, crop protection formulation, PCB etching). Supports technical sales guidance and product recommendation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the prospect company's primary operating location. Supports geographic territory mapping and logistics proximity analysis for supply chain planning.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the prospective customer organisation expressing interest in Chemical Mfg products. Serves as the primary identity label for the lead.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the lead contact used for digital outreach, campaign tracking, and follow-up communications. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead.Email field.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: contact_first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the primary contact person at the prospective company. Used for personalised outreach and correspondence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: contact_last_name
attributes.description: Family name of the primary contact person at the prospective company. Combined with contact_first_name to form the full contact identity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the lead contact. Used by technical sales representatives for direct outreach and qualification calls.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: contact_title
attributes.description: Professional title or role of the primary contact at the prospect organisation (e.g., Procurement Manager, R&D Director, Plant Engineer). Helps qualify decision-making authority.

attributes.name: converted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lead has been converted to a sales opportunity, account, and/or contact in Salesforce CRM. When True, the lead has progressed to the opportunity stage of the sales pipeline.

attributes.name: converted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead was converted to a sales opportunity in Salesforce CRM. Used to calculate lead-to-opportunity conversion cycle time and pipeline velocity metrics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP SD

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the prospect company's primary operating location (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). Used for territory assignment, regulatory compliance screening (REACH, TSCA), and export control checks.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA; DOT

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lead record was first created in Salesforce CRM. Serves as the business event timestamp marking entry into the sales pipeline. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead.CreatedDate.

attributes.name: crm_lead_code
attributes.description: Native lead identifier from Salesforce CRM (Lead.Id). Used to trace the record back to the source system and support incremental data loads.

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead contact has opted out of all outreach communications. When True, sales and marketing activities must cease per GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM compliance requirements.

attributes.name: email_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead contact has specifically opted out of email marketing communications. Distinct from do_not_contact which covers all channels. Enforced per GDPR and CAN-SPAM Act.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Approximate number of employees at the prospect organisation. Used as a firmographic qualifier to assess company size and potential purchasing volume.

attributes.name: estimated_opportunity_value_usd
attributes.description: Sales representative's estimate of the potential annual contract or deal value in US dollars if the lead converts to a customer. Used for pipeline forecasting and revenue planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: Date on which the assigned sales representative is scheduled to next contact the lead. Drives task management and ensures timely follow-up within the sales cadence.

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: End-market industry vertical of the prospective customer. Enables segmentation of the sales pipeline by target market and alignment with Chemical Mfg's product portfolio strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|agriculture|electronics|construction|consumer_goods|coatings|pharma|food_beverage|textiles|oil_gas|water_treatment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ACC Responsible Care; TSCA

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sales activity (call, email, meeting) logged against this lead in Salesforce CRM. Used to identify stale leads requiring re-engagement and to measure sales rep responsiveness.

attributes.name: lead_source
attributes.description: Channel or origination method through which the lead was generated (e.g., trade show, web inquiry, referral, cold outreach). Critical for marketing ROI analysis and channel effectiveness reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trade_show|web_inquiry|referral|cold_outreach|distributor|conference|digital_campaign|partner|inbound_call|event — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: lead_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sales lead within the qualification workflow. Drives pipeline reporting and sales rep task assignment. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead.Status field.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: qualification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the sales representative during lead qualification activities, including BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) assessment observations and technical application details.

attributes.name: rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the lead's sales readiness and urgency. Complements the numeric lead_score with a categorical signal used by sales managers for pipeline prioritisation.

attributes.name: reach_screening_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect's intended application or geography triggers a REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) compliance screening before product can be offered. Relevant for EU-based leads.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this lead record, sourced from Salesforce CRM Lead.LastModifiedDate. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: sales_territory
attributes.description: Geographic or account-based sales territory to which this lead is assigned (e.g., Northeast US, EMEA, APAC). Drives territory performance reporting and quota allocation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP SD

attributes.name: sample_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect has requested a product sample for laboratory evaluation or application testing. Sample requests advance the lead through the qualification pipeline and trigger sample fulfilment workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; SAP SD

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numeric qualification score (typically 0–100) assigned to the lead based on firmographic fit, engagement signals, and product interest alignment. Used to prioritise sales rep follow-up activities.

attributes.name: sds_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect has requested a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for the product of interest. SDS requests are a strong qualification signal and trigger EHS documentation workflows.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the prospect company's primary location. Used for territory management, regional sales assignment, and EPA/OSHA jurisdictional compliance screening.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; EPA; OSHA

attributes.name: tsca_review_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Review Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead's product interest requires a TSCA compliance review prior to commercial engagement. Applicable for US-based leads involving regulated chemical substances.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website address of the prospect company. Used for pre-qualification research, digital engagement tracking, and enrichment of firmographic data.

products.name: competitor
products.description: Master record of known competitors in the chemical manufacturing industry (e.g., BASF, Dow, Evonik, Lanxess) tracked for competitive intelligence purposes. Captures competitor name, product lines they compete in, market segments, known pricing posture, strengths/weaknesses, and win/loss history. Supports competitive positioning in sales negotiations and opportunity management.

attributes.name: competitor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the competitor master record in the chemical manufacturing competitive intelligence repository.
attributes.references: SAP SD Competitive Intelligence; Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: competing_market_segments
attributes.description: Description of the end-market segments where the competitor is active and overlaps with Chemical Mfg's customer base (e.g., Automotive Coatings, Construction Adhesives, Electronics Encapsulants, Agricultural Crop Protection). Used for territory and segment-level competitive strategy.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Market Segment Taxonomy; ACC Market Intelligence Reports

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Legal or commonly recognized trade name of the competitor organization (e.g., BASF SE, Dow Inc., Evonik Industries AG, Lanxess AG). Used as the primary human-readable identifier in sales negotiations and competitive positioning reports.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Name; ACC Responsible Care Member Directory

attributes.name: competitor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the competitor record: active (actively competing), inactive (no longer a competitive threat), acquired (absorbed by another entity), merged (combined with another company), dissolved (ceased operations), or monitoring (under observation for potential competitive entry).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP SD Competitive Account Management

attributes.name: competitor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the competitive relationship: direct (same product lines, same markets), indirect (substitute products or adjacent markets), potential (could enter our markets), distributor (resells competing products), or private_label (manufactures under customer brands). Drives competitive strategy prioritization.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitor Object; ACC Competitive Intelligence Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the competitor master record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record age analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM CreatedDate; SAP SD Change Document; ISO 8601

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Primary go-to-market distribution model used by the competitor: direct (sells directly to end customers), distributor (sells exclusively through distribution partners), both (hybrid direct and distributor model), or unknown. Informs channel strategy and distributor conflict risk assessment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Channel Management; SAP SD Distribution Channel Configuration

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System identifier uniquely identifying the competitor's legal entity for supplier and counterparty due diligence purposes.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; SAP Business Partner Master

attributes.name: employee_count_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total global headcount of the competitor organization. Sourced from public filings, LinkedIn data, or industry reports. Used as a proxy for operational scale and R&D capacity in competitive assessments.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet Firmographics; ACC Member Reporting

attributes.name: estimated_annual_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Estimated or publicly reported annual revenue of the competitor in US Dollars. Sourced from public financial disclosures, industry analyst reports, or internal intelligence. Used for market share benchmarking and competitive sizing. Represents the most recently available fiscal year figure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SEC 10-K Annual Report; EBITDA Benchmarking

attributes.name: estimated_revenue_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2023) to which the estimated_annual_revenue_usd figure corresponds. Ensures temporal accuracy when comparing revenue data across competitors with different fiscal year-end dates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SEC Annual Report Filing Standards

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Scope of the competitor's geographic market presence: global (operations across multiple continents), regional (multi-country within a region), national (single country), local (sub-national), or unknown. Used for territory-level competitive threat assessment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; Oracle TMS Geographic Coverage

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the country where the competitor's global headquarters is registered (e.g., DEU for Germany, USA for United States, CHN for China). Used for geopolitical risk assessment and trade compliance screening.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; TSCA Foreign Entity Reporting; REACH ECHA Registration

attributes.name: headquarters_region
attributes.description: Geographic region of the competitor's global headquarters used for regional competitive analysis and territory management (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East and Africa, Latin America). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: north_america|europe|asia_pacific|middle_east_africa|latin_america|greater_china — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; Oracle TMS Regional Segmentation

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: Primary chemical industry segment in which the competitor operates (e.g., Specialty Chemicals, Commodity Chemicals, Agrochemicals, Performance Materials, Plastics and Polymers, Coatings and Adhesives, Industrial Gases). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: specialty_chemicals|commodity_chemicals|agrochemicals|performance_materials|plastics_polymers|coatings_adhesives|industrial_gases|fine_chemicals|petrochemicals — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACC Industry Classification; NAICS Code 325 Chemical Manufacturing

attributes.name: intelligence_source
attributes.description: Primary source from which competitive intelligence for this record was gathered. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: public_filing|industry_report|customer_feedback|sales_team|trade_show|win_loss_interview|market_research|distributor_feedback|regulatory_database — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Data Source Tracking; ACC Market Intelligence Best Practices

attributes.name: is_publicly_traded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the competitor is a publicly listed company on a recognized stock exchange. True enables linkage to public financial disclosures; False indicates private, state-owned, or subsidiary status.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SEC Regulation S-K; FASB ASC 320

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the competitor holds a current ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. Relevant for sustainability-driven customer procurement decisions and competitive positioning in environmentally regulated markets.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management Systems; EPA Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the competitor holds a current ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Relevant for customer qualification requirements and competitive differentiation in quality-sensitive markets such as automotive and electronics.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems; SAP QM Vendor Qualification

attributes.name: known_strengths
attributes.description: Narrative description of the competitor's recognized competitive advantages such as proprietary chemistry, manufacturing scale, regulatory approvals (REACH, TSCA), distribution network breadth, technical service capabilities, or brand equity. Informs sales battle cards and technical sales positioning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitor Object; ACC Responsible Care Benchmarking

attributes.name: known_weaknesses
attributes.description: Narrative description of the competitor's recognized vulnerabilities such as supply chain constraints, limited product range, regulatory non-compliance gaps, quality issues (OOS/OOT history), poor technical service, or geographic coverage gaps. Used to identify win opportunities in competitive sales situations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitor Object; LIMS Quality Benchmarking; REACH Compliance Gaps

attributes.name: last_competitive_encounter_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sales opportunity in which this competitor was identified as a competing party. Used to assess recency of competitive activity and prioritize intelligence refresh efforts. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Close Date; SAP SD Sales Order Date

attributes.name: last_intelligence_refresh_date
attributes.description: Date on which the competitive intelligence record was last reviewed and updated by the responsible sales or marketing team member. Used to identify stale records requiring refresh. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Last Modified Date; SAP SD Data Quality Management

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the competitor as filed with the relevant corporate registry or regulatory authority. May differ from the trade name used commercially.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Registration; SEC EDGAR; FASB ASC 805

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of active manufacturing facilities operated globally by the competitor. Indicates production capacity scale and geographic manufacturing footprint relevant to supply chain competitive analysis.
attributes.references: EPA Facility Registry; OSHA PSM Site Inventory; REACH Site Registration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional competitive intelligence observations, recent strategic moves (M&A activity, plant expansions, new product launches, regulatory actions), or contextual information not captured in structured fields. Supports qualitative competitive analysis by the sales and marketing teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitor Notes; SAP SD Sales Activity Log

attributes.name: parent_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the ultimate parent or controlling entity if the competitor is a subsidiary or division (e.g., Covestro is a subsidiary of Bayer AG). Supports corporate hierarchy analysis and M&A tracking in competitive intelligence.
attributes.references: SAP Business Partner Hierarchy; Dun & Bradstreet Global Ultimate

attributes.name: pricing_posture
attributes.description: Characterization of the competitor's general pricing strategy relative to market: premium (above-market pricing with differentiation), parity (market-rate pricing), discount (below-market pricing), aggressive_discount (significantly below market, potentially predatory), or value_based (pricing tied to customer outcome metrics). Critical input for sales negotiation strategy and RFQ response pricing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitive Intelligence; SAP SD Pricing Condition Records

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal Chemical Mfg sales or marketing team member responsible for maintaining and updating intelligence on this competitor. Serves as the accountable owner for competitive record accuracy and freshness.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Owner; SAP SD Sales Representative Assignment

attributes.name: primary_product_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated or free-text description of the competitor's primary product lines that directly compete with Chemical Mfg's portfolio (e.g., Polyurethane Dispersions, Epoxy Resins, Acrylic Monomers, Agricultural Fungicides). Supports product-level competitive mapping in Salesforce CRM opportunity management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitor Product Mapping; SAP SD Material Master

attributes.name: rd_investment_intensity
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the competitor's R&D investment level relative to industry peers: high (>5% of revenue), medium (2-5% of revenue), low (<2% of revenue), or unknown. Indicates innovation pipeline threat and likelihood of new competing product introductions.
attributes.references: ACC R&D Investment Benchmarking; FASB ASC 730 Research and Development Costs

attributes.name: reach_registration_status
attributes.description: Status of the competitor's compliance with EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation for their competing substances. Indicates whether competing products are REACH-registered, pre-registered, exempt, or status is unknown. Relevant for EU market competitive positioning.
attributes.references: ECHA REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; ECHA Registered Substances Database

attributes.name: responsible_care_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the competitor is a member of the American Chemistry Council (ACC) Responsible Care program or equivalent national chemical industry responsible care initiative. Membership signals commitment to EHS standards and may influence customer procurement preferences.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care Program; ICCA Global Responsible Care Charter

attributes.name: stock_ticker
attributes.description: Exchange-listed stock ticker symbol for publicly traded competitors (e.g., BASF.DE, DOW, EVK.DE). Used to link to financial market data for revenue benchmarking and financial health monitoring. Null for privately held competitors.
attributes.references: NYSE/NASDAQ/XETRA Listing Standards; SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 320

attributes.name: threat_level
attributes.description: Sales team's assessed competitive threat level for this competitor: critical (major threat to core business), high (significant competitive overlap), medium (moderate overlap in select segments), low (minimal current overlap), or watch (emerging threat requiring monitoring). Drives sales resource allocation and battle card prioritization.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitive Intelligence; ACC Market Intelligence Framework

attributes.name: total_opportunities_competed
attributes.description: Total count of sales opportunities in Salesforce CRM where this competitor was identified as a competing party, over the trailing 12-month period. Provides the denominator context for win_rate_pct and indicates competitive encounter frequency.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; SAP SD Sales Pipeline Reporting

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the competitor's compliance posture with the US Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) for their competing chemical substances. Non-compliant or partial status may represent a competitive advantage for Chemical Mfg in US market sales negotiations.
attributes.references: EPA TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory; TSCA Section 5 PMN Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the competitor master record was most recently modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used to track data freshness and trigger intelligence refresh workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate; SAP SD Change Document; ISO 8601

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Primary public website URL of the competitor organization. Used as a reference for product catalog research, SDS/MSDS document retrieval, regulatory compliance verification, and ongoing competitive intelligence gathering.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Website; ECHA Substance Information Portal

attributes.name: win_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of competitive sales opportunities where Chemical Mfg won against this specific competitor, calculated over the trailing 12-month period. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 62.50 = 62.5%). Sourced from Salesforce CRM closed opportunity records. Supports sales performance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Win/Loss Analysis; SAP SD Sales Performance KPI

products.name: win_loss
products.description: Win/loss analysis record capturing the outcome of a closed sales opportunity, including reason for win or loss, competitor displaced or won by, decision criteria cited by the customer, product involved, and deal value. Enables structured competitive intelligence and sales process improvement in the chemical industry. Linked to closed opportunities in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: win_loss_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the win/loss analysis record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; SAP SD Sales Order

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this win/loss record. Identifies the chemical industry customer (e.g., automotive OEM, construction firm, electronics manufacturer) involved in the deal.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; SAP SD Customer Master

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary chemical product or formulation involved in the sales opportunity. Identifies the specific SKU, compound, or performance material that was the subject of the deal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; SAP SD

attributes.name: competitor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.competitor. Business justification: Standardizes competitor reference in win/loss analysis; removes redundant free‑text competitor_name column.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technical sales representative or account manager who owned the opportunity. Used for sales performance analysis and territory management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM User Object; SAP SD Sales Employee

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the closed sales opportunity in Salesforce CRM from which this win/loss record was generated. Links back to the originating opportunity record.

attributes.name: quality_deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_deviation. Business justification: Win/Loss analysis records if a lost opportunity was due to a quality deviation, supporting root‑cause reporting.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales territory associated with this win/loss record. Enables geographic and territory-level competitive analysis.

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sales opportunity was formally closed (won or lost). Represents the principal business event date for this win/loss record. Used for period-based win/loss trend analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Close Date; SAP SD

attributes.name: competitor_price_per_kg
attributes.description: The estimated or customer-disclosed unit price per kilogram offered by the winning or primary competing supplier. Classified as confidential. Critical for competitive pricing intelligence in chemical manufacturing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitor Object; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: competitor_product
attributes.description: The specific competing chemical product, formulation, or material that was selected by the customer or displaced by Chemical Mfg. Enables product-level competitive benchmarking. Classified as confidential.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this win/loss record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; ISO 9001 Record Control; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_number
attributes.description: The externally-known opportunity number from Salesforce CRM (e.g., OPP-2024-00123). Serves as the business-facing identifier for cross-system traceability between CRM and ERP.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deal value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency reporting for global chemical sales operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: customer_contact_role
attributes.description: The role or title of the primary customer contact who provided win/loss feedback or made the purchase decision (e.g., Procurement Manager, R&D Chemist, Plant Manager, EHS Director). Identifies the decision-maker level in the customer organization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: procurement_manager|rd_chemist|plant_manager|ehs_director|technical_director|ceo|purchasing_agent|formulation_engineer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; SAP SD Customer Contact

attributes.name: customer_region
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the customer's geographic region or country of operation (e.g., USA, DEU, CHN). Supports regional win/loss trend analysis and territory management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Salesforce CRM Account Address

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The market segment classification of the customer involved in the opportunity (e.g., automotive, construction, electronics, consumer goods, agriculture, pharmaceuticals). Enables segment-level competitive analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automotive|construction|electronics|consumer_goods|agriculture|pharmaceuticals|industrial|coatings — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Industry; SAP SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: deal_value_usd
attributes.description: The estimated or actual total deal value in US dollars associated with the closed opportunity. Represents the annual or contract revenue at stake. Used for pipeline value analysis and win/loss financial impact reporting. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Revenue Recognition; FASB ASC 606; SOX

attributes.name: deal_volume_kg
attributes.description: The estimated annual or contract volume of chemical product in kilograms associated with the opportunity. Volume-based analysis is critical in chemical manufacturing for capacity planning and margin assessment. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Order; Chemical Industry Volume Metrics

attributes.name: decision_criteria
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the key criteria the customer used to make their purchase decision. In chemical manufacturing, this may include technical performance specifications, regulatory compliance (REACH, TSCA, GHS), sustainability profile, price per kg, or application support capability.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Decision Criteria; REACH Regulation; TSCA

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer formally communicated their purchase decision. May differ from the CRM close date if there is a lag between customer notification and CRM update. Critical for accurate sales cycle analysis.

attributes.name: interview_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal win/loss interview or debrief was conducted with the customer contact (True/False). Interviews provide higher-quality decision intelligence than self-reported CRM data.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; ACC Responsible Care Customer Engagement

attributes.name: interview_source
attributes.description: Indicates the source of the win/loss intelligence: direct customer interview, sales representative self-report, third-party market research, or inferred from available data. Affects the reliability weighting of the win/loss analysis.

attributes.name: is_competitive_displacement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this win involved displacing an incumbent competitor (True) or was a greenfield opportunity with no prior supplier (False). Distinguishes competitive wins from new market development in win/loss analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity; ACC Responsible Care Competitive Intelligence

attributes.name: is_new_customer
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opportunity represented a new customer acquisition (True) or an existing customer retention/expansion deal (False). Critical for distinguishing new business wins from account growth in sales performance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP SD Customer Master

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional qualitative context, sales representative observations, or customer verbatim feedback captured during the win/loss debrief. Supports unstructured competitive intelligence capture.

attributes.name: opportunity_created_date
attributes.description: The date the sales opportunity was originally created in Salesforce CRM. Used to calculate the total sales cycle duration from opportunity creation to close.

attributes.name: opportunity_stage_at_loss
attributes.description: The CRM pipeline stage at which the opportunity was lost (e.g., prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, technical evaluation). Identifies where in the sales funnel Chemical Mfg loses deals, enabling targeted process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prospecting|qualification|needs_analysis|proposal|technical_evaluation|negotiation|contract_review|closed_lost — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The final outcome of the closed sales opportunity. 'won' indicates the deal was awarded to Chemical Mfg; 'lost' indicates it was awarded to a competitor; 'no_decision' indicates the customer deferred or cancelled the evaluation; 'withdrawn' indicates Chemical Mfg withdrew from the opportunity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Stage; ACC Responsible Care Sales Practices

attributes.name: price_competitiveness_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of Chemical Mfg's pricing position relative to the winning competitor at the time of the deal. Classified as confidential due to pricing strategy sensitivity. Used to analyze price-driven win/loss patterns.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; Salesforce CRM; FASB

attributes.name: primary_loss_reason
attributes.description: The principal reason cited for losing the opportunity. Common reasons in chemical manufacturing include price, product performance, technical specification mismatch, regulatory compliance gap (e.g., REACH, TSCA), competitor relationship, or delivery lead time. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price|product_performance|technical_specification|regulatory_compliance|competitor_relationship|delivery_lead_time|formulation_mismatch|credit_terms|incumbent_preference|no_decision — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Win/Loss Reason; ACC Responsible Care; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: primary_win_reason
attributes.description: The principal reason cited for winning the opportunity. Common win reasons in chemical manufacturing include superior product performance, technical support quality, regulatory compliance advantage (e.g., GHS, REACH), pricing competitiveness, or established customer relationship. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_performance|technical_support|price|regulatory_advantage|formulation_capability|delivery_reliability|relationship|sustainability_profile|application_expertise — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Win/Loss Reason; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: product_application
attributes.description: The specific end-use application or industry segment for which the chemical product was being evaluated (e.g., automotive coating, adhesive formulation, agricultural active ingredient, electronic-grade solvent). Enables application-level win/loss analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Classification; Chemical Industry Application Taxonomy

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The chemical product line or portfolio category involved in the opportunity (e.g., Performance Coatings, Specialty Polymers, Agricultural Solutions, Electronic Chemicals, Industrial Solvents). Supports product-line-level win/loss reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Product Hierarchy; Chemical Industry Product Classification

attributes.name: quoted_price_per_kg
attributes.description: The unit price per kilogram quoted by Chemical Mfg for the chemical product in this opportunity. Expressed in the deal currency. Classified as confidential. Enables price-level competitive analysis across won and lost deals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the win/loss analysis record. 'draft' indicates the record is being completed; 'active' indicates it is finalized and available for reporting; 'under_review' indicates it is being validated; 'archived' indicates it has been superseded or retired.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP SD; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_factor
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., REACH, TSCA, GHS, EPA, OSHA) were a cited factor in the customer's decision. Enables tracking of regulatory-driven wins and losses in the chemical industry.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC 1907/2006); TSCA; EPA; GHS; ECHA

attributes.name: sales_cycle_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from opportunity creation to close date. Represents the length of the sales cycle for this deal. Used to benchmark sales efficiency and identify process improvement opportunities in technical chemical sales.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP SD Sales Analytics

attributes.name: sds_compliance_cited
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Compliance Cited Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the availability, quality, or compliance of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS/MSDS) was cited as a factor in the customer's decision. SDS compliance is a critical differentiator in chemical sales under GHS and OSHA HazCom standards.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200); SDS (Safety Data Sheet)

attributes.name: sustainability_factor
attributes.description: Indicates whether sustainability, environmental profile, or ESG criteria (e.g., VOC content, HAP reduction, ISO 14001 compliance) were a cited factor in the customer's purchase decision. Reflects growing sustainability-driven procurement in chemical markets.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EPA VOC/HAP Regulations; ACC Responsible Care; ECHA REACH

attributes.name: technical_evaluation_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal technical evaluation, laboratory trial, or application testing was conducted as part of the sales process (True/False). In chemical manufacturing, technical evaluations (e.g., COA review, lab trials, LIMS-tracked testing) are a key stage in the sales cycle.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; SAP QM Quality Management; COA (Certificate of Analysis)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this win/loss record was most recently modified. Supports data freshness tracking and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX; ISO 9001 Record Control; Salesforce CRM

products.name: opportunity_product
products.description: Association record linking a specific chemical product or grade to a sales opportunity, capturing estimated quantity, unit of measure, estimated revenue, probability-weighted value, and competitive status for that product line within the opportunity. Enables product-level pipeline visibility and supports demand forecasting from the sales pipeline.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Product / Line Item

attributes.name: opportunity_product_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the opportunity-product association record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical product or grade being proposed within this opportunity. Identifies the specific finished good, intermediate, or specialty chemical.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; SAP SD

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales opportunity to which this product line belongs. Links the product-level detail back to the opportunity header.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: quality_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.quality_specification. Business justification: Each product in an opportunity is linked to its quality specification to ensure the offer meets required standards.

attributes.name: annual_volume_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated annual purchase volume for this product line, expressed in the quantity UOM. Supports long-term demand forecasting, supply chain planning, and volume-based pricing negotiations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; ACC Responsible Care Program

attributes.name: application_end_use
attributes.description: Specific end-use application or industry segment for which the customer intends to use this chemical product (e.g., automotive coatings, agricultural formulation, electronic cleaning). Critical for REACH downstream user notifications and technical sales support.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 — Downstream User; TSCA; GHS SDS Section 1

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique CAS registry number assigned by the American Chemical Society to identify the specific chemical substance. Essential for regulatory compliance (REACH, TSCA), SDS documentation, and customer technical communication.
attributes.references: CAS Registry; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; TSCA; GHS

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Expected or actual date on which this product line within the opportunity is anticipated to be won or lost. Used for pipeline aging analysis and sales forecast period alignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM OpportunityLineItem; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: coa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Certificate of Analysis (COA) with each shipment of this product. Drives quality documentation requirements in LabWare LIMS and SAP QM.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; SAP S/4HANA QM; ISO 9001; GMP

attributes.name: competitive_status
attributes.description: Describes the competitive landscape for this product line within the opportunity. Indicates whether Chemical Mfg is the sole supplier, competing against others, defending incumbent business, or attempting to displace a competitor.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; ACC Responsible Care — Market Intelligence

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary competing supplier for this product line in the opportunity. Used for competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, and strategic positioning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Competitor Object; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Proposed end date of the supply contract or pricing agreement for this product line. Defines the duration of the commercial commitment being negotiated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Scheduling Agreement; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: contract_start_date
