attributes.description: Proposed start date of the supply contract or pricing agreement for this product line if the opportunity is won. Feeds into contract management and SAP SD scheduling agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Scheduling Agreement; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this opportunity-product association record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and pipeline aging analysis.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_product_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Opportunity Product ID
attributes.description: External identifier for this opportunity-product line as recorded in Salesforce CRM (OpportunityLineItem ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation between CRM and SAP SD.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this opportunity product line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency reporting and FX conversion.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of calendar days from order placement to delivery for this product line, used in customer negotiations and supply chain planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Scheduling; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered on the list price for this product line as part of the commercial negotiation. Supports margin analysis and pricing governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Condition; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: estimated_quantity
attributes.description: Estimated volume or quantity of the chemical product the customer intends to purchase within the opportunity period. Used for demand forecasting and production planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM OpportunityLineItem Quantity

attributes.name: estimated_revenue
attributes.description: Total estimated revenue for this product line within the opportunity, calculated as estimated quantity multiplied by unit price. Represents the gross revenue potential before discounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM OpportunityLineItem TotalPrice; FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: first_shipment_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of the first product shipment if the opportunity is won. Used for production scheduling, raw material procurement planning, and customer commitment management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Planning; Oracle Transportation Management

attributes.name: formulation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this opportunity product line requires a customer-specific formulation or blending service rather than a standard catalog product. Triggers engagement with R&D and formulation teams.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Production Planning; Internal R&D Process

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this opportunity-product record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Salesforce CRM LastModifiedDate; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this product within the parent opportunity, enabling ordered display and reference of multiple product lines within a single opportunity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM OpportunityLineItem; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Published or standard list price per unit of measure for this chemical product before any negotiated discounts or customer-specific pricing adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Type PR00; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: moq
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required for this chemical product, expressed in the quantity UOM. Communicated to the customer during opportunity negotiation to set commercial expectations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record; SAP SD

attributes.name: opportunity_product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this specific product line within the opportunity. Allows individual product lines to be won, lost, or withdrawn independently of the overall opportunity status.

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Preferred or proposed packaging format for this chemical product in the opportunity (e.g., bulk tanker, 200L drum, IBC tote, 25kg bag). Affects logistics, pricing, and DOT/IATA hazmat compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk|drum|ibc|bag|cylinder|tote|flexibag — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Packaging; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; IATA DGR

attributes.name: probability_weighted_revenue
attributes.description: Estimated revenue for this product line adjusted by the win probability percentage. Used for pipeline valuation, sales forecasting, and revenue planning at the product level.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; FASB ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Controlling

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Specific grade or specification variant of the chemical product (e.g., technical grade, reagent grade, food grade, pharmaceutical grade). Critical for chemical manufacturing where the same base chemical may have multiple grades with different pricing and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the estimated quantity field (e.g., KG for kilograms, MT for metric tons, L for liters, DRUM for drum containers). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure for the material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|LB|L|GAL|DRUM|IBC|BAG|TON — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical product is confirmed compliant with REACH regulation for the customer's intended use and geography. Critical for European market opportunities.

attributes.name: sales_stage
attributes.description: Current sales pipeline stage for this product line, which may differ from the parent opportunity stage when individual products are at different negotiation phases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prospecting|qualification|needs_analysis|proposal|negotiation|closed_won|closed_lost — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Stage Field; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sample_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has requested a product sample for evaluation or qualification testing as part of this opportunity. Triggers sample order creation in SAP SD.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Sample Management

attributes.name: sap_sd_item_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Item Number

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Document Item

attributes.name: sds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for this chemical product as part of the opportunity documentation. Mandatory for hazardous chemicals under GHS and REACH.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System); REACH Regulation Article 31; OSHA HazCom 2012 (29 CFR 1910.1200)

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Internal SKU code identifying the specific packaged or bulk form of the chemical product being offered in this opportunity line. Aligns with SAP MM material number and warehouse management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; SAP EWM

attributes.name: technical_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product line requires a technical review by the applications engineering or R&D team before a formal proposal can be submitted to the customer.
attributes.references: Internal R&D and Technical Sales Process; ISO 9001

attributes.name: tsca_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical product is listed on the TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory and compliant for commercial sale in the United States.
attributes.references: TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act); EPA TSCA Inventory

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Proposed or target selling price per unit of measure for this chemical product in the opportunity. Represents the commercial pricing position before final negotiation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Condition; FASB Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: win_probability_pct
attributes.description: Estimated probability (0–100%) that this specific product line will be won, which may differ from the overall opportunity win probability when the customer is evaluating multiple products independently.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Probability Field; SAP S/4HANA SD

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Governs end-to-end supply chain network including supplier master data, purchase orders (PO), ASN tracking, vendor performance scorecards, supply risk management, procurement planning, RFQ processes, contract pricing with chemical suppliers, supplier qualification and audits, and inbound logistics coordination. Integrates with SAP MM and Oracle Transportation Management.
domains.references: ISO 9001 / Supply Chain Best Practices / ACC Responsible Care

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all chemical suppliers and raw material vendors including multi-site physical locations. Captures vendor identity, classification, SAP vendor number, DUNS number, tax identifiers, payment terms, currency, preferred incoterms, vendor tier (strategic/preferred/approved/conditional), Responsible Care certification status, REACH compliance flag, and onboarding status. Includes site-level detail: physical plant addresses, site types (manufacturing plant, distribution center, port of export), geographic regions, country of origin, UN/LOCODE, hazmat handling capabilities, ISO 9001/14001 certifications at site level, and site-level contacts. Single source of truth for supplier identity, locations, and site capabilities within the supply domain.

products.name: purchase_order

attributes.name: price_list_id

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: document_date

attributes.name: freight_terms

attributes.name: incoterms

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: vendor_contact_name

attributes.name: asn_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent ASN header document. Links this line item to its containing shipment notice.

attributes.name: experimental_formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.experimental_formulation. Business justification: Shipment planning for a formulation requires ASN lines to reference the experimental formulation they supply.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the chemical product being shipped. Links to the material catalog.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that this ASN line is fulfilling. Enables reconciliation between ordered and shipped quantities.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer batch or lot number for the shipped material. Critical for traceability, quality control, and recall management in chemical manufacturing.
attributes.references: GMP Batch Record Requirements, SAP QM Batch Management

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Critical for regulatory compliance, safety documentation, and material identification.
attributes.references: CAS Registry, TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the Certificate of Analysis document that accompanies this material shipment. Links to quality test results and specifications compliance.
attributes.references: GMP Quality Documentation, ISO 9001 Quality Records

attributes.name: coc_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the Certificate of Compliance document certifying the material meets regulatory and specification requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Records, Regulatory Compliance Documentation

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the chemical material was manufactured. Required for customs clearance, trade compliance, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, Customs and Trade Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ASN line record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the line value amount. Enables multi-currency procurement and financial reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Supplier delivery note or packing slip number associated with this shipment line. Used for cross-referencing supplier documentation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the chemical material should not be used due to degradation or regulatory restrictions. Critical for FEFO inventory management and quality assurance.
attributes.references: GMP Expiry Dating, FEFO Inventory Management

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which the chemical can vaporize to form an ignitable mixture in air. Critical safety parameter for flammable materials storage and handling.
attributes.references: NFPA 30 Flammable and Combustible Liquids Code

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight including chemical material and packaging. Used for freight calculations, warehouse capacity planning, and transportation compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, DOT Transportation Regulations

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT or UN hazard classification for the chemical material. Determines transportation requirements, storage restrictions, and emergency response procedures.
attributes.references: DOT Hazard Classes 49 CFR 173, UN Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material shipment requires quality inspection upon receipt before being released to inventory. Drives goods receipt workflow.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ASN line record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format, SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the ASN document. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the shipment notice.

attributes.name: line_value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of this ASN line item based on purchase order pricing. Used for goods receipt valuation and inventory accounting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt Valuation, GAAP Inventory Valuation

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Supplier lot number for the material shipment. May differ from internal batch number and is used for supplier traceability and quality investigations.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when the chemical material was manufactured or formulated by the supplier. Used to calculate shelf life and support quality investigations.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Full text description of the chemical material including grade, purity, and key characteristics. Provides human-readable context for the material.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the chemical material being shipped. Human-readable material code used across procurement and production systems.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Net weight of the chemical material excluding packaging. Used for inventory valuation, yield calculations, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: number_of_packages
attributes.description: Total count of individual packages or containers for this ASN line item. Used for receiving verification and warehouse space planning.

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of container or packaging used for shipping the chemical material. Critical for handling instructions, storage planning, and safety protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRUM|IBC|TANKER|BAG|BOTTLE|CARBOY|PAIL|TOTE|CYLINDER|BULK — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR, UN Packaging Codes

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: UN packing group indicating the degree of danger for hazardous materials. Group I is high danger, II is medium, III is low. Determines packaging and handling requirements.
attributes.references: UN Packing Group Classification, DOT 49 CFR 173

attributes.name: po_line_number
attributes.description: Specific line item number on the purchase order that this ASN line corresponds to. Enables line-level PO-to-ASN reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: quarantine_status
attributes.description: Quality control status indicating whether the material is released for use, held in quarantine pending inspection, rejected, or awaiting quality decision.
attributes.references: SAP QM Quality Management, GMP Quality Control

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: REACH registration number for the chemical substance as required by European chemicals regulation. Mandatory for chemicals imported into or manufactured in the EU above threshold tonnages.

attributes.name: sds_revision_date
attributes.description: Date when the Safety Data Sheet was last revised. Critical for ensuring compliance with current hazard communication requirements.

attributes.name: sds_version
attributes.description: Version number of the Safety Data Sheet applicable to this material shipment. Ensures receiving facility has current safety and handling information.
attributes.references: GHS SDS Requirements, OSHA Hazard Communication Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material being shipped on this ASN line. Represents the actual amount dispatched by the supplier for this line item.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature at which the chemical material can be stored without degradation. Defines upper bound for warehouse climate control.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature at which the chemical material must be stored to maintain stability and quality. Defines lower bound for warehouse climate control.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport. Required for shipping documentation and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the shipped quantity is expressed. Common chemical industry units include kilograms, liters, metric tons, gallons, drums, and intermediate bulk containers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|L|MT|GAL|LB|TON|M3|EA|DR|IBC — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000, SAP MM Unit of Measure

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Volume of the chemical material being shipped. Particularly important for liquid chemicals and storage capacity planning.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for volume values. Standardizes volume reporting for liquid chemical shipments.

attributes.name: weight_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for net and gross weight values. Standardizes weight reporting across international shipments.

products.name: rfq
products.description: Request for Quotation issued to chemical suppliers and the full vendor response lifecycle, covering solicitation through award. Captures RFQ number, type (spot buy, annual contract bid, emergency source), materials/CAS numbers, required quantities, submission deadline, and evaluation criteria. Includes all vendor quotation responses: quoted prices, price validity periods, lead times, MOQs, payment terms, incoterms, technical compliance notes, SDS availability confirmation, REACH compliance statements, and response evaluation status (submitted, under evaluation, accepted, rejected). Supports strategic sourcing events, competitive bid analysis, and supplier selection. Integrates with SAP MM ME41/ME47.
products.reference: SAP MM Request for Quotation (EKKO type AN)

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the request for quotation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: awarded_date
attributes.description: Date when the RFQ was awarded to the selected supplier. Marks the transition from evaluation to contracting phase.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order Creation Date

attributes.name: awarded_price
attributes.description: Final negotiated unit price from the winning supplier. Confidential business data used for cost analysis and future price benchmarking.

attributes.name: awarded_supplier_code
attributes.description: Vendor code of the supplier who was awarded the business after evaluation. Null if RFQ is not yet awarded or was cancelled.

attributes.name: buyer_email
attributes.description: Email address of the buyer for supplier communication and clarification requests. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement specialist or buyer who created and is managing this RFQ. Business reference, not direct PII.

attributes.name: buyer_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the buyer for urgent supplier inquiries. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Used for precise chemical identification in procurement and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the RFQ was closed (either awarded or cancelled). Marks the end of the RFQ lifecycle. Null if still open.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Contract or framework agreement number if the RFQ resulted in a long-term supply agreement. Null for spot purchases.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFQ record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY). Suppliers must quote prices in this currency.

attributes.name: delivery_address
attributes.description: Full physical address where the material should be delivered, including street, city, state, postal code, and country. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: delivery_plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing plant or warehouse where the material should be delivered. Links to plant master data.

attributes.name: evaluation_criteria
attributes.description: Detailed criteria that will be used to evaluate and compare supplier quotations, such as price (weight 40%), lead time (20%), quality certifications (20%), payment terms (10%), supplier track record (10%). May include scoring methodology.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Standard trade terms defining responsibilities for shipping, insurance, and risk transfer between buyer and seller. Examples: EXW (Ex Works), FOB (Free on Board), CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the RFQ was officially issued and sent to suppliers. Marks the start of the quotation solicitation period.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: Internal material master code for the chemical or raw material being sourced. Links to material master data in SAP MM.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the chemical material being sourced, including grade, purity, form (liquid, powder, granular), and any special specifications.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Short Text

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that suppliers must be willing to supply. Used to filter suppliers who cannot meet minimum volume requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RFQ record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, special requirements, clarifications, or internal notes related to the RFQ process.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms requested from suppliers, such as Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days, otherwise net 30 days), or advance payment requirements.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number generated after RFQ award. Links the RFQ to the resulting procurement transaction. Null if no PO has been created yet.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the buyer or procurement team responsible for this RFQ. Used for workload distribution and accountability.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Links to organizational hierarchy in SAP MM.

attributes.name: quality_requirements
attributes.description: Quality standards and certifications required from suppliers, such as ISO 9001, GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), REACH compliance, specific test methods, and Certificate of Analysis (COA) requirements.

attributes.name: reach_compliance_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material must comply with EU REACH regulation. True if REACH compliance documentation is mandatory, False if not applicable (e.g., non-EU supply).

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material requested in the RFQ. Used by suppliers to calculate pricing and assess capacity to fulfill the order.

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the material must be delivered to the plant. Used to evaluate supplier lead times and logistics capabilities.

attributes.name: response_count
attributes.description: Number of quotation responses received from suppliers. Used to calculate response rate and assess market interest.

attributes.name: rfq_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the RFQ, externally visible to suppliers and internal procurement teams. Typically follows format RFQ-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.

attributes.name: rfq_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RFQ: draft (being prepared), issued (sent to suppliers), open (accepting responses), under_evaluation (responses being reviewed), awarded (supplier selected), closed (process complete), cancelled (RFQ withdrawn). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|open|under_evaluation|awarded|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rfq_type
attributes.description: Classification of the RFQ based on procurement strategy: spot buy for one-time purchases, annual contract bid for long-term agreements, emergency source for urgent needs, framework agreement for multi-year supply, trial order for new supplier evaluation, bulk purchase for volume discounts.

attributes.name: sds_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppliers must provide a current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) compliant with GHS (Globally Harmonized System) standards with their quotation. True if SDS is mandatory, False if not required.

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: Date and time by which suppliers must submit their quotation responses. Late submissions may be rejected or evaluated separately.

attributes.name: supplier_count
attributes.description: Number of suppliers to whom this RFQ was sent. Used to track competitive bidding scope and response rate analysis.

attributes.name: technical_specifications
attributes.description: Detailed technical requirements for the material including purity levels, physical properties, packaging requirements, shelf life, storage conditions, and any industry-specific quality standards (GMP, ISO, REACH compliance).

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material must be listed on the EPA TSCA inventory for use in the United States. True if TSCA compliance is mandatory, False if not applicable.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the requested quantity: KG (kilogram), MT (metric ton), L (liter), GAL (gallon), LB (pound), TON (ton), M3 (cubic meter), DRUM, IBC (intermediate bulk container), BAG. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|L|GAL|LB|TON|M3|DRUM|IBC|BAG — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: rfq_response
products.description: Vendor quotation submitted in response to an RFQ for chemical raw materials or services. Captures response number, vendor, RFQ reference, quoted price, price validity period, quoted lead time, MOQ, payment terms, incoterms, technical compliance notes, SDS availability confirmation, REACH compliance statement, and response status (submitted, under evaluation, accepted, rejected). Supports competitive bid analysis and supplier selection.
products.reference: SAP MM Vendor Quotation (EKKO type AN response)

attributes.name: rfq_response_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor quotation response submitted in reply to a chemical raw material or service RFQ.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating RFQ document that this response addresses.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor submitting this quotation response.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the procurement team formally accepted the quotation response and selected the vendor for award.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS registry number uniquely identifying the chemical substance being quoted, in format XXXXXX-XX-X.

attributes.name: coa_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor will provide a Certificate of Analysis with each shipment documenting quality test results.

attributes.name: coc_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor will provide a Certificate of Compliance documenting regulatory and specification adherence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this RFQ response record was first created in the procurement system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the quoted price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Named location or address where the vendor will deliver the chemical materials as specified in the Incoterms.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Internal procurement team notes documenting the evaluation rationale, strengths, weaknesses, and decision factors for this response.

attributes.name: evaluation_score
attributes.description: Composite score assigned by the procurement team during competitive bid analysis, based on price, quality, lead time, and compliance factors.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP) per ICC standards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this RFQ response record was last updated, tracking changes to status, evaluation, or vendor revisions.

attributes.name: material_grade
attributes.description: Grade or quality specification of the chemical material being quoted (e.g., technical grade, pharmaceutical grade, food grade, reagent grade).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered for the vendor to accept the purchase order at the quoted price.

attributes.name: moq_unit_of_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity (e.g., kilogram, liter, drum, pallet).

attributes.name: packaging_size
attributes.description: Size or capacity of the packaging unit (e.g., 200L drum, 1000L IBC, 25kg bag).

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging in which the chemical material will be delivered (e.g., drum, IBC tote, bulk tanker, bag, cylinder).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms proposed by the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30, advance payment, letter of credit).

attributes.name: price_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quoted price (e.g., per kilogram, per liter, per metric ton, per drum).

attributes.name: price_validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date until which the quoted price remains valid, after which the vendor may revise pricing.

attributes.name: price_validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the quoted price becomes valid and can be applied to purchase orders.

attributes.name: purity_percentage
attributes.description: Guaranteed minimum purity of the chemical material expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.5% purity).

attributes.name: quoted_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from purchase order placement to delivery, as committed by the vendor.

attributes.name: quoted_price
attributes.description: Unit price quoted by the vendor for the requested chemical raw material or service.

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has confirmed that the quoted chemical material complies with EU REACH regulation.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the quotation response was rejected (e.g., non-competitive pricing, non-compliance, excessive lead time).

attributes.name: response_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the vendor quotation response, typically assigned by the vendor or procurement system.

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RFQ response in the procurement evaluation workflow.

attributes.name: sds_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has confirmed availability of a current Safety Data Sheet for the quoted chemical material.

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Guaranteed shelf life of the chemical material from manufacturing date, expressed in months.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor submitted the quotation response to the procurement team.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the vendor submitted the quotation response, used for deadline compliance verification.

attributes.name: technical_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Vendor notes addressing technical specifications, quality standards, and compliance with RFQ requirements.

attributes.name: tsca_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has confirmed that the quoted chemical material is listed on the TSCA inventory for US market.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the vendor representative for correspondence regarding this quotation response.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the vendor representative who submitted the quotation and serves as the primary contact for this response.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the vendor representative for direct communication regarding this quotation response.

products.name: contract
products.description: Long-term supply agreements, blanket purchase agreements, and scheduling agreements with chemical raw material suppliers. Captures contract number, type (quantity contract, value contract, scheduling agreement), vendor, material, validity period, total value, volume commitment, MOQ, delivery frequency, quality specifications, force majeure terms, and contract status. Includes all contracted pricing conditions (price scales, surcharges, discounts, escalation clauses, condition types, price determination sequences), and scheduling agreement delivery schedule lines (planned delivery dates, quantities, cumulative receipts, forecast vs. firm categories). Single source of truth for all long-term vendor commercial arrangements, their pricing, and delivery schedules. Integrates with SAP MM ME31K, condition records (KONP/KONH), and scheduling agreement transactions.
products.reference: SAP MM Outline Agreement / Contract (EKKO type MK/WK)

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Primary key for contract

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Vendor contracts are negotiated per customer account; contract management dashboards need this link.

attributes.name: contract_material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to rawmaterial.material_master

attributes.name: contract_material_material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to rawmaterial.material_master

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Vendor contracts are tied to the originating sales opportunity for revenue attribution and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: CONTRACT MGMT: Ownership of a contract is assigned to a procurement employee; needed for contract performance dashboards.

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_list. Business justification: Contract pricing process requires linking each vendor contract to the agreed price list for accurate cost calculation.

attributes.name: primary_contract_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary chemical raw material or product covered by this contract. For multi-material contracts, this represents the primary or representative material.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Supply contracts are often scoped to a specific research project; linking enables contract‑project compliance reporting.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical supplier or raw material vendor party with whom this contract is established.

attributes.name: vendor_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific vendor location or plant from which materials will be supplied under this contract.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was formally approved by authorized signatories and became legally binding.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive or manager who provided final approval for this contract.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews for another term if not explicitly terminated before the end date. True = auto-renews, False = expires at end date.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance described in the open scientific literature. Used for regulatory compliance and material identification.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code in SAP FI/CO that owns this contract for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the contract. Used in SAP MM ME31K and across procurement documents.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contract: draft (being prepared), pending approval (awaiting authorization), active (in force), suspended (temporarily halted), expired (validity period ended), terminated (ended early), or closed (completed and archived). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|expired|terminated|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract arrangement: quantity contract (fixed volume), value contract (fixed spend), scheduling agreement (delivery schedule), blanket purchase agreement (BPA), framework agreement, or spot contract.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: delivery_frequency
attributes.description: Planned frequency of material deliveries under this contract: daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, on-demand (as needed), or just-in-time (JIT synchronized with production). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|biweekly|monthly|quarterly|on_demand|just_in_time — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: force_majeure_terms
attributes.description: Contractual provisions defining events beyond parties control (natural disasters, war, pandemics, regulatory changes) that excuse performance obligations without penalty.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standardized trade terms defining responsibilities for shipping, insurance, and risk transfer between buyer and seller (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Incoterms 2020 standard. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms clause (e.g., Houston TX, Rotterdam Port). Defines the point where risk and cost transfer occurs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in calendar days from order placement to delivery. Used for MRP planning and scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master - Purchasing View

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered per purchase order or delivery schedule line. Used to manage supplier capacity constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered per purchase order or delivery schedule line under this contract. Enforces supplier minimum batch requirements.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Agreed payment terms and conditions (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). SAP payment terms key.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility for which this contract supplies materials. Four-character SAP plant code.

attributes.name: price_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contracted price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: price_escalation_clause
attributes.description: Description of price adjustment mechanism tied to market indices, inflation rates, or raw material cost changes (e.g., quarterly adjustment based on PPI Chemical Index).

attributes.name: price_per_unit
attributes.description: Base contracted price per unit of measure. For contracts with price scales or condition-based pricing, this represents the baseline or reference price.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity unit for which the price is specified (e.g., price per 1, per 100, per 1000 units). Used in SAP pricing to handle fractional pricing.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for managing this contract. Typically a three-character code in SAP MM.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit responsible for procurement activities and contract negotiation. Typically a four-character code.

attributes.name: quality_specification
attributes.description: Reference to quality standards, specifications, or Certificate of Analysis (COA) requirements that the supplied material must meet (e.g., purity >= 99.5%, pH 7.0-7.5, meets ASTM D1234).

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, GAL for gallons).

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for each automatic renewal period if auto-renewal is enabled.

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: Total volume or quantity of material committed under this contract. Applicable for quantity contracts and scheduling agreements.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance notice required to terminate the contract early. Protects both parties from abrupt contract cancellation.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract expires or terminates. Nullable for open-ended contracts. After this date, contract terms no longer apply unless renewed.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the contract becomes legally binding and effective. Contract terms apply from this date forward.

attributes.name: value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value committed under this contract. For value contracts, this is the maximum spend limit. For quantity contracts, this is the estimated total value based on contracted volumes and prices.

attributes.name: value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

products.name: contract_price
products.description: Contracted pricing conditions and price scales negotiated with chemical suppliers under supply contracts or info records. Captures condition type, material, vendor, plant, validity period, base price, price unit, currency, quantity scale breaks, surcharges (freight, hazmat handling), discounts, and price determination sequence. products.reference: SAP MM Purchasing Info Record / Condition Record (EINA/EINE/KONP)

attributes.name: contract_price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract price record. Primary key for the contract price entity.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical material or raw material covered by this contract price. Links to material master data.

attributes.name: negotiated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: PRICING AUDIT: Price negotiations are performed by a specific employee; linking supports pricing compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.contract

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical supplier or vendor providing the contracted pricing. Links to vendor master data.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the contract price. Indicates whether the price has been reviewed and authorized by procurement management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the procurement manager or authorized approver who approved this contract price.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract price was formally approved and authorized for use in purchase orders.

attributes.name: calculation_type
attributes.description: Method for calculating the condition value: percentage (e.g., 5% discount), fixed amount per unit, or absolute amount per order.

attributes.name: condition_class
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing condition into business categories: base price, surcharge (e.g., hazmat handling), discount, freight, tax, or other adjustments.

attributes.name: condition_record_number
attributes.description: SAP MM condition record number (KNUMH) that uniquely identifies the pricing condition in the source system. Business identifier for the contract price.

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: SAP condition type code that classifies the pricing element (e.g., PB00 for gross price, FRA1 for freight, SKTO for cash discount). Determines how the price is applied in purchase order calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the contract price record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Defines the monetary unit of the price amount.

attributes.name: freight_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether freight and transportation costs are included in the contract price or billed separately.

attributes.name: hazmat_surcharge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price includes or is subject to a hazardous material handling surcharge due to the chemical nature of the material.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP). Impacts freight and insurance pricing components.

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms agreement (e.g., Houston Port, Vendor Warehouse). Clarifies the point of delivery or risk transfer.

attributes.name: info_record_number
attributes.description: SAP purchasing info record number that stores vendor-material pricing and procurement data. Alternative to contract-based pricing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the contract price record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum order quantity allowed under this contract price. Orders exceeding this limit may require renegotiation or different pricing.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required to qualify for this contract price. Orders below this threshold may not receive the contracted rate.

attributes.name: negotiation_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract price was negotiated and agreed upon with the vendor.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code defining the payment schedule and discount conditions (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Influences cash discount calculations.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code where this contract price is applicable. May be blank for company-wide pricing agreements.

attributes.name: price_amount
attributes.description: The contracted price value or rate for the material. Represents the base price, surcharge, or discount amount depending on condition type.

attributes.name: price_change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason code for the price change or new pricing condition (e.g., raw material cost increase, volume commitment, market adjustment).

attributes.name: price_determination_rule
attributes.description: Rule or logic used to determine the final price when multiple condition records exist (e.g., most specific, lowest price, highest discount). Governs price selection in purchase orders.

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: Origin of the contract price: contract (formal supply agreement), info record (vendor-material record), quotation (RFQ response), catalog (vendor price list), or manual entry.

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contract price: active (in use), inactive (disabled), pending (awaiting approval), expired (past validity), or superseded (replaced by newer price).

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity unit for which the price amount applies (e.g., price per 1 unit, per 100 units, per 1000 kg). Used to normalize pricing across different order quantities.

attributes.name: pricing_sequence
attributes.description: Order of application in the pricing procedure. Lower numbers are applied first. Determines the sequence of price calculations, surcharges, and discounts.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities under this contract price. Defines the scope of the pricing agreement.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_from
attributes.description: Lower bound of the quantity scale break for tiered pricing. Defines the minimum order quantity for this price tier. Null for non-scaled pricing.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_to
attributes.description: Upper bound of the quantity scale break for tiered pricing. Defines the maximum order quantity for this price tier. Null for open-ended top tier.

attributes.name: scale_type
attributes.description: Type of scale pricing applied: quantity-based (volume discounts), value-based (order value thresholds), or none for flat pricing.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code or tax type applicable to this contract price (e.g., sales tax, VAT, excise tax). Used for tax calculation in purchase orders.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the material quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, GAL for gallons). Aligns with material master UOM.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the contract price validity period. The price becomes effective on this date.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the contract price validity period. The price expires after this date. May be open-ended (null) for indefinite agreements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date

attributes.name: evaluation_status

attributes.name: last_audit_date

attributes.name: lead_time_adherence_pct

attributes.name: packaging_compliance_rate_pct

attributes.name: sds_compliance_rate_pct

attributes.description: Total monetary value of all purchase orders issued to this vendor during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: tsca_compliance_status

attributes.description: Vendor compliance status with US EPA TSCA requirements for chemical substance inventory and reporting.

products.name: vendor_qualification
products.description: Comprehensive supplier qualification, audit, and compliance documentation lifecycle for chemical vendors. Covers formal qualification assessments (initial, periodic, for-cause), on-site and remote audit records (quality, EHS, PSM, GMP) with findings by severity and audit ratings, and the full repository of compliance documents (SDS, COA, COC, REACH dossiers, TSCA certifications, ISO/GMP certificates, Responsible Care attestations). Captures qualification status, audit scores, document versions and expiry dates, CAPA requirements from audits, lead auditor assignments, and document validity. Single source of truth for 'is this vendor approved, what audits have been conducted, and what evidence supports that decision.' Prerequisite for issuing POs to new suppliers.
