attributes.name: affected_supply_lane
attributes.description: Identification of the specific supply lane or transportation route affected by this risk (e.g., 'China-to-USA West Coast', 'Rotterdam-to-Antwerp rail', 'Gulf Coast LTL network'), used for logistics disruption risk tracking.

attributes.name: annual_spend_at_risk_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Spend at Risk in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total annual procurement spend (in USD) associated with the affected vendor or material that is exposed to this supply risk, used for financial impact assessment and prioritization.
attributes.references: FASB Accounting Standards, SAP MM Purchasing

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent risk assessment (severity, probability, score) was performed, following yyyy-MM-dd format. Used to track assessment currency and trigger periodic reviews.

attributes.name: business_impact_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the potential business impact if the supply risk materializes, including effects on production schedules, customer commitments, revenue, market share, and strategic objectives.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply risk record was first created in the system, following yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply risk was escalated to senior management or executive leadership, following yyyy-MM-dd format. Null if no escalation has occurred.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this supply risk requires escalation to senior management or executive leadership due to severity, financial exposure, or strategic importance.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External reference identifier linking this supply risk to related records in other systems (e.g., RFQ number, contract ID, incident ticket number, audit finding ID), enabling cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) where the supply risk originates or has primary impact (e.g., CHN for China, USA for United States, DEU for Germany), used for geopolitical and logistics risk analysis.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply risk was first identified and recorded in the risk management system, following yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: lead_time_buffer_days
attributes.description: Additional lead time buffer (in days) recommended for procurement planning to account for potential delays or disruptions associated with this supply risk.

attributes.name: mitigation_actual_date
attributes.description: Actual date when mitigation actions were completed and risk status changed to mitigated, following yyyy-MM-dd format. Null if mitigation is not yet complete.

attributes.name: mitigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when mitigation actions were initiated for this supply risk, following yyyy-MM-dd format. Null if no mitigation has been started.

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Detailed description of the mitigation actions and strategies planned or implemented to reduce the likelihood or impact of the supply risk (e.g., dual-sourcing, safety stock increase, contract renegotiation, supplier development program, alternative material qualification).

attributes.name: mitigation_target_date
attributes.description: Target date by which mitigation actions are planned to be completed and risk reduced to acceptable levels, following yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supply risk record was last updated or modified, following yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the next periodic review of this supply risk is scheduled, following yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for proactive risk monitoring and governance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or context related to the supply risk assessment, mitigation progress, stakeholder communications, or lessons learned.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Identification of the specific regulatory framework or compliance requirement associated with this risk (e.g., REACH, TSCA, GHS, EPA, OSHA), particularly relevant for regulatory/compliance category risks.

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency (in days) for periodic review and reassessment of this supply risk. Critical risks typically reviewed more frequently (e.g., 30 days) than low risks (e.g., 180 days).

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the supply risk type. Categories include single-source dependency (sole supplier risk), geopolitical (trade restrictions, sanctions, political instability), regulatory/REACH (compliance and registration risks under REACH and other chemical regulations), raw material scarcity (limited availability or depletion), financial instability (vendor bankruptcy or credit risk), natural disaster (weather events, earthquakes, floods affecting supply), and logistics disruption (transportation, port, or infrastructure failures). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_source_dependency|geopolitical|regulatory_reach|raw_material_scarcity|financial_instability|natural_disaster|logistics_disruption — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive narrative description of the supply risk, including background, potential impact on operations, affected products or production lines, and any relevant context for stakeholders.

attributes.name: risk_exposure_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Exposure Value in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Estimated financial exposure or potential loss in USD if the risk materializes, calculated based on affected material spend, production value at risk, or revenue impact.

attributes.name: risk_identifier
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the supply risk record, following the pattern SRISK-NNNNNNNN for external communication and tracking.

attributes.name: risk_probability
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the likelihood that the risk event will occur within the assessment time horizon. Very high (>75% probability), high (50-75%), medium (25-50%), low (10-25%), very low (<10%).

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score calculated from severity and probability assessments, typically on a scale of 0-100, used for prioritization and risk ranking across the supply portfolio.

attributes.name: risk_severity
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the potential impact severity if the risk materializes. Critical indicates potential production shutdown or major revenue loss; high indicates significant operational disruption; medium indicates manageable impact with workarounds; low indicates minimal operational impact.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply risk. Open indicates newly identified and under assessment; in_mitigation indicates active mitigation actions in progress; mitigated indicates risk has been successfully reduced to acceptable levels; accepted indicates risk acknowledged but no further action planned; closed indicates risk no longer applicable or threat has passed.

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity within the primary risk category (e.g., under geopolitical: trade_embargo, sanctions, border_closure; under regulatory: REACH_authorization, TSCA_restriction, GHS_reclassification).

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title summarizing the supply risk for quick identification and reporting (e.g., 'Single-source TiO2 supplier capacity constraint', 'REACH authorization deadline for Substance X').

attributes.name: safety_stock_recommendation_qty
attributes.description: Recommended additional safety stock quantity (in base unit of measure) to buffer against supply disruption risk, calculated based on lead time variability, demand volatility, and risk severity.

attributes.name: safety_stock_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the safety stock recommendation quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, EA for each), aligned with material master base UOM.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identification of the operational system where this supply risk record originated (e.g., SAP MM, Oracle TMS, Intelex EHS, custom risk management application), used for data lineage and integration tracking.

products.name: supply_procurement_plan
products.description: Forward-looking procurement planning records translating MRP-generated requirements, safety stock replenishment triggers, and campaign production schedules into actionable material procurement schedules. Captures plan ID, planning horizon (weekly/monthly/quarterly), material and CAS number, plant, planned procurement quantity, planned order date, planned delivery date, source of supply (vendor or intercompany), procurement type, lead time buffer for hazmat transport, planner assignment, and plan status. Critical for managing long lead-time specialty chemical orders and seasonal raw material availability. Integrates with SAP PP/MM MRP run outputs (MD04/MD07).
products.reference: SAP MM/PP Planned Order / Purchase Requisition (PLAF/EBAN)

attributes.name: supply_procurement_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the procurement plan record. Primary key for the procurement planning entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Procurement plans are created for specific customer accounts; budgeting and demand‑supply alignment reports depend on it.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production campaign or batch manufacturing schedule that drives this procurement requirement for campaign-based planning.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Procurement plans are tied to cost centers to align planned spend with financial budgeting and control.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where the procured material will be delivered and consumed.

attributes.name: primary_supply_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement planner or buyer responsible for executing this procurement plan and managing supplier relationships.

attributes.name: primary_supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the chemical raw material, intermediate, or finished good being procured.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Procurement planning per project requires each plan to be tied to the research project it supports.

attributes.name: tertiary_supply_planner_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor master record from whom the material will be procured, applicable for external vendor sourcing.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the procurement plan was formally approved for execution by authorized personnel.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement plan requires management approval before execution due to value thresholds, strategic importance, or policy requirements.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance, used for regulatory compliance and material identification.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master purchasing contract or blanket agreement under which this procurement will be executed, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this procurement plan record was first created in the system, capturing the initial planning event.

attributes.name: estimated_unit_price
attributes.description: The estimated or planned unit price for the material based on contract pricing, historical purchases, or market intelligence, used for budget planning.

attributes.name: hazmat_transport_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material being procured is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, documentation, and transport compliance per DOT/IATA regulations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this procurement plan record was last updated, reflecting the most recent planning adjustment or status change.

attributes.name: lead_time_buffer_days
attributes.description: Additional buffer time in days added to standard lead time to account for hazmat transport delays, customs clearance, quality inspection, or supply chain variability.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The standard procurement lead time in calendar days from order placement to delivery, based on vendor agreements and historical performance.

attributes.name: long_lead_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is classified as a long lead-time specialty chemical requiring extended procurement planning horizons (typically greater than 90 days).

attributes.name: mrp_element
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP MRP element (planned order, production order, or sales order) that generated this procurement requirement via MRP run (MD04/MD07).

attributes.name: mrp_run_date
attributes.description: The date when the MRP calculation was executed that generated this procurement plan requirement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planners to capture special instructions, supplier constraints, quality requirements, or other contextual information relevant to procurement execution.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the procurement plan, externally visible and used for cross-system reference and communication with procurement teams.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the procurement plan indicating its progression from draft through execution to completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|APPROVED|IN_EXECUTION|PARTIALLY_FULFILLED|COMPLETED|CANCELLED|ON_HOLD — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement plan based on the triggering mechanism: MRP-driven requirements, safety stock replenishment, campaign production schedules, spot purchases, strategic sourcing initiatives, or consignment stock replenishment.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: The target date when the material is expected to be delivered to the receiving plant or warehouse location.

attributes.name: planned_order_date
attributes.description: The target date when the purchase order or procurement request should be created and released to the supplier to meet delivery requirements.

attributes.name: planned_procurement_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material planned to be procured in this plan record, expressed in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: planning_horizon
attributes.description: Time period scope for the procurement plan, defining whether it covers weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, rolling 12-month, or campaign-specific planning cycles.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the manufacturing plant or distribution center receiving the material.

attributes.name: price_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated unit price and total planned value.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority classification for the procurement plan indicating urgency and importance for execution: critical for production-critical materials, high for near-term requirements, normal for standard planning, low for long-term strategic sourcing.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: The procurement method to be used for this plan: standard purchase order, blanket order release, contract release, spot buy, emergency procurement, or stock transfer order.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the purchasing group or procurement team responsible for this material category or commodity.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the purchasing organization or procurement entity responsible for negotiating and executing this procurement.

attributes.name: safety_stock_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement plan was triggered by safety stock replenishment logic due to inventory falling below minimum stock levels.

attributes.name: seasonal_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material has seasonal availability constraints requiring advance procurement planning and inventory build-up strategies.

attributes.name: source_of_supply
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement source indicating whether material will be sourced from external vendors, intercompany transfers, toll manufacturing arrangements, consignment stock, or contract manufacturers.

attributes.name: supply_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of supply chain risk for this material based on supplier concentration, geopolitical factors, market volatility, and availability constraints.

attributes.name: total_planned_value
attributes.description: The total estimated monetary value of this procurement plan calculated as planned quantity multiplied by estimated unit price, used for budget allocation and spend forecasting.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport classification, required for shipping documentation and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the planned procurement quantity, typically kilograms, metric tons, liters, gallons, or container units for chemical materials. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|L|GAL|LB|TON|M3|DRUM|IBC|BAG — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: purchase_requisition
products.description: Internal procurement request records and forward-looking procurement planning covering the full demand-to-sourcing lifecycle. Captures requisition number, type, requesting plant/cost center, material/CAS number, required quantity, delivery date, preferred vendor, estimated price, approval status, and PO conversion status. Also encompasses MRP-generated planned procurement schedules: planning horizons (weekly/monthly/quarterly), planned quantities and dates, source of supply assignments, procurement types, lead time buffers for hazmat transport, planner assignments, safety stock triggers, and campaign production schedule alignment. Integrates with SAP MM ME51N/ME52N and MRP outputs (MD04/MD07).

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase requisition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Procurement creates purchase requisitions to fulfill a specific sales opportunity, enabling end‑to‑end order‑to‑cash traceability.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred or suggested vendor for sourcing this requisition, if specified by the requester.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Requisition budgeting and approval workflows reference the research project that initiates the request.

attributes.name: requester_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUISITION: The employee who raises a requisition must be recorded for traceability and spend analysis.

attributes.name: rfq_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.rfq. Business justification: Link purchase requisition to its originating RFQ to give RFQ an inbound relationship and enable traceability from requisition to request for quotation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the requisition was approved by the authorized approver.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the requisition in the multi-level approval workflow.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the manager or authorized person who approved or rejected the requisition.

attributes.name: campaign_production_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition is aligned with a campaign production schedule for batch manufacturing.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance, used for regulatory compliance and material identification.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which the procurement expense will be charged for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the estimated price and total value.

attributes.name: estimated_total_value
attributes.description: Total estimated value of the requisition calculated as quantity multiplied by estimated unit price.

attributes.name: estimated_unit_price
attributes.description: Estimated price per unit of the material or service at the time of requisition creation.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification code for the chemical material being requisitioned, used for safety and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for financial posting of the procurement expense.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the requisitioned material is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, transport, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the requisition record, capturing any changes to status, quantities, or other fields.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of days from requisition approval to material delivery, including hazmat transport buffers if applicable.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material or service being requisitioned.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material being requisitioned, referencing the material master.

attributes.name: mrp_element
attributes.description: Type of MRP element that generated or is associated with this requisition in the planning run.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions provided by the requester regarding material specifications, delivery requirements, or other procurement considerations.

attributes.name: planner_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP planner or buyer responsible for managing procurement of this material.

attributes.name: planning_horizon
attributes.description: Time bucket granularity for forward-looking procurement planning associated with this requisition.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing or distribution plant where the material or service is required.

attributes.name: po_conversion_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the requisition has been converted to one or more purchase orders.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number generated from this requisition, if conversion has occurred.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the requisition to guide procurement sequencing and expediting decisions.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Classification of procurement purpose: stock replenishment, direct consumption, asset acquisition, or project-specific procurement.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities related to this requisition.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service being requested in the requisition.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested material or service is required at the destination.

attributes.name: requester_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the requisition requester for clarifications and follow-up.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the purchase requisition, externally visible and used in procurement workflows.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the requisition in the approval and conversion workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|partially_converted|fully_converted|cancelled|closed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requisition based on procurement scenario: standard purchase, subcontracting, consignment, stock transfer, service procurement, or third-party order.

attributes.name: safety_stock_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition was triggered by safety stock replenishment logic in MRP.

attributes.name: source_of_supply
attributes.description: Planned source type for fulfilling the requisition: external procurement from vendor, internal stock transfer, subcontracting, or consignment.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location within the plant where the material will be received.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the requisitioned quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, EA for each).

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was originally created in the system.

products.name: source_list
products.description: Approved source list defining which vendors are authorized to supply specific raw materials or chemicals to specific plants during defined validity periods. Captures material, plant, vendor, purchasing organization, validity start and end dates, fixed source flag, MRP relevance, agreement reference (contract or scheduling agreement), and source list status. Enforces approved vendor list (AVL) compliance and drives automatic source determination in SAP MM.

attributes.name: source_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the source list record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material or chemical product that this source list entry applies to. Links to the material master data.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved supplier or vendor authorized to supply this material to the specified plant.

attributes.name: agreement_item
attributes.description: The line item number within the referenced contract or scheduling agreement that applies to this material-vendor-plant combination.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: The document number of the contract or scheduling agreement that this source list entry references. Null if no formal agreement exists.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: The type of purchasing agreement that governs this source list entry. Indicates whether a formal contract or scheduling agreement is in place.

attributes.name: avl_status
attributes.description: The current status of this vendor on the Approved Vendor List for the material-plant combination. Enforces procurement compliance and quality standards.

attributes.name: blocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this source list entry is temporarily blocked from use in procurement. Used to suspend a vendor without deleting the source list record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this source list entry was created in the system. Part of the audit trail for source list management.

attributes.name: fixed_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the mandatory (fixed) source for the material-plant combination. When true, procurement must use this vendor exclusively during the validity period.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: The International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) that govern the delivery and risk transfer for shipments from this vendor. Examples: EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP.

attributes.name: incoterm_location
attributes.description: The specific location (port, warehouse, plant) associated with the Incoterm for this source list entry. Clarifies the point of delivery or risk transfer.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this source list entry. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this source list entry was last modified. Tracks the currency of the source list data.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent purchase order issued to this vendor for this material-plant combination. Used to track vendor activity and source list currency.

attributes.name: last_qualification_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor was last qualified or re-qualified for supplying this material. Used to track qualification currency and trigger re-qualification cycles.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The standard procurement lead time in days from this vendor for the material-plant combination. Used in MRP planning and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The business identifier (SKU or material code) for the raw material or chemical. Denormalized for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity that the vendor requires for this material. Enforces vendor-specific ordering constraints in procurement.

attributes.name: mrp_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this source list entry is considered during MRP runs for automatic source determination and purchase requisition generation.

attributes.name: next_qualification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the vendor must be re-qualified for this material. Supports proactive supplier management and compliance with AVL (Approved Vendor List) policies.

attributes.name: order_quantity_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the minimum order quantity and standard ordering unit for this material from this vendor.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or facility to which this approved source applies. Defines the scope of the source list entry.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the preferred source for the material-plant combination when multiple approved sources exist. Used to guide procurement decisions.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: The organizational unit responsible for procurement activities for this source list entry. Defines procurement authority and scope.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: The current qualification status of the vendor for supplying this material. Reflects the outcome of supplier audits, quality assessments, and compliance reviews.

attributes.name: record
attributes.description: The sequential record number within the source list for the material-plant combination. Used for ordering and identification within SAP MM.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: The supply risk rating for this vendor-material-plant combination. Reflects factors such as vendor financial stability, geopolitical risk, quality history, and supply chain disruption potential.

attributes.name: source_list_category
attributes.description: The procurement category or special procurement type that this source list entry supports. Distinguishes between regular purchasing, subcontracting, consignment, and pipeline scenarios.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The start date from which this vendor is approved to supply the material to the plant. Part of the validity period for the source list entry.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The end date until which this vendor is approved to supply the material. Null or far-future date indicates open-ended approval.

attributes.name: vendor_priority
attributes.description: The priority ranking of this vendor for the material-plant combination when multiple approved sources exist. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for automatic source determination.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this source list entry. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: inbound_delivery
products.description: Inbound logistics delivery record tracking the physical movement of raw materials and chemicals from vendor to plant, coordinated with Oracle Transportation Management. Captures delivery number, vendor, carrier, origin location, destination plant and storage location, scheduled arrival date/time, actual arrival date/time, transport mode (road tanker, rail, sea container, pipeline), hazmat transport document number (DOT), temperature-controlled flag, seal number, and delivery status. Links ASN to goods receipt.
products.reference: SAP EWM / Oracle TMS Inbound Shipment

attributes.name: inbound_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inbound delivery record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: asn_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Advanced Shipping Notice that preceded this delivery. Links the physical delivery to the electronic notification sent by the vendor.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for moving the materials from vendor to plant. May be third-party logistics provider or vendor-managed transport.

attributes.name: customer_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Inbound logistics must know which customer site receives the delivery; used in ETA and dock scheduling reports.

attributes.name: lab_experiment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.lab_experiment. Business justification: Delivery execution teams need to know which lab experiment the inbound delivery supports for traceability.

attributes.name: manufacturing_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.manufacturing_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Receiving reports tie each inbound delivery to the specific manufacturing order that consumes the delivered material.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Required for inbound delivery tracking per material to reconcile receipts, support inventory and regulatory compliance reports.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that authorized this delivery. Links delivery to procurement transaction.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the chemical supplier or vendor shipping the materials. Links to vendor master data.

attributes.name: vendor_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific vendor site or facility from which the materials are being shipped. Origin location for the delivery.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date the delivery arrived at the destination plant gate or receiving dock. Used for on-time delivery performance measurement.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the delivery arrived at the destination plant, including time zone. Captured by gate systems or receiving personnel.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of lading number issued by the carrier. Legal document serving as receipt of goods and contract of carriage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inbound delivery record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the inbound delivery, typically generated by Oracle Transportation Management or SAP EWM. Externally visible tracking number used across systems and by vendors.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inbound delivery. Tracks progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_transit|arrived|unloading|completed|cancelled|delayed|rejected — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: destination_plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the receiving chemical manufacturing plant or facility. Corresponds to SAP plant master data.

attributes.name: destination_storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location code within the destination plant where materials will be received. May reference tank farm, warehouse zone, or hazmat storage area.

attributes.name: dot_hazmat_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazardous Material Document Number
attributes.description: DOT-required shipping document number for hazardous materials transport. Must accompany hazmat shipments and be available for inspection.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR 172 - Hazardous Materials Table and Communications

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost for this delivery in the specified currency. May be vendor-paid or buyer-paid depending on Incoterm.

attributes.name: freight_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for freight cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_class
attributes.description: GHS classification of the primary hazard class for materials in this delivery (e.g., flammable liquids, corrosive substances, toxic materials).
attributes.references: GHS - Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the goods receipt was posted in SAP, confirming materials have been received into inventory. May differ from actual arrival date.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: SAP goods receipt document number created when materials are physically received and posted to inventory. Links delivery to inventory transaction.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the delivery including materials, packaging, and transport container, measured in kilograms. Used for freight billing and load planning.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 - Quantities and Units of Space and Time

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the delivery contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, documentation, and compliance with DOT and EPA regulations.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Incoterm defining the division of costs and risks between vendor and buyer for this delivery. Determines responsibility for freight, insurance, and customs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: SAP QM inspection lot number created for quality testing of received materials. Links delivery to quality control process.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inbound delivery record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking changes to delivery status and attributes.

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the actual chemical materials excluding packaging and container, measured in kilograms. Used for inventory valuation and goods receipt.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 - Quantities and Units of Space and Time

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special instructions, exceptions, incidents, or observations related to this delivery. Used for communication between logistics, receiving, and quality teams.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming materials require quality inspection before release to unrestricted inventory. Triggers QM inspection lot creation.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejecting the delivery if materials do not meet quality standards, documentation is incomplete, or delivery conditions are violated. Free-text field for detailed explanation.

attributes.name: required_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in Celsius that must not be exceeded during transport to prevent material degradation or safety hazards.

attributes.name: required_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in Celsius that must be maintained during transport to preserve material integrity. Applies to temperature-sensitive chemicals.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the delivery to arrive at the destination plant. Used for production planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_time
attributes.description: Planned date and time for the delivery to arrive at the destination plant, including time zone. Precise timing critical for dock scheduling and unloading crew coordination.

attributes.name: seal_intact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the security seal was found intact upon arrival at the destination. Broken seals trigger investigation and potential rejection.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number applied to the transport container or tanker. Used to verify container integrity and detect tampering during transit.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery requires temperature-controlled transport to maintain material stability and quality. Critical for temperature-sensitive chemicals.

attributes.name: transport_equipment_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific transport equipment used (tanker truck number, rail car number, container number). Used for tracking and safety audits.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Method of transportation used for the delivery. Critical for chemical logistics planning and hazmat compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: road_tanker|rail_car|sea_container|pipeline|bulk_truck|iso_tank|flexitank — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials being transported. Required for DOT compliance and emergency response.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: volume_liters
attributes.description: Total volume of liquid or bulk materials in the delivery, measured in liters. Critical for tank capacity planning and material balance.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 - Quantities and Units of Space and Time

products.name: invoice_verification
products.description: Three-way match verification records reconciling vendor invoices against purchase orders and goods receipts for chemical raw material purchases. Captures verification document number, vendor invoice number and date, PO and GR references, invoiced amount, tax amount, currency, price variance (common with index-linked chemical pricing), quantity variance (typical with bulk liquid deliveries measured by weight), blocking reasons (price tolerance exceeded, quantity short, quality hold pending COA review), payment release status, and posting status. Critical for chemical procurement where pricing often includes freight surcharges, hazmat handling fees, and index-based escalators. Integrates with SAP MM MIRO and FI accounts payable.

attributes.name: invoice_verification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the invoice verification record. Primary key for three-way match verification in SAP MM MIRO.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Invoice posting must allocate expense to the appropriate cost center for reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: GL account is required to post invoice amounts to the correct ledger account per accounting standards.

attributes.name: rd_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Invoice validation against project budgets requires linking each invoice verification to its research project.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chemical supplier who issued the invoice. Links to vendor master data.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Baseline date for payment terms calculation in SAP. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date depending on payment terms configuration.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the invoice verification is blocked from payment. Common blocks include price tolerance exceeded, quantity short, or quality hold pending Certificate of Analysis (COA) review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_tolerance_exceeded|quantity_short|quality_hold_pending_coa|duplicate_invoice|missing_gr|missing_po|tax_code_mismatch|vendor_blocked|manual_review_required|unblocked — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: coa_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Certificate of Analysis has been received from the vendor. Critical for chemical procurement where COA review is required before payment release.

attributes.name: coa_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the Certificate of Analysis review by Quality Control. Invoices may be blocked pending COA approval for chemical raw materials.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity receiving the invoice. Required for financial posting and legal compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the invoice verification record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Critical for multi-currency chemical procurement.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Document date of the invoice verification record. Typically matches the vendor invoice date but may differ for backdated postings.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the invoice verification document was posted.

attributes.name: freight_charge
attributes.description: Freight or transportation charge included in the vendor invoice. Common surcharge in chemical procurement for bulk material shipments.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the chemical materials were physically received and recorded in SAP MM.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: Goods receipt document number confirming physical receipt of chemical materials. Third element of three-way match (PO, GR, Invoice).

attributes.name: hazmat_handling_fee
attributes.description: Special handling fee for hazardous chemical materials. Charged by vendors for DOT-regulated hazmat transportation and storage compliance.

attributes.name: index_escalator_amount
attributes.description: Price adjustment based on commodity index escalation clauses common in chemical supply contracts. Reflects market-driven price volatility.

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Total amount invoiced by the vendor before tax. Base amount for three-way match price variance calculation.

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of chemical material invoiced by the vendor. Compared against PO quantity and GR quantity for variance detection.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material master number for the chemical raw material being invoiced. Enables material-level spend analysis.

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the invoice is blocked for payment. True if blocked, False if released for payment processing.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date by which payment is due to the vendor based on invoice date and payment terms. Critical for cash flow management and vendor relationship.

attributes.name: payment_release_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who released the invoice for payment. Audit trail for payment authorization.

attributes.name: payment_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice was released for payment after successful three-way match verification and block resolution.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code from the purchase order or vendor master (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Determines payment due date and early payment discount eligibility.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code where the chemical materials were received. Links to plant master data.

attributes.name: po_line_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the purchase order being verified. Enables line-level reconciliation for multi-material POs.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number against which the vendor invoice is being verified. Core reference for three-way match.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice verification document was posted to the financial ledger in SAP FI.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current posting status of the invoice verification document in SAP FI. Indicates whether the document has been financially posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: price_variance
attributes.description: Difference between invoiced price and PO price. Common in chemical procurement due to index-linked pricing, freight surcharges, and hazmat handling fees.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: Difference between invoiced quantity and goods receipt quantity. Typical with bulk liquid chemical deliveries measured by weight at receipt.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount on the vendor invoice (VAT, GST, sales tax). Calculated based on tax jurisdiction and material tax classification.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code determining the tax rate and tax account assignment. Varies by jurisdiction, material type, and vendor location.

attributes.name: total_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount including tax. Gross amount payable to the vendor upon verification approval.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the invoiced quantity (e.g., KG, L, MT, GAL). Critical for bulk chemical deliveries measured by weight or volume.

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor issued the invoice. Used for payment terms calculation and aging analysis.

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number provided by the chemical supplier on their invoice document. Critical for reconciliation and payment processing.

attributes.name: verification_document_number
attributes.description: SAP document number assigned to the invoice verification transaction. Unique business identifier for the three-way match record.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Overall status of the three-way match verification process. Tracks the invoice through verification workflow from receipt to approval.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who performed the invoice verification. Audit trail for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: verified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the invoice verification was completed. Tracks verification cycle time for process efficiency analysis.

products.name: material_info_record
products.description: Purchasing master data establishing approved sourcing parameters and default procurement conditions for specific material-vendor-plant combinations. Captures info record number, material, vendor, plant, purchasing organization, standard price, planned delivery time, MOQ/max order quantity, delivery tolerances, last PO price, and source status. Also serves as the approved source list (AVL): defines which vendors are authorized to supply specific materials to specific plants during defined validity periods, with fixed source flags, MRP relevance indicators, and agreement references. Single source of truth for which vendors can supply which materials to which plants under what conditions. Drives automatic source determination and default PO values. Integrates with SAP MM ME11/ME12 and source list functionality.

attributes.name: material_info_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the material info record. Primary key for this purchasing master data entity.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material being sourced. Links to the material master data defining the chemical product, raw material, or finished good covered by this purchasing agreement.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this material will be delivered. Defines the destination location for this sourcing arrangement.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved supplier for this material. Links to vendor master data defining the chemical supplier authorized to provide this material.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must send a formal acknowledgement confirming receipt and acceptance of purchase orders. When true, procurement tracks acknowledgement status.

attributes.name: agreement_item_number
attributes.description: Specific line item within the referenced contract that covers this material. Five-digit numeric identifier linking to the contract line item.

attributes.name: blocked_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether this source is temporarily blocked from procurement. When true, no new purchase orders can be created using this material-vendor-plant combination.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must provide a Certificate of Analysis with each shipment. Critical for chemical materials to verify composition, purity, and compliance with specifications.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master purchasing contract or agreement governing this sourcing relationship. Links to long-term supply agreements with negotiated terms and pricing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this info record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for sourcing relationship establishment.

attributes.name: fixed_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the mandatory source for the material. When true, Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and purchase requisitions must use this vendor exclusively.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal goods receipt transaction must be posted in SAP MM before invoice processing. Standard requirement for physical materials.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the division of costs and risks between buyer and seller. Standard three-letter code (e.g., DDP, FOB, CIF) governing shipping responsibilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Specific location or port referenced in the Incoterms agreement. Defines the point where risk and cost transfer occurs between vendor and buyer.

attributes.name: info_record_category
attributes.description: Classification of the purchasing info record type. Defines the procurement model: standard purchase, subcontracting arrangement, consignment stock, or pipeline supply for bulk chemicals.

attributes.name: info_record_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the purchasing info record. Unique alphanumeric code assigned by SAP MM system (ME11/ME12) to identify this material-vendor-plant sourcing relationship.

attributes.name: info_record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchasing info record. Determines whether this source can be used for new purchase orders and MRP planning.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoice verification is required for purchases from this source. When true, three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) is enforced.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who most recently updated this info record. Used for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent change to this info record. Tracks when pricing, terms, or other sourcing parameters were last updated.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order created for this material-vendor-plant combination. Used to track sourcing activity and identify inactive sources.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_price
attributes.description: Most recent actual price paid for this material from this vendor. Used for price variance analysis and to track pricing trends over time.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original manufacturer's part number when the vendor is a distributor. Ensures correct material identification and traceability to the chemical producer.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Largest quantity that can be ordered in a single purchase order from this vendor. May be limited by vendor production capacity, storage constraints, or hazmat shipping regulations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered from this vendor for this material. Enforced during purchase order creation to ensure compliance with vendor minimum order requirements.

attributes.name: mrp_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this source is considered during MRP runs for automatic source determination. When true, MRP will propose this vendor when generating planned orders or purchase requisitions.

attributes.name: net_price_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the standard price is a net price (no further discounts apply) or a gross price (subject to additional discounts or surcharges).

attributes.name: order_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for ordering this material from this vendor. Examples: KG (kilograms), L (liters), MT (metric tons), GAL (gallons). Must align with vendor packaging and shipping capabilities.

attributes.name: over_delivery_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage by which the vendor may exceed the ordered quantity without requiring approval. For example, 5.00 allows delivery of up to 105% of ordered quantity.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Expected lead time in calendar days from purchase order placement to goods receipt at the plant. Used by MRP for scheduling and by procurement for delivery date calculation.

attributes.name: price_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard price. Defines the currency in which pricing is negotiated and invoiced.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity to which the standard price applies. For example, if price_unit is 100 and standard_price is 50.00, the price is 50.00 per 100 units.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for this material-vendor combination. Three-character code identifying the specific purchasing group handling this sourcing relationship.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Four-character code identifying the purchasing group that negotiated and manages this sourcing relationship.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming materials from this vendor must undergo quality control inspection before release to production. When true, goods are placed in quality inspection stock upon receipt.

attributes.name: reach_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must provide REACH compliance documentation for materials supplied to European plants. Ensures regulatory compliance for chemical substance registration.

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must provide a current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) with shipments. Mandatory for hazardous chemicals to ensure safe handling and compliance with OSHA and GHS requirements.

attributes.name: source_list_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this info record is part of the approved vendor list (AVL). When true, this vendor is authorized to supply this material to this plant during the validity period.

attributes.name: standard_order_quantity
attributes.description: Recommended or typical order quantity for this material-vendor combination. Used as default value in purchase requisitions and for optimizing order economics.

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: Default unit price for this material from this vendor. Used as the baseline price for purchase order creation and cost estimation. Expressed in the currency specified in price_currency_code.

attributes.name: supplier_material_number
attributes.description: Vendor's internal part number or catalog code for this material. Used for cross-referencing between buyer and supplier systems and for accurate order communication.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining applicable sales tax, VAT, or other tax treatment for purchases from this vendor. Two-character code linked to tax calculation rules.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage by which the vendor may deliver less than the ordered quantity without triggering a shortage alert. For example, 2.00 allows delivery of as low as 98% of ordered quantity.

attributes.name: unlimited_over_delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is allowed to deliver any quantity above the purchase order amount without restriction. Typically used for bulk chemicals where exact quantities are difficult to control.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this info record expires and can no longer be used for new purchase orders. Defines the end of the approved sourcing period. Null indicates indefinite validity.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this info record becomes active and can be used for purchase order creation. Defines the beginning of the approved sourcing period.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID of the procurement specialist who created this info record in SAP MM. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: delivery_schedule
products.description: Scheduling agreement delivery schedule lines defining planned delivery dates and quantities for long-term supply arrangements with chemical vendors. Captures schedule line number, scheduling agreement reference, material, plant, scheduled delivery date, scheduled quantity, cumulative received quantity, delivery category (forecast vs. firm), and schedule line status. Supports just-in-time raw material delivery planning for continuous chemical manufacturing processes.
products.reference: SAP MM Scheduling Agreement Delivery Schedule (EKET)

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery schedule line. Primary key for the supply delivery schedule entity.

attributes.name: primary_delivery_material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the raw material, chemical compound, or finished product being scheduled for delivery. Links to material master data.

attributes.name: scheduling_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent scheduling agreement contract that governs this delivery schedule line. Links to the long-term supply arrangement with the chemical vendor.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the chemical supplier responsible for delivering materials according to this schedule line. Links to vendor master data.

attributes.name: actual_delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material delivered and received. Used to track delivery accuracy and calculate over-delivery or under-delivery variances.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the material was delivered and goods receipt was posted. Used for vendor performance measurement and on-time delivery KPI calculation.

attributes.name: batch_managed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material requires batch or lot number tracking for quality control, traceability, and Certificate of Analysis (COA) management.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance. Used for regulatory reporting, safety data sheet (SDS) management, and chemical inventory tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this delivery schedule line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cumulative_received_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material received to date against this scheduling agreement. Used to track fulfillment progress and calculate outstanding delivery obligations.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the price per unit (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency procurement operations.

attributes.name: delivery_category
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery schedule line indicating the commitment level. Forecast deliveries are planning estimates, firm deliveries are binding commitments, just-in-time deliveries support lean manufacturing, blanket deliveries cover long-term agreements, and trade-off deliveries allow quantity adjustments.

attributes.name: delivery_tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage variance (plus or minus) from the scheduled quantity that the vendor is allowed to deliver without requiring approval. Supports flexible chemical supply chain management.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: Document number of the goods receipt posted against this schedule line. Links delivery schedule to warehouse management and inventory transactions.

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the scheduled material is classified as hazardous and requires special handling, transportation, and storage procedures per DOT and OSHA regulations.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms code defining the responsibilities and risks between buyer and seller for this delivery (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP). Critical for chemical logistics and customs compliance.

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Specific location or port associated with the Incoterms code (e.g., Houston Port, Vendor Warehouse). Defines the point where risk and cost transfer occurs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this delivery schedule line record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Classification code grouping similar materials for procurement analysis, spend management, and supplier performance reporting (e.g., solvents, polymers, catalysts).

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Total net value of this schedule line calculated as scheduled quantity multiplied by price per unit. Used for budget tracking and financial planning.

attributes.name: outstanding_quantity
attributes.description: Remaining quantity yet to be delivered under this schedule line. Calculated as scheduled quantity minus cumulative received quantity.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing plant or facility where the scheduled material delivery will be received. Supports multi-site chemical manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: price_per_unit
attributes.description: Agreed unit price for the material as defined in the scheduling agreement. Used for cost planning and invoice verification.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the procurement team or buyer responsible for managing this scheduling agreement and delivery schedule. Used for workload distribution and accountability.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming material must undergo quality control (QC) inspection and laboratory testing before release to production. Supports Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when this schedule line was officially released to the vendor for fulfillment. Marks the transition from planning to execution.

attributes.name: release_strategy
attributes.description: Method by which schedule lines are released to the vendor for fulfillment. Immediate releases are sent directly, forecast-based uses demand planning, consumption-based triggers on usage, and manual requires buyer approval.

attributes.name: schedule_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the scheduling agreement that uniquely identifies this delivery schedule entry. Used for ordering and referencing specific schedule lines.
attributes.references: SAP MM Scheduling Agreement Line Item

attributes.name: schedule_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery schedule line. Tracks progression from initial scheduling through vendor confirmation, partial fulfillment, completion, or cancellation.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the vendor is expected to deliver the material quantity to the receiving plant. Used for just-in-time manufacturing planning and production scheduling.

attributes.name: scheduled_quantity
attributes.description: Planned quantity of material to be delivered on the scheduled delivery date. Supports continuous chemical manufacturing process planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Mode of transportation planned for this delivery. Critical for hazardous material transportation planning and Department of Transportation (DOT) compliance.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing specific requirements for material handling, storage, or transportation (e.g., temperature control, moisture sensitivity, light protection). Critical for chemical safety and quality preservation.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location code within the plant where the delivered material will be stored. Critical for hazardous material segregation and inventory management.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials used in international transportation (e.g., UN1090 for acetone). Required for shipping documentation and emergency response.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the scheduled quantity (e.g., KG for kilograms, L for liters, MT for metric tons, GAL for gallons). Critical for chemical quantity calculations and conversions.

attributes.name: vendor_confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor confirmed their ability to meet the scheduled delivery date and quantity. Critical for supply chain reliability tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity that the vendor has confirmed they can deliver on the scheduled date. May differ from scheduled quantity if vendor capacity constraints exist.

products.name: vendor_document
products.description: Repository of compliance and regulatory documents received from chemical suppliers including SDS/MSDS, COA, COC, REACH registration dossiers, TSCA certifications, ISO certificates, GMP certificates, and Responsible Care attestations. Captures document type, vendor, material or CAS number reference, document version, issue date, expiry date, issuing authority, document file reference, and document validity status. Ensures regulatory document currency for EHS and procurement compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor document record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific chemical material or product that this document pertains to. May be null for vendor-level certificates.

attributes.name: superseded_by_document_vendor_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer vendor document that supersedes this document. Null if this is the current version.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chemical supplier who provided this document. Links to the vendor master data.

attributes.name: applicable_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or jurisdiction for which this document is valid (e.g., USA, EU, APAC). Pipe-separated list if multiple regions apply.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of the document for use in procurement and operations.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the person who approved the document for operational use.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was formally approved for use by the authorized approver.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: The CAS registry number identifying the chemical substance covered by this document. Format: XXXXXX-XX-X.
attributes.references: CAS Registry, TSCA Chemical Substance Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp

domains.name: logistics
domains.description: Manages outbound and inbound freight execution including carrier selection, LTL/FTL shipment planning, hazardous materials transport compliance (DOT 49 CFR), route optimization, delivery confirmation, ASN generation, bill of lading, and transport documentation for regulated chemical shipments. products.name: shipment
products.description: Core master record for every outbound or inbound freight movement of chemical products. Captures shipment type (LTL/FTL/intermodal), origin and destination facilities, scheduled and actual departure/arrival dates, total weight, volume, hazmat class, UN number, DOT 49 CFR compliance status, carrier assignment, freight terms (prepaid/collect), shipment status, and Oracle TMS shipment reference. products.name: hazmat_declaration
products.description: Consolidated hazardous materials compliance record for each regulated chemical shipment line, combining SDS-derived transport requirements with DOT 49 CFR, IATA DGR, and IMDG Code shipping declarations. Records UN number, proper shipping name, hazard class and division, packing group, quantity and type of packaging, emergency response guide number (ERG), shipper certification, segregation requirements for incompatible chemicals, temperature limits during transport, PPE requirements for drivers, spill response instructions, and applicable transport regulation. products.name: carrier_qualification
products.description: Represents the qualification relationship between a raw material and a freight carrier. Each record captures the status and date of qualification for a specific material-carrier pair.. Existence Justification: A material can be qualified with multiple approved carriers, and each carrier can be qualified for multiple materials. The qualification status and date are managed as a distinct business process, with humans creating, updating, and retiring these records.
