products.name: carrier_pricing_agreement
products.description: Represents the contractual agreement between a freight carrier and a price list. Each record links one carrier to one price list and stores contract‑specific data such as contract number and validity period.. Existence Justification: Carriers negotiate distinct pricing agreements (price lists) that are valid for specific periods. A single carrier can have multiple active price‑list contracts, and a single price list can be applied to multiple carriers. The business tracks each contract with its own contract number and effective dates, making the relationship an operational M:N entity.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Single source of truth for all revenue and financial transaction data: customer invoices, credit/debit memos, payment receipts, dispute management, revenue recognition, rebate settlements, and intercompany billing. Manages pricing execution, invoice generation from orders, payment reconciliation, and accounts receivable. Integrates with SAP FI/CO and supports SOX-compliant financial reporting.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a customer invoice generated from a sales order or delivery. Captures invoice number, billing date, customer account, total amount, currency, payment terms, tax totals, and lifecycle status (open, partially paid, cleared, disputed). Serves as the primary accounts receivable document and SSOT for all customer-facing billing transactions in the chemical manufacturing order-to-cash cycle. Links to invoice_line for item detail and to payment_receipt for cash application.

products.name: billing_adjustment
products.description: Financial adjustment document issued to a customer to either reduce (credit) or increase (debit) the amount owed on an existing invoice. Credit scenarios include product returns, quality disputes (OOS/OOT), pricing corrections, or volume rebate settlements. Debit scenarios include underbilling corrections, surcharges, freight adjustments, or hazardous material handling fees. Captures adjustment document number, adjustment type (credit/debit), reference invoice, reason code, adjustment amount, tax impact, and approval workflow status. Serves as the SSOT for all post-invoice billing modifications in the chemical manufacturing order-to-cash cycle. Managed in SAP SD/FI as billing document types.

Includes safety incidents, near-misses, PSM/HAZOP records, PHA documentation, VOC/HAP emissions tracking, TRI reporting, OSHA recordkeeping, EPA regulatory submissions, chemical exposure monitoring, waste disposal records, and ISO 14001/ISO 45001 audit trails. Integrates with Intelex EHS Management.
domains.references: ISO 14001:2015 / ISO 45001:2018 / OSHA 29 CFR / EPA / ACC Responsible Care

products.name: safety_incident
products.description: Master record for all workplace safety incidents, near-misses, first-aid events, and occupational chemical exposure monitoring at Chemical Mfg facilities. Captures incident type (injury, illness, near-miss, property damage, process safety, chemical exposure), severity classification (OSHA recordable, lost-time, first-aid), incident date/time, location, affected personnel, initial description, root cause category, and regulatory reportability flags. For chemical exposure events: captures substance (CAS number), exposure measurement type (personal air sampling, area monitoring, biological monitoring), measured concentration, OSHA PEL/ACGIH TLV threshold, exceedance flag, and required follow-up. Integrates with Intelex EHS Management. Supports OSHA 300/300A recordkeeping, PSM incident reporting, and OSHA 1910.1000 air contaminants compliance.

products.name: incident_investigation

products.name: hazop_study
products.description: Process safety master record encompassing Process Safety Information (PSI), Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) studies, Process Hazard Analyses (PHA), and granular study nodes for chemical process units at Chemical Mfg plants. PSI content: chemical identity (CAS number), maximum intended inventory, physical/chemical properties, reactivity hazards, corrosivity data, thermal stability, P&ID references, equipment design specifications, safe operating limits. Study content: study scope, process unit reference, team composition, methodology (HAZOP, What-If, Checklist, LOPA), study/revalidation dates, overall risk ranking. Node-level detail: node identifier, design intent, guide words (No, More, Less, Reverse, Other Than), deviations, causes, consequences, safeguards, risk rankings (likelihood × severity), recommended actions. Required under OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119(d) and (e) and EPA RMP 40 CFR Part 68. Integrates with Intelex EHS Management.

domains.name: research
domains.description: Research and Development domain managing new chemical compound development, experimental formulations, lab-scale synthesis records, patent filings, technology transfer to commercial production, compound registry (CAS number assignment), trial batch records, stability study data, R&D project portfolio management, and innovation pipeline. Integrates with LabWare LIMS and Aspen HYSYS.

products.name: project
products.description: Master record for R&D projects in the chemical manufacturing innovation pipeline. Captures project identity, objectives, scope, phase (discovery, feasibility, scale-up, technology transfer), priority tier, budget allocation, target application market (automotive, agriculture, electronics, etc.), project sponsor, lead scientist, start/end dates, current stage-gate status, and external collaboration context (partner organizations, CRO contracts, IP terms). Serves as the portfolio management backbone for all new compound development and formulation research initiatives, including open innovation partnerships.

products.name: rd_stability_study
products.description: Master and detail record for stability studies conducted on experimental compounds and formulations per ICH Q1A/Q1B, EPA, and internal protocols. Master level captures study ID, study type (accelerated, real-time, photostability, freeze-thaw), test conditions (temperature, humidity, light exposure), study duration, sampling intervals, acceptance criteria, regulatory protocol reference, study status, and responsible scientist. Detail level captures each scheduled timepoint: interval (T=0, T=1mo, T=3mo, T=6mo, etc.), actual test date, parameters measured (assay, pH, viscosity, color, particulate count, degradation products in PPM), pass/fail against criteria, OOS/OOT flags, analyst ID, and instrument reference. Supports shelf-life determination, trend analysis, and product registration.

attributes.name: transfer_package_id
attributes.description: Primary key for transfer_package

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual time when the transfer completed.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual time when the transfer began.

attributes.name: carrier_id

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary values.

attributes.name: destination_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the receiving facility or warehouse for the transfer.

attributes.name: gross_cost

attributes.name: hazard_classification

attributes.name: net_cost

attributes.name: package_number
attributes.description: External business identifier assigned to the transfer package, used in shipping documents and tracking systems.

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned completion time for the transfer operation.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp

attributes.name: source_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating facility or warehouse for the transfer.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Any additional handling requirements or notes for the transfer.

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag

attributes.name: transfer_method

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: volume_m3

attributes.name: weight_kg

domains.name: maintenance
domains.description: Plant maintenance and asset management domain for production equipment, reactors, vessels, pumps, and instrumentation. Includes maintenance work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, equipment master data, maintenance history, spare parts management, equipment reliability metrics (MTBF, MTTR), P&ID asset registry, equipment calibration, and MOC workflows for process equipment changes. Integrates with SAP PM and supports PSM mechanical integrity requirements.
domains.references: ISO 9001 / ISO 45001:2018 / CMMS/EAM Standards / OSHA PSM (29 CFR 1910.119)

products.name: equipment
products.description: Equipment master data registry for all maintainable plant assets including reactors, vessels, pumps, compressors, heat exchangers, instrumentation, and piping systems. SSOT for equipment identity, technical specifications (design pressure/temperature, materials of construction, nameplate data), installation history, criticality classification (A/B/C), PSM mechanical integrity status, and regulatory inspection requirements. Supports equipment taxonomy, BOM structure, P&ID tag cross-reference, and full maintenance history linkage.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each maintainable plant asset in the equipment master registry. Primary key for the equipment data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Asset ownership tracking; required for customer asset registers and billing reports linking equipment to the owning account.

attributes.name: customer_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.site. Business justification: Required for Service Contract Management: links each equipment to the owning customer's site for billing, compliance, and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.functional_location. Business justification: Equipment must be assigned to a functional location for hierarchy and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Equipment spec sheets require exact material grade for construction; regulatory compliance (PSM, ASME) and corrosion tracking depend on this link.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where this equipment is physically installed and operated.

attributes.name: sales_rep_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Assigns a sales rep to each sold equipment; used in after‑sales support KPIs and regional sales performance dashboards.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Maps equipment to the sales territory where it is installed; supports regional service planning and territory performance metrics.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Needed for equipment procurement, warranty, recall, and regulatory compliance tracking of the supplier of each equipment.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA fixed asset number linked to this equipment for financial accounting, depreciation calculation, and CapEx tracking. Bridges the maintenance and finance domains.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Accounting (ANLN1); FASB ASC 360; SOX

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical asset tag or nameplate number affixed to the equipment in the field. Used for physical identification during inspections, maintenance activities, and fixed asset accounting reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: calibration_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equipment (typically instrumentation) requires periodic calibration to maintain measurement accuracy and regulatory compliance. True=calibration program applies; False=not applicable.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5; LabWare LIMS; SAP PM

attributes.name: capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the equipment capacity value (e.g., m3, m3/hr, kW, kg/hr, bar). Follows SI unit conventions for chemical process engineering.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units; SAP PM

attributes.name: capacity_value
attributes.description: Principal rated capacity or throughput of the equipment (e.g., volumetric capacity for vessels in m³, flow rate for pumps in m³/hr, heat duty for heat exchangers in kW). The unit is specified in capacity_unit.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date the equipment was formally commissioned and accepted into operational service following installation, pre-commissioning checks, and startup testing. Distinct from installation date.
attributes.references: SAP PM; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119 Mechanical Integrity

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year in which the equipment was manufactured or constructed. Used for age-based risk assessment, remaining useful life estimation, and regulatory inspection scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master (BAUJJ); API 510 Pressure Vessel Inspection Code

attributes.name: corrosion_allowance_mm
attributes.description: Designed corrosion allowance in millimeters added to the minimum required wall thickness to account for expected corrosion over the equipment's design life. Used in fitness-for-service assessments and remaining life calculations.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code Section VIII; API 510; API 579 Fitness-for-Service

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center to which maintenance costs for this equipment are charged. Used for maintenance cost allocation, OpEx reporting, and budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment master record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record origination and supports data lineage tracking in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: criticality_class
attributes.description: Equipment criticality ranking used to prioritize maintenance resources and inspection frequency. A=Safety-critical/production-critical (highest priority, PSM-covered); B=Important but has redundancy or workaround; C=Non-critical/low impact on safety or production.
attributes.references: ACC Responsible Care; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; API 580 Risk-Based Inspection

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date the equipment was permanently removed from service and decommissioned. Null for active equipment. Required for fixed asset retirement accounting and regulatory closure documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA; ISO 55000; EPA Decommissioning Requirements

attributes.name: design_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Maximum allowable working pressure (MAWP) for which the equipment was designed, expressed in kilopascals (kPa). Critical nameplate data for pressure vessel inspection, relief valve sizing, and PSM mechanical integrity documentation.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code Section VIII; API 510; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: design_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable design temperature for which the equipment was designed, expressed in degrees Celsius. Used for material of construction verification, thermal stress analysis, and PSM mechanical integrity records.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code; API 510; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: SAP PM equipment category code classifying the asset type: M=Mechanical, E=Electrical, I=Instrumentation, P=Piping, V=Vessel/Reactor. Drives maintenance planning strategy and inspection requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: M|E|I|P|V|C|R — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: equipment_class
attributes.description: Detailed equipment classification within the category (e.g., Centrifugal Pump, Reciprocating Compressor, Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger, Pressure Vessel, Control Valve, Thermocouple). Aligns with ISO 14224 equipment taxonomy for reliability data collection.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 - Reliability and Maintenance Data for Equipment

attributes.name: equipment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name or short description of the equipment asset (e.g., 'Reactor Feed Pump', 'Distillation Column Overhead Condenser'). Corresponds to SAP PM equipment description field.

attributes.name: equipment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric equipment number assigned in SAP PM (EQUNR). Serves as the primary business identifier used across maintenance work orders, inspection records, and P&ID cross-references.

attributes.name: equipment_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the equipment asset. Active=in normal service; Inactive=installed but not in service; Decommissioned=permanently removed from service; Standby=available as backup; Under_Maintenance=currently undergoing planned or corrective maintenance.

attributes.name: hazardous_area_classification
attributes.description: Electrical area classification of the location where this equipment is installed, per NEC/IEC standards. Determines requirements for explosion-proof or intrinsically safe electrical equipment. Zone 0/1/2 per IEC 60079; Division 1/2 per NEC Article 500.
attributes.references: IEC 60079 Explosive Atmospheres; NEC Article 500; NFPA 70; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.307

attributes.name: inspection_interval_months
attributes.description: Required inspection frequency in months as determined by regulatory requirements, risk-based inspection (RBI) analysis, or manufacturer recommendations. Used to auto-calculate next_inspection_date.
attributes.references: API 580 Risk-Based Inspection; OSHA PSM; API 510/570/653

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the equipment was physically installed at its current functional location. Marks the start of the equipment's operational lifecycle at this site for maintenance history and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: insulation_type
attributes.description: Type of thermal or acoustic insulation applied to the equipment (e.g., mineral wool, calcium silicate, cellular glass, none). Relevant for corrosion under insulation (CUI) inspection programs and energy efficiency assessments.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently completed inspection for this equipment. Used to calculate inspection intervals, assess compliance with regulatory inspection frequency requirements, and support risk-based inspection (RBI) programs.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119(j); API 580 Risk-Based Inspection; API 510

attributes.name: maintenance_planner_group
attributes.description: SAP PM planner group code responsible for planning and scheduling maintenance activities for this equipment. Determines which maintenance team owns the equipment's work order planning.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: Assigned maintenance strategy for this equipment asset: Time_Based=fixed interval preventive maintenance; Condition_Based=maintenance triggered by condition monitoring thresholds; Predictive=data-driven prediction of failure; Run_To_Failure=no planned maintenance; Reliability_Centered=RCM-derived strategy.
attributes.references: SAP PM Maintenance Strategy; IEC 60300-3-11 RCM; ISO 55000

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM). Used for spare parts sourcing, warranty claims, and technical support escalation.

attributes.name: moc_status
attributes.description: Current Management of Change (MOC) workflow status for any pending or recent modification to this equipment. Not_Required=no active MOC; Pending=MOC initiated and under review; Approved=MOC approved, change authorized; Closed=MOC completed and documented.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119(l) Management of Change; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or part number for this equipment type. Used for spare parts procurement, technical documentation retrieval, and like-for-like replacement identification.

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next calibration of this instrument or measurement device must be completed to maintain traceability and compliance. Null if calibration_required is False.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the next mandatory regulatory or internal inspection due for this equipment. Drives inspection scheduling for PSM mechanical integrity, API 510/570/653 inspections, and insurance surveys.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119(j); API 510; API 570; API 653

attributes.name: operating_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Normal operating pressure of the equipment under standard process conditions, expressed in kilopascals (kPa). Used for process monitoring, deviation detection, and SPC control limit setting.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System; Honeywell Experion DCS; OSHA PSM

attributes.name: operating_temperature_c
attributes.description: Normal operating temperature of the equipment under standard process conditions, expressed in degrees Celsius. Used for process monitoring, heat balance calculations, and corrosion rate estimation.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System; Honeywell Experion DCS; ASPEN HYSYS

attributes.name: pi_tag_reference
attributes.description: Aveva PI System historian tag name or tag pattern associated with this equipment for real-time process data retrieval (e.g., temperature, pressure, flow readings). Enables linkage between equipment master data and real-time operational data.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System Asset Framework; SAP PM-PI Integration

attributes.name: pid_tag
attributes.description: The P&ID tag number identifying this equipment on process engineering drawings (e.g., P-101A, E-201, V-301). Used for cross-referencing with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams, HAZOP studies, and PSM documentation.
attributes.references: ISA-5.1 Instrumentation Symbols and Identification; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: psm_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equipment is subject to OSHA Process Safety Management (PSM) mechanical integrity requirements under 29 CFR 1910.119. True=PSM-covered; requires documented inspection, testing, and quality assurance program.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number for the equipment unit. Required for warranty tracking, OEM service records, and regulatory inspection documentation.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master (SERGE); ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Dry operating weight of the equipment in kilograms. Used for structural load calculations, rigging and lifting plans, and transportation logistics for equipment removal or replacement.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Rigging Safety

attributes.name: work_center
attributes.description: SAP PM work center responsible for executing maintenance activities on this equipment (e.g., MECH-01, ELEC-02, INST-03). Drives labor scheduling, capacity planning, and cost center assignment.

products.name: functional_location
products.description: Hierarchical functional location structure representing the physical and logical plant topology — plant, unit, area, system, and sub-system levels. Provides the spatial context for equipment installation and maintenance activities. Aligns with SAP PM Functional Location (IFLOT) and supports P&ID-based asset hierarchy for chemical process units.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the functional location record in the lakehouse. Primary key for the functional_location data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Enables charging maintenance expenses of a functional location to its assigned cost center, used in plant cost‑center performance reports.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.plant. Business justification: Functional location belongs to a plant; plant_code is redundant after FK.

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: Criticality classification of the functional location using the SAP PM ABC indicator. 'A' = critical (production-critical, safety-critical), 'B' = important (significant impact), 'C' = non-critical (minimal impact). Drives maintenance prioritization, spare parts stocking, and OEE improvement focus. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-ABCKZ.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; ISO 14224; ISO 55001; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Financial fixed asset number from SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting linked to this functional location. Enables reconciliation between the maintenance asset hierarchy and the financial asset register for CapEx tracking, depreciation, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT-ANLNR; SAP FI/CO; FASB ASC 360; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: building_or_area_code
attributes.description: Physical building, bay, or plant area code where the functional location is situated. Used for maintenance crew routing, emergency response, and facility management. Complements the hierarchical floc_code with a physical location reference.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; NFPA 1 Fire Code; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: catalog_profile_code
attributes.description: SAP PM catalog profile assigned to this functional location, defining the damage codes, cause codes, and activity codes available for maintenance notifications and work orders. Ensures standardized failure coding for reliability analysis and CAPA workflows. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-RBNR.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; ISO 14224 Failure Taxonomy

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the functional location was formally commissioned and handed over to operations. Marks the start of the operational lifecycle and the beginning of preventive maintenance scheduling. May differ from installation_date for complex systems.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; ISO 55001; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code (Buchungskreis) representing the legal entity that owns this functional location. Required for financial reporting, asset accounting, and SOX compliance. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-BUKRS.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; SAP FI/CO; SOX Section 302/404; FASB

attributes.name: construction_material
attributes.description: Primary material of construction for the functional location (e.g., 'Carbon Steel A516-70', '316L Stainless Steel', 'Hastelloy C-276', 'FRP'). Critical for corrosion management, inspection planning, and chemical compatibility assessment under REACH and PSM requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ASME B31.3; ISO 14224; REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this functional location record was first created in the source system (SAP PM). Provides audit trail for asset master data governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 55001

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the functional location was formally decommissioned and removed from active service. Null for active locations. Required for asset lifecycle reporting, regulatory closure documentation, and EPA/OSHA decommissioning notifications.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; ISO 55001; EPA RCRA; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: floc_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the functional location within the plant hierarchy, as maintained in SAP PM (IFLOT-TPLNR). Follows the plant-unit-area-system-subsystem naming convention (e.g., CH01-RX-001-P-001). This is the business identifier used on work orders, P&IDs, and maintenance records.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; ISO 14224 Equipment Taxonomy

attributes.name: floor_or_elevation
attributes.description: Floor level or elevation reference (e.g., 'Grade Level', 'EL +12.5m', 'Mezzanine Level 2') for the functional location within a building or structure. Supports maintenance crew navigation and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: functional_location_category
attributes.description: Broad equipment category grouping for the functional location. Used for maintenance strategy segmentation, PSM mechanical integrity scope definition, and EHS compliance reporting. Aligns with ISO 14224 taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: process_equipment|utility_equipment|instrumentation|electrical|civil_structural|safety_system|environmental_control — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: functional_location_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the functional location, describing its physical or logical purpose within the plant (e.g., 'Reactor Feed Pump — Unit 3 Ethylene Plant'). Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-PLTXT.

attributes.name: geo_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the functional location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Enables spatial analytics, emergency response planning, and integration with plant GIS systems for asset location visualization.

attributes.name: geo_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the functional location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Enables spatial analytics, emergency response planning, and integration with plant GIS systems for asset location visualization.

attributes.name: hazardous_area_classification
attributes.description: Electrical area classification for the functional location per NEC/IEC standards, indicating the presence and likelihood of flammable gases or vapors. Drives equipment selection, inspection requirements, and EHS compliance. Critical for OSHA and NFPA compliance.
attributes.references: NFPA 70 NEC Article 500; IEC 60079; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.307

attributes.name: inspection_class
attributes.description: Inspection methodology classification for this functional location. 'RBI' (Risk-Based Inspection) applies to pressure equipment per API 580/581; 'fixed_interval' for time-based statutory inspections; 'condition_based' for CBM programs; 'run_to_failure' for non-critical assets. Drives inspection planning and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: API 580/581 Risk-Based Inspection; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ISO 14224; ASME PCC-3

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the functional location (equipment or system) was physically installed and commissioned at the plant. Used for asset age calculations, depreciation scheduling, and mechanical integrity baseline establishment.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; ISO 55001 Asset Management; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this functional location record in the source system (SAP PM). Supports change tracking, data lineage, and master data governance audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; SOX Section 302/404; ISO 55001

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently completed inspection for this functional location. Used to calculate inspection overdue status, support audit readiness, and demonstrate PSM mechanical integrity compliance to regulators.

attributes.name: linear_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this functional location represents a linear asset (e.g., pipeline, cable tray, conveyor) as opposed to a point asset. Linear assets require linear reference measurement for inspection and maintenance location identification.
attributes.references: SAP PM Linear Asset Management; ISO 55001

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the functional location. Drives maintenance scheduling eligibility, work order creation, and PSM mechanical integrity scope. 'Decommissioned' locations are retained for historical traceability.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Hierarchical level classification of the functional location within the plant topology. Defines whether this node represents a plant, process unit, area, system, or sub-system. Drives hierarchy navigation and maintenance planning scope.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; ISO 14224 Equipment Taxonomy; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy_code
attributes.description: SAP PM maintenance strategy assigned to this functional location, defining the preventive maintenance cycle (e.g., time-based, condition-based, predictive). Drives automatic generation of maintenance orders and inspection plans. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-MSTRAT.

attributes.name: moc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether any modification to this functional location requires a formal Management of Change (MOC) workflow per OSHA PSM requirements. Typically true for PSM-covered locations and safety-critical systems. Drives MOC initiation in the change management process.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119(l); ACC Responsible Care; ISO 45001

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled statutory or preventive inspection for this functional location. Used for maintenance planning, regulatory compliance tracking, and PSM mechanical integrity program management. Derived from inspection intervals but stored for operational scheduling.

attributes.name: object_type
attributes.description: SAP PM object type code classifying the functional location by equipment category (e.g., reactor, pump, heat exchanger, vessel, compressor, instrumentation). Drives maintenance strategy assignment and spare parts planning. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-EQART. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reactor|pump|heat_exchanger|vessel|compressor|instrumentation|piping|column|tank|filter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; ISO 14224 Equipment Taxonomy

attributes.name: parent_floc_code
attributes.description: The floc_code of the immediate parent node in the functional location hierarchy. Enables recursive traversal of the plant topology from plant down to sub-system level. Null for top-level plant nodes. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-TPLMA.

attributes.name: pi_tag_reference
attributes.description: Primary process historian tag identifier in the Aveva PI System associated with this functional location. Enables linkage between the SAP PM asset hierarchy and real-time process data for condition-based maintenance, OEE analysis, and predictive analytics.
attributes.references: Aveva PI System; ISA-88 Batch Control; ISA-95 Enterprise-Control Integration

attributes.name: pid_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or drawing identifier of the P&ID document on which this functional location appears. Critical for PSM mechanical integrity, MOC workflows, and HAZOP studies. Enables traceability between the physical asset hierarchy and engineering drawings.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ISA-5.1 P&ID Standards; NFPA 30

attributes.name: planner_group_code
attributes.description: SAP PM planner group responsible for planning and scheduling maintenance activities at this functional location. Used for workload distribution, capacity planning, and maintenance KPI reporting. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-INGRP.

attributes.name: pressure_rating_bar
attributes.description: Maximum allowable working pressure (MAWP) for the functional location in bar units. Used for mechanical integrity assessments, inspection planning, and PSM compliance. Applies primarily to pressure vessels, reactors, and piping systems.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code; ISO 14224

attributes.name: process_unit_name
attributes.description: Name of the chemical process unit or production unit to which this functional location belongs (e.g., 'Ethylene Cracker Unit 1', 'Sulfuric Acid Plant', 'Polymerization Train B'). Provides operational context for maintenance planning and P&ID alignment.
attributes.references: SAP PM; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; P&ID Standards ISA-5.1

attributes.name: psm_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this functional location is within the scope of OSHA Process Safety Management (PSM) regulations (29 CFR 1910.119). PSM-covered locations require mechanical integrity programs, PHA/HAZOP studies, and MOC documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ACC Responsible Care

attributes.name: sort_field
attributes.description: Alphanumeric sort field used for grouping and filtering functional locations in maintenance reports and work order lists. Typically encodes plant area, equipment class, or operational unit for reporting convenience. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-EQFNR.

attributes.name: temperature_rating_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable design temperature for the functional location in degrees Celsius. Used for material selection validation, mechanical integrity assessments, and process safety compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code; ISO 14224

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: SAP work center responsible for performing maintenance activities at this functional location. Used for capacity planning, scheduling, and cost allocation. Corresponds to SAP PM IFLOT-GEWRK.
attributes.references: SAP PM IFLOT; SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core maintenance work order record capturing all planned, corrective, preventive, predictive, and externally-contracted maintenance activities. Tracks work order type, priority, functional location, equipment, planner group, work center, scheduled/actual dates, labor hours, material consumption summary, internal/external cost totals, permit-to-work reference, and completion status. Supports both internal craft execution and external service provider work. Primary transactional entity for maintenance execution, cost tracking, and PM compliance.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance work order. Primary key for the work order entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Work orders are billed to a customer account; linking provides the Accounting & Invoicing report and compliance with contract billing.

attributes.name: chemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.chemical_product. Business justification: Needed for Production Work Order report to track which chemical product is being manufactured in each work order.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for allocating labor and material costs of each work order to the proper cost center for financial reporting and budgeting.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Work Order Creation Report requires tracking which employee created each work order for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment, asset, reactor, vessel, pump, or instrumentation device that is the subject of this maintenance work order.

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.freight_order. Business justification: Freight Order Maintenance Request creates a work order to service carrier equipment or resolve issues tied to a specific freight order.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location (plant area, process unit, or facility section) where the maintenance work is to be performed. Functional locations represent the hierarchical structure of the plant.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Shipment‑Delay Work Order process requires linking a work order to the affected shipment for root‑cause analysis and delay reporting.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Maintenance work orders often replace raw materials; linking enables material cost tracking, inventory deduction, and safety‑data‑sheet reference.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Service work orders are generated from sales opportunities; needed for service revenue attribution and opportunity closure analysis.

attributes.name: planner_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.planner_group. Business justification: Work order is planned by a planner group; code string replaced by FK.

attributes.name: pm_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preventive maintenance plan that generated this work order, if applicable. Null for corrective or breakdown work orders not originating from a scheduled maintenance plan.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: Links installation work orders to the original sales quote; enables cost reconciliation and quote‑to‑service reporting.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Links external maintenance contractor (vendor) to work order for cost allocation, contract compliance, and safety reporting.

attributes.name: actual_duration_hours
attributes.description: Actual total duration of the maintenance work in hours, calculated from start to completion timestamps. Used for performance analysis and future work estimation.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when maintenance work execution was completed, recorded when all work activities are finished and equipment is ready for return to service.

attributes.name: actual_labor_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost of internal labor based on confirmed hours and standard or actual labor rates. Used for maintenance cost accounting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: Actual total labor hours consumed across all crafts and operations, confirmed through time confirmations. Used for cost accounting and productivity analysis.

attributes.name: actual_material_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost of spare parts, materials, and consumables consumed during work order execution, based on goods issue transactions and purchase order receipts.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when maintenance work execution began, recorded by the maintenance crew or supervisor when work commences on site.

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes recorded by the maintenance crew upon work completion, documenting work performed, parts replaced, test results, and any deviations from planned scope.

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken to address the root cause and prevent recurrence. Part of the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) process.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this work order record was first created in the maintenance management system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all cost amounts on this work order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for global manufacturing sites.

attributes.name: downtime_duration_hours
attributes.description: Actual duration in hours that the equipment or process unit was offline due to this maintenance work. Used for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculation and production loss analysis.

attributes.name: downtime_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance work requires taking the equipment or process unit offline. True for intrusive maintenance; false for online maintenance activities.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Planned total duration of the maintenance work in hours, used for scheduling and resource allocation. Includes all craft labor time across all operations.

attributes.name: estimated_labor_cost
attributes.description: Planned total cost of internal labor based on estimated hours and standard labor rates by craft. Used for maintenance budget planning.

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours
attributes.description: Planned total labor hours across all crafts and operations for this work order. Used for workforce planning and cost estimation.

attributes.name: estimated_material_cost
attributes.description: Planned total cost of spare parts, materials, and consumables required for this work order. Used for budget planning and work order approval.

attributes.name: external_service_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of external contractor services, third-party vendors, or specialized service providers engaged for this work order. Includes service labor, equipment rental, and contractor-supplied materials.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Description of the equipment failure mode or degradation mechanism that necessitated this corrective maintenance work. Used for reliability analysis and Root Cause Investigation (RCI).

attributes.name: lockout_tagout_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether lockout/tagout procedures are required for this work order to control hazardous energy sources. True for work on equipment with electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, or chemical energy hazards.

attributes.name: long_text
attributes.description: Detailed instructions, technical notes, safety precautions, and procedural guidance for executing the maintenance work. May include references to Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID), or special tools required.

attributes.name: moc_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Management of Change (MOC) authorization if this work order involves modifications to process equipment, instrumentation, or control systems that require formal change management per PSM requirements.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this work order record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this work order record was last modified in the maintenance management system.

attributes.name: notification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating maintenance notification or trouble report that triggered creation of this work order. Links work order to the initial problem report or service request.

attributes.name: permit_to_work_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the safety permit authorizing this maintenance work, required for work in hazardous areas, confined spaces, hot work, or energized equipment per Process Safety Management (PSM) requirements.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the work order indicating urgency and impact on production operations. Critical priority indicates immediate safety or production impact requiring emergency response.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the equipment failure or maintenance need, determined through Root Cause Investigation (RCI). Used to drive Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) programs.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date when maintenance work is scheduled to be completed. Used for outage planning and production restart coordination.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date when maintenance work is scheduled to begin. Used for capacity planning and coordination with production schedules.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Total actual cost of the work order including internal labor, materials, and external services. Used for maintenance cost reporting and asset lifecycle cost analysis.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the maintenance work center (craft shop or service group) that will execute the work. Work centers represent organizational units such as mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, or contractor crews.

attributes.name: work_order_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the maintenance work to be performed, summarizing the scope and nature of the activity for quick identification and communication.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the work order, typically system-generated and used for tracking and communication across maintenance teams and external service providers.

attributes.name: work_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work order tracking progression from creation through execution to closure. Released status indicates work is approved and ready for execution; completed indicates work is finished but administrative closure pending. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|released|in_progress|on_hold|completed|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: work_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance work order indicating the nature of the maintenance activity: planned maintenance, corrective repair, preventive maintenance schedule, predictive maintenance based on condition monitoring, emergency breakdown response, or capital project work.

products.name: work_order_operation
products.description: Individual operation (task step) within a maintenance work order, representing discrete work activities assigned to specific work centers and crafts. Captures operation number, description, work center, control key, planned and actual labor hours, setup time, execution factor, and confirmation status. Aligns with SAP PM Order Operation (AFVC) and supports detailed labor planning and execution tracking.

attributes.name: work_order_operation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work order operation. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each operation may be billed to a specific cost center; required for detailed operation‑level cost tracking and internal charge‑back.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment, asset, or technical object on which the operation is performed (e.g., pump, reactor, vessel, instrument).

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location (process unit, area, or system) where the operation is performed. Provides hierarchical location context.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rawmaterial.material_master. Business justification: Operation‑level details need the specific material used for accurate labor/material costing and SDS compliance.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: FK to maintenance.plant

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Associates each operation’s consumed spare parts with the purchase order that supplied them, enabling traceability, inventory reconciliation, and audit of maintenance costs.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external vendor or service provider performing the operation, applicable only when external_operation_flag is true.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (maintenance crew, shop, or organizational unit) responsible for executing this operation.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent maintenance work order that contains this operation. Links to the work_order product.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance activity being performed (e.g., mechanical repair, electrical work, instrumentation calibration, inspection). Used for cost allocation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: actual_finish_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when work on the operation was completed, as recorded in the final time confirmation.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when work on the operation actually began, as recorded in the first time confirmation.

attributes.name: actual_work_duration
attributes.description: Actual labor hours spent on the operation as recorded through time confirmations. Used for performance analysis and variance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_work_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for actual work duration. H=hours, MIN=minutes, D=days.

attributes.name: calculation_key
attributes.description: Key that determines how operation duration is calculated based on work quantity and standard values. Used for automatic time calculation in preventive maintenance.

attributes.name: confirmation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether time confirmation is required for this operation. True if the operation must be confirmed with actual hours and completion status.

attributes.name: control_key
attributes.description: Control key that determines the operation type and scheduling parameters (e.g., PM01 for internal processing, PM02 for external service, PM03 for inspection). Defines whether the operation requires confirmation, external processing, or automatic goods issue.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: earliest_finish_date
attributes.description: Earliest date the operation can be completed based on earliest start date and planned duration.

attributes.name: earliest_start_date
attributes.description: Earliest date the operation can begin based on scheduling constraints, predecessor operations, and resource availability.

attributes.name: external_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this operation is performed by an external service provider rather than internal maintenance staff. True for subcontracted work.

attributes.name: final_confirmation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the operation has received its final confirmation and no further time bookings are expected. True when operation is complete.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operation record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: latest_finish_date
attributes.description: Latest date the operation must be completed to meet the work order required end date.

attributes.name: latest_start_date
attributes.description: Latest date the operation must start to meet the work order required end date without delaying subsequent operations.

attributes.name: number_of_capacities
attributes.description: Number of people or capacity units required to perform the operation simultaneously. Used for resource leveling and scheduling.

attributes.name: operation_long_text
attributes.description: Detailed description of the operation including step-by-step instructions, safety precautions, and technical specifications required to complete the task.

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Sequential operation number within the work order, typically a 4-digit numeric code (e.g., 0010, 0020, 0030) that defines the execution sequence.

attributes.name: operation_short_text
attributes.description: Brief description of the operation task, summarizing the work to be performed (e.g., 'Replace pump seal', 'Calibrate pressure transmitter').

attributes.name: planned_work_duration
attributes.description: Planned labor hours required to complete the operation, excluding setup time. Used for capacity planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: planned_work_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for planned work duration. H=hours, MIN=minutes, D=days.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Urgency level for the operation. 1=Very High (immediate), 2=High (same day), 3=Medium (this week), 4=Low (this month), 5=Very Low (planned). Inherited from work order but can be overridden at operation level.

attributes.name: setup_time
attributes.description: Time required to prepare tools, equipment, and work area before the actual maintenance work can begin. Measured in the same unit as work duration.

attributes.name: standard_text_key
attributes.description: Reference to standard text templates containing predefined operation instructions, safety procedures, or technical specifications that apply to this operation.

attributes.name: system_status
attributes.description: Current system-controlled status of the operation in its lifecycle. System status is automatically set by SAP PM based on business transactions and controls which actions are allowed.

attributes.name: teardown_time
attributes.description: Time required to clean up, restore the work area, and return tools after operation completion. Measured in the same unit as work duration.

attributes.name: user_status
attributes.description: User-defined status that provides additional business-specific status information beyond system status. Configurable per business requirements.

attributes.name: work_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of work to be performed, expressed in operation-specific units (e.g., number of valves to inspect, meters of pipe to replace, number of calibrations).

attributes.name: work_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for work quantity (e.g., EA=each, M=meter, KG=kilogram). ISO unit codes.

products.name: notification
products.description: Maintenance notification record capturing all unplanned maintenance demand including equipment defects, malfunctions, breakdowns, activity requests, and condition-based alerts raised by operators, inspectors, or automated monitoring systems. Tracks notification type (M1 malfunction/breakdown, M2 activity request, M3 inspection finding), breakdown indicator with start/end timestamps and duration, reported damage/cause/activity codes (via catalog_code reference), failure mode classification, production impact and loss quantity, safety implications, time to restore, and notification-to-work-order linkage. Serves as the SSOT for all failure events including full breakdowns — consolidating failure recording into a single entry point. Supports MTBF/MTTR calculation, reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) analysis, RCI/RCA investigations, CAPA workflows, PSM incident reporting, and Pareto analysis of failure modes.

attributes.name: notification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for notification

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Customer‑impact notifications must be tied to the responsible account for SLA tracking and regulatory incident reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Notifications trigger maintenance actions that generate costs; linking to cost center ensures proper cost capture in the notification‑to‑work‑order flow.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator, inspector, or technician who created the notification. Supports accountability and follow-up communication.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment, reactor, vessel, pump, or instrumentation asset that is the subject of this notification.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location (plant area, process unit, or system) where the equipment or asset is installed.

attributes.name: notification_activity_code_maintenance_catalog_catalog_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catalog code describing the corrective activity or repair action required (e.g., replace seal, recalibrate instrument, clean filter).

attributes.name: notification_catalog_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catalog code describing the type of damage or defect observed (e.g., corrosion, wear, leakage, electrical failure). Supports Pareto analysis of failure modes.

attributes.name: notification_cause_code_maintenance_catalog_catalog_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catalog code identifying the root cause of the failure (e.g., material fatigue, operator error, design flaw, inadequate maintenance). Critical for Root Cause Investigation (RCI) and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflows.

attributes.name: planner_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.planner_group. Business justification: Notification is planned by a planner group; replace string with FK.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.plant. Business justification: Notification is tied to a plant; replace plant code with FK.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order created to address this notification. Establishes the notification-to-work-order linkage for tracking resolution.

attributes.name: breakdown_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the breakdown or malfunction in hours, calculated from breakdown start to end timestamps. Key metric for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and reliability reporting.

attributes.name: breakdown_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the equipment was restored to operational status. Used to calculate Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) and total downtime.

attributes.name: breakdown_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this notification represents a complete equipment breakdown (true) or a partial malfunction/defect (false). Critical for MTBF and reliability analysis.

attributes.name: breakdown_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the equipment breakdown or malfunction began. Used to calculate downtime duration and Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF).

attributes.name: capa_number
attributes.description: Cross-reference to the CAPA workflow document if a formal corrective action plan was created.

attributes.name: capa_required_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the notification requires a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflow to prevent recurrence.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the notification was closed and the issue was resolved. Used for cycle time analysis and notification aging reports.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the notification was completed. Supports time-to-resolve KPI calculation.

attributes.name: ehs_incident_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Incident Number
attributes.description: Cross-reference to an EHS incident report if the notification is related to a safety event, environmental release, or occupational health issue.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of how the equipment failed or the nature of the defect. Supports Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis and failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA).

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the defect, malfunction, or activity request, including symptoms, observations, and any immediate actions taken by the reporter.

attributes.name: malfunction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the defect or malfunction was first observed, which may differ from the reported date if discovered retrospectively.

attributes.name: malfunction_start_time
attributes.description: Time of day when the malfunction started, in HH:MM format. Used in conjunction with malfunction_start_date for precise event timing.

attributes.name: moc_number
attributes.description: Cross-reference to the MOC workflow document if a formal change review was triggered by this notification.

attributes.name: moc_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the corrective action requires a formal Management of Change (MOC) review due to process equipment modification or operating parameter change. Critical for PSM compliance.

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the maintenance notification, typically a 10-12 digit system-generated number used for tracking and communication.

attributes.name: notification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the notification: outstanding (newly created), in_progress (under investigation or work order created), completed (resolved), cancelled (no action required).

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the notification: M1 (Malfunction/Breakdown), M2 (Activity Request), M3 (Inspection Finding), M4 (Other). Determines workflow and priority handling.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level indicating urgency and impact: critical (immediate safety or production risk), high (significant impact), medium (moderate impact), low (minor issue).

attributes.name: production_impact_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the malfunction or breakdown caused a production stoppage or throughput reduction (true) or had no production impact (false).

attributes.name: production_loss_quantity
attributes.description: Estimated quantity of product not produced due to the equipment breakdown, measured in the primary unit of measure for the affected production line (e.g., metric tons, liters, kilograms).

attributes.name: production_loss_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the production loss quantity: MT (metric tons), KG (kilograms), L (liters), GAL (gallons), LB (pounds).

attributes.name: rci_number
attributes.description: Cross-reference to the RCI or RCA investigation document if a formal root cause analysis was initiated.

attributes.name: rci_required_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the failure severity or recurrence pattern requires a formal Root Cause Investigation (RCI) or Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date when the notification was created in the system. Used for response time analysis and notification aging reports.

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the notification was created. Supports time-to-respond KPI calculation and audit trail.

attributes.name: required_end_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the issue must be resolved to avoid production impact or regulatory non-compliance.

attributes.name: required_start_date
attributes.description: Target date by which corrective action or work order execution should begin, based on priority and production schedule impact.

attributes.name: safety_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the notification involves a safety hazard, near-miss, or condition that could lead to injury or environmental release. Triggers Process Safety Management (PSM) review.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief summary of the notification issue, typically 40-80 characters, used for list views and quick identification.

attributes.name: work_order_created_date
attributes.description: Date when the work order was created in response to this notification. Used to calculate notification-to-work-order response time.
attributes.references: SAP PM Work Order Creation Date

products.name: pm_plan
products.description: Preventive maintenance plan master record defining the scheduling strategy, cycle packages, and parameters for time-based, counter-based, or condition-based PM activities on equipment or functional locations. Captures plan type (single cycle, strategy, multiple counter), strategy cycles and packages (e.g., 3M/6M/12M/5Y), scheduling indicator, call horizon, tolerance window, task list references for work content definition, cycle set definitions, and seasonal scheduling adjustments. Governs automated generation of schedule calls and resulting work orders. References task_list for standardized work procedures. Supports PSM mechanical integrity inspection programs, API/ASME code-required inspection intervals (API 510, 570, 653), RBI risk-based inspection optimization, and insurance carrier PM requirements.

attributes.name: pm_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for pm_plan

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Preventive maintenance plans are often part of a service contract with a specific customer account; needed for contract compliance dashboards.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center that bears the financial burden of maintenance activities generated by this plan. Used for maintenance cost allocation and budgeting.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment master record (reactor, vessel, pump, compressor, heat exchanger, instrumentation) covered by this PM plan.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location (plant area, process unit, production line) where the PM plan applies. Alternative to equipment_id for location-based maintenance.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance strategy defining cycle packages and intervals (e.g., 3-month inspection, 6-month service, 12-month overhaul, 5-year major turnaround). Used for strategy_plan type.

attributes.name: planner_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance planner group responsible for scheduling, coordinating, and managing the PM plan execution.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or facility where the PM plan is executed. Supports multi-site maintenance management.

attributes.name: rbi_assessment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RBI assessment that optimized the inspection interval for this PM plan based on probability of failure and consequence of failure analysis. Supports API 580/581 RBI methodology.

attributes.name: strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.pricing_strategy. Business justification: Preventive maintenance plans are aligned with pricing strategies to ensure maintenance cost recovery is reflected in product pricing.

attributes.name: task_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the task list (general maintenance task list, equipment task list, functional location task list) defining the standardized work procedures, operations, materials, and labor for this PM plan.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work center (mechanical shop, electrical shop, instrumentation shop, contractor crew) responsible for executing the PM activities.

attributes.name: auto_generate_work_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system automatically generates work orders when maintenance calls are created, or whether manual planner review and approval is required before work order creation.

attributes.name: call_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days in advance that the system generates maintenance call objects (schedule lines) before the planned date. Enables proactive work order creation and resource planning.

attributes.name: counter_reading_at_last_maintenance
attributes.description: Performance counter value (operating hours, production cycles, runtime hours) recorded at the time of last maintenance completion. Used for counter-based scheduling.

attributes.name: counter_threshold_for_next_maintenance
attributes.description: Performance counter value that triggers the next maintenance call for counter-based plans (e.g., next PM at 10,000 operating hours).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the PM plan master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_length
attributes.description: Numeric value defining the interval between maintenance activities in the specified cycle_unit (e.g., 90 days, 500 operating hours, 1000 production cycles).

attributes.name: cycle_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the maintenance cycle interval: day, week, month, year (time-based), operating_hour, runtime_hour (performance-based), production_cycle, batch_count (counter-based). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: day|week|month|year|operating_hour|production_cycle|batch_count|runtime_hour — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Effective end date when the PM plan expires and stops generating maintenance calls. Nullable for indefinite plans. Used for equipment decommissioning or plan retirement.

attributes.name: inspection_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory inspection requirement driving this PM plan (API 510 pressure vessel inspection, API 570 piping inspection, API 653 tank inspection, ASME boiler inspection, PSM mechanical integrity inspection). Links to compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: API 510, API 570, API 653, ASME, OSHA PSM

attributes.name: insurance_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PM plan is mandated by insurance carrier requirements for boilers, pressure vessels, or other insured equipment. Compliance affects insurance coverage.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the last preventive maintenance activity was completed under this plan. Used to calculate the next scheduled maintenance date based on cycle length.

attributes.name: moc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether changes to this PM plan require formal MOC approval per PSM regulations. True for safety-critical equipment and process safety-related maintenance.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID of the maintenance planner or engineer who last modified the PM plan master record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the PM plan master record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calculated date for the next preventive maintenance activity based on cycle length, last maintenance date, and scheduling parameters. Drives work order generation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes capturing planner comments, historical context, lessons learned, or special considerations for plan execution. Supports knowledge retention.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the PM plan, externally visible and used in work order generation and scheduling communications.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PM plan: active (generating calls), inactive (not generating calls), suspended (temporarily paused), completed (end date reached), cancelled (permanently terminated).

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the PM plan structure: single_cycle (one maintenance cycle), strategy_plan (multiple cycles with different intervals), multiple_counter (based on operating hours or production volume), time_based (calendar-driven), performance_based (triggered by performance degradation), condition_based (triggered by sensor readings or inspection results).

attributes.name: pm_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the PM plan purpose, scope, and maintenance objectives. Includes equipment context, maintenance rationale, and special instructions.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level for maintenance activities generated by this plan. Critical for safety-critical equipment (PSM), high for production-critical assets, medium for supporting equipment, low for non-critical assets.

attributes.name: scheduling_indicator
attributes.description: Defines how the PM plan generates maintenance calls: time_based (calendar intervals), performance_based (operating hours, cycles, production volume), condition_based (sensor thresholds, inspection findings), fixed_date (specific calendar dates), annual (yearly recurrence), seasonal (tied to production seasons or weather).

attributes.name: scheduling_tolerance_after_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the planned date that maintenance can be performed without resetting the cycle counter. Provides flexibility for delayed execution.

attributes.name: scheduling_tolerance_before_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the planned date that maintenance can be performed without resetting the cycle counter. Provides flexibility for early execution.

attributes.name: seasonal_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PM plan schedule is adjusted for seasonal production patterns (e.g., agricultural chemical production peaks, winter shutdown periods, summer turnaround windows).

attributes.name: seasonal_adjustment_months
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of month numbers (1-12) when seasonal adjustments apply to the PM schedule. Used in conjunction with seasonal_adjustment_flag.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date when the PM plan becomes active and begins generating maintenance calls. Aligns with equipment commissioning or plan activation.

attributes.name: created_by
