products.name: schedule_call
products.description: Individual scheduled maintenance call item generated from a preventive maintenance plan, representing a specific due date and call object for a PM activity. attributes.name: schedule_call_id
attributes.description: Primary key for schedule_call

attributes.name: equipment_id

attributes.name: planner_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.planner_group. Business justification: Schedule call is assigned to a planner group; replace string with FK.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.plant. Business justification: Schedule call occurs at a plant; replace plant code string with FK.

attributes.name: pm_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent preventive maintenance plan that generated this schedule call item.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (maintenance crew, technician group) assigned to execute this maintenance call.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order that was generated from this schedule call item to execute the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the maintenance work was completed. Null if not yet completed.

attributes.name: call_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule call item was automatically generated by the maintenance planning system.

attributes.name: call_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days in advance that this call was generated before the scheduled date, based on the maintenance plan call horizon configuration.

attributes.name: call_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the scheduled maintenance call, typically a sequential number within the maintenance plan.

attributes.name: call_object_type

attributes.name: call_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scheduled maintenance call item.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if this scheduled maintenance call was cancelled (equipment decommissioned, plan revised, consolidated with other work, etc.).

attributes.name: compliance_requirement
attributes.description: Regulatory or internal compliance requirement that mandates this maintenance activity (PSM, EPA, OSHA, ISO certification, etc.).

attributes.name: counter_reading_at_call
attributes.description: The equipment counter reading (operating hours, cycles, production volume) at the time this maintenance call was generated, for performance-based maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: counter_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the counter reading (hours, cycles, kilometers, batches, etc.).

attributes.name: cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential cycle number within the maintenance plan, indicating which iteration of the recurring maintenance this call represents.

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of days this maintenance call is overdue beyond the tolerance window. Null or zero if not overdue.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated time in hours required to complete the scheduled maintenance activity.

attributes.name: is_overdue
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this scheduled maintenance call is past its due date and tolerance window.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule call record was last updated (status change, date adjustment, work order assignment, etc.).

attributes.name: maintenance_activity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance activity to be performed (inspection, lubrication, calibration, overhaul, cleaning, etc.).
attributes.references: SAP PM Maintenance Activity Type Catalog

attributes.name: moc_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated MOC workflow if this maintenance involves process equipment changes.

attributes.name: moc_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a Management of Change workflow is required for this maintenance activity due to process equipment modifications.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this scheduled maintenance call, including special instructions, coordination requirements, or planning remarks.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: The planned date by which the maintenance work should be completed.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The planned start date for executing the maintenance work, may differ from scheduled date due to planning adjustments.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this scheduled maintenance call, indicating urgency and business criticality.

attributes.name: psm_critical_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this maintenance call is for PSM-critical equipment requiring mechanical integrity compliance per OSHA PSM regulations.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date when this preventive maintenance call is scheduled to be performed, calculated from the maintenance plan cycle.

attributes.name: shutdown_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether equipment or process shutdown is required to perform this maintenance activity.

attributes.name: tolerance_days_early
attributes.description: Number of days before the scheduled date that the maintenance can be performed and still be considered on-time.

attributes.name: tolerance_days_late
attributes.description: Number of days after the scheduled date that the maintenance can be performed before being considered overdue.

products.name: measurement_point
products.description: Measurement point master record defining a specific location on equipment where counter readings or measurement values are recorded (e.g., vibration, temperature, pressure, operating hours). Captures measurement point category, characteristic, unit of measure, target value, upper/lower limits, and counter overflow value. Aligns with SAP PM Measurement Point (MPLA/IMRG) and supports condition-based maintenance and OEE tracking.

attributes.name: measurement_point_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the measurement point record. Primary key.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment or functional location on which this measurement point is defined. Links to the equipment master record.

attributes.name: market_price_index_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.market_price_index. Business justification: Raw‑material measurement points are tied to market price indices for dynamic cost adjustments in pricing calculations.

attributes.name: planner_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.planner_group. Business justification: Measurement point is managed by a planner group; replace string with FK.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work center responsible for monitoring and maintaining this measurement point. Links to work center master data.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the measurement point was activated and monitoring began. Used for historical analysis and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: calibration_frequency_days
attributes.description: Planned interval in days between calibration activities for this measurement point. Supports compliance with ISO 9001 and GMP requirements.

attributes.name: calibration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measurement point requires periodic calibration to maintain accuracy and compliance with quality and safety standards.

attributes.name: characteristic_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical characteristic being measured (e.g., vibration, temperature, pressure, flow rate, pH, operating hours). Aligns with plant instrumentation standards.

attributes.name: characteristic_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the characteristic being measured at this point.

attributes.name: counter_overflow_value
attributes.description: Maximum value at which a counter-type measurement point resets to zero. Used for cumulative counters such as operating hours or cycle counts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the measurement point record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: criticality_code
attributes.description: Classification of the measurement points importance to safety, environmental compliance, product quality, or equipment reliability. Drives prioritization of monitoring and maintenance activities.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: System or method by which measurement readings are captured: manual entry, Distributed Control System (DCS), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), or process historian.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the measurement point was deactivated or decommissioned. Null for active measurement points.

attributes.name: decimal_places
attributes.description: Number of decimal places to which measurement values should be recorded and displayed, ensuring precision consistency.

attributes.name: historian_tag
attributes.description: Tag identifier in the process historian system (e.g., Aveva PI System) that stores time-series data for this measurement point. Enables integration with real-time process data.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the measurement point or associated instrument was last calibrated. Used to track calibration compliance and schedule next calibration.

attributes.name: last_reading_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent measurement reading was recorded for this point. Used to track compliance with reading schedules.

attributes.name: last_reading_value
attributes.description: The most recent measurement value recorded at this point. Provides current state for condition monitoring and trend analysis.

attributes.name: lower_alarm_limit
attributes.description: Lower critical threshold that triggers an alarm and may require immediate maintenance action or equipment shutdown per Process Safety Management (PSM) requirements.

attributes.name: lower_warning_limit
attributes.description: Lower threshold value that triggers a warning alert when measurement falls below this level. Part of condition-based maintenance strategy.

attributes.name: measurement_point_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the measurement point. Active points are monitored per schedule; inactive or decommissioned points are no longer in use.

attributes.name: measurement_position
attributes.description: Specific physical location or position on the equipment where the measurement is taken (e.g., bearing housing north side, inlet flange, discharge line). References Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID) tag.

attributes.name: moc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether changes to this measurement point (limits, frequency, sensor type) require formal Management of Change (MOC) approval per PSM requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the measurement point record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next calibration activity based on calibration frequency. Critical for maintaining measurement accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: next_reading_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next measurement reading based on the reading frequency. Used for work order generation and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: oee_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measurement point contributes to Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculations, such as operating hours, cycle counts, or production rates.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the manufacturing plant or facility where the measurement point is located. Supports multi-site maintenance management.

attributes.name: point_category
attributes.description: Classification of the measurement point type: counter (cumulative readings such as operating hours) or measurement (instantaneous readings such as temperature or pressure).

attributes.name: point_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the measurement point, including its physical location on the equipment and what is being measured.

attributes.name: point_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the measurement point, typically alphanumeric code used in operations and maintenance documentation.

attributes.name: psm_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measurement point is critical to Process Safety Management (PSM) mechanical integrity requirements and must be monitored per OSHA PSM regulations.

attributes.name: reading_frequency_days
attributes.description: Planned interval in days between successive readings of this measurement point. Supports preventive and condition-based maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: sensor_type
attributes.description: Type of sensor or instrument used to capture the measurement (e.g., thermocouple, pressure transmitter, vibration sensor, flow meter, pH probe).

attributes.name: tag_number
attributes.description: Unique tag identifier from the Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID) for the instrument or sensor associated with this measurement point. Aligns with ISA standards.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The ideal or expected value for this measurement point under normal operating conditions. Used for variance analysis and condition monitoring.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the measurement is recorded (e.g., degC, bar, ppm, hours, rpm, m3/h). Must align with ISO and industry standards.

attributes.name: upper_alarm_limit
attributes.description: Upper critical threshold that triggers an alarm and may require immediate maintenance action or equipment shutdown per Process Safety Management (PSM) requirements.

attributes.name: upper_warning_limit
attributes.description: Upper threshold value that triggers a warning alert when measurement exceeds this level. Part of condition-based maintenance strategy.

products.name: measurement_reading
products.description: Individual measurement document recording an actual counter or measurement value captured at a measurement point on equipment. Tracks reading date and time, measured value, unit, reading type (actual, estimated), reader identification, and deviation from target. Aligns with SAP PM Measurement Document (IMRG) and supports condition monitoring, predictive maintenance triggers, and Aveva PI System integration.

attributes.name: measurement_reading_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the measurement reading record. Primary key for the measurement reading entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the person or system that captured the measurement reading. For manual readings, this is the employee ID; for automatic readings, this is the sensor or SCADA system identifier.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment asset on which the measurement was taken. Links to equipment master data for reactors, vessels, pumps, instrumentation, and other process equipment.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location in the plant hierarchy where the measurement was taken. Supports spatial organization of measurement data.

attributes.name: measurement_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the measurement point on the equipment where this reading was captured. Links to the measurement point master data defining the characteristic being measured.

attributes.name: notification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance notification that was automatically generated when this reading violated threshold limits. Supports condition-based maintenance triggering.

attributes.name: pm_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preventive maintenance plan that scheduled this measurement reading. Links measurement data to planned maintenance strategies.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order that triggered or resulted from this measurement reading. Links measurement data to maintenance execution.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the reader or reviewer regarding the measurement reading. Used to document unusual conditions, context, or corrective actions taken.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the person who approved or validated this measurement reading. Used for quality assurance and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SAP PM, GMP Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this measurement reading was approved or validated. Supports audit trail and regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP PM, GMP Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: The date when the measurement instrument or sensor is next due for calibration. Used to assess the reliability of the reading and trigger calibration work orders.

attributes.name: counter_overflow_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that is true when a counter reading has rolled over or reset. Used to maintain accurate cumulative totals across counter resets.

attributes.name: counter_reading_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that is true when this reading represents a cumulative counter value (such as operating hours, cycle count, production volume) rather than an instantaneous measurement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this measurement reading record was first created in the system. Represents the system capture time, which may differ from the actual reading timestamp.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The system or method from which the measurement reading originated. Identifies whether the reading came from SCADA, DCS, Aveva PI System, LIMS, manual field entry, mobile application, or sensor network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SCADA|DCS|PI_System|LIMS|Manual_Entry|Mobile_App|Sensor_Network — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Aveva PI System, Honeywell Experion DCS, Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7

attributes.name: deviation_from_target
attributes.description: The calculated difference between the measured value and the target value. Positive values indicate readings above target, negative values indicate readings below target. Used for trend analysis and condition monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP PM, SPC Statistical Process Control

attributes.name: deviation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage deviation of the measured value from the target value. Calculated as (measured_value - target_value) / target_value * 100. Enables normalized comparison across different measurement points.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: The date when the measurement instrument or sensor was last calibrated. Provides context for reading accuracy and quality assurance.

attributes.name: lower_alarm_limit
attributes.description: The lower critical threshold value that triggers an alarm when the measured value falls below this limit. Indicates a serious condition requiring immediate attention.
attributes.references: SAP PM Measurement Point, PSM Process Safety Management

attributes.name: lower_warning_limit
attributes.description: The lower threshold value that triggers a warning alert when the measured value falls below this limit. Part of condition monitoring and predictive maintenance logic.
attributes.references: SAP PM Measurement Point, PSM Process Safety Management

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual numeric value captured by the measurement reading. Represents the observed quantity such as temperature, pressure, flow rate, vibration, pH, or counter reading.
attributes.references: SAP PM Measurement Document, Aveva PI System

attributes.name: measurement_characteristic
attributes.description: The physical or operational characteristic being measured. Examples include temperature, pressure, vibration, flow rate, pH, conductivity, viscosity, level, speed, power consumption.

attributes.name: measurement_document_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the measurement document. Used for traceability and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: measurement_position
attributes.description: The specific position or location on the equipment where the measurement was taken. Examples include inlet, outlet, bearing housing, motor winding, seal area, valve stem.
attributes.references: SAP PM Measurement Point, P&ID Piping and Instrumentation Diagram

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this measurement reading record was last modified. Used for audit trail and data quality tracking.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The Aveva PI System tag name associated with this measurement reading. Enables integration and traceability between the maintenance system and the real-time process historian.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or facility where the measurement reading was captured. Supports multi-site maintenance operations and reporting.

attributes.name: quality_code
attributes.description: Data quality indicator for the measurement reading. Good indicates reliable data, bad indicates known error, uncertain indicates possible error, substituted indicates estimated value, questionable indicates requires review.

attributes.name: reading_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the measurement reading was taken. Used for day-level aggregation and reporting.

attributes.name: reading_status
attributes.description: Current validation status of the measurement reading. Indicates whether the reading has been reviewed, approved, or flagged for quality issues.

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the measurement reading was actually captured in the field or by the sensor. Represents the real-world event time of the observation.
attributes.references: SAP PM Measurement Document, Aveva PI System

attributes.name: reading_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the reading was obtained. Actual indicates direct measurement, estimated indicates interpolated or approximated value, calculated indicates derived from other readings, manual indicates human-entered, automatic indicates sensor-captured.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The expected or target value for this measurement point. Used to calculate deviation and trigger alerts when actual readings fall outside acceptable range.

attributes.name: threshold_violation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that is true when the measured value falls outside the defined warning or alarm limits. Used to trigger maintenance notifications and condition-based maintenance workflows.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the measured value is expressed. Examples include PSI (pressure), DEG_C (temperature), GPM (flow), HZ (frequency), PPM (concentration), PH (acidity).

attributes.name: upper_alarm_limit
attributes.description: The upper critical threshold value that triggers an alarm when the measured value exceeds this limit. Indicates a serious condition requiring immediate attention.
attributes.references: SAP PM Measurement Point, PSM Process Safety Management

attributes.name: upper_warning_limit
attributes.description: The upper threshold value that triggers a warning alert when the measured value exceeds this limit. Part of condition monitoring and predictive maintenance logic.
attributes.references: SAP PM Measurement Point, PSM Process Safety Management

products.name: calibration_record
products.description: Calibration record for instrumentation and measurement devices (transmitters, analyzers, gauges, safety valves) documenting as-found and as-left conditions, calibration procedure, tolerance limits, pass/fail status, calibration interval, and next due date. attributes.name: calibration_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the calibration record. Primary key for the calibration record entity.

attributes.name: calibration_procedure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) or work instruction used for this calibration. Links to documented calibration method.

attributes.name: calibration_standard_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reference standard or master instrument used for calibration. Ensures traceability to national or international standards.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Calibration activities incur costs that must be posted to the responsible cost center for compliance and cost recovery.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment or instrument being calibrated (transmitters, analyzers, gauges, safety valves, laboratory instruments).

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location where the calibrated equipment is installed.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.plant. Business justification: Calibration record is linked to a plant for traceability; replace plant code with FK.

attributes.name: primary_calibration_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technician or calibration specialist who performed the calibration. Required for accountability and competency tracking.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality assurance reviewer who verified and approved the calibration record.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to external calibration service provider or laboratory, if calibration was performed by third party.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order under which this calibration was performed, linking calibration to preventive maintenance schedule.

attributes.name: accuracy_specification
attributes.description: Manufacturer or regulatory accuracy requirement for the instrument (e.g., ±0.5%, ±2 degC). Used to determine tolerance limits.

attributes.name: adjustment_performed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the instrument required adjustment or recalibration to bring it within tolerance.

attributes.name: as_found_value
attributes.description: Measured value of the instrument before calibration adjustment. Documents initial condition and drift since last calibration.

attributes.name: as_left_value
attributes.description: Measured value of the instrument after calibration adjustment. Documents final calibrated state.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.1.5 Monitoring and Measuring Resources

attributes.name: calibration_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number issued for this calibration event. External business identifier for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: calibration_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of calibration activity including labor, materials, and external service fees. Supports maintenance budget tracking.

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the calibration was performed. Principal business event timestamp for this calibration record.

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled calibration date based on calibration interval. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: Standard calibration frequency in days (e.g., 365 for annual, 180 for semi-annual). Determines next due date calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.1.5 Monitoring and Measuring Resources

attributes.name: calibration_points_tested
attributes.description: Number of measurement points tested during calibration (e.g., 5-point calibration across instrument range).

attributes.name: calibration_standard_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number of the reference standard used, providing traceability to NIST or equivalent national metrology institute.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the calibration record: scheduled (planned but not started), in-progress (calibration underway), passed (within tolerance), failed (out of tolerance), conditional (marginal pass with restrictions), cancelled (calibration not performed), overdue (past due date). attributes.name: calibration_type
attributes.description: Classification of calibration method: in-house (performed by internal technicians), external (third-party calibration lab), vendor (OEM calibration service), field (on-site calibration), laboratory (off-site lab calibration).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this calibration record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: environmental_humidity

attributes.name: environmental_temperature
attributes.description: Ambient temperature during calibration in degrees Celsius. Environmental condition documentation required for measurement traceability.

attributes.name: gmp_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this calibration is subject to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements for pharmaceutical or food-contact chemical production.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this calibration record was last updated. Audit trail for record lifecycle and change tracking.

attributes.name: measurement_uncertainty

attributes.name: out_of_tolerance_flag

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Calibration result: pass (within tolerance), fail (out of tolerance), conditional (marginal but acceptable with restrictions).

attributes.name: psm_critical_instrument_flag

attributes.name: remarks

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the calibration record was reviewed and approved by quality assurance.

attributes.name: target_value

attributes.name: technician_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification or qualification number of the technician performing calibration, demonstrating competency for this calibration type.

attributes.name: tolerance_lower_limit

attributes.name: tolerance_upper_limit

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Engineering unit for calibration values (e.g., PSI, bar, degC, degF, pH, mA, mV, GPM, kg/h). Applies to as-found, as-left, target, and tolerance values.

attributes.name: vendor_lab_accreditation

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of change being requested: equipment modification, piping alteration, instrumentation upgrade, chemical substitution, procedure revision, or operating condition adjustment.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the MOC was formally closed after all implementation activities, PSSR, training, documentation updates, and post-implementation review were completed.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the MOC request record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_description
attributes.description: Assessment of environmental impacts including emissions changes, waste generation, spill potential, and regulatory compliance implications.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost for implementing the change including materials, labor, engineering, downtime, and contractor expenses.

attributes.name: final_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the final approval was granted and the MOC was authorized for implementation.

attributes.name: implementation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed plan describing how the change will be executed including sequence of activities, resource requirements, safety precautions, and coordination needs.

attributes.name: initiator_department
attributes.description: Department or functional area of the initiating employee, used for routing and accountability.

attributes.name: initiator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who initiated the MOC request for reference and communication purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the MOC request record was last updated, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: moc_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the MOC request, externally visible and used for tracking and reference across systems and documentation.

attributes.name: moc_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MOC request from initiation through closure. Tracks workflow progression through review, approval, implementation, and PSSR completion stages. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|implementation|pssr_pending|closed|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: operational_impact_description
attributes.description: Description of impacts on production operations including downtime requirements, capacity changes, quality effects, and process performance.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date for completing all implementation activities and closing out the MOC.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Target date for beginning implementation of the approved change.

attributes.name: post_implementation_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the post-implementation review was conducted.

attributes.name: post_implementation_review_findings
attributes.description: Summary of findings from the post-implementation review including effectiveness assessment, lessons learned, and any corrective actions required.

attributes.name: post_implementation_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal post-implementation review is required to verify the change achieved its objectives and did not introduce unintended consequences.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the change request based on safety impact, operational urgency, regulatory deadlines, or strategic importance.

attributes.name: psm_covered_process_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Safety Management (PSM) Covered Process Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change affects a process covered under OSHA PSM regulations (29 CFR 1910.119), requiring enhanced review and documentation.

attributes.name: pssr_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the PSSR was completed and the equipment or process was cleared for startup.

attributes.name: pssr_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pre-Startup Safety Review is required before the modified equipment or process can be returned to service, as mandated by OSHA PSM for covered processes.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when the MOC request is rejected, including specific concerns or deficiencies that must be addressed.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_method
attributes.description: Type of risk assessment methodology applied: Process Hazard Analysis, Hazard and Operability Study, What-If Analysis, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis, Layer of Protection Analysis, or not required.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal risk assessment (PHA, HAZOP, or similar) is required for this change based on its scope and potential impact.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119(l)(3) - Safety and Health Considerations

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk level determined from the risk assessment, considering safety, environmental, and operational impacts.

attributes.name: safety_impact_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of potential safety impacts including hazards introduced, hazards eliminated, and mitigation measures required.

attributes.name: sop_update_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Update Completion Date
attributes.description: Date when all required SOP revisions were completed and approved.

attributes.name: sop_update_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Update Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether existing SOPs must be revised to reflect the implemented change.

attributes.name: training_completion_status
attributes.description: Current status of required employee training activities associated with the MOC implementation.

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employee training is required as a result of the change to procedures, equipment operation, or safety protocols.

products.name: breakdown_event
products.description: Unplanned equipment breakdown or failure event record capturing the onset of failure, failure mode, failure cause, affected production unit, production loss quantity, safety implications, and time to restore. Tracks breakdown start and end timestamps, breakdown duration, malfunction start indicator, and linkage to corrective work order and PM notification. Supports MTBF/MTTR calculation, RCI investigations, and PSM incident reporting.

attributes.name: breakdown_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the breakdown event record. Primary key for the breakdown event entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Breakdown events incur repair and downtime costs; assigning a cost center is required for loss analysis and financial impact reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or operator who first reported the breakdown event to the maintenance system.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment asset that experienced the breakdown failure.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location where the breakdown occurred within the plant hierarchy.

attributes.name: planner_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.planner_group. Business justification: Breakdown event is managed by a planner group; replace string with FK.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.plant. Business justification: Breakdown event occurs at a plant; replace plant code with FK.

attributes.name: pm_notification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PM notification that reported this breakdown event. Links to the maintenance notification system.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrective work order created to address this breakdown event.

attributes.name: affected_production_unit
attributes.description: Identifier of the production unit, process line, or manufacturing cell that was impacted by the equipment breakdown.

attributes.name: breakdown_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in hours from breakdown start to restoration. Used for Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) calculation and downtime analysis.

attributes.name: breakdown_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the equipment was restored to operational status following the breakdown event.

attributes.name: breakdown_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the breakdown event, typically auto-generated or manually assigned for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: breakdown_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the equipment breakdown or failure was first detected or occurred. Critical for MTBF and MTTR calculations.

attributes.name: breakdown_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the breakdown event indicating progression from detection through resolution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the breakdown event record was first created in the maintenance management system.

attributes.name: damage_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the type of damage observed on the equipment, such as crack, deformation, erosion, or contamination.
attributes.references: SAP PM - Damage and Cause Code Catalog

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the breakdown event was first detected, such as operator observation, automated alarm, scheduled inspection, or predictive analytics.

attributes.name: ehs_incident_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Incident Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated EHS incident report if the breakdown event had safety or environmental implications.
attributes.references: OSHA - Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: environmental_release_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the breakdown event resulted in an unplanned release of chemicals or hazardous materials to the environment.

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost to repair or restore the equipment following the breakdown event, including labor, materials, and contractor costs.

attributes.name: failure_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the breakdown, such as wear, corrosion, operator error, design defect, or inadequate maintenance.

attributes.name: failure_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the root cause analysis findings for the breakdown event. Supports RCI (Root Cause Investigation) documentation.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Description of how the equipment failed, such as mechanical fracture, electrical short, seal leak, bearing seizure, or control system fault. Supports failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the breakdown event record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the breakdown event, including symptoms, observations, and contextual information.

attributes.name: malfunction_start_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this breakdown event marks the initial onset of a malfunction or is a continuation of a previous issue.

attributes.name: moc_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the MOC workflow initiated to implement corrective actions for this breakdown event.

attributes.name: moc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether corrective actions for this breakdown require a formal Management of Change process due to process safety implications.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority classification for the breakdown event response, determining urgency of corrective action and resource allocation.

attributes.name: production_impact_severity
attributes.description: Categorical assessment of the severity of production impact caused by the breakdown, ranging from critical plant shutdown to minimal disruption.

attributes.name: production_loss_quantity
attributes.description: Quantified amount of production output lost due to the breakdown event, measured in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: production_loss_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the production loss quantity, such as kilograms, liters, tons, or batch count.

attributes.name: psm_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the breakdown event involved PSM-covered equipment requiring mechanical integrity documentation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: rci_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal root cause investigation conducted for this breakdown event.

attributes.name: rci_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the breakdown event severity or recurrence pattern requires a formal root cause investigation.

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the breakdown event was formally reported into the maintenance management system.

attributes.name: response_time_hours
attributes.description: Elapsed time in hours from breakdown detection to initiation of corrective action. Key metric for maintenance responsiveness.

attributes.name: restoration_method
attributes.description: Method used to restore equipment to operational status, such as on-site repair, component replacement, temporary fix, or operational workaround.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the breakdown event resulted in or was associated with a safety incident requiring EHS reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA - Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief summary description of the breakdown event for quick identification and reporting purposes.

products.name: inspection_round
products.description: Operator or maintenance inspection round record capturing structured field inspection activities performed on equipment, instruments, safety devices, and process systems at defined intervals. Tracks round type (operator rounds, predictive inspection, statutory/regulatory inspection, PSM mechanical integrity inspection), route definition, inspection date/time, inspector qualification, checklist findings, measured values, deviations noted, severity classification, and follow-up action status with work order generation. Distinct from calibration_record (which covers instrument accuracy verification) and from PM schedule_call (which triggers full maintenance work orders). Supports PSM mechanical integrity programs, OSHA Process Safety compliance, API 510/570/653 inspection documentation, and insurance carrier inspection requirements.
products.reference: OSHA PSM Mechanical Integrity / API RP 580

attributes.name: inspection_round_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inspection round record. Primary key for the inspection round entity.

attributes.name: checklist_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the structured checklist template used during this inspection round. Defines the inspection points, parameters, and acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment, reactor, vessel, pump, or instrument inspected during this round.

attributes.name: follow_up_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary maintenance work order created to address findings from this inspection round. Links inspection findings to corrective maintenance actions.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location where the inspection round was performed. Represents the hierarchical location structure in the plant.

attributes.name: primary_inspection_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or employee who performed the inspection round. Links to workforce/employee master data.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the predefined inspection route or path that defines the sequence of equipment and checkpoints to be inspected during this round.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work center responsible for this inspection round. Identifies the organizational unit performing the inspection.

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection round was completed. Used to calculate inspection duration and verify compliance with scheduled intervals.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspector actually began the inspection round. Captures the real-world start of the inspection activity.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inspection round results require formal approval by a supervisor, engineer, or regulatory authority before being finalized.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection round results were formally approved. Part of the audit trail for compliance documentation.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the inspection round was cancelled if status is cancelled. Captures reasons such as equipment unavailability, safety concerns, or rescheduling.

attributes.name: compliance_due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory or statutory deadline by which this inspection must be completed to maintain compliance. Overdue inspections may result in regulatory violations or insurance coverage issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inspection round record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: deviations_found_count
attributes.description: Number of deviations, anomalies, or out-of-specification conditions identified during the inspection round. Triggers follow-up actions and work orders.

attributes.name: highest_severity_level
attributes.description: The most severe classification level among all deviations found during the inspection round. Critical findings require immediate action; high findings require urgent attention; medium and low findings are tracked for planned maintenance.

attributes.name: inspection_findings_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary text describing the overall findings, observations, and conclusions from the inspection round. Provides executive-level overview of inspection results.

attributes.name: inspection_interval_days
attributes.description: Defined interval in days between successive inspection rounds for this equipment or route. Based on regulatory requirements, manufacturer recommendations, or risk-based inspection methodology.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection round. Tracks progression from scheduled through execution to completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: inspector_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for inspector comments, observations, and contextual information not captured in structured checklist fields. Provides qualitative insights and situational context.

attributes.name: inspector_qualification_code
attributes.description: Code representing the qualification or certification level of the inspector performing the round. Ensures inspections are performed by appropriately trained personnel per OSHA PSM and API requirements.

attributes.name: insurance_carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the insurance carrier for whom this inspection is performed or to whom results must be reported.

attributes.name: insurance_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection round is required by or performed for insurance carrier compliance. Insurance carriers often mandate periodic inspections of pressure vessels, boilers, and critical equipment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inspection round record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: moc_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the MOC workflow initiated as a result of this inspection round findings. Links inspection to change management process.

attributes.name: moc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether findings from this inspection round require a Management of Change (MOC) process before corrective actions can be implemented, per PSM requirements for process equipment modifications.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calculated date for the next inspection round based on the inspection interval and completion date of this round. Used for forward planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or facility where the inspection round was performed.

attributes.name: psm_mechanical_integrity_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Safety Management (PSM) Mechanical Integrity Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection round is part of the PSM mechanical integrity program required by OSHA for process equipment handling highly hazardous chemicals.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific regulatory or statutory requirement that mandates this inspection (e.g., OSHA PSM, API 510, API 570, API 653, insurance carrier requirement, local jurisdiction code).

attributes.name: round_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the inspection round. Externally visible unique number used for tracking and reference in maintenance systems and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: round_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection round activity. Operator rounds are routine operational checks; predictive inspections use condition monitoring; statutory/regulatory inspections meet legal requirements; PSM mechanical integrity inspections support Process Safety Management programs; safety device inspections verify critical safety equipment.

attributes.name: safety_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection round covers safety-critical equipment or systems that are subject to Process Safety Management (PSM) mechanical integrity requirements.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the inspection round is scheduled to be performed. Used for planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: total_checkpoints_completed
attributes.description: Actual number of inspection checkpoints completed during the round. Used to track inspection progress and completeness.

attributes.name: total_checkpoints_planned
attributes.description: Total number of inspection checkpoints or measurement points planned for this round based on the route and checklist definition.

attributes.name: work_order_generated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more maintenance work orders were automatically generated as a result of deviations or findings from this inspection round.

products.name: permit_to_work
products.description: Permit to Work (PTW) record authorizing maintenance and construction activities in hazardous areas of a chemical plant. Captures permit type (hot work, confined space entry, electrical isolation, line breaking, excavation), issuing authority, work description, hazard identification, isolation requirements, PPE requirements, gas test results, validity period, and closure confirmation. Supports OSHA PSM, EHS compliance, and safe work practices.

attributes.name: permit_to_work_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the permit to work record. Primary key for the permit to work entity.

attributes.name: alt5_permit_attendant_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the person assigned as confined space attendant who remains outside the space to monitor entrants and initiate rescue if needed.

attributes.name: alt5_permit_closed_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authorized person who closed the permit after verifying work completion and area safety.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Permit issuance often includes fees and resource allocation; linking to cost center supports permit cost accounting and audit trails.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment or asset on which the permitted work will be performed.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location where the permitted work will be performed. Identifies the specific plant area or process unit.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.plant. Business justification: Permit to work is issued for a specific plant; replace plant code with FK.

attributes.name: primary_permit_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authorized person who issued and approved the permit. Must be a qualified individual with authority to authorize work in hazardous areas.

attributes.name: quaternary_permit_safety_officer_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Environment Health and Safety (EHS) officer who reviewed and approved the permit from a safety compliance perspective.

attributes.name: quinary_permit_fire_watch_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the person assigned as fire watch for hot work operations. Must be trained in fire prevention and emergency response.

attributes.name: tertiary_permit_area_authority_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operations supervisor or area owner who has authority over the work location and must approve work in their area.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work center responsible for executing the permitted work.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order that this permit authorizes. Links permit to the underlying maintenance activity.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation if the permit was cancelled before work completion. Includes reason code and detailed justification.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the permit was formally closed after work completion and area inspection confirmed safe conditions restored.

attributes.name: closure_confirmation
attributes.description: Documentation confirming that all work is complete, all tools and materials removed, all isolations restored, area cleaned, and safe conditions verified before permit closure.

attributes.name: confined_space_entry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work involves entry into a permit-required confined space as defined by OSHA 1910.146. Triggers additional safety requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the permit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: fire_watch_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dedicated fire watch person must be present during hot work operations to monitor for ignition and respond to fire emergencies.

attributes.name: gas_test_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether atmospheric testing for oxygen, flammable gases, and toxic gases is required before and during the work.

attributes.name: gas_test_results
attributes.description: Results of atmospheric testing including oxygen percentage, lower explosive limit (LEL) readings, and toxic gas concentrations. Recorded before work begins and at specified intervals.

attributes.name: hazard_identification
attributes.description: Comprehensive identification of all hazards present in the work area including chemical, physical, biological, and process hazards. Critical for risk assessment and control measures.

attributes.name: isolation_requirements
attributes.description: Specific isolation and lockout/tagout requirements for the work including electrical isolation, mechanical isolation, line blanking, and energy isolation procedures.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the permit was officially issued and approved by the issuing authority.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the permit record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: lel_percent
attributes.description: Measured flammable gas concentration as percentage of lower explosive limit. Must be below threshold (typically <10% LEL) for hot work authorization.

attributes.name: moc_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated Management of Change document if MOC review was required for this work.

attributes.name: moc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work requires a Management of Change review because it involves modifications to process equipment, procedures, or chemicals.

attributes.name: oxygen_level_percent
attributes.description: Measured oxygen concentration in the work area atmosphere expressed as percentage. Must be within safe range (typically 19.5% to 23.5%) for entry.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique permit number assigned to this work authorization. Used for tracking and reference in safety documentation.

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the permit to work. Tracks the permit from initial request through closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|suspended|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the permit based on the nature of hazardous work being authorized. Determines specific safety protocols and approval requirements.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Mandatory personal protective equipment required for the permitted work including respirators, protective clothing, gloves, eye protection, and fall protection.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority level of the permitted work indicating urgency and scheduling precedence.

attributes.name: psm_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work is on PSM-covered equipment or processes that contain highly hazardous chemicals above threshold quantities.

attributes.name: rescue_plan
attributes.description: Documented rescue and emergency response plan for confined space entry or other high-risk work. Includes rescue equipment, procedures, and emergency contacts.

attributes.name: shutdown_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work requires a process unit shutdown or can be performed during normal operations.

attributes.name: special_precautions
attributes.description: Additional safety precautions, restrictions, or conditions specific to this permit beyond standard requirements. May include weather restrictions, simultaneous operations restrictions, or special monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: toxic_gas_ppm
attributes.description: Measured concentration of toxic gases in parts per million. Must be below permissible exposure limits for the specific chemicals present.

attributes.name: valid_from_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the permit becomes effective and work is authorized to begin. Marks the start of the permits validity period.

attributes.name: valid_until_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the permit expires and work must cease. Permits typically have limited duration (e.g., 8 hours, 12 hours, or one shift) and must be renewed if work continues.

attributes.name: work_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the maintenance or construction activity to be performed under this permit. Includes scope, methods, and expected outcomes.

products.name: catalog_code
products.description: Maintenance catalog code master defining the standardized taxonomy of damage codes, cause codes, activity codes, and object part codes used across PM notifications and work orders for structured failure analysis. Each catalog entry is a first-class reference entity with its own identity (catalog type + code group + code), versioned lifecycle, hierarchical grouping structure, and cross-references to industry failure mode standards (ISO 14224, API 689). Supports RCA/RCI investigations, Pareto analysis of failure modes, reliability reporting, and consistent coding across all maintenance transactions. Aligns with SAP PM Catalog Profile (T352/T353/T357).

attributes.name: catalog_code_id
attributes.description: Primary key for catalog_code

attributes.name: api_689_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference to API 689 (Collection and Exchange of Reliability and Maintenance Data for Equipment) standard. Used for alignment with American Petroleum Institute reliability standards.

attributes.name: capa_trigger_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Trigger Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog code automatically triggers a CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) workflow for quality management and continuous improvement. Aligns with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) and ISO 9001 requirements.

attributes.name: catalog_code_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code within the catalog type and code group. This is the actual code value used in PM (Plant Maintenance) notifications and work orders for structured failure analysis. Example: CORR for corrosion, WEAR for wear, FRAC for fracture.

attributes.name: catalog_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the catalog code. Active codes are available for use in maintenance transactions. Deprecated codes are retained for historical reporting but not available for new entries.

attributes.name: catalog_type
attributes.description: The type of catalog this code belongs to: damage codes (what failed), cause codes (why it failed), activity codes (what was done), object part codes (which component), or symptom codes (how failure manifested). Aligns with SAP PM catalog profile structure.

attributes.name: code_group
attributes.description: Hierarchical grouping identifier for the catalog code. Enables multi-level classification and rollup reporting. For example, mechanical failures, electrical failures, instrumentation failures. Corresponds to SAP PM code group.

attributes.name: code_long_text
attributes.description: Detailed description of the catalog code providing full definition, usage guidance, and examples. Used for training and reference documentation.

attributes.name: code_short_text
attributes.description: Brief description of the catalog code, typically 20-40 characters. Used in dropdown lists and compact displays in maintenance transactions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this catalog code entry was created in the system. Used for audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this catalog code is no longer valid for new transactions. Null for codes with no planned end date. Historical transactions retain the code for reporting continuity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this catalog code becomes valid and available for use in maintenance transactions. Supports versioned catalog management.

attributes.name: ehs_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environment Health and Safety (EHS) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failures coded with this catalog entry require EHS (Environment Health and Safety) incident reporting to regulatory authorities (EPA, OSHA, ECHA).

attributes.name: equipment_class
attributes.description: The equipment class or category this catalog code is applicable to (e.g., rotating equipment, static equipment, instrumentation, electrical, piping). Enables filtering of relevant codes by equipment type.

attributes.name: estimated_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Typical equipment downtime duration in hours associated with this failure mode or activity code. Used for production impact planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost
attributes.description: Typical repair cost in base currency associated with this failure mode or activity code. Used for maintenance budgeting and cost analysis.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The depth level in the catalog hierarchy. Level 1 is top-level, level 2 is sub-category, etc. Used for reporting aggregation and navigation.

attributes.name: iso_14224_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference to ISO 14224 (Petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas industries - Collection and exchange of reliability and maintenance data for equipment) failure mode taxonomy. Enables benchmarking against industry standards.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the catalog code text. Supports multi-language catalog maintenance for global operations.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: The most recent date this catalog code was used in a maintenance transaction. Used to identify obsolete codes for catalog cleanup.

attributes.name: moc_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this failure mode or activity code automatically triggers a MOC (Management of Change) workflow for process equipment changes. Required for PSM mechanical integrity compliance.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this catalog code entry. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this catalog code entry was last modified. Used for audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: parent_code_group
attributes.description: Reference to the parent code group in the hierarchical catalog structure. Enables multi-level rollup and drill-down analysis. Null for top-level groups.

products.name: task_list
products.description: Reusable maintenance task list (job plan/procedure template) defining standardized sequences of operations, required materials, tools, safety precautions, and estimated labor for recurring maintenance activities. Serves as the master template from which work order operations are generated, ensuring consistent execution quality across crews and shifts. Captures task list type (equipment-specific, functional-location-specific, general), group/counter structure, operation steps with detailed descriptions, work center assignments, planned hours per operation, required craft qualifications, material/tool requirements with quantities, and safety/lockout-tagout instructions. products.name: equipment_allocation
products.description: Represents the assignment of equipment to a shipment, capturing the load and unload timestamps for each equipment‑shipment pair. Each record links one shipment to one piece of equipment and stores attributes that belong only to the relationship.. Existence Justification: In the chemical plant, equipment such as trailers, containers, and loading devices is assigned to shipments for loading and unloading. A single shipment can involve multiple pieces of equipment, and each piece of equipment can be used on many shipments over time. The plant tracks load and unload timestamps for each equipment‑shipment pair, making the relationship an operational many‑to‑many entity.

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Human resources and workforce management domain for employee master data, organizational structure, staffing, training, and labor management. Includes employee records, job roles, certifications, safety training records (OSHA PSM), GMP personnel qualification, shift schedules, labor hours, competency tracking, and workforce planning. Supports compliance with OSHA training requirements and operator certification.

products.name: employee
products.description: Core master record for ALL workers performing work at Chemical Mfg plant sites — full-time employees, part-time staff, contract/temporary workers, and service provider personnel. Single source of truth for worker identity regardless of employment relationship. Captures personal identity, employment status, hire date, job classification, plant assignment, cost center, employment type discriminator (full-time, part-time, contractor, temporary, service-provider), union membership, badge number, site access authorization level, SAP HR personnel number. For contractors and service providers: contractor company name, contract start/end dates, sponsoring department, safety induction completion status, OSHA training verification date, site-specific PPE requirements, and contractor insurance verification. Provides unified worker identity for all downstream systems including MES operator login, DCS access control, training compliance, safety qualification tracking, and OSHA recordkeeping. All qualification, training, and site access management flows through this single worker identity regardless of payroll relationship.

products.name: competency
products.description: Authoritative reference catalog of ALL competencies, skills, certifications, licenses, and technical capabilities tracked for Chemical Mfg workforce. Includes technical skills (DCS operation, HAZOP facilitation, GC/HPLC analysis, reactor operation), safety competencies (confined space entry, LOTO/LOTOTO procedures, hot work), regulatory qualifications (PSM operator authorization, GMP personnel qualification), and formal certifications/licenses (OSHA 30-Hour, Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Certified Safety Professional (CSP), CDL for hazmat transport, Forklift Operator License, HAZWOPER 40-Hour, API Inspector Certification, Confined Space Rescue). products.name: employee_competency
products.description: Unified transactional record linking employees to ALL assessed competencies, regulatory qualifications, process-specific authorizations, and formal certifications held. This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for answering 'what is this worker qualified to do?' Covers: technical competencies (DCS operation proficiency, HAZOP facilitation, GC/HPLC analysis), safety qualifications (confined space entry authorization, LOTO certification), OSHA PSM operator qualifications for specific covered processes (HF alkylation, chlorine handling, ammonia refrigeration — per 29 CFR 1910.119), GMP personnel qualifications (initial qualification, periodic requalification, hygiene assessment, documentation practice evaluation), and formal certifications/licenses (OSHA 30-Hour card, CIH, CSP, CDL, HAZWOPER 40-Hour, API Inspector, Forklift Operator). Captures: referenced competency from catalog, proficiency level or pass/fail, assessment/qualification date, assessor/qualified-by name, qualification type discriminator (PSM, GMP, certification, license, general skill), regulatory mandate reference, process unit (for PSM), written test score, practical evaluation result, issuing/certifying body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, renewal/refresher due date, renewal status, verification document reference, and current qualification status (active, expired, suspended, revoked). Triggers automated renewal alerts, blocks MES/DCS login for lapsed qualifications, and supports single-query compliance reporting for OSHA PSM audits, GMP inspections, FDA reviews, ISO 9001 assessments, and insurance audits.

domains.description: Demand planning, sales and operations planning (S&OP), material requirements planning (MRP), capacity planning, and production scheduling for chemical manufacturing operations. Manages demand forecasts, supply-demand balancing, and capacity allocation.

products.name: price_list

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `chemical_mfg_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_ar_open_item`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Accounts receivable aging and exposure metrics"
  source: "`chemical_mfg_ecm`.`billing`.`ar_open_item`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "aging_bucket"
      expr: aging_bucket
      comment: "Aging bucket classification"
    - name: "collection_status"
      expr: collection_status
      comment: "Current collection status"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency of the AR amount"
    - name: "credit_memo_flag"
      expr: credit_memo_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating presence of a credit memo"
    - name: "dispute_flag"
      expr: dispute_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating a dispute exists"
    - name: "dunning_level"
      expr: dunning_level
      comment: "Current dunning level"
    - name: "posting_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', posting_date)
      comment: "Posting month for time analysis"
    - name: "due_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', due_date)
      comment: "Due month for aging analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_outstanding_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_outstanding AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of outstanding AR amounts"
    - name: "total_original_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_original AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of original AR amounts"
    - name: "total_credit_memo_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(credit_memo_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of credit memo amounts"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of discount amounts"
    - name: "total_write_off_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of write‑off amounts"
    - name: "open_item_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of AR open item records"
$$
metric_views.description: Accounts receivable aging and exposure metrics

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `chemical_mfg_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_schedule`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Metrics for recurring billing schedules"
  source: "`chemical_mfg_ecm`.`billing`.`billing_schedule`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "billing_frequency"
      expr: billing_frequency
      comment: "Frequency of billing (e.g., monthly, quarterly)"
    - name: "billing_interval"
      expr: billing_interval
      comment: "Interval descriptor for the schedule"
    - name: "billing_schedule_status"
      expr: billing_schedule_status
      comment: "Current status of the schedule"
    - name: "billing_currency"
      expr: billing_currency
      comment: "Currency used for the schedule"
    - name: "is_milestone_based"
      expr: is_milestone_based
      comment: "Flag indicating milestone‑based billing"
    - name: "fixed_amount_flag"
      expr: fixed_amount_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating a fixed amount schedule"
    - name: "start_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', start_date)
      comment: "Schedule start month"
    - name: "end_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', end_date)
      comment: "Schedule end month"
  measures:
    - name: "total_billing_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(billing_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of scheduled billing amounts"
    - name: "average_billing_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(billing_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average billing amount per schedule"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of discounts applied in schedules"
    - name: "schedule_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of billing schedule records"
$$

  dimensions:
